2.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
athoddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi caturasrādikasya ca ..
arkāṃgulamitaṃ kṣetraṃ caturasraṃ prakalpayet..1..
2.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
अथोद्धारं प्रवक्ष्यामि चतुरस्रादिकस्य च ॥
अर्कांगुलमितं क्षेत्रं चतुरस्रं प्रकल्पयेत्॥1॥
2.2.m:
Sūta said:
Now I shall declare the extraction of the square and other shapes: / one should fashion a square area measuring twelve finger-breadths.

2.2.s:
guṇāṃgulaṃ pratidiśaṃ vardhayetsuvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
caturasraṃ samaṃ kuyādiṣṭeraṣṭādaśāṃgulam .. 2 ..
2.2.d:
गुणांगुलं प्रतिदिशं वर्धयेत्सुविचक्षणः ॥
चतुरस्रं समं कुयादिष्टेरष्टादशांगुलम् ॥ 2 ॥
2.2.m: A prudent person should increase it by three finger-breadths in each direction; / he should make an equal square of eighteen finger-breadths according to the bricks.

2.2.s:
dvihaste caiva sūtrāgre tryaṃgulāni samaṃtataḥ ..
caturasrīkṛte paścāddvihastamapi jāyate .. 3 ..
2.2.d:
द्विहस्ते चैव सूत्राग्रे त्र्यंगुलानि समंततः ॥
चतुरस्रीकृते पश्चाद्द्विहस्तमपि जायते ॥ 3 ॥
2.2.m: And on a two-cubit [field], three finger-breadths all around from the tip of the cord; / when made into a square, it then becomes two cubits as well.

2.2.s:
evaṃ poḍaśahastāṃtaṃ vardhayetkramataḥ svayam ..
haste vinirṇayaṃ viprā racayenmaṃḍala sudhīḥ .. 4 ..
2.2.d:
एवं पोडशहस्तांतं वर्धयेत्क्रमतः स्वयम् ॥
हस्ते विनिर्णयं विप्रा रचयेन्मंडल सुधीः ॥ 4 ॥
2.2.m: In this way one should oneself increase it up to sixteen cubits in order. / O brāhmaṇas, having made the determination in cubits, an intelligent person should draw the maṇḍala.

2.2.s:
dvādaśāṃgulakalpābhyāṃ madhuhaste ca maṃḍale ..
dvihaste hastamātraṃ syāddvihastaṃ tu catuṣkare .. 5 ..
2.2.d:
द्वादशांगुलकल्पाभ्यां मधुहस्ते च मंडले ॥
द्विहस्ते हस्तमात्रं स्याद्द्विहस्तं तु चतुष्करे ॥ 5 ॥
2.2.m: With units of twelve finger-breadths in a maṇḍala of one cubit, / there would be just one cubit on a two-cubit [maṇḍala], and two cubits on a four-cubit one.

2.2.s:
padmamānaṃ caturddhā tu vṛttaṃ kuryātsamaṃtataḥ ..
prathame karṇikā kāryyā keśarāṇi dvitīyake .. 6 ..
2.2.d:
पद्ममानं चतुर्द्धा तु वृत्तं कुर्यात्समंततः ॥
प्रथमे कर्णिका कार्य्या केशराणि द्वितीयके ॥ 6 ॥
2.2.m: One should make the circular lotus-dimension all around in four parts: / in the first the pericarp is to be made, and the filaments in the second;

2.2.s:
tṛtīye dalasaṃdhīṃśca dalāgrāṇi caturthake ..
karṇikāṃ pītavarṇena śuddhena paṃkajaṃ likhet ..7..
2.2.d:
तृतीये दलसंधींश्च दलाग्राणि चतुर्थके ॥
कर्णिकां पीतवर्णेन शुद्धेन पंकजं लिखेत् ॥7॥
2.2.m: In the third the petal-joints, and in the fourth the petal-tips. / One should draw the lotus pericarp with a pure yellow colour.

2.2.s:
keśarāstrividhāḥ proktā mūlamadhyāgradeśataḥ ..
mūle śuklāruṇā madhye pītāścāgre pratiṣṭhitāḥ .. 8 ..
2.2.d:
केशरास्त्रिविधाः प्रोक्ता मूलमध्याग्रदेशतः ॥
मूले शुक्लारुणा मध्ये पीताश्चाग्रे प्रतिष्ठिताः ॥ 8 ॥
2.2.m: The filaments are declared to be threefold: from base, middle, and tip: / white at the base, reddish in the middle, and established as yellow at the tip.

2.2.s:
pātrasaṃdhirbhavecchyāmaḥ koṇe raktena raṃjayet ..
devāstrāṇi likhedbāhye puramadhye ca koṇake .. 9 ..
2.2.d:
पात्रसंधिर्भवेच्छ्यामः कोणे रक्तेन रंजयेत् ॥
देवास्त्राणि लिखेद्बाह्ये पुरमध्ये च कोणके ॥ 9 ॥
2.2.m: The joint of the receptacle should be dark; one should colour it red at the corner. / One should draw the divine weapons on the outside, and in the centre and corners of the city,

2.2.s:
aṣṭāṃgulapramāṇaṃ yadyathāvarṇaṃ vināditaḥ ..
śaṃbhurgaurī tathā brahmā rāmakṛṣṇetyanukramāt .. 2.2.1.10 ..
2.2.d:
अष्टांगुलप्रमाणं यद्यथावर्णं विनादितः ॥
शंभुर्गौरी तथा ब्रह्मा रामकृष्णेत्यनुक्रमात् ॥ 2.2.1.10 ॥
2.2.m: Measuring eight finger-breadths, according to their colour, without sound, / in proper sequence: Śambhu, Gaurī, then Brahmā, Rāma, and Kṛṣṇa.

2.2.s:
sīmarekhāṃgulocchrāyaṃ tattadardhena yojayet ..
śivaviṣṇvormahāyāge śaṃbhumārabhya dāpayet .. 11 ..
2.2.d:
सीमरेखांगुलोच्छ्रायं तत्तदर्धेन योजयेत् ॥
शिवविष्ण्वोर्महायागे शंभुमारभ्य दापयेत् ॥ 11 ॥
2.2.m: One should provide boundary-lines of a finger's height, with half of that [width]. / In a great sacrifice of Śiva and Viṣṇu, one should assign [places] beginning with Śambhu.

2.2.s:
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ ca rāmāṃtaṃ kṛṣṇāṃtaṃ ca jalāśaye ..
durgāyāge ca śrīpakṣe brahmādīnparikalpayet .. 12 ..
2.2.d:
प्रतिष्ठायां च रामांतं कृष्णांतं च जलाशये ॥
दुर्गायागे च श्रीपक्षे ब्रह्मादीन्परिकल्पयेत् ॥ 12 ॥
2.2.m: In a consecration, ending with Rāma; and in [a rite for] a water reservoir, ending with Kṛṣṇa. / In a sacrifice to Durgā, and in rites of fortune, one should assign Brahmā and the others.

2.2.s:
grahayāge ca pītādīnkuryācca na tadanyathā ..
navavyūhamatho vakṣye purāṇamatasammatam .. 13 ..
2.2.d:
ग्रहयागे च पीतादीन्कुर्याच्च न तदन्यथा ॥
नवव्यूहमथो वक्ष्ये पुराणमतसम्मतम् ॥ 13 ॥
2.2.m: And in a planetary sacrifice, one should make them yellow and the rest, and not otherwise. / Now I shall declare the ninefold array (navavyūha) approved by the opinion of the Purāṇas.

2.2.s:
sarvaṃ ca pūrvavatkāryaṃ paṃkajaṃ sulikhetsudhīḥ ..
tāvatsaṃkhyāharaṇayorveṣṭayetprakramādapi .. 14 ..
2.2.d:
सर्वं च पूर्ववत्कार्यं पंकजं सुलिखेत्सुधीः ॥
तावत्संख्याहरणयोर्वेष्टयेत्प्रक्रमादपि ॥ 14 ॥
2.2.m: Everything should be done as before; an intelligent man should draw the lotus well; / he should surround them also successively in both removals of that number,

2.2.s:
śuklāruṇaistathā pītaiḥ pītāruṇasitairapi ..
pītāruṇasitairevaṃ svabhāve pratibhāgake .. 15 ..
2.2.d:
शुक्लारुणैस्तथा पीतैः पीतारुणसितैरपि ॥
पीतारुणसितैरेवं स्वभावे प्रतिभागके ॥ 15 ॥
2.2.m: With white and red, as well as yellow; and with yellow, red, and white; / and thus with yellow, red, and white, according to nature in each division.

2.2.s:
kalāyaṃtraṃ tadaṃte ca guhyapatrā grakeṇa tu ..
ṣoḍaśairviṃśamāne tu saliṅgaṃ cāṣṭapatrake ..16..
2.2.d:
कलायंत्रं तदंते च गुह्यपत्रा ग्रकेण तु ॥
षोडशैर्विंशमाने तु सलिङ्गं चाष्टपत्रके ॥16॥
2.2.m:
And at its end [one should draw] the Kalāyantra with the tip of a secret petal,
with sixteen [divisions] in twenty measures, with a liṅga, and with eight petals.

2.2.s:
evaṃ maṃḍalamaṃtrāṇāṃ varjayetparamārthataḥ ..
tadvanmūleṣu koṇeṣu keśarāṇi prakalpayet..17..
2.2.d:
एवं मंडलमंत्राणां वर्जयेत्परमार्थतः ॥
तद्वन्मूलेषु कोणेषु केशराणि प्रकल्पयेत्॥17॥
2.2.m:
In this way, one must thoroughly avoid [mistakes in] the mantras of the maṇḍala.
Likewise, one should arrange filaments at the bases and the corners,

2.2.s:
daśadaṃḍasamākāraṃ trivarṇaṃ pratiraṃjitam ..
araṃ dadyāddaśāgre tu sarvāṃgulapramāṇataḥ .. 18 ..
2.2.d:
दशदंडसमाकारं त्रिवर्णं प्रतिरंजितम् ॥
अरं दद्याद्दशाग्रे तु सर्वांगुलप्रमाणतः ॥ 18 ॥
2.2.m:
having the form of ten rods, coloured in three hues.
One should place a spoke at the tip of the ten, measuring all angulas,

2.2.s:
pītenāraṃ ca sarvatra tanmadhye śoṇatuṃḍakam ..
navavyūhamidaṃ proktaṃ dharmakāmārthadāyakam .. 19 ..
2.2.d:
पीतेनारं च सर्वत्र तन्मध्ये शोणतुंडकम् ॥
नवव्यूहमिदं प्रोक्तं धर्मकामार्थदायकम् ॥ 19 ॥
2.2.m:
and the spoke everywhere [coloured] with yellow, and in its centre a red beak.
This is proclaimed as the ninefold array, which bestows dharma, kāma, and artha.

2.2.s:
na śūdro maṃḍalaṃ kuryānna kuryādbrāhmaṇabruvaḥ ..
kuryācca saṃgame tīrthe devatāyataneṣu ca .. 2.2.1.20 ..
2.2.d:
न शूद्रो मंडलं कुर्यान्न कुर्याद्ब्राह्मणब्रुवः ॥
कुर्याच्च संगमे तीर्थे देवतायतनेषु च ॥ 2.2.1.20 ॥
2.2.m:
A Śūdra should not make the maṇḍala, nor should a nominal Brahmin.
One should make it at a confluence [of rivers], at a sacred bathing-place, and in shrines of deities.

2.2.s:
likhitvā nārcayedya stu agnikāryavihīnakaḥ ..
aviddho jāyate so'pi yato janmanijanmani .. 21 .. ..
krauñcamānavarṇanam
2.2.d:
लिखित्वा नार्चयेद्य स्तु अग्निकार्यविहीनकः ॥
अविद्धो जायते सोऽपि यतो जन्मनिजन्मनि ॥ 21 ॥ ॥
क्रौञ्चमानवर्णनम्
2.2.m:
He who draws it but does not worship, being devoid of the fire-rite,
is born unimpaired […] from birth to birth.
Description of the Krauñca-measure

2.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca ..
krauñcamānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvedārthavādinām ..
saṃmataṃ sarvataṃtreṣu gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ .. 1 ..
2.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥
क्रौञ्चमानं प्रवक्ष्यामि यथावेदार्थवादिनाम् ॥
संमतं सर्वतंत्रेषु गोपनीयं प्रयत्नतः ॥ 1 ॥
2.2.m:
Sūta said:
I shall explain the Krauñca-measure according to the teachers of the Vedic meaning,
approved in all tantras, which must be kept secret with great care.

2.2.s:
ātmano'ratnimānena dviguṇaṃ parikalpayet ..
madhye vṛddhyā tu tatsūtraṃ bhrāmayetkīlakopari .. 2 ..
2.2.d:
आत्मनोऽरत्निमानेन द्विगुणं परिकल्पयेत् ॥
मध्ये वृद्ध्या तु तत्सूत्रं भ्रामयेत्कीलकोपरि ॥ 2 ॥
2.2.m:
One should measure twice the length of one's own cubit;
increasing it in the middle, one should rotate that cord over a peg.

2.2.s:
catuṣṭayaṃ nyasedvṛttaṃ madhyamādhamabhāvataḥ..
karṇikā prathame vṛtte dvitīye tvatha keśaram .. 3 ..
2.2.d:
चतुष्टयं न्यसेद्वृत्तं मध्यमाधमभावतः॥
कर्णिका प्रथमे वृत्ते द्वितीये त्वथ केशरम् ॥ 3 ॥
2.2.m:
One should lay down four circles according to high, middle, and low status:
the pericarp in the first circle, and filaments in the second;

2.2.s:
tṛtīye padmapatrāṇi caturthe ṣoḍaśacchadāḥ ..
śobhopaśobhe kuryācca caturasre same śubhe .. 4 ..
2.2.d:
तृतीये पद्मपत्राणि चतुर्थे षोडशच्छदाः ॥
शोभोपशोभे कुर्याच्च चतुरस्रे समे शुभे ॥ 4 ॥
2.2.m:
lotus petals in the third, and sixteen petals in the fourth.
One should also make the main decoration and sub-decoration on an even, auspicious square.

2.2.s:
taddakṣiṇāgraṃ sulikhetpārśvayoḥ pakṣakadvayam ..
tatra padmayugaṃ kuryānmadhye cāṃgulamaṃtaram..5..
2.2.d:
तद्दक्षिणाग्रं सुलिखेत्पार्श्वयोः पक्षकद्वयम् ॥
तत्र पद्मयुगं कुर्यान्मध्ये चांगुलमंतरम्॥5॥
2.2.m:
One should properly draw its southern point, and two wings on both flanks;
there one should make a pair of lotuses, with a space of an angula between them.

2.2.s:
śuklaṃ pītaṃ tathā raktaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ lohitasannibham ..
saṃkhyātaṃ tāmraparṇaṃ ca śyāmalaṃ cāṣṭakaṃ rajaḥ .. 6 ..
2.2.d:
शुक्लं पीतं तथा रक्तं कृष्णं लोहितसन्निभम् ॥
संख्यातं ताम्रपर्णं च श्यामलं चाष्टकं रजः ॥ 6 ॥
2.2.m:
White, yellow, and red, black, that resembling blood,
the calculated copper-coloured one, and dark-blue: these are the eight powders.

2.2.s:
śuklaṃ taṃḍulacūrṇotthaṃ pītaṃ tu niśayā smṛtam ..
raktaṃ tu niśayā yogācchaṃkhacūrṇādibhāvitam .. 7 ..
2.2.d:
शुक्लं तंडुलचूर्णोत्थं पीतं तु निशया स्मृतम् ॥
रक्तं तु निशया योगाच्छंखचूर्णादिभावितम् ॥ 7 ॥
2.2.m:
White is produced from rice-powder, and yellow is traditionally taught [as made] from turmeric;
red is from the mixture of turmeric processed with conch-shell powder and the like;

2.2.s:
kṛṣṇaṃ pulakādidagdhaṃ raktaṃ pītāsyayogataḥ ..
kuṃkumābhaṃ pāṃḍuraṃ ca raktaśvetairvinirmitam .. 8 ..
2.2.d:
कृष्णं पुलकादिदग्धं रक्तं पीतास्ययोगतः ॥
कुंकुमाभं पांडुरं च रक्तश्वेतैर्विनिर्मितम् ॥ 8 ॥
2.2.m:
black is burnt from unhusked grain and the like; red is from the mixture of yellow and [lime];
the saffron-coloured and pale [powders] are prepared from red and white;

2.2.s:
tāmravarṇaṃ kusuṃbhena śyāmalaṃ bilvapatrajam ..
yavagodhūmacūrṇādiyogena tu rajaḥ smṛtam .. 9 ..
2.2.d:
ताम्रवर्णं कुसुंभेन श्यामलं बिल्वपत्रजम् ॥
यवगोधूमचूर्णादियोगेन तु रजः स्मृतम् ॥ 9 ॥
2.2.m:
copper-coloured is from safflower; dark-blue is produced from bilva leaves;
and powder is taught as [made] from the mixture of barley- and wheat-flour and the like.

2.2.s:
sarvarekhāsu vibhajecchuklaṃ madhye tu pītakam ..
karṇikāyāṃ keśareṣu śubhrameva nipātayet .. 2.2.2.10 ..
2.2.d:
सर्वरेखासु विभजेच्छुक्लं मध्ये तु पीतकम् ॥
कर्णिकायां केशरेषु शुभ्रमेव निपातयेत् ॥ 2.2.2.10 ॥
2.2.m:
One should divide white on all the lines, but yellow in the middle;
on the pericarp and the filaments one should drop only white.

2.2.s:
pūrvādikramayogena śuklādīni prayoja yet ..
patrasaṃdhau tu vibhajedrajaḥ sekāṃtarakramāt ..11..
2.2.d:
पूर्वादिक्रमयोगेन शुक्लादीनि प्रयोज येत् ॥
पत्रसंधौ तु विभजेद्रजः सेकांतरक्रमात् ॥11॥
2.2.m:
In regular order beginning with the east, one should apply the white and the rest;
at the junction of petals, one should distribute powder in succession through alternating sprinklings.

2.2.s:
tataḥ ṣoḍaśapatreṣu pūrvādikramato bhavet ..
śuklaṃ pītaṃ tathā tāmraṃ tataḥ saṃkhyātameva ca ..12..
2.2.d:
ततः षोडशपत्रेषु पूर्वादिक्रमतो भवेत् ॥
शुक्लं पीतं तथा ताम्रं ततः संख्यातमेव च ॥12॥
2.2.m:
Then, on the sixteen petals, in order starting from the east, there should be:
white, yellow, and copper-coloured, and then the calculated one;

2.2.s:
śyāmalaṃ kuṃkumābhaṃ ca raktaṃ śuklaṃ ca kṛṣṇakam ..
pītaṃ tāmraṃ ca saṃkhyātaṃ śyāmaṃ kuṃkumaraktakam .. 13..
2.2.d:
श्यामलं कुंकुमाभं च रक्तं शुक्लं च कृष्णकम् ॥
पीतं ताम्रं च संख्यातं श्यामं कुंकुमरक्तकम् ॥ 13॥
2.2.m:
dark-blue, saffron-coloured, red, white, and black;
yellow, copper-coloured, calculated, dark-blue, saffron-coloured, and red.

2.2.s:
evaṃ dadyāddvijaḥ pūrve īśānāṃtaṃ vibhāvayet ..
krauṃcamūrghni bhavedraktaṃ caturaṃgulamānataḥ..14..
2.2.d:
एवं दद्याद्द्विजः पूर्वे ईशानांतं विभावयेत् ॥
क्रौंचमूर्घ्नि भवेद्रक्तं चतुरंगुलमानतः॥14॥
2.2.m:
Thus the twice-born should apply [them] in the east, conceiving them up to the northeast.
On the head of the Krauñca, there should be red measuring four angulas;

2.2.s:
tuṃḍabhāge bhavetpītaṃ grīvāyāṃ śuklameva ca ..
pucche viṃśatipatrāṇi ādau paṃca rajaḥkramāt ..15..
2.2.d:
तुंडभागे भवेत्पीतं ग्रीवायां शुक्लमेव च ॥
पुच्छे विंशतिपत्राणि आदौ पंच रजःक्रमात् ॥15॥
2.2.m:
in the region of the beak there should be yellow, and on the neck white;
on the tail there are twenty feathers, five at first in the sequence of powders.

2.2.s:
ṣaḍaṃguleṣvaṃḍabhāge pītena parikalpayet ..
grīvāyāṃ śuklarajasā bhāvitāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..16..
2.2.d:
षडंगुलेष्वंडभागे पीतेन परिकल्पयेत् ॥
ग्रीवायां शुक्लरजसा भावितायां विशेषतः ॥16॥
2.2.m:
Over six angulas in the region of the egg, one should fashion [it] with yellow;
especially on the neck, when it is prepared with white powder,

2.2.s:
tatra pītādikaṃ lekhyaṃ pūrvoktaṃ ca yathā bhavet ..
śuklādikaṃ pradadyānu pātreṣvekaikaśaḥ pṛthak .. 17 ..
2.2.d:
तत्र पीतादिकं लेख्यं पूर्वोक्तं च यथा भवेत् ॥
शुक्लादिकं प्रदद्यानु पात्रेष्वेकैकशः पृथक् ॥ 17 ॥
2.2.m:
yellow and the others are to be drawn there as previously stated.
One should apply white and the others separately, one by one, on the vessels.

2.2.s:
caturaṃgulake pāde jānorūrdhve tu pītakam ..
adhastāttu bhavedraktaṃ tadeva caturaṃgulam ..18..
2.2.d:
चतुरंगुलके पादे जानोरूर्ध्वे तु पीतकम् ॥
अधस्तात्तु भवेद्रक्तं तदेव चतुरंगुलम् ॥18॥
2.2.m:
On the four-angula foot, above the knee there should be yellow;
below it should be red, measuring the same four angulas.

2.2.s:
dvyaṃgulena bhavecchyāmamaṃgulīṣvapi vinyaset ..
evaṃ pakṣadvayenāpi likhecchuklaṃ vibhāvayet .. 19 ..
2.2.d:
द्व्यंगुलेन भवेच्छ्याममंगुलीष्वपि विन्यसेत् ॥
एवं पक्षद्वयेनापि लिखेच्छुक्लं विभावयेत् ॥ 19 ॥
2.2.m:
It should be dark-blue by two angulas, and one should also place it on the toes;
thus with both wings, one should draw and visualize white.

2.2.s:
pade śuddhaṃ cāṃgulīṣu raktaṃ śyāmena bhāvayet ..
pūrvapaścimadigbhāge śuklaṃ syādvāradeśataḥ ..2.2.2.20..
2.2.d:
पदे शुद्धं चांगुलीषु रक्तं श्यामेन भावयेत् ॥
पूर्वपश्चिमदिग्भागे शुक्लं स्याद्वारदेशतः ॥2.2.2.20॥
2.2.m:
Pure [white] on the foot, and on the toes one should visualize red with dark-blue;
in the eastern and western quarters it should be white, from the region of the entrance,

2.2.s:
dakṣiṇottarataścaiva raktavarṇaṃ vinirdiśet ..
mahākrauṃcamidaṃ jñeyaṃ madhyakraucamidaṃ śṛṇu .. 21 ..
2.2.d:
दक्षिणोत्तरतश्चैव रक्तवर्णं विनिर्दिशेत् ॥
महाक्रौंचमिदं ज्ञेयं मध्यक्रौचमिदं शृणु ॥ 21 ॥
2.2.m:
and on the south and north one should prescribe the colour red.
This is known as the Great Krauñca; now hear this Middling Krauñca,

2.2.s:
kaniṣṭhaṃ sarvayajñeṣu vidyānāṃ saptamuttamam ..
athāparaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvataṃtramataṃ kramāt .. 22 ..
2.2.d:
कनिष्ठं सर्वयज्ञेषु विद्यानां सप्तमुत्तमम् ॥
अथापरं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वतंत्रमतं क्रमात् ॥ 22 ॥
2.2.m:
and the Smallest in all sacrifices, the best of the seven lores.
Now I shall declare another in regular sequence, according to the doctrine of all tantras:

2.2.s:
raktapītaṃ raktapītaiḥ kuryātpucchacatuṣṭayam ..
pūrvādikramayoge tu patrāṃte dharaṇītale .. ..23..
2.2.d:
रक्तपीतं रक्तपीतैः कुर्यात्पुच्छचतुष्टयम् ॥
पूर्वादिक्रमयोगे तु पत्रांते धरणीतले ॥ ॥23॥
2.2.m:
With red-and-yellow powders one should make four tails;
in regular order starting from the east, at the edge of the petals on the ground,

2.2.s:
sulikhenmūlasaṃlagnaṃ bahiṣkoṇacatuṣṭayam ..
kaniṣṭhe'ṣṭakulaṃ kuryātpucchaṃ kuryāccaturvidham ..24..
2.2.d:
सुलिखेन्मूलसंलग्नं बहिष्कोणचतुष्टयम् ॥
कनिष्ठेऽष्टकुलं कुर्यात्पुच्छं कुर्याच्चतुर्विधम् ॥24॥
2.2.m:
one should properly draw four outer corners joined to the base.
In the smallest [maṇḍala], one should make eight families, and make the tail of four kinds.

2.2.s:
trivṛttaṃ veṣṭayetpaścātsitaraktāsitaiḥ kramāt ..
dṛṣṭaṃ janmaśatodbhūtaṃ pāpaṃ nāśayate dhuvam ..25..
2.2.d:
त्रिवृत्तं वेष्टयेत्पश्चात्सितरक्तासितैः क्रमात् ॥
दृष्टं जन्मशतोद्भूतं पापं नाशयते धुवम् ॥25॥
2.2.m:
One should surround it behind with three circles of white, red, and black in succession;
seen, it surely destroys sin born of a hundred lifetimes.

2.2.s:
pītaṃ vā vilikhedviprā naśyaṃti sakalāpadaḥ..
ataścakraṃ bahiścakraṃ kṣetre ca pratidarśanam ..26..
2.2.d:
पीतं वा विलिखेद्विप्रा नश्यंति सकलापदः॥
अतश्चक्रं बहिश्चक्रं क्षेत्रे च प्रतिदर्शनम् ॥26॥
2.2.m:
Or, O Brahmins, if one draws it yellow, all misfortunes are destroyed.
Therefore, the wheel and the outer wheel, and its sight in the field,

2.2.s:
tasya kalpaśatodbhūtaṃ pāpaṃ nāśayate dhuvam ..
mayūraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ caiva siṃhaṃ krauṃcaṃ ca vai kapim ..27..
2.2.d:
तस्य कल्पशतोद्भूतं पापं नाशयते धुवम् ॥
मयूरं वृषभं चैव सिंहं क्रौंचं च वै कपिम् ॥27॥
2.2.m:
surely destroys the sin born of a hundred aeons for him.
A peacock, a bull, a lion, a curlew, and indeed a monkey:

2.2.s:
pramādādvā gṛhe kṣetre vṛkṣāgre cāpi bho dvijāḥ ..
utthāya vaṃdanaṃ kuryādbrahmahatyāśataṃ dahet .. 28 ..
2.2.d:
प्रमादाद्वा गृहे क्षेत्रे वृक्षाग्रे चापि भो द्विजाः ॥
उत्थाय वंदनं कुर्याद्ब्रह्महत्याशतं दहेत् ॥ 28 ॥
2.2.m:
O Brahmins, whether by chance in the house, the field, or at the top of a tree,
rising and bowing [to them], one burns away a hundred slayings of a Brahmin.

2.2.s:
poṣaṇātkīrtimāpnoti darśanātpāpavicyutiḥ ..
darśanādvardhate lakṣmīrāyurvṛddhiśca jāyate .. 29 ..
2.2.d:
पोषणात्कीर्तिमाप्नोति दर्शनात्पापविच्युतिः ॥
दर्शनाद्वर्धते लक्ष्मीरायुर्वृद्धिश्च जायते ॥ 29 ॥
2.2.m:
From feeding [them] one attains fame; from seeing [them] comes liberation from sin;
from seeing [them] fortune increases, and lengthening of life comes to be.

2.2.s:
mayūro brahmaṇo mūrtirvṛṣabhaśca sadāśivaḥ.. .
siṃhe ca saṃbhaveddurgā vaiṣṇavo vidhirucyate ..2.2.2.30..
2.2.d:
मयूरो ब्रह्मणो मूर्तिर्वृषभश्च सदाशिवः॥ ।
सिंहे च संभवेद्दुर्गा वैष्णवो विधिरुच्यते ॥2.2.2.30॥
2.2.m:
The peacock is the form of Brahmā, and the bull is Sadāśiva;
in the lion Durgā resides, and the Vaiṣṇava rite is proclaimed [there].

2.2.s:
krauṃco nārāyaṇo devo vyāghrastripurasuṃdarī ..
kālikā kṛṣṇavyāghraśca lakṣmīścitrakapotakaḥ ..31..
2.2.d:
क्रौंचो नारायणो देवो व्याघ्रस्त्रिपुरसुंदरी ॥
कालिका कृष्णव्याघ्रश्च लक्ष्मीश्चित्रकपोतकः ॥31॥
2.2.m:
The curlew is the god Nārāyaṇa; the tigress is Tripurasundarī;
Kālikā is the black tigress; and Lakṣmī is the spotted dove.

2.2.s:
snātaḥ paśyati pratyahni grahadoṣo na jāyate ..
tasmātprayatnato bhūtvā dhārayetpoṣayedgṛhe .. 32 ..
2.2.d:
स्नातः पश्यति प्रत्यह्नि ग्रहदोषो न जायते ॥
तस्मात्प्रयत्नतो भूत्वा धारयेत्पोषयेद्गृहे ॥ 32 ॥
2.2.m:
Having bathed, he who sees them daily suffers no planetary affliction;
therefore, becoming attentive, one should keep and nurture [them] in the house.

2.2.s:
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi maṃḍale maṃḍaleṣvapi ..
rajodravyapramāṇaṃ ca yathoktaṃ yatnavarjanam .. 33 ..
2.2.d:
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि मंडले मंडलेष्वपि ॥
रजोद्रव्यप्रमाणं च यथोक्तं यत्नवर्जनम् ॥ 33 ॥
2.2.m:
Hereafter I shall explain, in each and every maṇḍala,
the measure of powder substances and the careful avoidance as prescribed.

2.2.s:
taṃḍulotthaṃ yavotthaṃ vā varjyaṃ makararopaṇam ..
yadbālyaśrāvaṇe jātaṃ hiṃgulaṃ gaṃdhakaṃ tathā ..34..
2.2.d:
तंडुलोत्थं यवोत्थं वा वर्ज्यं मकररोपणम् ॥
यद्बाल्यश्रावणे जातं हिंगुलं गंधकं तथा ॥34॥
2.2.m:
Derived from rice or derived from barley, the drawing of a sea-monster is to be avoided;
that which is produced in early Śrāvaṇa, cinnabar, and sulphur,

2.2.s:
haritālaṃ subhadraṃ ca sadā vighnaṃ vivarjayet ..
haimaṃtikodbhavaṃ yacca sitapāṣāṇameva ca ..35..
2.2.d:
हरितालं सुभद्रं च सदा विघ्नं विवर्जयेत् ॥
हैमंतिकोद्भवं यच्च सितपाषाणमेव च ॥35॥
2.2.m:
orpiment, and subhadra: one should always avoid [these, which cause] obstacles;
and that which arises in winter, and white stone,

2.2.s:
kāṃcanyāśca prabhedaṃ yacchastaṃ śuklaguṇaṃ dvijāḥ ..
śephālivṛttaṃ niśayā atasīkusumāni ca ..36..
2.2.d:
कांचन्याश्च प्रभेदं यच्छस्तं शुक्लगुणं द्विजाः ॥
शेफालिवृत्तं निशया अतसीकुसुमानि च ॥36॥
2.2.m:
and the variety of gold—these are praised for their white quality, O Brahmins.
Round night-jasmine with turmeric, and linseed flowers,

2.2.s:
kiṃśukasya ca puṣpāṇi śastaṃ pītaṃ guṇaṃ bhavet ..
nāgajaṃ gairikaṃ caiva kusuṃbha kusumāni ca ..37..
2.2.d:
किंशुकस्य च पुष्पाणि शस्तं पीतं गुणं भवेत् ॥
नागजं गैरिकं चैव कुसुंभ कुसुमानि च ॥37॥
2.2.m:
and flowers of the palāśa: [these] are praised for their yellow quality;
red lead, red chalk, and safflower blossoms [for red].

2.2.s:
kuśītaṃ guḍakaṃ caiva maṃjiṣṭhāṃ paṃcaraṃgakam ..
vijayāpatrakaṃ caiva bilvapatraṃ tathaiva ca..38..
2.2.d:
कुशीतं गुडकं चैव मंजिष्ठां पंचरंगकम् ॥
विजयापत्रकं चैव बिल्वपत्रं तथैव च॥38॥
2.2.m:
[White] water-lily, guḍaka, and madder as a fivefold coloring;
vijayā leaves and likewise bilva leaves,

2.2.s:
punarnavāyāḥ patraṃ ca keśarasya bakasya ca..
kṛṣṇapāṣāṇakaṃ caiva kṛṣṇābhraṃ samayūthakam..39..
2.2.d:
पुनर्नवायाः पत्रं च केशरस्य बकस्य च॥
कृष्णपाषाणकं चैव कृष्णाभ्रं समयूथकम्॥39॥
2.2.m:
and the leaf of punarnavā, and of saffron, and of baka;
black stone and black mica along with myrobalan,

2.2.s:
nāgapāṣāṇakaṃ caiva punnāgaṃ dagdhapaṃcakam ..
śaṃkhacūrṇaṃ lohaviṣṭhāṃ nāgaviṣṭhāṃ ca varjayet..2.2.2.40..
2.2.d:
नागपाषाणकं चैव पुन्नागं दग्धपंचकम् ॥
शंखचूर्णं लोहविष्ठां नागविष्ठां च वर्जयेत्॥2.2.2.40॥
2.2.m:
nāgapāṣāṇa, punnāga, and the five burnt substances;
one should avoid conch powder, iron slag, and lead slag.

2.2.s:
karpūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ caiva rocanārocanāṃ śrayet ..
yavaśālīyakairbhinnaṃ śuklaṃ ca kārayetsudhīḥ ..41..
2.2.d:
कर्पूरं कुंकुमं चैव रोचनारोचनां श्रयेत् ॥
यवशालीयकैर्भिन्नं शुक्लं च कारयेत्सुधीः ॥41॥
2.2.m:
One should use camphor, saffron, and rocanā;
a wise person should make white from barley and winter rice.

2.2.s:
lākṣāṃ ca yadi gṛhṇīyāttadbharjitvā pradāpayet ..
ākāśaṃ pṛthivīṃ caiva bhaumaṃ rāmaṃ tathā śanī ..42..
2.2.d:
लाक्षां च यदि गृह्णीयात्तद्भर्जित्वा प्रदापयेत् ॥
आकाशं पृथिवीं चैव भौमं रामं तथा शनी ॥42॥
2.2.m:
And if one takes red lac, one should apply it after roasting it;
space, earth, Mars, Rāma, and Saturn.

2.2.s:
dharaṇīṃ sadanasthāne pañcadhā vibhajedbahiḥ ..
padmamullikhya prathamaṃ karṇikāṃ tadanantaram ..43..
2.2.d:
धरणीं सदनस्थाने पञ्चधा विभजेद्बहिः ॥
पद्ममुल्लिख्य प्रथमं कर्णिकां तदनन्तरम् ॥43॥
2.2.m:
One should divide the ground outside the house area into five parts;
having first drawn a lotus, then the pericarp,

2.2.s:
tarjanyamadhyā pūrvotthaṃ vibhajedvā samāhitaḥ ..
tarjanyaṃguṣṭhayogairvā tṛṇamārabhya yadbhavet .. 44 ..
2.2.d:
तर्जन्यमध्या पूर्वोत्थं विभजेद्वा समाहितः ॥
तर्जन्यंगुष्ठयोगैर्वा तृणमारभ्य यद्भवेत् ॥ 44 ॥
2.2.m:
composed, one should divide what arises from the east with forefinger and middle finger;
or with the junction of the forefinger and thumb, starting from the grass, whatever it may be.

2.2.s:
tṛṇamārabhya sāmānye śakto vā madhyamāditaḥ ..
rākṣasādipratiṣṭhāyāṃ grahapakṣe'gnimāditaḥ .. 45 ..
2.2.d:
तृणमारभ्य सामान्ये शक्तो वा मध्यमादितः ॥
राक्षसादिप्रतिष्ठायां ग्रहपक्षेऽग्निमादितः ॥ 45 ॥
2.2.m:
Starting from the grass in ordinary rites, or if able, from the middle finger first;
in the consecration of demons and so forth, from Fire in the context of the planets.

2.2.s:
aṃgulyagre ca vibhajetsarvakāmārthasiddhaye ..
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ grahamakhe kāmyeṣu parivarjayet .. 46 ..
2.2.d:
अंगुल्यग्रे च विभजेत्सर्वकामार्थसिद्धये ॥
प्रतिष्ठायां ग्रहमखे काम्येषु परिवर्जयेत् ॥ 46 ॥
2.2.m:
And one should divide it at the fingertip for the attainment of all desires and aims;
in a consecration, in a planetary sacrifice, and in rites for specific desires, one should avoid [certain faults].

2.2.s:
subhadraṃ maṇḍalaṃ vakṣye śubhadaṃ śubhamādiśet ..
ataḥ subhadramuddiṣṭaṃ svargamokṣapradāyakam .. 47 ..
2.2.d:
सुभद्रं मण्डलं वक्ष्ये शुभदं शुभमादिशेत् ॥
अतः सुभद्रमुद्दिष्टं स्वर्गमोक्षप्रदायकम् ॥ 47 ॥
2.2.m:
I shall describe the subhadra maṇḍala, which bestows good fortune; one should declare it auspicious;
hence subhadra is declared as bestowing heaven and liberation.

2.2.s:
sārdhahastena mānena kuryānmaṃṇḍalamuttamam ..
caturviśāṃgulaiḥ pūrṇaṃ sarvatra hastamādiśet .. 48 ..
2.2.d:
सार्धहस्तेन मानेन कुर्यान्मंण्डलमुत्तमम् ॥
चतुर्विशांगुलैः पूर्णं सर्वत्र हस्तमादिशेत् ॥ 48 ॥
2.2.m:
One should make the excellent maṇḍala with a measurement of one and a half cubits;
one should declare a cubit everywhere as full with twenty-four finger-breadths.

2.2.s:
karturmadhyasahasrasya madhyamā madhyaparvaṇi ..
madhyamā dīrghamānena mānāṃgulamiti smṛtam .. 49 ..
2.2.d:
कर्तुर्मध्यसहस्रस्य मध्यमा मध्यपर्वणि ॥
मध्यमा दीर्घमानेन मानांगुलमिति स्मृतम् ॥ 49 ॥
2.2.m:
At the middle joint of the middle finger of an average patron,
the standard finger-breadth is traditionally known by the length of the middle finger.

2.2.s:
rekhādvayāṃtaraṃ yacca mūlarekhāṃ na cāśrayet ..
vaddhāṃguṣṭhanakhadvaṃdvaṃ mānāṃgulamathāpi vā ..2.2.2.50..
2.2.d:
रेखाद्वयांतरं यच्च मूलरेखां न चाश्रयेत् ॥
वद्धांगुष्ठनखद्वंद्वं मानांगुलमथापि वा ॥2.2.2.50॥
2.2.m:
And the space between two lines—one should not rely on the baseline—
or the standard finger-breadth is the pair of nails of joined thumbs.

2.2.s:
madhye nibadhya śaṃkuṃ ca muṣṭibāhupramāṇataḥ ..
trivṛttaṃ kārayenmadhye jyeṣṭhottarakanīyasam .. 51 ..
2.2.d:
मध्ये निबध्य शंकुं च मुष्टिबाहुप्रमाणतः ॥
त्रिवृत्तं कारयेन्मध्ये ज्येष्ठोत्तरकनीयसम् ॥ 51 ॥
2.2.m:
Having fixed a peg in the middle according to the measure of the arm with a clenched fist,
one should make three circles in the middle, largest, middle, and smallest.

2.2.s:
prakalpya karṇikādīni madhye cāṣṭadalaṃ likhet ..
bahiścārkadalaṃ kuryādvarṇānāṃ kramakeṇa tu ..52..
2.2.d:
प्रकल्प्य कर्णिकादीनि मध्ये चाष्टदलं लिखेत् ॥
बहिश्चार्कदलं कुर्याद्वर्णानां क्रमकेण तु ॥52॥
2.2.m:
Having formed the pericarp and other parts, one should draw an eight-petalled [lotus] in the center;
and outside one should make twelve petals according to the order of the colors.

2.2.s:
paṃcamaṃ śvetavarṇena bahiḥ kuryāttriveṣṭanam ..
sitapītāruṇaṃ kuryātpaścādvedāṃgulāṃtare .. 53 ..
2.2.d:
पंचमं श्वेतवर्णेन बहिः कुर्यात्त्रिवेष्टनम् ॥
सितपीतारुणं कुर्यात्पश्चाद्वेदांगुलांतरे ॥ 53 ॥
2.2.m:
One should make the fifth a triple enclosure outside with white color;
one should make it white, yellow, and red, then at an interval of four finger-breadths,

2.2.s:
veṣṭayecchuklavarṇena madhye kalpalatāṃ likhet ..
subhadraṃ maṇḍalātpūrvaṃ sarvatobhadrakaṃ śṛṇu .. .. 54 ..
2.2.d:
वेष्टयेच्छुक्लवर्णेन मध्ये कल्पलतां लिखेत् ॥
सुभद्रं मण्डलात्पूर्वं सर्वतोभद्रकं शृणु ॥ ॥ 54 ॥
2.2.m:
one should enclose it with white color and draw a wish-fulfilling creeper in the middle.
This was the subhadra maṇḍala; now hear first of the sarvatobhadra:

2.2.s:
sarvakāryeṣu yajñeṣu sarvakalyāṇamāpnuyāt ..
maṃḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ sarvayajñeṣu puṣṭidam .. 55 ..
2.2.d:
सर्वकार्येषु यज्ञेषु सर्वकल्याणमाप्नुयात् ॥
मंडलं सर्वतोभद्रं सर्वयज्ञेषु पुष्टिदम् ॥ 55 ॥
2.2.m:
in all undertakings and in all sacrifices, one attains all welfare;
the sarvatobhadra maṇḍala provides nourishment in all sacrifices.

2.2.s:
sādhakānāṃ hitārthāya īśvareṇaiva bhāṣitam ..
caturviṃśatyaṃgulena hastaḥ prathamato bhavet .. 56 ..
2.2.d:
साधकानां हितार्थाय ईश्वरेणैव भाषितम् ॥
चतुर्विंशत्यंगुलेन हस्तः प्रथमतो भवेत् ॥ 56 ॥
2.2.m:
It was spoken by the Lord himself for the welfare of practitioners;
a cubit should first be twenty-four finger-breadths.

2.2.s:
koṇe sūtradvayaṃ dadyānmadhye sūtradvayaṃ punaḥ ..
tato matsyānviracayetkarṇe sūtrāṇi sādhakaḥ ..57..
2.2.d:
कोणे सूत्रद्वयं दद्यान्मध्ये सूत्रद्वयं पुनः ॥
ततो मत्स्यान्विरचयेत्कर्णे सूत्राणि साधकः ॥57॥
2.2.m:
One should lay two cords at the corner, and again two cords in the middle;
then the practitioner should make fish marks on the cords at the diagonal.

2.2.s:
catuḥ sūtraṃ pātayecca pūrvāparavibhāgataḥ ..
punardadyāccatuḥsūtraṃ karṇasūtraṃ punardadet .. 58 ..
2.2.d:
चतुः सूत्रं पातयेच्च पूर्वापरविभागतः ॥
पुनर्दद्याच्चतुःसूत्रं कर्णसूत्रं पुनर्ददेत् ॥ 58 ॥
2.2.m:
And one should cast four cords according to the division into east and west;
one should lay four cords again, and then lay diagonal cords again,

2.2.s:
śatadvayapadaṃ yāvatṣaṭpaṃcāśādhikaṃ tathā ..
pātayecca tathā sūtramevaṃ saptadaśaṃ bhavet .. 59 ..
2.2.d:
शतद्वयपदं यावत्षट्पंचाशाधिकं तथा ॥
पातयेच्च तथा सूत्रमेवं सप्तदशं भवेत् ॥ 59 ॥
2.2.m:
up to two hundred and fifty-six squares;
and one should cast the cords thus; there will be seventeen [lines].

2.2.s:
ūrdhvapaṃktyā padayugaṃ cādye padacatuṣṭayam ..
dvārapārśve bhavedyāvaddaṃtapaṃktyā padatrayam .. 2.2.2.60 ..
2.2.d:
ऊर्ध्वपंक्त्या पदयुगं चाद्ये पदचतुष्टयम् ॥
द्वारपार्श्वे भवेद्यावद्दंतपंक्त्या पदत्रयम् ॥ 2.2.2.60 ॥
2.2.m:
A pair of squares in the upper row and four squares at the beginning,
up to the side of the entrance there should be three squares in the tooth-row.

2.2.s:
rekhāṃ sarvatra śuklena racayedyajñiyottamaḥ ..
paṅkajaṃ śuklavarṇena vaiṣṇavo yāgakarmaṇi .. 61 ..
2.2.d:
रेखां सर्वत्र शुक्लेन रचयेद्यज्ञियोत्तमः ॥
पङ्कजं शुक्लवर्णेन वैष्णवो यागकर्मणि ॥ 61 ॥
2.2.m:
The best of sacrificial performers should draw the line everywhere with white;
a Vaiṣṇava should draw the lotus with white color in a sacrificial rite.

2.2.s:
śaktiyoge bhavedraktaṃ śaive pītaṃ vinirdiśet ..
pratiṣṭhāsu ca sarvāsu śuklameva praśasyate .. 62 ..
2.2.d:
शक्तियोगे भवेद्रक्तं शैवे पीतं विनिर्दिशेत् ॥
प्रतिष्ठासु च सर्वासु शुक्लमेव प्रशस्यते ॥ 62 ॥
2.2.m:
In a Śākta rite it should be red, and in a Śaiva rite one should designate it yellow;
and in all consecrations, white alone is praised.

2.2.s:
pītena karṇikā kāryā caturbhāgena mānataḥ ..
śubhaṃ cakorāvasthāne tāpayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 63 ..
2.2.d:
पीतेन कर्णिका कार्या चतुर्भागेन मानतः ॥
शुभं चकोरावस्थाने तापयित्वा विचक्षणः ॥ 63 ॥
2.2.m:
The pericarp should be made yellow, measuring a fourth part;
having heated the auspicious [substances] at the position of the cakora bird, the expert,

2.2.s:
karṇikāmūlamārabhya rekhāḥ ṣoḍaśa kalpayet ..
rekhāmūle bhavecchuklaṃ madhye raktaṃ nipātayet .. 64 ..
2.2.d:
कर्णिकामूलमारभ्य रेखाः षोडश कल्पयेत् ॥
रेखामूले भवेच्छुक्लं मध्ये रक्तं निपातयेत् ॥ 64 ॥
2.2.m:
starting from the base of the pericarp, should fashion sixteen lines;
at the base of the line it should be white, in the middle one should lay down red,

2.2.s:
agre pītaṃ bhavedevaṃ kṛtvā paṃkajaveṣṭanam ..
śubhravarṇena taddadyātpītavarṇena sarvataḥ .. 65 ..
2.2.d:
अग्रे पीतं भवेदेवं कृत्वा पंकजवेष्टनम् ॥
शुभ्रवर्णेन तद्दद्यात्पीतवर्णेन सर्वतः ॥ 65 ॥
2.2.m:
and at the tip it should be yellow: having thus made the enclosure of the lotus,
one should provide it with white color and with yellow color all around.

2.2.s:
madhye raktaṃ bhavettacca evaṃ ṣoḍaśakalpayet ..
koṇeṣu raktaṃ dadyācca padmaṃ kṣetreṣu nirdiśet .. 66 ..
2.2.d:
मध्ये रक्तं भवेत्तच्च एवं षोडशकल्पयेत् ॥
कोणेषु रक्तं दद्याच्च पद्मं क्षेत्रेषु निर्दिशेत् ॥ 66 ॥
2.2.m:
And in the middle it should be red; thus one should fashion sixteen [petals];
and one should place red in the corners, and assign a lotus in the fields.

2.2.s:
śuklena pīṭhagātrāṇi pīṭhakoṇe padatraye ..
pītavarṇena racayeddvidhā paṃktidvaye tathā .. 67 ..
2.2.d:
शुक्लेन पीठगात्राणि पीठकोणे पदत्रये ॥
पीतवर्णेन रचयेद्द्विधा पंक्तिद्वये तथा ॥ 67 ॥
2.2.m:
With white the limbs of the pedestal, and in the three squares at the corner of the pedestal,
one should fashion it with yellow color in two ways, likewise in two rows.

2.2.s:
śuddhena racayetpādau punaḥ pītādivarṇakaiḥ..
citraṃ suśobhanaṃ kāryaṃ tatra kalpalatāṃ nyaset .. ..68..
2.2.d:
शुद्धेन रचयेत्पादौ पुनः पीतादिवर्णकैः॥
चित्रं सुशोभनं कार्यं तत्र कल्पलतां न्यसेत् ॥ ॥68॥
2.2.m:
One should fashion the feet with pure [white], and again with yellow and other colors;
one should make it multi-colored and very beautiful, and place a wish-fulfilling creeper there.

2.2.s:
mānaṃ kalpalatāyāstu dvyaṅgulaṃ parikīrtitam ..
dvedve śastaṃ ca bhramaṇaṃ śaṃkhāvartakramāttrayam ..69..
2.2.d:
मानं कल्पलतायास्तु द्व्यङ्गुलं परिकीर्तितम् ॥
द्वेद्वे शस्तं च भ्रमणं शंखावर्तक्रमात्त्रयम् ॥69॥
2.2.m:
The measure of the wish-fulfilling creeper is declared to be two finger-breadths;
two and two windings are praised, and three in the order of a conch-spiral.

2.2.s:
graṃthaugraṃthau puṣpaphale nānāvarṇena bhāvayet ..
nānāpaśugaṇairyuktaṃ nānāpakṣigaṇairyutam .. 2.2.2.70 ..
2.2.d:
ग्रंथौग्रंथौ पुष्पफले नानावर्णेन भावयेत् ॥
नानापशुगणैर्युक्तं नानापक्षिगणैर्युतम् ॥ 2.2.2.70 ॥
2.2.m:
At every knot one should visualize flowers and fruits with various colors;
endowed with various hosts of beasts, endowed with various flocks of birds.

2.2.s:
vaiṣṇave gāruḍaṃ śastaṃ śaive kīśavṛṣaṃ likhet ..
śākte vyāghraṃ tathaiśe ca śarabhaṃ harimālikhet ..71..
2.2.d:
वैष्णवे गारुडं शस्तं शैवे कीशवृषं लिखेत् ॥
शाक्ते व्याघ्रं तथैशे च शरभं हरिमालिखेत् ॥71॥
2.2.m:
In a Vaiṣṇava [rite] Garuḍa is praised; in a Śaiva rite one should draw a monkey and a bull;
in a Śākta rite a tiger, and in an Aiśa rite one should draw a śarabha and a lion.

2.2.s:
śobhāṃ pītena racayedupaśobhāṃ ca pītakaiḥ ..
koṇeṣu kṛṣṇavarṇena bahiḥ syādveṣṭanatrayam .. 72 ..
2.2.d:
शोभां पीतेन रचयेदुपशोभां च पीतकैः ॥
कोणेषु कृष्णवर्णेन बहिः स्याद्वेष्टनत्रयम् ॥ 72 ॥
2.2.m:
One should make the border with yellow, and the secondary border with yellow tones;
with black color in the corners; outside there should be three enclosures.

2.2.s:
śuklapītāruṇaiḥ kāryaṃ maṇḍalaṃ syānmanoramam ..
sarvatobhadramaparaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam .. 73 ..
2.2.d:
शुक्लपीतारुणैः कार्यं मण्डलं स्यान्मनोरमम् ॥
सर्वतोभद्रमपरं सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकम् ॥ 73 ॥
2.2.m:
With white, yellow, and red the maṇḍala should be made delightful;
[now] another sarvatobhadra, granting all accomplishments,

2.2.s:
sarvajñānamayaṃ śuddhaṃ dharmakāmārthadāyakam ..
caturasraṃ samaṃ kṛtvā digbhyo dvādaśadhā dvijāḥ .. 74 ..
2.2.d:
सर्वज्ञानमयं शुद्धं धर्मकामार्थदायकम् ॥
चतुरस्रं समं कृत्वा दिग्भ्यो द्वादशधा द्विजाः ॥ 74 ॥
2.2.m:
consisting of all knowledge, pure, bestowing virtue, desire, and wealth:
having made a square equal from the cardinal points into twelve parts, O twice-born ones,

2.2.s:
pātayettatra sūtrāṇi koṣṭhānāṃ dṛśyate śatam ..
catuścatvāriṃśadādyaṃ paścātṣaṭtriṃśadaṃbujam .. 75 ..
2.2.d:
पातयेत्तत्र सूत्राणि कोष्ठानां दृश्यते शतम् ॥
चतुश्चत्वारिंशदाद्यं पश्चात्षट्त्रिंशदंबुजम् ॥ 75 ॥
2.2.m:
one should cast cords there: one hundred squares are seen;
first forty-four, and then a thirty-six-square lotus.

2.2.s:
koṣṭhaṃ prakalpayetpīṭhaṃ paṃktyā caivātra vīthikām ..
dvāraśobhe yathāpūrvamupaśobhaṃ ca dṛśyate .. 76 ..
2.2.d:
कोष्ठं प्रकल्पयेत्पीठं पंक्त्या चैवात्र वीथिकाम् ॥
द्वारशोभे यथापूर्वमुपशोभं च दृश्यते ॥ 76 ॥
2.2.m:
One should designate a square for the pedestal, and an aisle here along the row;
as before, the door-borders and secondary border are seen.

2.2.s:
avaśiṣṭaiḥ padaiḥ kuryātsadbhistaṃtrāṇi mantravit ..
vidadhyātpūrvavaccheṣamevaṃ vā maṇḍalaṃ bhavet .. 77..
2.2.d:
अवशिष्टैः पदैः कुर्यात्सद्भिस्तंत्राणि मन्त्रवित् ॥
विदध्यात्पूर्ववच्छेषमेवं वा मण्डलं भवेत् ॥ 77॥
2.2.m:
The knower of mantras should perform the rituals with the remaining noble squares;
one should arrange the rest as before; thus or so the maṇḍala should be.

2.2.s:
pūrvoktamaṇḍale vidvandharaṇīsadanaṃ bahiḥ ..
madhye kalpalatā kāryā bahiṣkoṇeṣu sattamāḥ .. 78 ..
2.2.d:
पूर्वोक्तमण्डले विद्वन्धरणीसदनं बहिः ॥
मध्ये कल्पलता कार्या बहिष्कोणेषु सत्तमाः ॥ 78 ॥
2.2.m:
In the previously described maṇḍala, O wise ones, the earth-chamber is outside;
a wish-fulfilling creeper should be made in the middle, and at the outer corners, O best of men,

2.2.s:
gulālītūryavarṇena mahāmatta iti smṛtaḥ ..
śobhopaśobhe śobhāgrāṃ kuryādvai maṇḍalaṃ bhavet .. 79 ..
2.2.d:
गुलालीतूर्यवर्णेन महामत्त इति स्मृतः ॥
शोभोपशोभे शोभाग्रां कुर्याद्वै मण्डलं भवेत् ॥ 79 ॥
2.2.m:
with the color of gulālī and tūrya, it is called mahāmatta;
one should make the border and secondary border, having the tip of the border; indeed the maṇḍala is formed.

2.2.s:
etaddhi sarvatobhadraṃ rāśiyuktamataḥ param ..
śatapatraṃ vajranābhaṃ biṃbanābhaṃ sahasrakam .. 2.2.2.80 ..
2.2.d:
एतद्धि सर्वतोभद्रं राशियुक्तमतः परम् ॥
शतपत्रं वज्रनाभं बिंबनाभं सहस्रकम् ॥ 2.2.2.80 ॥
2.2.m:
This indeed is the sarvatobhadra; thereafter the one endowed with zodiacal signs:
the hundred-petalled, the vajranābha, the bimbanābha, the thousand-petalled,

2.2.s:
gajāhvaṃ ca gajākāraṃ madhye tu samalaṅkṛtam ..
catuścandre candrabimbaścandrakāṃtamudāhṛtam .. 81 ..
2.2.d:
गजाह्वं च गजाकारं मध्ये तु समलङ्कृतम् ॥
चतुश्चन्द्रे चन्द्रबिम्बश्चन्द्रकांतमुदाहृतम् ॥ 81 ॥
2.2.m:
and the one named gaja, shaped like an elephant, adorned in the middle;
and in the four-moon [maṇḍala], the lunar orb is declared as candrakānta.

2.2.s:
bahirdvādaśabhiḥ sūryaiḥ sūryākrāṃtaṃ prakīrtitam ..
śekharī tripuṭaṃ caiva śatapatraṃ ca prakramāt .. 82 ..
2.2.d:
बहिर्द्वादशभिः सूर्यैः सूर्याक्रांतं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
शेखरी त्रिपुटं चैव शतपत्रं च प्रक्रमात् ॥ 82 ॥
2.2.m: [The maṇḍala] bounded on the outside by twelve suns is declared as Sūryākrānta. / Śekharī, Tripuṭa, and Śatapatra in succession,

2.2.s:
sahasrameva viprendrāḥ padmānte yasya svastikam ..
svastikaṃ tadbhavedviprāḥ puṣkaraṃ vajrasaṃmatam .. 83 ..
2.2.d:
सहस्रमेव विप्रेन्द्राः पद्मान्ते यस्य स्वस्तिकम् ॥
स्वस्तिकं तद्भवेद्विप्राः पुष्करं वज्रसंमतम् ॥ 83 ॥
2.2.m: and Sahasra, O foremost of Brahmins; at the end of whose lotus there is a svastika, / that becomes Svastika, O Brahmins; Puṣkara is agreed to be [like] a vajra;

2.2.s:
cintāmaṇiṃ kuṃkumāṃśaṃ khātaṃ ca harivallabham ..
pañcasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca pañcasiṃhāsanaṃ viduḥ .. 84 ..
2.2.d:
चिन्तामणिं कुंकुमांशं खातं च हरिवल्लभम् ॥
पञ्चसिंहासनस्थं च पञ्चसिंहासनं विदुः ॥ 84 ॥
2.2.m: Cintāmaṇi, Kuṅkumāṃśa, Khāta, and Harivallabha; / and that which rests upon five lion-thrones is known as Pañcasiṃhāsana;

2.2.s:
tadvadvṛṣāsanaṃ jñeyaṃ śikhirūpaṃ śikhidhvajam ..
nārasiṃhaṃ padmagarbhaṃ kapotāsyaṃ tathā bhavet .. 85 ..
2.2.d:
तद्वद्वृषासनं ज्ञेयं शिखिरूपं शिखिध्वजम् ॥
नारसिंहं पद्मगर्भं कपोतास्यं तथा भवेत् ॥ 85 ॥
2.2.m: likewise Vṛṣāsana should be known, Śikhirūpa, Śikhidhvaja, / Nārasiṃha, Padmagarbha, and Kapotāsya likewise;

2.2.s:
gāruḍaṃ merugarbhaṃ ca nīlakaṇṭhaṃ narākṛtim ..
śatakratugajārūḍhaṃ śrībiṃbanavasūtrakam .. 86 ..
2.2.d:
गारुडं मेरुगर्भं च नीलकण्ठं नराकृतिम् ॥
शतक्रतुगजारूढं श्रीबिंबनवसूत्रकम् ॥ 86 ॥
2.2.m: Gāruḍa, Merugarbha, Nīlakaṇṭha, Narākṛti, / Śatakratugajārūḍha, Śrībimbanavasūtraka,

2.2.s:
aṣṭāsramaṣṭakoṇādyaṃ bahiḥ padmavanaṃ kṛtam ..
kāmadvayena puṭitaṃ sahasraṃ padmaveṣṭitam .. 87 ..
2.2.d:
अष्टास्रमष्टकोणाद्यं बहिः पद्मवनं कृतम् ॥
कामद्वयेन पुटितं सहस्रं पद्मवेष्टितम् ॥ 87 ॥
2.2.m: eight-sided, beginning with eight angles, having a lotus grove made outside; / encased by two kāmas, a thousand [petals] enclosed by lotuses;

2.2.s:
tryasragarbhaṃ paṅkajaṃ ca tryasraṃ tatparikīrtitam ..
aṣṭa patrāṇi vai meruṃ sumeruṃ tadviparyaye .. 88 ..
2.2.d:
त्र्यस्रगर्भं पङ्कजं च त्र्यस्रं तत्परिकीर्तितम् ॥
अष्ट पत्राणि वै मेरुं सुमेरुं तद्विपर्यये ॥ 88 ॥
2.2.m: having a triangular interior and a lotus, that is proclaimed as Tryasra. / Eight petals [make] Meru; the reverse of that is Sumeru;

2.2.s:
mahāmahāmerupṛṣṭhaṃ śatatrayacchadairvṛtam ..
chidravyaktiṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā mānena bho dvijāḥ .. 89 ..
vasu 8 dig 10 viṃśakaiścaiva 20 catvāriṃśat 40 śatārdhakam 50 ..
2.2.d:
महामहामेरुपृष्ठं शतत्रयच्छदैर्वृतम् ॥
छिद्रव्यक्तिं प्रवक्ष्यामि यथा मानेन भो द्विजाः ॥ 89 ॥
वसु 8 दिग् 10 विंशकैश्चैव 20 चत्वारिंशत् 40 शतार्धकम् 50 ॥
2.2.m:
Mahāmahāmerupṛṣṭha is surrounded by three hundred petals. / I shall declare the manifestation of the spaces according to measure, O Brahmins:
Eight (8), ten (10), twenty (20), forty (40), half a hundred (50),

2.2.s: daṃḍiśravaṇasaṃpanna 60 mākāśaṃ vasusaṃmitam .. 2.2.2.90 ..
2.2.d: दंडिश्रवणसंपन्न 60 माकाशं वसुसंमितम् ॥ 2.2.2.90 ॥
2.2.m: endowed with a stick and ears: sixty (60), the sky, measured by the Vasus (8),

2.2.s:
śataviṃśādhikaṃ caiva 120 dalāni tadanantaram ..
śuklaraktaṃ cāṣṭavaṇairbiṃboṣṭhaṃ paripūrayet .. 91 ..
2.2.d:
शतविंशाधिकं चैव 120 दलानि तदनन्तरम् ॥
शुक्लरक्तं चाष्टवणैर्बिंबोष्ठं परिपूरयेत् ॥ 91 ॥
2.2.m: and one hundred increased by twenty (120) petals thereafter. / With white, red, and eight colours one should fill the bimba rim;

2.2.s:
śuklena paṅkajaṃ tatra paścātkuryāttriveṣṭanam ..
śatapatramatho vakṣye bimbarājeti kathyate .. 92 ..
2.2.d:
शुक्लेन पङ्कजं तत्र पश्चात्कुर्यात्त्रिवेष्टनम् ॥
शतपत्रमथो वक्ष्ये बिम्बराजेति कथ्यते ॥ 92 ॥
2.2.m: there [one draws] a lotus in white, and afterwards makes a triple enclosure. / Now I shall declare the hundred-petalled [maṇḍala], called Bimbarāja:

2.2.s:
sthaṃḍile kuśahaste ca pūrvavadveṣṭayetkramāt ..
vasu 8 pañcakalā 16 pañcaviṃśakaṃ 25 tannapatrakāt .. 93 ..
2.2.d:
स्थंडिले कुशहस्ते च पूर्ववद्वेष्टयेत्क्रमात् ॥
वसु 8 पञ्चकला 16 पञ्चविंशकं 25 तन्नपत्रकात् ॥ 93 ॥
2.2.m: on the altar, with kuśa grass in hand, one should encircle [it] in order as before; / eight (8), five and a digit (16), twenty-five (25), from those nine petals,

2.2.s:
catvāriṃśattataḥ paścā 40 daṣṭottaraśataṃ 108 bhavet ..
śuklaṃ śoṇaṃ tathā pītaṃ śyāmaśuklairanaṃtaram .. 94 ..
2.2.d:
चत्वारिंशत्ततः पश्चा 40 दष्टोत्तरशतं 108 भवेत् ॥
शुक्लं शोणं तथा पीतं श्यामशुक्लैरनंतरम् ॥ 94 ॥
2.2.m: after that forty (40), [and then] there should be one hundred and eight (108); / with white, crimson, likewise yellow, and thereafter dark-blue and white;

2.2.s:
vilome dalasandhīni śākte śaive tu ṣaṭpuram ..
veṣṭayetpaṃcavarṇena śuklādīni samaṃtataḥ .. 95 ..
2.2.d:
विलोमे दलसन्धीनि शाक्ते शैवे तु षट्पुरम् ॥
वेष्टयेत्पंचवर्णेन शुक्लादीनि समंततः ॥ 95 ॥
2.2.m: in reverse order [one fills] the joints of the petals; in Śākta and Śaiva [rites] a six-city [design]. / One should encircle [it] on all sides with five colours, white and the rest;

2.2.s:
raktapītaiḥ samāstīrya koṇāñchuklena pūrayet ..
sthaṃḍile tārahastena aṣṭahastaṃ prakalpayet .. 96 ..
2.2.d:
रक्तपीतैः समास्तीर्य कोणाञ्छुक्लेन पूरयेत् ॥
स्थंडिले तारहस्तेन अष्टहस्तं प्रकल्पयेत् ॥ 96 ॥
2.2.m: having spread [them] with red and yellow, one should fill the corners with white. / On the altar, with an elevated cubit, one should prepare an eight-cubit [design],

2.2.s:
maṃḍalaṃ biṃbarājasya aṣṭottaradalairvṛtam ..
vasupañcaśaktiviṃśaccatvāriṃśacchatārddhakam .. 97 ..
2.2.d:
मंडलं बिंबराजस्य अष्टोत्तरदलैर्वृतम् ॥
वसुपञ्चशक्तिविंशच्चत्वारिंशच्छतार्द्धकम् ॥ 97 ॥
2.2.m: the maṇḍala of Bimbarāja, surrounded by a hundred and eight petals: / eight, five, śakti (six), twenty, forty, half a hundred,

2.2.s:
tryṛtupatraṃ suvṛttaṃ syādvṛttayuktaṃ sabilvakam ..
catvāriṃśaddvayaṃ caiva gaganena samāvṛtam .. 98 ..
2.2.d:
त्र्यृतुपत्रं सुवृत्तं स्याद्वृत्तयुक्तं सबिल्वकम् ॥
चत्वारिंशद्द्वयं चैव गगनेन समावृतम् ॥ 98 ॥
2.2.m: thirty-six petals, very circular, endowed with circles, along with bilva [leaves]; / twice forty (80), enclosed by the sky,

2.2.s:
śataṃ viṃśādhikaśataṃ dviśataṃ viṃśamuttamam ..
veṣṭanāṃse ca triśataṃ prakramādatha vardhayet .. 99 ..
2.2.d:
शतं विंशाधिकशतं द्विशतं विंशमुत्तमम् ॥
वेष्टनांसे च त्रिशतं प्रक्रमादथ वर्धयेत् ॥ 99 ॥
2.2.m: one hundred, one hundred and twenty, an excellent two hundred and twenty; / and at the shoulder of the enclosure three hundred, increasing in due order.

2.2.s:
lavalyābhamatho vakṣye sārddhahastapramāṇataḥ ..
navaviṃśaṃ kalpayettu catuḥsūtrāṇi pātayet .. 2.2.2.100 ..
2.2.d:
लवल्याभमथो वक्ष्ये सार्द्धहस्तप्रमाणतः ॥
नवविंशं कल्पयेत्तु चतुःसूत्राणि पातयेत् ॥ 2.2.2.100 ॥
2.2.m: Now I shall declare the Lavalyābha, having the measure of one and a half cubits; / one should fashion twenty-nine, and cast down four threads,

2.2.s:
dakṣiṇottarataścaiva tadvadeva vijānīhi ..
pītena retapuḥṭitā madhye śuklaṃ vibhāvyate .. 101 ..
2.2.d:
दक्षिणोत्तरतश्चैव तद्वदेव विजानीहि ॥
पीतेन रेतपुःटिता मध्ये शुक्लं विभाव्यते ॥ 101 ॥
2.2.m: and likewise in the south and north; know it thus. / Enclosed with yellow lines, white is perceived in the middle;

2.2.s:
grahapakṣennapītena madhye raktaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ..
sarvā rekhāśca śuklena pauṣṭike pītamādiśet .. 102 ..
2.2.d:
ग्रहपक्षेन्नपीतेन मध्ये रक्तं प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
सर्वा रेखाश्च शुक्लेन पौष्टिके पीतमादिशेत् ॥ 102 ॥
2.2.m: in the planetary wing, yellow; in the middle, red is established. / All lines are [drawn] in white; in a rite of nourishment one should prescribe yellow;

2.2.s:
saśāṃtike na yoktavyaṃ kāme raktaṃ vinirdiśet ..
madhye tu paṅkajaṃ raktaṃ yugme somasya paṅkajam .. 103 ..
2.2.d:
सशांतिके न योक्तव्यं कामे रक्तं विनिर्दिशेत् ॥
मध्ये तु पङ्कजं रक्तं युग्मे सोमस्य पङ्कजम् ॥ 103 ॥
2.2.m: it must not be used in an appeasement rite; in a desire-rite one should prescribe red. / In the middle [is] a red lotus; in the pair, the lotus of Soma;

2.2.s:
śuklavarṇena tatkuryātpītavarṇamudasya ca ..
aiśānyāṃ cottare bhāge guroḥ pītaṃ tu paṅkajam .. 104 ..
2.2.d:
शुक्लवर्णेन तत्कुर्यात्पीतवर्णमुदस्य च ॥
ऐशान्यां चोत्तरे भागे गुरोः पीतं तु पङ्कजम् ॥ 104 ॥
2.2.m: one should make that with a white colour, throwing off the yellow colour. / In the north-eastern part, the lotus of Guru is yellow;

2.2.s:
pūrvasyāṃ diśi śukrasya paṅkajaṃ śubhravarṇakam ..
vāruṇe tu śanaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ nairṛtyāṃ dhūmravarṇakam .. 105 ..
2.2.d:
पूर्वस्यां दिशि शुक्रस्य पङ्कजं शुभ्रवर्णकम् ॥
वारुणे तु शनैः कृष्णं नैरृत्यां धूम्रवर्णकम् ॥ 105 ॥
2.2.m: in the eastern direction the lotus of Śukra is of a bright white colour; / in the western [direction] the black [lotus] of Śani; in the south-western [direction] a smoke-coloured one

2.2.s:
rāhoḥ prakalpayettacca ketorapi niyojayet ..
vāyavyāṃ diśi saṃyojya paṅkajaṃ vilikhettataḥ .. .. 106 ..
2.2.d:
राहोः प्रकल्पयेत्तच्च केतोरपि नियोजयेत् ॥
वायव्यां दिशि संयोज्य पङ्कजं विलिखेत्ततः ॥ ॥ 106 ॥
2.2.m: one should prepare for Rāhu, and one should assign [it] to Ketu also; / having joined it in the north-western direction, one should then draw the lotus.

2.2.s:
vilome dalasandhīni pūrayatsuvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
bahiḥ pañcarajaiḥ kāryaṃ yuvadurgavibhūṣitam .. 107 ..
2.2.d:
विलोमे दलसन्धीनि पूरयत्सुविचक्षणः ॥
बहिः पञ्चरजैः कार्यं युवदुर्गविभूषितम् ॥ 107 ॥
2.2.m: The wise man should fill the intersections of the petals in reverse order. / Outside, it is to be made with five powders, adorned with a young fortress;

2.2.s:
pūrvapaścimadigbhāge śuklaṃ syāddvāradeśataḥ ..
dakṣiṇottaradigbhāge raktameva praśasyate .. 108 ..
2.2.d:
पूर्वपश्चिमदिग्भागे शुक्लं स्याद्द्वारदेशतः ॥
दक्षिणोत्तरदिग्भागे रक्तमेव प्रशस्यते ॥ 108 ॥
2.2.m: in the eastern and western quarters it should be white, by the door area; / in the southern and northern quarters red alone is commended.

2.2.s:
tristhāne samamadhye ca dvādaśāṃgulaprakramāt ..
dvihastādāvaṃgulena varddhayettadvibhāgataḥ .. .. 109 ..
2.2.d:
त्रिस्थाने सममध्ये च द्वादशांगुलप्रक्रमात् ॥
द्विहस्तादावंगुलेन वर्द्धयेत्तद्विभागतः ॥ ॥ 109 ॥
2.2.m: In three places, evenly in the middle, by the method of twelve angulas; / starting from two cubits, one should increase [it] by angula according to that division.

2.2.s:
pañcābjamaṇḍalaṃ jñeyaṃ catuḥsvastikabhūṣitam .. 2.2.2.110 ..
mūlyakathanavarṇanam
2.2.d:
पञ्चाब्जमण्डलं ज्ञेयं चतुःस्वस्तिकभूषितम् ॥ 2.2.2.110 ॥
मूल्यकथनवर्णनम्
2.2.m:
This is known as the Pañcābja-maṇḍala, adorned with four svastikas.
Description of the Declaration of Values

2.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
na kuryāddakṣiṇāhīnaṃ mānahīnaṃ na kārayet ..
amānena hato yajñastasmānmānaṃ praśasyate .. 1 ..
2.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
न कुर्याद्दक्षिणाहीनं मानहीनं न कारयेत् ॥
अमानेन हतो यज्ञस्तस्मान्मानं प्रशस्यते ॥ 1 ॥
2.2.m: Sūta said: / One should not perform [a rite] devoid of sacrificial fee, nor make it lacking in proper measure; / a sacrifice is ruined by lack of measure, therefore proper measure is praised.

2.2.s:
yasya yajñasya yanmānaṃ tattu tenaiva yojayet ..
amānena kṛte sarve vrajeyurnarakaṃ punaḥ .. 2 ..
2.2.d:
यस्य यज्ञस्य यन्मानं तत्तु तेनैव योजयेत् ॥
अमानेन कृते सर्वे व्रजेयुर्नरकं पुनः ॥ 2 ॥
2.2.m: Whatever is the measure of a given sacrifice, one should furnish it only with that; / if it is performed without proper measure, all [involved] will go to hell again.

2.2.s:
ācāryahotṛbrahmāṇo vidhijñaḥ sahakartṛkaḥ ..
yasya yajñe pāpakaśca jātihīnaḥ praveśayet .. 3 ..
2.2.d:
आचार्यहोतृब्रह्माणो विधिज्ञः सहकर्तृकः ॥
यस्य यज्ञे पापकश्च जातिहीनः प्रवेशयेत् ॥ 3 ॥
2.2.m: The preceptor, the hotṛ, and the brahmā [priests] should know the rules, along with the patron. / In whose sacrifice a sinful and low-caste person enters,

2.2.s:
aśītibhirvarāṭaiśca paṇa ityabhidhīyate ..
taistu ṣoḍaśabhirjñeyaṃ purāṇaṃ saptabhistu taiḥ .. 4 ..
2.2.d:
अशीतिभिर्वराटैश्च पण इत्यभिधीयते ॥
तैस्तु षोडशभिर्ज्ञेयं पुराणं सप्तभिस्तु तैः ॥ 4 ॥
2.2.m: By eighty cowries a paṇa is named; / by sixteen of those a purāṇa is known; by seven of those,

2.2.s:
rājataiścāṣṭabhiḥ svarṇaṃ yajñādau dakṣiṇā smṛtā ..
mahārāme dvisauvarṇaṃ kūpe svarṇārdhameva ca .. 5 ..
2.2.d:
राजतैश्चाष्टभिः स्वर्णं यज्ञादौ दक्षिणा स्मृता ॥
महारामे द्विसौवर्णं कूपे स्वर्णार्धमेव च ॥ 5 ॥
2.2.m: and by eight of silver, a suvarṇa; [this] is remembered as the sacrificial fee in a sacrifice and other [rites]. / In a great grove [consecration] two gold coins; and at a well half a gold coin;

2.2.s:
tulasyāmalakīyāge suvarṇaikaṃ pracakṣate ..
yakṛlloke ca sauvarṇaṃ lakṣe svarṇaṃ catuṣṭayam .. 6 ..
2.2.d:
तुलस्यामलकीयागे सुवर्णैकं प्रचक्षते ॥
यकृल्लोके च सौवर्णं लक्षे स्वर्णं चतुष्टयम् ॥ 6 ॥
2.2.m: at a sacrifice to Tulasī and Āmalakī they declare one gold coin; / among common people a gold coin, and at a lakṣa [recitation/homa] four gold coins;

2.2.s:
navame koṭihome ca devatānāṃ ca sthāpane ..
prāsādasya samutsarge aṣṭādaśa suvarṇakāḥ .. 7 ..
2.2.d:
नवमे कोटिहोमे च देवतानां च स्थापने ॥
प्रासादस्य समुत्सर्गे अष्टादश सुवर्णकाः ॥ 7 ॥
2.2.m: in the ninth [rite], at a koṭi-homa, and at the installation of deities, / and at the dedication of a temple: eighteen gold coins;

2.2.s:
taḍāge puṣkariṇyāṃ ca ardhārdhaṃ pari kīrtitam ..
mahādāne ca dīkṣāyāṃ vṛṣotsarge ca sattamāḥ .. 8 ..
2.2.d:
तडागे पुष्करिण्यां च अर्धार्धं परि कीर्तितम् ॥
महादाने च दीक्षायां वृषोत्सर्गे च सत्तमाः ॥ 8 ॥
2.2.m: at a pond and at a lotus-pool, half of half is proclaimed; / in a great gift, at initiation, and at the release of a bull, O best of men;

2.2.s:
jīvataśca vṛṣotsarge gayāśrāddhe tathaiva ca ..
avittasādhyamānena yajñaṃ kuryātkalauyuge .. 9 ..
2.2.d:
जीवतश्च वृषोत्सर्गे गयाश्राद्धे तथैव च ॥
अवित्तसाध्यमानेन यज्ञं कुर्यात्कलौयुगे ॥ 9 ॥
2.2.m: and at the release of a bull during lifetime, likewise at the Gayā-śrāddha: / in the Kali age one should perform sacrifice by the measure attainable without [great] wealth.

2.2.s:
daṃpatyośca vṛṣotsarge mānamekamudāhṛtam ..
bahubhiḥ kiyamāṇopi yāga eko mahottamaiḥ .. 2.2.3.10 ..
2.2.d:
दंपत्योश्च वृषोत्सर्गे मानमेकमुदाहृतम् ॥
बहुभिः कियमाणोपि याग एको महोत्तमैः ॥ 2.2.3.10 ॥
2.2.m: And for a married couple releasing a bull, a single measure is declared; / even if performed by many, a sacrifice is one, O most eminent ones.

2.2.s:
rājñaḥ karagrahe caiva dīkṣāyāṃ dāna karmaṇi ..
aśītirattikaṃ svarṇaṃ śravaṇe bhāratasya ca .. 11 ..
2.2.d:
राज्ञः करग्रहे चैव दीक्षायां दान कर्मणि ॥
अशीतिरत्तिकं स्वर्णं श्रवणे भारतस्य च ॥ 11 ॥
2.2.m: At a king's marriage, at initiation, and in an act of giving, / and at the hearing of the Mahābhārata, [the fee is] gold of eighty rattis;

2.2.s:
grahayāge pratiṣṭhāyāṃ suvarṇaśatarattikaḥ ..
lakṣahome cāyute ca koṭyāmeva vidhīyate .. .. 12 ..
2.2.d:
ग्रहयागे प्रतिष्ठायां सुवर्णशतरत्तिकः ॥
लक्षहोमे चायुते च कोट्यामेव विधीयते ॥ ॥ 12 ॥
2.2.m: in a planetary sacrifice and in a consecration, a gold coin of a hundred rattis; / in a hundred-thousand oblation, in a ten-thousand oblation, and in a ten-million [oblation] it is prescribed.

2.2.s:
devānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca dānaṃ yasya prakalpitam ..
tasyaiva deyaṃ taddānaṃ sāṃgopāṃgaṃ sadakṣiṇam .. 13 ..
2.2.d:
देवानां ब्राह्मणानां च दानं यस्य प्रकल्पितम् ॥
तस्यैव देयं तद्दानं सांगोपांगं सदक्षिणम् ॥ 13 ॥
2.2.m: A gift that is intended for gods and Brahmins / must be given to that very one, complete with all its limbs and secondary parts, along with a sacrificial fee.

2.2.s:
nānāsya kiñciddātavyaṃ saṃgabhaṃgo bhavedyataḥ ..
gṛhī tu kṛtvā yaddānaṃ tadā tasya ṛṇī bhavet .. 14 ..
2.2.d:
नानास्य किञ्चिद्दातव्यं संगभंगो भवेद्यतः ॥
गृही तु कृत्वा यद्दानं तदा तस्य ऋणी भवेत् ॥ 14 ॥
2.2.m: Nothing of this should be withheld, because [otherwise] a rupture of the rite occurs; / but a householder who makes a gift, [if not giving the fee], becomes his debtor.

2.2.s:
yajñeṣu home yaddravyaṃ kāṣṭhamājyādikaṃ ca yat ..
tannāyakasya pūjāyāṃ dravyamāhurvinirmitam .. 15 ..
2.2.d:
यज्ञेषु होमे यद्द्रव्यं काष्ठमाज्यादिकं च यत् ॥
तन्नायकस्य पूजायां द्रव्यमाहुर्विनिर्मितम् ॥ 15 ॥
2.2.m: Whatever substance—wood, clarified butter, and so forth—is [used] in sacrificial oblations, / they say that substance was produced for the worship of its presiding deity.

2.2.s:
anādidevatārcāyāṃ pūjāsnānādikarmaṇi ..
yasyārhaṇādikaṃ dravyaṃ tasya devasya tadbhavet .. 16 ..
2.2.d:
अनादिदेवतार्चायां पूजास्नानादिकर्मणि ॥
यस्यार्हणादिकं द्रव्यं तस्य देवस्य तद्भवेत् ॥ 16 ॥
2.2.m: In the worship of beginningless deities, in rites such as worship and bathing, / the substance intended for honouring and the like belongs to that deity.

2.2.s:
pratyakṣaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādyajñadānavratādike ..
adakṣiṇaṃ naiva kāryaṃ prakuryādbhūridakṣiṇam .. 17 ..
2.2.d:
प्रत्यक्षं दक्षिणां दद्याद्यज्ञदानव्रतादिके ॥
अदक्षिणं नैव कार्यं प्रकुर्याद्भूरिदक्षिणम् ॥ 17 ॥
2.2.m: One should give a sacrificial fee directly in rites such as sacrifices, gifts, and votive observances; / [a rite] should never be performed without a sacrificial fee; one should provide an abundant sacrificial fee.

2.2.s:
ato dattaṃ purā dattaṃ dātavyaṃ caiva saṃprati ..
parasvodārabuddhīnāṃ sā sā hi dakṣiṇā bhavet .. 18 ..
2.2.d:
अतो दत्तं पुरा दत्तं दातव्यं चैव संप्रति ॥
परस्वोदारबुद्धीनां सा सा हि दक्षिणा भवेत् ॥ 18 ॥
2.2.m: Therefore, what was given formerly, and what is to be given now— / for those of generous mind regarding others' property, that indeed becomes the sacrificial fee.

2.2.s:
dattāni vidhivatpuṃsāṃ devadānāni yāni hi ..
dāsīdāsagavādīni manasā yāni karhi cit .. 19 ..
2.2.d:
दत्तानि विधिवत्पुंसां देवदानानि यानि हि ॥
दासीदासगवादीनि मनसा यानि कर्हि चित् ॥ 19 ॥
2.2.m: The divine gifts given according to rule by men, / such as female and male slaves, cattle, and the like, which were ever [intended] in the mind—

2.2.s:
dātavyānyapi tānyeva kārayetparivarttanam ..
ekasyānekadānaṃ ca dadetkaścitpṛthakpṛthak .. 2.2.3.20 ..
2.2.d:
दातव्यान्यपि तान्येव कारयेत्परिवर्त्तनम् ॥
एकस्यानेकदानं च ददेत्कश्चित्पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 2.2.3.20 ॥
2.2.m: even those must be given, [or] one should cause an exchange; / and one may give multiple gifts for one [obligation], severally.

2.2.s:
varaṇaṃ ca kadā kuryāttantre kuryācca dakṣiṇām ..
ratnasya dakṣiṇā deyā kāṃcanaṃ samudāhṛtam .. 21 ..
2.2.d:
वरणं च कदा कुर्यात्तन्त्रे कुर्याच्च दक्षिणाम् ॥
रत्नस्य दक्षिणा देया कांचनं समुदाहृतम् ॥ 21 ॥
2.2.m: And when should one make the formal appointment? One should give the sacrificial fee in the ritual procedure: / for a gem, gold is declared to be the sacrificial fee to be given;

2.2.s:
kāṃcanasya bhavedraupyaṃ raupye kāṃcanamudviśet ..
bhūmerbhūmirdakṣiṇā syādvastrasya vastradakṣiṇā .. 22 ..
2.2.d:
कांचनस्य भवेद्रौप्यं रौप्ये कांचनमुद्विशेत् ॥
भूमेर्भूमिर्दक्षिणा स्याद्वस्त्रस्य वस्त्रदक्षिणा ॥ 22 ॥
2.2.m: for gold, there should be silver; for silver, one should designate gold; / for land, the sacrificial fee should be land; for cloth, the sacrificial fee is cloth;

2.2.s:
pānīyasya tu pānīyaṃ vrīhīṇāṃ vrīhidakṣiṇā ..
gajasya dakṣiṇā chāgo hyaśvasya meṣa īritaḥ .. ..23..
2.2.d:
पानीयस्य तु पानीयं व्रीहीणां व्रीहिदक्षिणा ॥
गजस्य दक्षिणा छागो ह्यश्वस्य मेष ईरितः ॥ ॥23॥
2.2.m: for water, indeed, water; for rice, the sacrificial fee is rice; / for an elephant, the sacrificial fee is a goat; for a horse, a ram is declared;

2.2.s:
paśūnāṃ ca catuṣpādā devasya devadakṣiṇā ..
yajño mānasya ṣaḍbhāgo dviguṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 24 ..
2.2.d:
पशूनां च चतुष्पादा देवस्य देवदक्षिणा ॥
यज्ञो मानस्य षड्भागो द्विगुणः परिकीर्तितः ॥ 24 ॥
2.2.m: and for animals, four-footed [beasts]; for a god, a divine sacrificial fee; / the sacrifice is proclaimed to be a sixth part of the standard, doubled.

2.2.s:
ācāryasyaiva bhāgaikaṃ yajamānaḥ pradāsyati ..
pāpakaistu kalatrāṇāṃ bhāgaikaṃ tadanaṃtaram .. 25 ..
2.2.d:
आचार्यस्यैव भागैकं यजमानः प्रदास्यति ॥
पापकैस्तु कलत्राणां भागैकं तदनंतरम् ॥ 25 ॥
2.2.m: The patron of the sacrifice shall give one share to the preceptor alone; / thereafter, along with sinful ones, one share to the wives;

2.2.s:
pātrāṇāmṛtvigādīnāṃ bhāgatrayamudāhṛtam ..
sarvasattvasya bhāgaikaṃ svalpaṃ cecchiṣṭagauravāt ..26.ḥ
ācāryādyaṃśataḥ kaścitkṣīṇavittaṃ samāharet ..
amūlyaṃ vargamūlyaṃ yadbhavedvai dakṣiṇottamā .. 27 ..
2.2.d:
पात्राणामृत्विगादीनां भागत्रयमुदाहृतम् ॥
सर्वसत्त्वस्य भागैकं स्वल्पं चेच्छिष्टगौरवात् ॥26.ः
आचार्याद्यंशतः कश्चित्क्षीणवित्तं समाहरेत् ॥
अमूल्यं वर्गमूल्यं यद्भवेद्वै दक्षिणोत्तमा ॥ 27 ॥
2.2.m: three shares are declared for worthy recipients such as the officiating priests; / one share is for all living beings, or small out of respect for what remains. / From the portion of the preceptor and others, one may make up for deficient wealth; / that which is priceless or the value of the class indeed becomes the highest sacrificial fee.

2.2.s:
mānāśaktau tu yajñānāṃ yaddeyaṃ yajñasiddhaye ..
devatā pustakaṃ ratnaṃ gāvo dhānyaṃ tilāstathā ..28..
2.2.d:
मानाशक्तौ तु यज्ञानां यद्देयं यज्ञसिद्धये ॥
देवता पुस्तकं रत्नं गावो धान्यं तिलास्तथा ॥28॥
2.2.m: When unable to meet the standard of sacrifices, what should be given for the success of the sacrifice: / a deity, a book, a jewel, cattle, grain, and sesame seeds,

2.2.s:
nameruphalapuṣpāṇi deyānyetāni sarvataḥ ..
catuścakrāṃkito yastu sāṃdro vṛtto janārdanaḥ ..29..
2.2.d:
नमेरुफलपुष्पाणि देयान्येतानि सर्वतः ॥
चतुश्चक्रांकितो यस्तु सांद्रो वृत्तो जनार्दनः ॥29॥
2.2.m: nameru fruits and flowers—these are to be given everywhere; / that which is marked with four discs, solid, and round is Janārdana;

2.2.s:
devatāpratimādyaṃ ca śironābhistathaiva ca ..
śvetaliṃgaṃ ratnaliṃgamindranīlādikaṃ ca yat ..2.2.3.30..
2.2.d:
देवताप्रतिमाद्यं च शिरोनाभिस्तथैव च ॥
श्वेतलिंगं रत्नलिंगमिन्द्रनीलादिकं च यत् ॥2.2.3.30॥
2.2.m: an image of a deity and so forth, as well as the head and navel, / a white liṅga, a jeweled liṅga, and what is sapphire and the like,

2.2.s:
dakṣiṇāvartaśaṃkhaṃ ca harivaṃśastathā khilaḥ ..
kapilo nīlavṛṣabhaḥ somadhānyaṃ tathaiva ca .. 31 ..
2.2.d:
दक्षिणावर्तशंखं च हरिवंशस्तथा खिलः ॥
कपिलो नीलवृषभः सोमधान्यं तथैव च ॥ 31 ॥
2.2.m: a right-spiraling conch, and the entire Harivaṃśa, / a tawny [cow], a blue bull, and likewise somadhānya grain:

2.2.s:
amūlyānyāhuretāni dattvānantaphalāni ca ..
svarṇapādo bhavenmūlyaṃ śālagrāmasya dakṣiṇā .. 32 ..
2.2.d:
अमूल्यान्याहुरेतानि दत्त्वानन्तफलानि च ॥
स्वर्णपादो भवेन्मूल्यं शालग्रामस्य दक्षिणा ॥ 32 ॥
2.2.m: these they call priceless, yielding endless fruit when given; / a quarter-share of gold should be the value, the sacrificial fee for a śālagrāma stone;

2.2.s:
kṣudraliṃge svarṇamūlyaṃ pādārdhaṃ śrīdharepi ca ..
anantonantamityuktaṃ pādārdhaṃ bāṇaliṅgake .. 33 ..
2.2.d:
क्षुद्रलिंगे स्वर्णमूल्यं पादार्धं श्रीधरेपि च ॥
अनन्तोनन्तमित्युक्तं पादार्धं बाणलिङ्गके ॥ 33 ॥
2.2.m: for a small liṅga, the value is gold, and half a quarter-share for a śrīdhara; / ananta is said to be endless; half a quarter-share for a bāṇaliṅga;

2.2.s:
yathā pustakamātreṇa svarṇa pādārdhamiṣyate ..
jyotiṣerdhaṃ suvarṇasya rajatārdhaṃ vṛṣe tathā .. 34 ..
2.2.d:
यथा पुस्तकमात्रेण स्वर्ण पादार्धमिष्यते ॥
ज्योतिषेर्धं सुवर्णस्य रजतार्धं वृषे तथा ॥ 34 ॥
2.2.m: for a book alone, half a quarter-share of gold is desired; / for Jyotiṣa, half a suvarṇa, and likewise half a silver [piece] for a bull;

2.2.s:
harivaṃśe ślokaśate svarṇamekaṃ prakīrtitam ..
dharmaśāstrasya sāhasre rajatatrayamīritam.. 35 ..
2.2.d:
हरिवंशे श्लोकशते स्वर्णमेकं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
धर्मशास्त्रस्य साहस्रे रजतत्रयमीरितम्॥ 35 ॥
2.2.m: for a hundred verses of the Harivaṃśa, one gold [coin] is proclaimed; / for a thousand [verses] of the Dharmaśāstra, three silver [coins] are declared;

2.2.s:
kapilāyāṃ suvarṇārdhaṃ dhenumātre purāṇakam ..
prāyaścittavidhau jñeyaṃ dhenumātraṃ purāṇakam .. 36 ..
2.2.d:
कपिलायां सुवर्णार्धं धेनुमात्रे पुराणकम् ॥
प्रायश्चित्तविधौ ज्ञेयं धेनुमात्रं पुराणकम् ॥ 36 ॥
2.2.m: for a tawny cow, half a suvarṇa; for an ordinary cow, a purāṇa; / in the rule of expiation, an ordinary cow is known to be a purāṇa;

2.2.s:
purāṇatritayaṃ cānye vīryahīne dvayaṃ bhavet ..
kṛṣṇe vṛṣe ṣaṭpurāṇaṃ śvete navapurāṇakam ..37..
2.2.d:
पुराणत्रितयं चान्ये वीर्यहीने द्वयं भवेत् ॥
कृष्णे वृषे षट्पुराणं श्वेते नवपुराणकम् ॥37॥
2.2.m: and three purāṇas for another, [or] there should be two for one lacking vigor; / for a black bull, six purāṇas; for a white, nine purāṇas;

2.2.s:
dvātriṃśacca purāṇaṃ syādvṛṣe nīle tathaiva ca ..
nameroḥ praticakre ca dvādaśa svarṇarattikāḥ .. .. 38 ..
2.2.d:
द्वात्रिंशच्च पुराणं स्याद्वृषे नीले तथैव च ॥
नमेरोः प्रतिचक्रे च द्वादश स्वर्णरत्तिकाः ॥ ॥ 38 ॥
2.2.m: and there should be thirty-two purāṇas for a blue bull; / and for each disc of a nameru, twelve golden rattikās;

2.2.s:
mūlyaṃ śrīphalamātre'pi purāṇatritayaṃ bhavet ..
paṅktyāpi turyakaṃ vivātkalau paṇavyavasthayā .. 39 ..
2.2.d:
मूल्यं श्रीफलमात्रेऽपि पुराणत्रितयं भवेत् ॥
पङ्क्त्यापि तुर्यकं विवात्कलौ पणव्यवस्थया ॥ 39 ॥
2.2.m: for an ordinary śrīphala, the value should be three purāṇas; / even by a row, one fourth [...], according to the regulation of paṇas in the Kali age;

2.2.s:
dhātrīphalasya pratyekaṃ bhavedrajatamā ṣakam ..
etānyāhuḥ praśastāni mūlayoge paraṃ viduḥ .. 2.2.3.40 .. ..
mūlyadānavarṇanam
2.2.d:
धात्रीफलस्य प्रत्येकं भवेद्रजतमा षकम् ॥
एतान्याहुः प्रशस्तानि मूलयोगे परं विदुः ॥ 2.2.3.40 ॥ ॥
मूल्यदानवर्णनम्
2.2.m:
for an emblic myrobalan fruit, each should be a silver māṣaka; / these they call praiseworthy; they know the supreme in the employment of roots.
Description of the Gift of Values

2.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
pūrṇapātramatho vakṣye yajñe sādhāraṇe'pi ca ..
kāmahome bhavenmuṣṭirmuṣṭayoṣṭau tu kuñcikā .. 1 ..
2.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
पूर्णपात्रमथो वक्ष्ये यज्ञे साधारणेऽपि च ॥
कामहोमे भवेन्मुष्टिर्मुष्टयोष्टौ तु कुञ्चिका ॥ 1 ॥
2.2.m: Sūta said: / Now I shall declare the full vessel, even in an ordinary sacrifice: / in an optional oblation, there should be a handful, and eight handfuls are a kuñcikā;

2.2.s:
ekaika kuñcimānena kuryātpātrāṇi vai sadā ..
pātrāṇi ca pṛthakkṛtvā sthāpayeddvāradeśataḥ .. 2 ..
2.2.d:
एकैक कुञ्चिमानेन कुर्यात्पात्राणि वै सदा ॥
पात्राणि च पृथक्कृत्वा स्थापयेद्द्वारदेशतः ॥ 2 ॥
2.2.m: one should always make vessels with the measure of each single kuñci; / having made the vessels separate, one should place them at the doorway.

2.2.s:
siddhānāṃ khaḍgadhārāṇāṃ pratyekasya dinakramāt ..
tatraiva dadyā nnānyatra na kuryādvyatyayaṃ kvacit .. 3 ..
2.2.d:
सिद्धानां खड्गधाराणां प्रत्येकस्य दिनक्रमात् ॥
तत्रैव दद्या न्नान्यत्र न कुर्याद्व्यत्ययं क्वचित् ॥ 3 ॥
2.2.m: For perfected ones bearing swords, for each in daily order, / one should give right there, not elsewhere; one should never make a transposition anywhere.

2.2.s:
kuṇḍānāṃ kuḍmalānāṃ ca vedanaṃ yādṛśaṃ śṛṇu ..
caturasrapadasyāpi raupyārdhaṃ ca kalau yuge .. 4 ..
2.2.d:
कुण्डानां कुड्मलानां च वेदनं यादृशं शृणु ॥
चतुरस्रपदस्यापि रौप्यार्धं च कलौ युगे ॥ 4 ॥
2.2.m: Hear what the wage is for sacrificial pits and buds: / even for a square space, half a silver [coin] in the Kali age;

2.2.s:
dve raupye sarvatobhadre krauñcaghrāṇe caturthakam..
mahāsiṃhāsane pañca daśapātre tadardhakam .. 5 ..
2.2.d:
द्वे रौप्ये सर्वतोभद्रे क्रौञ्चघ्राणे चतुर्थकम्॥
महासिंहासने पञ्च दशपात्रे तदर्धकम् ॥ 5 ॥
2.2.m: two silver [coins] for a sarvatobhadra; a fourth for a krauñca's beak; / five for a great throne; half of that for a ten-vessel;

2.2.s:
sahasrāre merupṛṣṭhe turyaraupyavṛṣādhikam ..
vṛṣe gale ca vṛṣabhaṃ śeṣe raupyasahasrakam .. 6 ..
2.2.d:
सहस्रारे मेरुपृष्ठे तुर्यरौप्यवृषाधिकम् ॥
वृषे गले च वृषभं शेषे रौप्यसहस्रकम् ॥ 6 ॥
2.2.m: for a thousand-spoked one on the back of Meru, a fourth silver [coin] plus a bull; / on a bull and on a neck, a bull; on the remainder, a thousand silver [coins];

2.2.s:
caturasrasya nirmāṇe svarṇapādaḥ kalau yuge ..
mahākuṇḍe tu dviguṇaṃ vṛtte raupyaṃ nivedayet .. 7 ..
2.2.d:
चतुरस्रस्य निर्माणे स्वर्णपादः कलौ युगे ॥
महाकुण्डे तु द्विगुणं वृत्ते रौप्यं निवेदयेत् ॥ 7 ॥
2.2.m: in the construction of a square one, a quarter of gold in the Kali age; / in a great sacrificial pit, double that; in a round one, one should present silver;

2.2.s:
padmakuṇḍe tu vṛṣabhamardha candre tu raupyakam ..
yonikuṇḍe dadeddhenumaṣṭārdhasvarṇamāṣakam .. 8 ..
2.2.d:
पद्मकुण्डे तु वृषभमर्ध चन्द्रे तु रौप्यकम् ॥
योनिकुण्डे ददेद्धेनुमष्टार्धस्वर्णमाषकम् ॥ 8 ॥
2.2.m: in a lotus sacrificial pit, a bull; in a crescent-shaped one, a silver [coin]; / in a vulva-shaped sacrificial pit, one should give a cow, [or] four golden māṣakas;

2.2.s:
ṣaḍasre tu tadardhaṃ syādyāge māṣadvayaṃ bhavet ..
śaive codyāpane caiva pratyahnā svarṇamāṣakam .. 9 ..
2.2.d:
षडस्रे तु तदर्धं स्याद्यागे माषद्वयं भवेत् ॥
शैवे चोद्यापने चैव प्रत्यह्ना स्वर्णमाषकम् ॥ 9 ॥
2.2.m: in a hexagonal one, it should be half of that; in a sacrifice, it should be two māṣakas; / in a Śaiva concluding rite, a golden māṣaka per day;

2.2.s:
dāraṇe hastamātraṃ syātsvarṇakṛṣṇakalaṃ bhavet ..
iṣṭikākaraṇe caiva pratyahnā syātpaṇadvayam .. 2.2.4.10 ..
2.2.d:
दारणे हस्तमात्रं स्यात्स्वर्णकृष्णकलं भवेत् ॥
इष्टिकाकरणे चैव प्रत्यह्ना स्यात्पणद्वयम् ॥ 2.2.4.10 ॥
2.2.m: in splitting, for one cubit it should be a gold kṛṣṇakala; / and in the making of bricks, it should be two paṇas per day;

2.2.s:
khaṇḍe daśavarāṭaṃ syādbṛ hanmāne tu kākiṇī ..
taḍāge puṣkariṇyāṃ ca khanane prathamāṃgake .. 11 ..
2.2.d:
खण्डे दशवराटं स्याद्बृ हन्माने तु काकिणी ॥
तडागे पुष्करिण्यां च खनने प्रथमांगके ॥ 11 ॥
2.2.m: in a piece, it should be ten cowries; in a large measure, a kākiṇī; / in a tank and in a lotus-pool, in digging the first section,

2.2.s:
saptahastamite kuṇḍe niṣṭhe ābaddhamātrakam ..
purāṇasya ca ekāṃśaṃ vetanaṃ parikīrtitam .. 12 ..
2.2.d:
सप्तहस्तमिते कुण्डे निष्ठे आबद्धमात्रकम् ॥
पुराणस्य च एकांशं वेतनं परिकीर्तितम् ॥ 12 ॥
2.2.m: in a sacrificial pit measuring seven cubits, when completed and enclosed, / one part of a purāṇa is declared to be the wage;

2.2.s:
vardhayetpaṇamātreṇa nimne patre ca prakramāt ..
bṛhatkūpasya nirmāṇe pratyahaṃ ca paṇadvayam .. 13 ..
2.2.d:
वर्धयेत्पणमात्रेण निम्ने पत्रे च प्रक्रमात् ॥
बृहत्कूपस्य निर्माणे प्रत्यहं च पणद्वयम् ॥ 13 ॥
2.2.m: one should increase [it] by merely a paṇa in the lower part and in order; / in the construction of a large well, two paṇas each day;

2.2.s:
śaile jñeyaṃ kāñcanasya rattikā gṛhakarmaṇi..
koṣṭhe jñeyaṃ sārddhapaṇaṃ raṃgādiracite paṇam..14..
2.2.d:
शैले ज्ञेयं काञ्चनस्य रत्तिका गृहकर्मणि॥
कोष्ठे ज्ञेयं सार्द्धपणं रंगादिरचिते पणम्॥14॥
2.2.m: in stone, a rattikā of gold should be known; in house construction, / in a storehouse, a paṇa and a half should be known; in one decorated with colors and the like, a paṇa;

2.2.s:
vṛkṣāṇāṃ ropaṇe dadyātpratyahnā sārdhamāṣakam ..
setubaṃdhe ca paṃkile ca paṇadvayaṃ ca kākiṇī .. 15 ..
2.2.d:
वृक्षाणां रोपणे दद्यात्प्रत्यह्ना सार्धमाषकम् ॥
सेतुबंधे च पंकिले च पणद्वयं च काकिणी ॥ 15 ॥
2.2.m: in the planting of trees, one should give a māṣaka and a half each day; / in dam-building and in muddy ground, two paṇas and a kākiṇī;

2.2.s:
paṇepaṇe tu tāmrasya dadyātpaṇacatuṣṭayam ..
ghaṭane kāṃsyasīsānāṃ paṇatrayamudāhṛtam .. 16 ..
2.2.d:
पणेपणे तु ताम्रस्य दद्यात्पणचतुष्टयम् ॥
घटने कांस्यसीसानां पणत्रयमुदाहृतम् ॥ 16 ॥
2.2.m: for every paṇa of copper, one should give four paṇas; / in the fashioning of bronze and lead, three paṇas are declared;

2.2.s:
atha vā dinasaṃkhyānaṃ paṇaikaṃ ca sakākiṇi ..
suvarṇasya paṇaike tu purāṇaṃ ratnakuṭṭime .. 17 ..
2.2.d:
अथ वा दिनसंख्यानं पणैकं च सकाकिणि ॥
सुवर्णस्य पणैके तु पुराणं रत्नकुट्टिमे ॥ 17 ॥
2.2.m: or the daily calculation is one paṇa with a kākiṇī; / for one paṇa of gold, a purāṇa; on a pavement of jewels.

2.2.s:
rajate tu tadardhaṃ syātsphaṭikasya ca dāraṇe ..
dinasaṃkhyāpaṇadvaṃdvaṃ ratnānāmatha kuḍmalam.. 18 ..
2.2.d:
रजते तु तदर्धं स्यात्स्फटिकस्य च दारणे ॥
दिनसंख्यापणद्वंद्वं रत्नानामथ कुड्मलम्॥ 18 ॥
2.2.m: For silver it should be half of that, and for cutting crystal / the count of days is two paṇas, and likewise for buds of gems.

2.2.s:
maṇivedhe maṇau jñeyaṃ kākiṇī parikīrtitā ..
caturvarāṭamadhikaṃ sphāṭike maṇivedhane .. 19 ..
2.2.d:
मणिवेधे मणौ ज्ञेयं काकिणी परिकीर्तिता ॥
चतुर्वराटमधिकं स्फाटिके मणिवेधने ॥ 19 ॥
2.2.m: For perforating a jewel, one should know that a kākiṇī is prescribed for each jewel; / four cowries more for perforating a crystal bead.

2.2.s:
kāṃsyatālasya nirmāṇe dhamane tu paṇatrayam ..
lākṣānirmāṇake kārye tadardhamapi kīrtitam..2.2.4.20..
2.2.d:
कांस्यतालस्य निर्माणे धमने तु पणत्रयम् ॥
लाक्षानिर्माणके कार्ये तदर्धमपि कीर्तितम्॥2.2.4.20॥
2.2.m: In fashioning a bell-metal cymbal, three paṇas are prescribed for melting; / in the work of making lac, half of that is stated.

2.2.s:
gavāṃ ca dohane caiva varāṭe turyavetanam..
vetane vastranirmāṇe patre hastapaṇatrayam ..21..
2.2.d:
गवां च दोहने चैव वराटे तुर्यवेतनम्॥
वेतने वस्त्रनिर्माणे पत्रे हस्तपणत्रयम् ॥21॥
2.2.m: And for milking cows, the wage is a quarter of a cowrie; / as a wage for making cloth, three paṇas per cubit on the piece.

2.2.s:
avivastrasya nirmāṇe syaṃdanaṃ daśakākiṇī ..
pidhānavastranirmāṇe tripaṇaṃ parikīrtitam .. 22 ..
2.2.d:
अविवस्त्रस्य निर्माणे स्यंदनं दशकाकिणी ॥
पिधानवस्त्रनिर्माणे त्रिपणं परिकीर्तितम् ॥ 22 ॥
2.2.m: In making woolen cloth, the rolling is ten kākiṇīs; / in making covering-cloth, three paṇas are proclaimed.

2.2.s:
daśa kākiṇī ūrdhvādhastadvyaye paṇyavetanam ..
vaṃśājīvasya pratyahnā paṇasyārdhe sakākiṇi .. 23 ..
2.2.d:
दश काकिणी ऊर्ध्वाधस्तद्व्यये पण्यवेतनम् ॥
वंशाजीवस्य प्रत्यह्ना पणस्यार्धे सकाकिणि ॥ 23 ॥
2.2.m: Above and below ten kākiṇīs, upon those expenses is the merchant's fee; / for a bamboo-worker, daily, half a paṇa with a kākiṇī.

2.2.s:
lohakārasya ca tathā nāpitasya ca vetanam ..
śirasā tasya vapane vijñeyā daśa kākiṇī .. 24 ..
2.2.d:
लोहकारस्य च तथा नापितस्य च वेतनम् ॥
शिरसा तस्य वपने विज्ञेया दश काकिणी ॥ 24 ॥
2.2.m: And likewise is the wage of a blacksmith and a barber: / for shaving the head, ten kākiṇīs should be known.

2.2.s:
saśmaśrunakhamāne tu pradadyātkākiṇīdvayam ..
nārīṇāmatha saṃskāre nakhacitrādirañjane .. 25 ..
2.2.d:
सश्मश्रुनखमाने तु प्रदद्यात्काकिणीद्वयम् ॥
नारीणामथ संस्कारे नखचित्रादिरञ्जने ॥ 25 ॥
2.2.m: For trimming beard and nails, one should give two kākiṇīs; / and in adorning women, painting their nails and the like,

2.2.s:
sakākiṇi paṇaṃ tacca savitre ca payodhare ..
paṇānāṃ turyakaṃ dadyātsīmaṃtasyālake tathā .. 26 ..
2.2.d:
सकाकिणि पणं तच्च सवित्रे च पयोधरे ॥
पणानां तुर्यकं दद्यात्सीमंतस्यालके तथा ॥ 26 ॥
2.2.m: one paṇa along with a kākiṇī; and on the breast with the sun, / one should give a quarter of a paṇa, and likewise on the part of the hair and the lock.

2.2.s:
padacitre tu sārddhaṃ syādgrīvāṇāṃ guhyadhāraṇe ..
dhānyānāṃ ropaṇe caiva dinaike paṇa vetanam .. 27 ..
2.2.d:
पदचित्रे तु सार्द्धं स्याद्ग्रीवाणां गुह्यधारणे ॥
धान्यानां रोपणे चैव दिनैके पण वेतनम् ॥ 27 ॥
2.2.m: For painting the feet, it should be one and a half; for decorating the necks and hidden parts; / and for planting grains, the wage is one paṇa for a single day.

2.2.s:
lavaṇe tu tathā deyā guvākānāṃ ca ropaṇe ..
daṇḍapatrasya saṃskāre maricānāṃ tathaiva ca .. 28 ..
2.2.d:
लवणे तु तथा देया गुवाकानां च रोपणे ॥
दण्डपत्रस्य संस्कारे मरिचानां तथैव च ॥ 28 ॥
2.2.m: Likewise it should be given for harvesting and for planting betel-nut trees; / in dressing the stem and leaf, and likewise of black pepper,

2.2.s:
paṇadvayaṃ varāṭānāmadhikaṃ daśameva tu ..
halehale paṇaikaṃ syātkākiṇyadhikameva ca .. 29 ..
2.2.d:
पणद्वयं वराटानामधिकं दशमेव तु ॥
हलेहले पणैकं स्यात्काकिण्यधिकमेव च ॥ 29 ॥
2.2.m: two paṇas, with an addition of ten cowries; / for each plow, it should be one paṇa and an additional kākiṇī.

2.2.s:
paṇatrayaṃ cakrapaṇe mahiṣāṇāṃ paṇādhikam ..
narāṇāṃ vāhane caiva paṇaikaṃ daśa kākiṇī .. 2.2.4.30 ..
2.2.d:
पणत्रयं चक्रपणे महिषाणां पणाधिकम् ॥
नराणां वाहने चैव पणैकं दश काकिणी ॥ 2.2.4.30 ॥
2.2.m: Three paṇas for a wheel-toll; for buffaloes, one paṇa more; / and for carrying men, one paṇa and ten kākiṇīs.

2.2.s:
dāsīnāṃ gardabhānāṃ ca adhikaṃ kākiṇīdvayāt ..
kṣālane cāpi vastrasya tailakṣāravivarjite .. 31 ..
2.2.d:
दासीनां गर्दभानां च अधिकं काकिणीद्वयात् ॥
क्षालने चापि वस्त्रस्य तैलक्षारविवर्जिते ॥ 31 ॥
2.2.m: For female servants and donkeys, two kākiṇīs more; / and for washing cloth free of oil and alkaline salt,

2.2.s:
vastre pratipaṇaṃ dadyāddīrghe prasthe'pi vardhayet ..
sadyaḥ prakṣālane'pyardhaṃ dinādāvadhikaṃ bhaved .. 32 ..
2.2.d:
वस्त्रे प्रतिपणं दद्याद्दीर्घे प्रस्थेऽपि वर्धयेत् ॥
सद्यः प्रक्षालनेऽप्यर्धं दिनादावधिकं भवेद् ॥ 32 ॥
2.2.m: one should give a paṇa per cloth; for one that is long and wide, one should increase [it]; / even for immediate washing, it should be half more at the beginning of the day.

2.2.s:
śvetavastre bhavennyūnaṃ pade sūkṣme ca varddhayet ..
mṛttikānāṃ samuddhāraṃ kuddāle cekṣupīḍane .. 33 ..
2.2.d:
श्वेतवस्त्रे भवेन्न्यूनं पदे सूक्ष्मे च वर्द्धयेत् ॥
मृत्तिकानां समुद्धारं कुद्दाले चेक्षुपीडने ॥ 33 ॥
2.2.m: For white cloth it should be less; for fine foot-cloth one should increase [it]; / for digging up earth with a spade, and for pressing sugarcane,

2.2.s:
vetanaṃ puṣpasaṃskāre sahasraṃ daśakākiṇī ..
kākiṇī sraṅnibaddhe ca dviguṇaṃ kaṇṭhamālikā .. 34 ..
2.2.d:
वेतनं पुष्पसंस्कारे सहस्रं दशकाकिणी ॥
काकिणी स्रङ्निबद्धे च द्विगुणं कण्ठमालिका ॥ 34 ॥
2.2.m: the wage for preparing flowers is ten kākiṇīs per thousand; / a kākiṇī for a tied garland, and double for a neck-garland.

2.2.s:
abaddhe dvyaṃgulaṃ yāvanmuṇḍamālā prakīrtitā ..
hastatraye kaṇṭhamālā ānābhi kamalāvadhi .. 35 ..
2.2.d:
अबद्धे द्व्यंगुलं यावन्मुण्डमाला प्रकीर्तिता ॥
हस्तत्रये कण्ठमाला आनाभि कमलावधि ॥ 35 ॥
2.2.m: Untied, up to two finger-breadths, it is termed a head-garland; / a neck-garland measures three cubits, down to the navel, up to the lotus.

2.2.s:
kākiṇīkatrayaṃ caiva nirmāṇe dvijasattamāḥ ..
mālatyāśca tulasyāśca jātiyūthyośca sattamāḥ .. 36 ..
2.2.d:
काकिणीकत्रयं चैव निर्माणे द्विजसत्तमाः ॥
मालत्याश्च तुलस्याश्च जातियूथ्योश्च सत्तमाः ॥ 36 ॥
2.2.m: Three kākiṇīs for the fashioning, O best of the twice-born, / of jasmine and tulasī, and of Spanish jasmine and yellow jasmine, O excellent ones.

2.2.s:
tadardhārdhaṃ mārutena damane bakulasya ca ..
vetanaṃ dīpataile ca ājyasya parivardhayet .. 37 ..
2.2.d:
तदर्धार्धं मारुतेन दमने बकुलस्य च ॥
वेतनं दीपतैले च आज्यस्य परिवर्धयेत् ॥ 37 ॥
2.2.m: Half of that half for marjoram, and for bakula; / the wage is for lamp-oil; for ghee one should increase it.

2.2.s:
yāmeyāme raupyamāṣaṃ snehe caiva tu kākiṇī ..
sārdhāṃgulapramāṇena vastravartiṃ vidurbudhāḥ .. 38 ..
2.2.d:
यामेयामे रौप्यमाषं स्नेहे चैव तु काकिणी ॥
सार्धांगुलप्रमाणेन वस्त्रवर्तिं विदुर्बुधाः ॥ 38 ॥
2.2.m: Watch by watch, a silver māṣa, and a kākiṇī for oil; / the wise know a cloth wick to measure one and a half finger-breadths.

2.2.s:
ṣaḍaṃgulena dairghyaṃ ca na nyūnaṃ nādhikaṃ bhavet ..
pañcaviṃśatibhiḥ saṃkhyā taṃtubhirdvijasattamāḥ .. 39 ..
2.2.d:
षडंगुलेन दैर्घ्यं च न न्यूनं नाधिकं भवेत् ॥
पञ्चविंशतिभिः संख्या तंतुभिर्द्विजसत्तमाः ॥ 39 ॥
2.2.m: And the length should be six finger-breadths, neither less nor more; / its count should be twenty-five threads, O best of the twice-born.

2.2.s:
pañcāṅgulena mānena kartavyaḥ susamāhitaḥ ..
hastocchrāye pradadyāttu muṣṭihaste tu madhyamam .. 2.2.4.40 ..
2.2.d:
पञ्चाङ्गुलेन मानेन कर्तव्यः सुसमाहितः ॥
हस्तोच्छ्राये प्रदद्यात्तु मुष्टिहस्ते तु मध्यमम् ॥ 2.2.4.40 ॥
2.2.m: It should be carefully made with a measure of five finger-breadths; / one should give one measuring a cubit in height; one measuring a fist and a cubit is middling.

2.2.s:
trihaste caturhaste vā uttamaṃ mānamīritam ..
svarṇadhāre hato rājā rajate sarvakāmadaḥ .. 41 ..
2.2.d:
त्रिहस्ते चतुर्हस्ते वा उत्तमं मानमीरितम् ॥
स्वर्णधारे हतो राजा रजते सर्वकामदः ॥ 41 ॥
2.2.m: Three cubits or four cubits is stated to be the superior measure; / on a gold stand, the king is slain; on silver, it grants all desires;

2.2.s:
tāmre cāyuḥkṣayakaramāyase durgatipradaḥ ..
śastasya karamardasya praśastottara ucyate .. 42 ..
2.2.d:
ताम्रे चायुःक्षयकरमायसे दुर्गतिप्रदः ॥
शस्तस्य करमर्दस्य प्रशस्तोत्तर उच्यते ॥ 42 ॥
2.2.m: on copper, it causes loss of lifespan; on iron, it brings misfortune; / of the sword and of the carissa carandas, the northern is said to be praiseworthy.

2.2.s:
dīpādhāraṃ kāṃsyamayaṃ tathārītimayasya ca ..
abhāve mṛnmayasyaiva mṛnmaye mānavarjitam .. 43 ..
2.2.d:
दीपाधारं कांस्यमयं तथारीतिमयस्य च ॥
अभावे मृन्मयस्यैव मृन्मये मानवर्जितम् ॥ 43 ॥
2.2.m: The lampstand should be made of bell-metal, and likewise of brass; / in their absence, of clay; for clay, it is devoid of [rigid] measure.

2.2.s:
daśāṅgadhūpake mūlyaṃ viṃśake tu paṇatrayam ..
dvādaśakāṃgule'pyardhavartiṃ dhūpāya vartayet .. 44 ..
2.2.d:
दशाङ्गधूपके मूल्यं विंशके तु पणत्रयम् ॥
द्वादशकांगुलेऽप्यर्धवर्तिं धूपाय वर्तयेत् ॥ 44 ॥
2.2.m: The cost for ten-ingredient incense, and for twenty, is three paṇas; / one should also prepare a half-wick of twelve finger-breadths for incense.

2.2.s:
haste paṃcapramāṇaṃ ca vastraiḥ kuryācca vartikām ..
pañcaviṃśatibhirvā yaḥ sa mahāvartirucyate ..45.. ..
kalaśanirṇayavarṇanam
2.2.d:
हस्ते पंचप्रमाणं च वस्त्रैः कुर्याच्च वर्तिकाम् ॥
पञ्चविंशतिभिर्वा यः स महावर्तिरुच्यते ॥45॥ ॥
कलशनिर्णयवर्णनम्
2.2.m:
And with cloths one should make a wick measuring five in a cubit; / or that which is made with twenty-five is called a great wick.
Description of the determination of the water pot

2.2.s:
sūta uvāca ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kalaśānāṃ vinirṇayam ..
yasyārpite ca māṃgalye yātrāsiddhiśca jāyate ..1..
2.2.d:
सूत उवाच ॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि कलशानां विनिर्णयम् ॥
यस्यार्पिते च मांगल्ये यात्रासिद्धिश्च जायते ॥1॥
2.2.m: Sūta said: / Hereafter I shall explain the determination of the water pots, / by whose auspicious presentation the success of the journey is accomplished.

2.2.s:
saptāṅgaṃ kalaśe jñeyaṃ pañcāṅgamatha vā punaḥ ..
vārimātreṇa saṃpūrṇe na sā siddhiḥ prajāyate ..2..
2.2.d:
सप्ताङ्गं कलशे ज्ञेयं पञ्चाङ्गमथ वा पुनः ॥
वारिमात्रेण संपूर्णे न सा सिद्धिः प्रजायते ॥2॥
2.2.m: The water pot should be known as having seven limbs or five limbs; / when filled with water alone, that success does not come to pass.

2.2.s:
atha vākṣatapuṣpeṣu devamāvāhya pūjayet ..
na cānyatra yajeddevānviphalaṃ parikīrtitam..3..
2.2.d:
अथ वाक्षतपुष्पेषु देवमावाह्य पूजयेत् ॥
न चान्यत्र यजेद्देवान्विफलं परिकीर्तितम्॥3॥
2.2.m: Or having invoked the deity into unbroken rice and flowers, one should worship [him]; / one should not worship the gods elsewhere; it is proclaimed to be fruitless.

2.2.s:
vaṭasyāśvatthavṛkṣasya dhātakībilvakasya ca ..
pañcapallavamuddiṣṭaṃ vinyasetkalaśopari .. 4 ..
2.2.d:
वटस्याश्वत्थवृक्षस्य धातकीबिल्वकस्य च ॥
पञ्चपल्लवमुद्दिष्टं विन्यसेत्कलशोपरि ॥ 4 ॥
2.2.m: Of the banyan tree, the sacred fig tree, the dhātakī, and the bilva tree: / five sprouts are prescribed to be placed upon the water pot.

2.2.s:
sauvarṇā rājatā vāpi tāmrādyā mṛnmayāstathā ..
kalaśāḥ kramaśaḥ proktā yathāvittānusārataḥ .. 5 ..
2.2.d:
सौवर्णा राजता वापि ताम्राद्या मृन्मयास्तथा ॥
कलशाः क्रमशः प्रोक्ता यथावित्तानुसारतः ॥ 5 ॥
2.2.m: Golden, silver, copper, and likewise clay: / water pots are proclaimed in sequence according to one's wealth.

2.2.s:
abhedyāḥ suṣamāḥ plakṣāḥ sarve ādyāḥ supūritāḥ ..
