niśchidrā ṛjavaścaiva secanānyekakarṣakaḥ .. 6 ..
2.2.d:
अभेद्याः सुषमाः प्लक्षाः सर्वे आद्याः सुपूरिताः ॥
निश्छिद्रा ऋजवश्चैव सेचनान्येककर्षकः ॥ 6 ॥
2.2.m: Unbroken, well-proportioned, smooth, all the prime ones well-filled, / without holes and straight, sprinkled with a single karṣa.

2.2.s:
eka triṃśāṅgulaṃ kuryātkālāhe dviguṇaṃ śatam ..
mukhaṃ cāṣṭāṃgulaṃ tasya dvyaṃgule ca varārthite ..7..
2.2.d:
एक त्रिंशाङ्गुलं कुर्यात्कालाहे द्विगुणं शतम् ॥
मुखं चाष्टांगुलं तस्य द्व्यंगुले च वरार्थिते ॥7॥
2.2.m: One should make it thirty-one finger-breadths; in a large vessel, twice a hundred; / its mouth should be eight finger-breadths, and two finger-breadths when prayed for boons.

2.2.s:
taijasaiḥ kārayenmānaṃ mṛnmaye mānamucyate ..
kalaśodakanirmāṇe amānaṃ naiva yojayet .. 8 ..
2.2.d:
तैजसैः कारयेन्मानं मृन्मये मानमुच्यते ॥
कलशोदकनिर्माणे अमानं नैव योजयेत् ॥ 8 ॥
2.2.m: One should have the measure made with metallic [vessels]; the measure is stated for clay; / in preparing water pot water, one should never employ an improper measure.

2.2.s:
kalaśasthāpanaṃ vakṣye yatra sannihitāḥ surāḥ ..
vyutkrameṇa pravinyāse yātudhāno haretkila .. 9 ..
2.2.d:
कलशस्थापनं वक्ष्ये यत्र सन्निहिताः सुराः ॥
व्युत्क्रमेण प्रविन्यासे यातुधानो हरेत्किल ॥ 9 ॥
2.2.m: I shall declare the installation of the water pot, wherein the gods are present; / if it is arranged in reverse order, a demon indeed carries [the merit] away.

2.2.s:
yajñe sādhāraṇaṃ vakṣye yadvidhānaṃ yathāmatam ..
svastikopari vinyāse saṃpūrṇasyārdhamānake .. 2.2.5.10 ..
2.2.d:
यज्ञे साधारणं वक्ष्ये यद्विधानं यथामतम् ॥
स्वस्तिकोपरि विन्यासे संपूर्णस्यार्धमानके ॥ 2.2.5.10 ॥
2.2.m: I shall declare what is common to the sacrifice, which rule is according to tradition: / placed upon a svastika, half the measure of the full one.

2.2.s:
caturasrottaraṃ bhittvā cordhvādhomānataḥ samam ..
turyasūtrāṇi matimānpañca pūrvāyatanāni ca .. 11 ..
2.2.d:
चतुरस्रोत्तरं भित्त्वा चोर्ध्वाधोमानतः समम् ॥
तुर्यसूत्राणि मतिमान्पञ्च पूर्वायतनानि च ॥ 11 ॥
2.2.m: Having divided the square area equally from top to bottom according to measure, / the wise man [draws] four cords and five extending eastward.

2.2.s:
mārjayetsvastikākāraṃ turyamātraṃ yathā bhavet ..
svastikaṃ jāyate tatra kalaśānāṃ tathāsanam .. 12 ..
2.2.d:
मार्जयेत्स्वस्तिकाकारं तुर्यमात्रं यथा भवेत् ॥
स्वस्तिकं जायते तत्र कलशानां तथासनम् ॥ 12 ॥
2.2.m: One should wipe it into the form of a svastika so that it is fourfold in measure; / a svastika is produced there, and likewise a seat for the water pots.

2.2.s:
syonā pṛthivīti maṃtreṇa kuryādbhūbhiparigraham ..
madhyamānānikābhyāṃ ca nyasyetpātālasaṃmukham ..
ṛṣirnārāyaṇo'sya syādgāyatrī devatā raviḥ .. 13 ..
2.2.d:
स्योना पृथिवीति मंत्रेण कुर्याद्भूभिपरिग्रहम् ॥
मध्यमानानिकाभ्यां च न्यस्येत्पातालसंमुखम् ॥
ऋषिर्नारायणोऽस्य स्याद्गायत्री देवता रविः ॥ 13 ॥
2.2.m: With the mantra 'Syonā pṛthivī', he should perform the taking possession of the earth; / and with the middle and ring fingers he should place it facing Pātāla; / its seer is Nārāyaṇa, its meter is Gāyatrī, and the deity is Ravi.

2.2.s:
viniyogaḥ sthāpane ca tathā bhūmiparigrahaḥ ..
dhānyamasīti mantreṇa dhānyasūktaṃ paristavet .. 14 ..
2.2.d:
विनियोगः स्थापने च तथा भूमिपरिग्रहः ॥
धान्यमसीति मन्त्रेण धान्यसूक्तं परिस्तवेत् ॥ 14 ॥
2.2.m: The application is in the installation, and likewise in taking possession of the earth; / with the mantra 'Dhānyam asi', he should praise with the Dhānyasūkta.

2.2.s:
asya mantrasya ca ṛṣirgautamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ..
anuṣṭupca bhavecchando devatāsya guruḥ smṛtaḥ .. 15 ..
2.2.d:
अस्य मन्त्रस्य च ऋषिर्गौतमः परिकीर्तितः ॥
अनुष्टुप्च भवेच्छन्दो देवतास्य गुरुः स्मृतः ॥ 15 ॥
2.2.m: The seer of this mantra is proclaimed to be Gautama; / the meter is Anuṣṭubh, and its deity is remembered as Guru.

2.2.s:
ājighraṃ kalaśaṃ mahyāṃ sthāpayetkalaśaṃ tataḥ ..
kaniṣṭhāṃguṣṭhakaṃ tyaktvā kumbhāgre udare'pi ca .. 16 ..
2.2.d:
आजिघ्रं कलशं मह्यां स्थापयेत्कलशं ततः ॥
कनिष्ठांगुष्ठकं त्यक्त्वा कुम्भाग्रे उदरेऽपि च ॥ 16 ॥
2.2.m: With [the mantra] beginning with “Ājighra”, he should establish the jar upon the earth, and then establish the jar / having released the little finger and the thumb, at the top and the belly of the jar.

2.2.s:
vinyāsaścaiva kartavyastryaṃgule brahmamudrayā ..
ājighrasya ca mantrasya ṛṣirbharga udāhṛtaḥ ..
paṃktiśchandaśca uddiṣṭo devatā viṣṇuravyayaḥ .. 17 ..
2.2.d:
विन्यासश्चैव कर्तव्यस्त्र्यंगुले ब्रह्ममुद्रया ॥
आजिघ्रस्य च मन्त्रस्य ऋषिर्भर्ग उदाहृतः ॥
पंक्तिश्छन्दश्च उद्दिष्टो देवता विष्णुरव्ययः ॥ 17 ॥
2.2.m: The ritual placement should be performed across three finger-breadths with the Brahma mudrā. / Of the mantra beginning with “Ājighra”, the seer is proclaimed to be Bharga, / the metre is declared to be Paṅkti, and the deity is the imperishable Viṣṇu.

2.2.s:
kalaśasthāpane caiva somayāge ca yojayet ..
paṃcanadyetimantreṇa kṣipedgaṅgājalaṃ tataḥ .. 18 ..
2.2.d:
कलशस्थापने चैव सोमयागे च योजयेत् ॥
पंचनद्येतिमन्त्रेण क्षिपेद्गङ्गाजलं ततः ॥ 18 ॥
2.2.m: One should employ [this mantra] in establishing the jar and in the Soma sacrifice. / Then, with the mantra beginning with “Pañcanadī”, he should pour the water of the Gaṅgā.

2.2.s:
devatā paramā triṣṭubdevatā somabhāvitaḥ ..
viniyogaḥ pallave ca vinyasetparikīrtitaḥ .. 19 ..
2.2.d:
देवता परमा त्रिष्टुब्देवता सोमभावितः ॥
विनियोगः पल्लवे च विन्यसेत्परिकीर्तितः ॥ 19 ॥
2.2.m: The highest deity [is proclaimed], the metre is Triṣṭubh, and the deity is connected with Soma. / The application is declared: he should place it upon the sprout.

2.2.s:
yāḥ phalinīti maṃtreṇa pradadyātsaphalākṣatam ..
yāḥ phalinīti maṃtrasya ṛṣiḥ kamalasaṃjñakaḥ ..
triṣṭupchando gaṇapatirdevatā parikīrtitā .. 2.2.5.20 ..
2.2.d:
याः फलिनीति मंत्रेण प्रदद्यात्सफलाक्षतम् ॥
याः फलिनीति मंत्रस्य ऋषिः कमलसंज्ञकः ॥
त्रिष्टुप्छन्दो गणपतिर्देवता परिकीर्तिता ॥ 2.2.5.20 ॥
2.2.m: With the mantra beginning with “Yāḥ phalinīḥ”, he should offer unbroken grains along with fruit. / Of the mantra beginning with “Yāḥ phalinīḥ”, the seer is known as Kamala, / the metre is Triṣṭubh, and the deity is proclaimed to be Gaṇapati.

2.2.s:
badaraṃ nāgaraṃ caiva dhātrī ca picumardakam ..
jīvaṃtī pīvaraṃ caiva phalānyetāni varjayet .. 21 ..
2.2.d:
बदरं नागरं चैव धात्री च पिचुमर्दकम् ॥
जीवंती पीवरं चैव फलान्येतानि वर्जयेत् ॥ 21 ॥
2.2.m: Jujube, ginger, āmlakī, and neem, / jīvantī, and pīvara—one should avoid these fruits.

2.2.s:
hiraṇyagarbheti ṛcā pañcaratnāni nikṣipet ..
ṛṣirhiraṇyagarbhosya chandastriṣṭubudāhṛtam ..
savitā devatā cāsya ratnanyāseti yoja yet ..22..
2.2.d:
हिरण्यगर्भेति ऋचा पञ्चरत्नानि निक्षिपेत् ॥
ऋषिर्हिरण्यगर्भोस्य छन्दस्त्रिष्टुबुदाहृतम् ॥
सविता देवता चास्य रत्नन्यासेति योज येत् ॥22॥
2.2.m: With the verse beginning with “Hiraṇyagarbha”, he should throw in the five jewels. / Its seer is Hiraṇyagarbha, its metre is declared to be Triṣṭubh, / its deity is Savitṛ, and one should employ it in the placement of the jewels.

2.2.s:
amṛtīkaraṇaṃ kuryāddaivaśulbanameva ca ..
varuṇasya tveti ṛṣirvaruṇāṃtare yojayet ..23..
2.2.d:
अमृतीकरणं कुर्याद्दैवशुल्बनमेव च ॥
वरुणस्य त्वेति ऋषिर्वरुणांतरे योजयेत् ॥23॥
2.2.m: He should perform the immortalisation and the divine measuring-cord ritual. / With the verse beginning with “Varuṇasya tvā”, the seer should apply it within Varuṇa.

2.2.s:
śrīśca te iti mantreṇa dadyātpuṣpaṃ sacandanam ..
gandhadvāreti maṃtreṇa dadyādgandhaṃ viloḍitam .. 24 ..
2.2.d:
श्रीश्च ते इति मन्त्रेण दद्यात्पुष्पं सचन्दनम् ॥
गन्धद्वारेति मंत्रेण दद्याद्गन्धं विलोडितम् ॥ 24 ॥
2.2.m: With the mantra beginning with “Śrīś ca te”, he should offer a flower smeared with sandalwood paste. / With the mantra beginning with “Gandhadvārā”, he should offer blended perfume.

2.2.s:
kāṇḍāditi ca mantreṇa dadyāddūrvākṣataṃ punaḥ ..
vrīhayaśceti mantreṇa pañca vrīhīṃśca nikṣipet ..25..
2.2.d:
काण्डादिति च मन्त्रेण दद्याद्दूर्वाक्षतं पुनः ॥
व्रीहयश्चेति मन्त्रेण पञ्च व्रीहींश्च निक्षिपेत् ॥25॥
2.2.m: And with the mantra beginning with “Kāṇḍāt”, he should again offer dūrvā grass and unbroken grains. / With the mantra beginning with “Vrīhayaḥ”, he should throw in the five grains:

2.2.s:
tilāśca māṣā mudgāśca śyāmākāḥ śālayaḥ smṛtāḥ ..
pañca dhānyagaṇaḥ proktaḥ sarvāriṣṭaniṣūdanaḥ .. 26 ..
māsavarṇanam
2.2.d:
तिलाश्च माषा मुद्गाश्च श्यामाकाः शालयः स्मृताः ॥
पञ्च धान्यगणः प्रोक्तः सर्वारिष्टनिषूदनः ॥ 26 ॥
मासवर्णनम्
2.2.m:
Sesame, black gram, mung bean, śyāmāka, and rice are declared. / This group of five grains is proclaimed to destroy all calamities.
Description of the Months

2.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
atha māsāśrayaṃ karma kartuṃ māsanirūpaṇam ..
kriyate tadvidhaṃ saṃkhye bhavenmāsa ścaturvidhaḥ .. 1 ..
2.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
अथ मासाश्रयं कर्म कर्तुं मासनिरूपणम् ॥
क्रियते तद्विधं संख्ये भवेन्मास श्चतुर्विधः ॥ 1 ॥
2.2.m: Sūta said: / Now, in order to perform rites dependent on months, the determination of months is undertaken; / in the enumeration of those types, a month is of four kinds:

2.2.s:
cāndraḥ sauraḥ sāvanaśca nākṣatraśca tathāparaḥ ..
śuklapratipadaṃ prāpya yāvaddarśa ca aindavaḥ .. 2 ..
2.2.d:
चान्द्रः सौरः सावनश्च नाक्षत्रश्च तथापरः ॥
शुक्लप्रतिपदं प्राप्य यावद्दर्श च ऐन्दवः ॥ 2 ॥
2.2.m: lunar, solar, civil, and the other is sidereal. / Beginning from the bright pratipad up to the new moon is the lunar [month].

2.2.s:
ekarāśau raviryāvatsa māsaḥ saura ucyate ..
triṃśatā divasairmāsaḥ sāvanaḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 3 ..
2.2.d:
एकराशौ रविर्यावत्स मासः सौर उच्यते ॥
त्रिंशता दिवसैर्मासः सावनः परिकीर्तितः ॥ 3 ॥
2.2.m: As long as the sun remains in a single zodiacal sign, that month is called solar. / A month measured by thirty days is proclaimed to be civil.

2.2.s:
nākṣatramāso'śvinyādirevatyanto hi viśrutaḥ..
udayādudayaṃ yastu sāvano divaso raveḥ .. 4 ..
2.2.d:
नाक्षत्रमासोऽश्विन्यादिरेवत्यन्तो हि विश्रुतः॥
उदयादुदयं यस्तु सावनो दिवसो रवेः ॥ 4 ॥
2.2.m: The sidereal month is famed as beginning with Aśvinī and ending with Revatī. / But that which is from sunrise to sunrise is a civil day of the sun.

2.2.s:
taṃtreṇaikatitherbhāgakālo divasa aindavaḥ ..
rāśestriṃśadbhāgakālaḥ kālastvekasya bhāsvataḥ ..5..
2.2.d:
तंत्रेणैकतिथेर्भागकालो दिवस ऐन्दवः ॥
राशेस्त्रिंशद्भागकालः कालस्त्वेकस्य भास्वतः ॥5॥
2.2.m: According to the system, the time of the division of a single lunar day is a lunar day. / The time of a thirtieth division of a zodiacal sign is the time of a single sun.

2.2.s:
ahorātraṃ tu tannaivaṃ saure'pi bhāgamānataḥ..
ahorātraṃ sādhanasya mukhyavṛttvaiva labhyate .. 6 ..
2.2.d:
अहोरात्रं तु तन्नैवं सौरेऽपि भागमानतः॥
अहोरात्रं साधनस्य मुख्यवृत्त्वैव लभ्यते ॥ 6 ॥
2.2.m: A day-and-night is not like that, even in the solar [system], according to the measure of the division; / a day-and-night of practice is obtained only by the primary sense.

2.2.s:
saure cāndre tūpagaṇau triṃśadbhāge tvadarśanāt ..
sāvanā divasā grāhyā ṛṣīṇāṃ samaye gṛhe .. 7 ..
2.2.d:
सौरे चान्द्रे तूपगणौ त्रिंशद्भागे त्वदर्शनात् ॥
सावना दिवसा ग्राह्या ऋषीणां समये गृहे ॥ 7 ॥
2.2.m: In the solar and lunar [systems], because of the lack of observation in the thirtieth division, / civil days are to be taken according to the tradition of the sages in the house,

2.2.s:
atibhāgavyavasthāyāṃ prāyaścittakriyāsu ca..
mantropāsanakārye ca annasya prāśane śiśoḥ..8..
2.2.d:
अतिभागव्यवस्थायां प्रायश्चित्तक्रियासु च॥
मन्त्रोपासनकार्ये च अन्नस्य प्राशने शिशोः॥8॥
2.2.m: in the arrangement of fractional shares, in expiatory rites, / in rites of worshipping mantras, and in the first feeding of an infant,

2.2.s:
karasya grahaṇe rājño vyavahāreṣu māḥsu ca..
yajñeṣu dinasaṃ khyāyāṃ grāhyo māsastu sāvanaḥ ..9..
2.2.d:
करस्य ग्रहणे राज्ञो व्यवहारेषु माःसु च॥
यज्ञेषु दिनसं ख्यायां ग्राह्यो मासस्तु सावनः ॥9॥
2.2.m: in the king's collection of tax, in legal transactions, in lunar months, / and in the enumeration of days in sacrifices, the civil month is to be taken.

2.2.s:
sauramāso vivāhādau yadādyaiḥ supragṛhyate ..
yajñeṣvapi vrate vāpi vihite snānakarmaṇi ..2.2.6.10..
2.2.d:
सौरमासो विवाहादौ यदाद्यैः सुप्रगृह्यते ॥
यज्ञेष्वपि व्रते वापि विहिते स्नानकर्मणि ॥2.2.6.10॥
2.2.m: The solar month is appropriately accepted in marriages and the like by the ancient sages, / and also in sacrifices, in a votive observance, and in the prescribed rite of bathing.

2.2.s:
cāndrastu pārvaṇe grāhyo vārṣikeṣvaṣṭakāsu ca ..
śrāddheṣu tithikāryeṣu tithyukteṣu vrateṣu ca ..11..
2.2.d:
चान्द्रस्तु पार्वणे ग्राह्यो वार्षिकेष्वष्टकासु च ॥
श्राद्धेषु तिथिकार्येषु तिथ्युक्तेषु व्रतेषु च ॥11॥
2.2.m: The lunar [month] is to be taken for the new- and full-moon rites, annual [rites], the aṣṭakās, / ancestral rites, rites tied to lunar days, and votive observances prescribed for lunar days.

2.2.s:
nākṣatraḥ somapādīnāmāryabhāgavicāraṇe ..
karagrahavidhau rājñāṃ nāyaṃ sarvajanākṛtiḥ .. 12..
2.2.d:
नाक्षत्रः सोमपादीनामार्यभागविचारणे ॥
करग्रहविधौ राज्ञां नायं सर्वजनाकृतिः ॥ 12॥
2.2.m: The sidereal [month] is used in examining the shares of the worthy for Soma-drinkers and others; / in the kings' method of collecting tax, this does not apply to all people.

2.2.s:
tadvaccaitrādimāsoktaṃ tithyuktaṃ karma dṛśyate ..
tattu cāndreṇa kartavyaṃ sā hi caitrādinocyate ..13..
2.2.d:
तद्वच्चैत्रादिमासोक्तं तिथ्युक्तं कर्म दृश्यते ॥
तत्तु चान्द्रेण कर्तव्यं सा हि चैत्रादिनोच्यते ॥13॥
2.2.m: Likewise, a rite declared for the months beginning with Caitra and connected with a lunar day is observed; / that must be performed by the lunar [reckoning], for that [sequence] is named from Caitra and the rest.

2.2.s:
rājoktau sāvanaḥ prokte tithisaṃbhāgakarmaṇi..
tatra sauro bhavedvācyaḥ sauraśabdapravartanāt ..14..
2.2.d:
राजोक्तौ सावनः प्रोक्ते तिथिसंभागकर्मणि॥
तत्र सौरो भवेद्वाच्यः सौरशब्दप्रवर्तनात् ॥14॥
2.2.m: In a king's declaration, the civil [month] is taught; in rites concerning the division of lunar days, / there the solar should be expressed, because of the application of the term 'solar'.

2.2.s:
citrānakṣatrayogena caitrī sā pūrṇimā smṛtā..
tayopalakṣito māsaścaitra ityabhidhīyate .. 15 ..
2.2.d:
चित्रानक्षत्रयोगेन चैत्री सा पूर्णिमा स्मृता॥
तयोपलक्षितो मासश्चैत्र इत्यभिधीयते ॥ 15 ॥
2.2.m: Due to conjunction with the Citrā asterism, that full moon is recorded as Caitrī; / characterised by that [full moon], the month is named Caitra.

2.2.s:
sa ca tithyātmako māsaścāndraḥ śravaṇabhāskaraḥ ..
cāndraścaitryaṃtiko māso mukhyaścaitrādisaṃjñakaḥ .. 16..
2.2.d:
स च तिथ्यात्मको मासश्चान्द्रः श्रवणभास्करः ॥
चान्द्रश्चैत्र्यंतिको मासो मुख्यश्चैत्रादिसंज्ञकः ॥ 16॥
2.2.m: That month consisting of lunar days is lunar, with the sun in Śravaṇa; / the lunar month ending with Caitrī is the primary one designated as Caitra and the rest.

2.2.s:
gauṇo'pyasau yugādyāderanurodhena vardhanāt ..
mukhyaḥ śuklādidarśāṃto māso lākṣaṇiko mataḥ .. 17 ..
2.2.d:
गौणोऽप्यसौ युगाद्यादेरनुरोधेन वर्धनात् ॥
मुख्यः शुक्लादिदर्शांतो मासो लाक्षणिको मतः ॥ 17 ॥
2.2.m: Even this secondary one increases in accordance with the beginning of the yuga and so on; / the primary month, ending with the new moon from the bright fortnight onward, is considered standard.

2.2.s:
caitrādyāścāndramāsā ye dvādaśāpi tu yogataḥ ..
paurṇamāsīyutābhistu na carkṣatvaṃ na rebhire .. 18 ..
2.2.d:
चैत्राद्याश्चान्द्रमासा ये द्वादशापि तु योगतः ॥
पौर्णमासीयुताभिस्तु न चर्क्षत्वं न रेभिरे ॥ 18 ॥
2.2.m: Those twelve lunar months beginning with Caitra, arising from conjunction / with [the lunar asterisms] joined with the full moon, did not fail to possess the asterism.

2.2.s:
viśākhayādyeṣu yā vā tathā bhādrapadena vā ..
yatra na pūrṇimāyogo māsaḥ sa syādvināśakaḥ .. 19 ..
2.2.d:
विशाखयाद्येषु या वा तथा भाद्रपदेन वा ॥
यत्र न पूर्णिमायोगो मासः स स्याद्विनाशकः ॥ 19 ॥
2.2.m: That [full moon] which is in the [months] beginning with Viśākhā, or with Bhādrapada, / wherein there is no conjunction with the full moon, that month would become destructive.

2.2.s:
yo'sau yadyapi caitrādau naiṣṭhiko'pi pralabhyate ..
yathā saure'pi yāto'sau yogo'yamatidurghaṭaḥ .. 2.2.6.20 ..
2.2.d:
योऽसौ यद्यपि चैत्रादौ नैष्ठिकोऽपि प्रलभ्यते ॥
यथा सौरेऽपि यातोऽसौ योगोऽयमतिदुर्घटः ॥ 2.2.6.20 ॥
2.2.m: Even if that which is constant is obtained in Caitra and the rest, / as it passes even into the solar, this conjunction is extremely difficult to achieve.

2.2.s:
tathā ca māsasāmānye yogenāyaṃ bhavetkvacit ..
yadi varṣasahasrānte tadakṣeṇaiva pūrṇimā .. 21 ..
2.2.d:
तथा च माससामान्ये योगेनायं भवेत्क्वचित् ॥
यदि वर्षसहस्रान्ते तदक्षेणैव पूर्णिमा ॥ 21 ॥
2.2.m: And so, in a general month, this [conjunction] might occur somewhere; / if at the end of a thousand years, a full moon with that very axle

2.2.s:
saṃyuktā labhyate yatra bhavedrājyavināśanam ..
sūryācandramasau nityaṃ kurvāte tithibhojanam .. 22 ..
2.2.d:
संयुक्ता लभ्यते यत्र भवेद्राज्यविनाशनम् ॥
सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ नित्यं कुर्वाते तिथिभोजनम् ॥ 22 ॥
2.2.m: is found conjoined, where that happens, destruction of the kingdom would occur. / The sun and the moon constantly consume the lunar days.

2.2.s:
daṇḍadvaye bhuktaśeṣe na bhuñjīta kadācana ..
atikramyāparāṃ bhoktuṃ tithiṃ yatra ubhāvapi ..23..
2.2.d:
दण्डद्वये भुक्तशेषे न भुञ्जीत कदाचन ॥
अतिक्रम्यापरां भोक्तुं तिथिं यत्र उभावपि ॥23॥
2.2.m: When two daṇḍas remain of what was eaten, one should never eat. / Where both [luminaries], passing beyond, consume another lunar day,

2.2.s:
yatra viṃśattithistasmātsañcitaikā bhavediti ..
triṃśatā cāndramāsau tu candreṇaiko hi varddhate .. 24..
2.2.d:
यत्र विंशत्तिथिस्तस्मात्सञ्चितैका भवेदिति ॥
त्रिंशता चान्द्रमासौ तु चन्द्रेणैको हि वर्द्धते ॥ 24॥
2.2.m: where the twentieth lunar day is, from that one [day] becomes accumulated. / In thirty lunar months, one indeed increases by the moon.

2.2.s:
sa cādhiko yato māsastataḥ syādadhimāsakaḥ ..
samarātriṃ divaṃ kṛtvā vaivasvatapurīgatim .. 25 ..
2.2.d:
स चाधिको यतो मासस्ततः स्यादधिमासकः ॥
समरात्रिं दिवं कृत्वा वैवस्वतपुरीगतिम् ॥ 25 ॥
2.2.m: And since that month is additional, it becomes an intercalary month. / Having made day and night equal, [the sun] going to the city of Vaivasvata,

2.2.s:
gaśe rāśyaṃtare sūryo yāvadgacchati bhānumān ..
gacchanvardhayati pūrvaṃ tithayastāstu saṃcitāḥ .. 26 ..
2.2.d:
गशे राश्यंतरे सूर्यो यावद्गच्छति भानुमान् ॥
गच्छन्वर्धयति पूर्वं तिथयस्तास्तु संचिताः ॥ 26 ॥
2.2.m: as long as the luminous sun moves to another zodiacal sign, / in moving, it increases the previous [days]; those lunar days are accumulated.

2.2.s:
vardhate tithayo yāvattulāṃ yāti divā karaḥ ..
tulādirāśiṣaṭke tu na varddhate kadācana .. 27 ..
2.2.d:
वर्धते तिथयो यावत्तुलां याति दिवा करः ॥
तुलादिराशिषट्के तु न वर्द्धते कदाचन ॥ 27 ॥
2.2.m: The lunar days increase until the sun goes to Libra; / in the six zodiacal signs beginning with Libra, they never increase,

2.2.s:
svabhāvātsamagatyā tu yataḥ saṃkramate raviḥ ..
saṃcayamānātvekaikā pratimāsaṃ vivarddhate ..
niśāsvapi tu saure tā ekasmiṃstisra ityapi .. 28 ..
2.2.d:
स्वभावात्समगत्या तु यतः संक्रमते रविः ॥
संचयमानात्वेकैका प्रतिमासं विवर्द्धते ॥
निशास्वपि तु सौरे ता एकस्मिंस्तिस्र इत्यपि ॥ 28 ॥
2.2.m: because by nature the sun transits with equal motion. / By accumulated measure, one [fraction] increases each month; / even in the nights of a solar [month], those are three in one.

2.2.s:
saṃpūrṇatriṃśattithibhirmāsyekasminyadā bhavet ..
sa cāndro malino māsaḥ koṇapādyaiḥ samīhitaḥ .. 29 ..
2.2.d:
संपूर्णत्रिंशत्तिथिभिर्मास्येकस्मिन्यदा भवेत् ॥
स चान्द्रो मलिनो मासः कोणपाद्यैः समीहितः ॥ 29 ॥
2.2.m: When in one month there are thirty complete lunar days, / that lunar month is an impure month, sought by Koṇapa and others.

2.2.s:
bhuktocchiṣṭā tu tanmāsādasaṃspṛṣṭadivākaraḥ ..
yadā saṃkramate laṃghya tadā jñeyo malimlucaḥ .. 2.2.6.30 ..
2.2.d:
भुक्तोच्छिष्टा तु तन्मासादसंस्पृष्टदिवाकरः ॥
यदा संक्रमते लंघ्य तदा ज्ञेयो मलिम्लुचः ॥ 2.2.6.30 ॥
2.2.m: When the sun, untouched by that month, transits by leaping over the remnant that was consumed, / then it should be known as an intercalary month.

2.2.s:
sārdhavarṣadvaye pūrṇe patatyevaṃ niśākaraḥ ..
parityaktāśca yāvaṃtyo vyutkramiṇyaśca yāḥ punaḥ ..
tithayaste niyoktavyā naro na syātsa pūraṇaḥ .. 31 ..
2.2.d:
सार्धवर्षद्वये पूर्णे पतत्येवं निशाकरः ॥
परित्यक्ताश्च यावंत्यो व्युत्क्रमिण्यश्च याः पुनः ॥
तिथयस्ते नियोक्तव्या नरो न स्यात्स पूरणः ॥ 31 ॥
2.2.m: When two and a half years are complete, the moon falls thus [into intercalation]. / Whatever lunar days are omitted and also those that are irregular, / they should be appointed; a man should not be that replenisher.

2.2.s:
nairṛtyāṃtaṃ hitārthāya jalaketurnigacchati ..
nirmamaṃ malinaṃ māsaṃ pretānāṃ ca hitāya ca ..32..
2.2.d:
नैरृत्यांतं हितार्थाय जलकेतुर्निगच्छति ॥
निर्ममं मलिनं मासं प्रेतानां च हिताय च ॥32॥
2.2.m: For the sake of welfare toward the southwest, Jalaketu goes forth, / indifferent to the unclean month, and for the benefit of the pretas.

2.2.s:
ataḥ pretakriyāḥ sarvāḥ kāryā malimluce'pi ca..
yatkartavyaṃ na kartavyaṃ malamāse dvijottamāḥ ..33..
2.2.d:
अतः प्रेतक्रियाः सर्वाः कार्या मलिम्लुचेऽपि च॥
यत्कर्तव्यं न कर्तव्यं मलमासे द्विजोत्तमाः ॥33॥
2.2.m: Therefore all preta-rites are to be performed even in an intercalary month. / What is to be done and what is not to be done in an intercalated month, O best of the twice-born,

2.2.s:
tadidānīṃ pravakṣyāmi kathitaṃ ca prasaṃgataḥ ..
yacchrāddhaṃ pretasaṃbaṃdhi sarpiḍīkaraṇāvadhi ..
malamāse'pi tatkāryaṃ viśi naṣṭi sapiṃḍanam .. 34 ..
2.2.d:
तदिदानीं प्रवक्ष्यामि कथितं च प्रसंगतः ॥
यच्छ्राद्धं प्रेतसंबंधि सर्पिडीकरणावधि ॥
मलमासेऽपि तत्कार्यं विशि नष्टि सपिंडनम् ॥ 34 ॥
2.2.m: that I will now declare, as it has been mentioned in this context: / The śrāddha related to the preta up to the sapiṇḍīkaraṇa rite / must be performed even in an intercalary month; it preserves the sapiṇḍana.

2.2.s:
yadā tu dvādaśo māso daivānmalimluco bhavet.
tatraiva yatnātkartavyā kriyā pretasya vārṣikī .. 35 ..
2.2.d:
यदा तु द्वादशो मासो दैवान्मलिम्लुचो भवेत्।
तत्रैव यत्नात्कर्तव्या क्रिया प्रेतस्य वार्षिकी ॥ 35 ॥
2.2.m: When, however, the twelfth month happens by fate to be an intercalary month, / right there the annual rite for the preta must be performed with diligence.

2.2.s:
māsāṃtare tu patite tasminneva malimluce ..
tadā trayodaśe māsi kartavyaṃ tatsapiṃḍanam.. 36 ..
2.2.d:
मासांतरे तु पतिते तस्मिन्नेव मलिम्लुचे ॥
तदा त्रयोदशे मासि कर्तव्यं तत्सपिंडनम्॥ 36 ॥
2.2.m: When, however, that intercalary month falls within the intervening months, / then that sapiṇḍana must be performed in the thirteenth month.

2.2.s:
varjyaṃ māsikayā śrāddhamekaṃ tasmiṃstrayodaśe ..
triṃśatā ghaṭikaiḥ śrāddhaṃ vardhate'dyāpi saṃmitam .. 37 ..
2.2.d:
वर्ज्यं मासिकया श्राद्धमेकं तस्मिंस्त्रयोदशे ॥
त्रिंशता घटिकैः श्राद्धं वर्धतेऽद्यापि संमितम् ॥ 37 ॥
2.2.m: One monthly śrāddha is to be avoided in that thirteenth [month]; / up to today, a śrāddha increases measured by thirty ghaṭikās.

2.2.s:
kuryātpatyābdikaṃ karma prayatnena malimluce ..
naimittikaṃ ca kurvīta nādhikārastayorbhavet .. 38 ..
2.2.d:
कुर्यात्पत्याब्दिकं कर्म प्रयत्नेन मलिम्लुचे ॥
नैमित्तिकं च कुर्वीत नाधिकारस्तयोर्भवेत् ॥ 38 ॥
2.2.m: One should diligently perform the annual rite of the husband in an intercalary month, / and one may perform occasional rites; there is no additional entitlement for both.

2.2.s:
tīrthasnānamalabhyaṃ tattadādyaṃ devadarśanam ..
upavāsādikaṃ karma sīmantonnayanaṃ tathā .. 39 ..
2.2.d:
तीर्थस्नानमलभ्यं तत्तदाद्यं देवदर्शनम् ॥
उपवासादिकं कर्म सीमन्तोन्नयनं तथा ॥ 39 ॥
2.2.m: Bathing at holy places that is hard to attain, the first darśana of a deity, / rites such as fasting, and likewise the parting of the hair rite,

2.2.s:
ārtavarjaṃ puṃsavanaṃ putrādimukhadarśanam ..
malamāsepi kurvīta śukre cāstamupāgate ..2.2.6.40..
2.2.d:
आर्तवर्जं पुंसवनं पुत्रादिमुखदर्शनम् ॥
मलमासेपि कुर्वीत शुक्रे चास्तमुपागते ॥2.2.6.40॥
2.2.m: the puṃsavana rite, except during menses, looking upon the face of one's son and so forth— / one should perform these even in an intercalary month, and when Venus has set.

2.2.s:
malamāsepi kurvīta nṛpāṇāmabhiṣecanam..
vratāraṃbhaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca cūḍākarma ca mekhalām..41..
2.2.d:
मलमासेपि कुर्वीत नृपाणामभिषेचनम्॥
व्रतारंभं प्रतिष्ठां च चूडाकर्म च मेखलाम्॥41॥
2.2.m: [Nor] in an intercalary month should one perform the consecration of kings, / the commencement of a votive observance, installation, tonsure, and the investiture of the girdle,

2.2.s:
maṃtropāsāṃ rahasyaṃ ca mahādānaṃ sumaṅgalam ..
vivāhaṃ ca gṛhāraṃbhaṃ praveśaṃ navaveśmanaḥ .. 42 ..
2.2.d:
मंत्रोपासां रहस्यं च महादानं सुमङ्गलम् ॥
विवाहं च गृहारंभं प्रवेशं नववेश्मनः ॥ 42 ॥
2.2.m: worship with mantras, secret [rites], highly auspicious great donations, / marriage, beginning a house, entering a new house,

2.2.s:
upagrahaṃ gavādīnāmāśramāṃtarasaṃkramam ..
dīrghamātrāsu nejyaṃ vai tīrthayātrāvasecanam.. 43 ..
2.2.d:
उपग्रहं गवादीनामाश्रमांतरसंक्रमम् ॥
दीर्घमात्रासु नेज्यं वै तीर्थयात्रावसेचनम्॥ 43 ॥
2.2.m: purchasing cattle and the like, transitioning to another stage of life; / sacrifice is certainly not [to be done] on long journeys, nor pilgrimage, nor sprinkling rites.

2.2.s:
varṣavṛddhivṛṣotsargakanyā dvirnayanādi ca ..
yajñaṃ ca kāmikaṃ vidvānmalamāse vivarjayet ..44..
2.2.d:
वर्षवृद्धिवृषोत्सर्गकन्या द्विर्नयनादि च ॥
यज्ञं च कामिकं विद्वान्मलमासे विवर्जयेत् ॥44॥
2.2.m: Birthdays, release of a bull, taking away a maiden for the second time, and so forth, / and optional sacrifices—a wise person should avoid them in an intercalary month.

2.2.s:
evamastaṃ gate śukre vṛddhabālye ca saṃtyajet..
pādāstaṃ ca mahāstaṃ ca dvividhaṃ cāstamasya tu .. 45 ..
2.2.d:
एवमस्तं गते शुक्रे वृद्धबाल्ये च संत्यजेत्॥
पादास्तं च महास्तं च द्विविधं चास्तमस्य तु ॥ 45 ॥
2.2.m: Likewise, when Venus has set, and in its old age and infancy, one should renounce [such acts]. / Its setting is twofold: pādāsta and mahāsta.

2.2.s:
dvisaptatirdinānyasya mahāstaṃ pūrvato bhavet ..
pṛthivyāmeva pādāstaṃ bhaveddvādaśa vatsarān .. 46 ..
2.2.d:
द्विसप्ततिर्दिनान्यस्य महास्तं पूर्वतो भवेत् ॥
पृथिव्यामेव पादास्तं भवेद्द्वादश वत्सरान् ॥ 46 ॥
2.2.m: Its mahāsta in the east lasts seventy-two days; / on earth indeed, the pādāsta lasts twelve years.

2.2.s:
ūnapañcāśadadhikaṃ divasānāṃ śatadvayam ..
pratīcyāmuditaḥ kāvyo dṛśyo bhavati sarvadā .. 47 ..
2.2.d:
ऊनपञ्चाशदधिकं दिवसानां शतद्वयम् ॥
प्रतीच्यामुदितः काव्यो दृश्यो भवति सर्वदा ॥ 47 ॥
2.2.m: Two hundred and forty-nine days, / when risen in the west, Venus is always visible.

2.2.s:
ekarkṣe guruṇā yukto yāvattiṣṭhati bhārgavaḥ ..
malamāsavatkarmāṇi prāhustyājyāni sarvaśaḥ ..48..
2.2.d:
एकर्क्षे गुरुणा युक्तो यावत्तिष्ठति भार्गवः ॥
मलमासवत्कर्माणि प्राहुस्त्याज्यानि सर्वशः ॥48॥
2.2.m: As long as Venus remains conjoined with Jupiter in a single asterism, / they say all rites are to be completely abandoned, just as in an intercalary month.

2.2.s:
ṛkṣabhede tvekarāśau saṃparke yadi vānayoḥ ..
guro rāhorapi tathā tyajedvidvānna saṃśayaḥ .. 49 ..
2.2.d:
ऋक्षभेदे त्वेकराशौ संपर्के यदि वानयोः ॥
गुरो राहोरपि तथा त्यजेद्विद्वान्न संशयः ॥ 49 ॥
2.2.m: If there is a contact between these two even in different asterisms but within a single zodiacal sign, / or likewise between Jupiter and Rāhu, the wise man should undoubtedly avoid [rites].

2.2.s:
siṃhe rāśau sthite sūrye jīve cāstamupāgate ..
heyāni yāni karmāṇi niṣiddhāni malimluce .. 2.2.6.50 ..
2.2.d:
सिंहे राशौ स्थिते सूर्ये जीवे चास्तमुपागते ॥
हेयानि यानि कर्माणि निषिद्धानि मलिम्लुचे ॥ 2.2.6.50 ॥
2.2.m: When the sun is in the sign of Leo and Jupiter has set, / those rites that are forbidden in an intercalary month should be abandoned.

2.2.s:
mithunasthe yadā bhānau malamāsaḥ patatyasau ..
dvirāṣāḍha iti khyāto gauṇe śabdavivartanāt .. 51 ..
2.2.d:
मिथुनस्थे यदा भानौ मलमासः पतत्यसौ ॥
द्विराषाढ इति ख्यातो गौणे शब्दविवर्तनात् ॥ 51 ॥
2.2.m: When that intercalary month falls while the sun is in Gemini, / it is known as Double Āṣāḍha, through a secondary transference of the word.

2.2.s:
phalaṃ cātra mṛtasyaurdhvadehikaṃ karma kurvatā ..
āṣāḍhakīrtanaṃ kāryamevaṃ varṣāṃtare'pi ca .. 52 ..
2.2.d:
फलं चात्र मृतस्यौर्ध्वदेहिकं कर्म कुर्वता ॥
आषाढकीर्तनं कार्यमेवं वर्षांतरेऽपि च ॥ 52 ॥
2.2.m: And here, for the person performing the post-mortem rite for the deceased, the fruit [accrues]; / the mention of Āṣāḍha is to be made, and likewise in another year.

2.2.s:
āṣāḍhadvayasaṃyuktapūrṇamāsīdvayaṃ tathā ..
yugmakarkaṭayo rāśyo dvirāṣāḍhastadā bhavet .. 53 ..
2.2.d:
आषाढद्वयसंयुक्तपूर्णमासीद्वयं तथा ॥
युग्मकर्कटयो राश्यो द्विराषाढस्तदा भवेत् ॥ 53 ॥
2.2.m: Endowed with two Āṣāḍhas, and likewise with two full-moon days / across the two signs of Gemini and Cancer, it then becomes Double Āṣāḍha.

2.2.s:
bhavedgauṇo dvirāṣāḍho rāśistatraiva saṃyute ..
pūrvatrike tu patite tadeva bhagavānhariḥ .. 54 ..
2.2.d:
भवेद्गौणो द्विराषाढो राशिस्तत्रैव संयुते ॥
पूर्वत्रिके तु पतिते तदेव भगवान्हरिः ॥ 54 ॥
2.2.m: Double Āṣāḍha becomes secondary when the zodiacal sign is conjoined right there; / when it falls in the first triad, then Lord Hari

2.2.s:
karkaṭe śayanaṃ kuryādāgamiṣyaṃ paratrake ..
karkiṇyarke suptaharau śakrapūjāśvine bhavet .. 55 ..
2.2.d:
कर्कटे शयनं कुर्यादागमिष्यं परत्रके ॥
कर्किण्यर्के सुप्तहरौ शक्रपूजाश्विने भवेत् ॥ 55 ॥
2.2.m: should take His rest in Cancer, intending to come in the later triad. / When the sun is in Cancer and Hari is sleeping, the worship of Indra takes place in Āśvina;

2.2.s:
durgotthānaṃ tulāyāṃ tu viṣṇurnidrāṃ jahātyasau .. 56 ..
tithividhānavarṇanam
2.2.d:
दुर्गोत्थानं तुलायां तु विष्णुर्निद्रां जहात्यसौ ॥ 56 ॥
तिथिविधानवर्णनम्
2.2.m:
the awakening of Durgā takes place in Libra, [when] Viṣṇu abandons His sleep.
Description of the rules regarding lunar days

2.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
daivaṃ vā paitṛkaṃ karma kālamāśritya vartate ..
kāle tānyeva karmāṇi phalaṃ yacchaṃti kurvatām .. 1 ..
2.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
दैवं वा पैतृकं कर्म कालमाश्रित्य वर्तते ॥
काले तान्येव कर्माणि फलं यच्छंति कुर्वताम् ॥ 1 ॥
2.2.m: Sūta said: / A rite for the gods or for the ancestors depends upon time; / in proper time, those very rites bestow fruit upon those who perform them.

2.2.s:
muhurbālye karmaphalaṃ trikāle'pi na vidyate ..
vyayo vā mukhyabhāvena phaladaḥ karmaśālinām .. 2 ..
2.2.d:
मुहुर्बाल्ये कर्मफलं त्रिकालेऽपि न विद्यते ॥
व्ययो वा मुख्यभावेन फलदः कर्मशालिनाम् ॥ 2 ॥
2.2.m: A karmic fruit repeatedly in its nascent stage does not exist even in the three divisions of time; / or expenditure primarily bears fruit for those who possess rites.

2.2.s:
kālastu guṇabhāvena sarvakālāśritā kriyā ..
na kālena vinā kiñcittriṣu lokeṣu jāyate .. 3 ..
2.2.d:
कालस्तु गुणभावेन सर्वकालाश्रिता क्रिया ॥
न कालेन विना किञ्चित्त्रिषु लोकेषु जायते ॥ 3 ॥
2.2.m: Time, however, serves as a subordinate factor, while action depends upon all time; / nothing in the three worlds comes to be without time.

2.2.s:
ataḥ kālaṃ pravakṣyāmi nimittaṃ karmaṇāmiha .
kāle hyamūrtirbhagavāneka eva tu yadyapi ..
tathāpyupādhibhedena bhidyate kālabhedibhiḥ ..4..
2.2.d:
अतः कालं प्रवक्ष्यामि निमित्तं कर्मणामिह ।
काले ह्यमूर्तिर्भगवानेक एव तु यद्यपि ॥
तथाप्युपाधिभेदेन भिद्यते कालभेदिभिः ॥4॥
2.2.m: Therefore I will explain time here, the cause of rites. / For though the Lord is bodiless and only one in time, / He is nevertheless differentiated by the dividers of time through differences in limiting conditions.

2.2.s:
tithinakṣatravārādau rātriyogādayopi ye ..
te'pi kālāḥ pakṣamāsarāśivarṣāṃtare'pi ca ..
sādhanāni bhavantyete svātantryeṇa na kasyacit ..5..
2.2.d:
तिथिनक्षत्रवारादौ रात्रियोगादयोपि ये ॥
तेऽपि कालाः पक्षमासराशिवर्षांतरेऽपि च ॥
साधनानि भवन्त्येते स्वातन्त्र्येण न कस्यचित् ॥5॥
2.2.m: Whatever [divisions exist] at the beginning of lunar days, asterisms, weekdays, and the combinations of night, / those times also within fortnights, months, signs, and years / become means [of rites], never through the autonomy of anyone.

2.2.s:
dharmasya vāpyadharmasya mukhyo vyāpāra eva saḥ ..
tithyādikālabhāveṣu niṣiddhaṃ nihitaṃ hi tat .. 6 ..
2.2.d:
धर्मस्य वाप्यधर्मस्य मुख्यो व्यापार एव सः ॥
तिथ्यादिकालभावेषु निषिद्धं निहितं हि तत् ॥ 6 ॥
2.2.m: That very activity is the principal element of virtue or of non-virtue; / for that which is forbidden is laid down according to the temporal conditions such as the lunar day.

2.2.s:
pālayansvargamāpnoti hitvā prāpnotyadhogatim ..
sādhayaṃtyapi karmāṇi parasparamavekṣyate .. .. 7 ..
2.2.d:
पालयन्स्वर्गमाप्नोति हित्वा प्राप्नोत्यधोगतिम् ॥
साधयंत्यपि कर्माणि परस्परमवेक्ष्यते ॥ ॥ 7 ॥
2.2.m: Observing it, one attains heaven; abandoning it, one attains a low state. / While rites accomplish [their ends], they are mutually observed;

2.2.s:
kālabhāgo niḥsahāyo ye'pi syuḥ karmasādhanāḥ ..
tithau pūrvāhṇavyāpinyāṃ kurvīta karma vaidikam .. 8 ..
2.2.d:
कालभागो निःसहायो येऽपि स्युः कर्मसाधनाः ॥
तिथौ पूर्वाह्णव्यापिन्यां कुर्वीत कर्म वैदिकम् ॥ 8 ॥
2.2.m: a portion of time is without assistance, whatever means of rites there may be. / On a lunar day pervading the morning, one should perform a Vedic rite.

2.2.s:
ekoddiṣṭaṃ tu madhyāhnavyāpinyāṃ hi samācaret..
parāhṇavyāpinīṃ prāpya tithiṃ kuryāttu pārvaṇam .. 9 ..
2.2.d:
एकोद्दिष्टं तु मध्याह्नव्यापिन्यां हि समाचरेत्॥
पराह्णव्यापिनीं प्राप्य तिथिं कुर्यात्तु पार्वणम् ॥ 9 ॥
2.2.m: One should perform an ekoddiṣṭa rite on [a lunar day] pervading midday; / having reached a lunar day pervading the afternoon, one should perform a pārvaṇa rite.

2.2.s:
na tu pūrvāhṇamadhyāhnaparāhṇeṣu yathocitam ..
apradhāne tu kurvīta karma daivādikaṃ ca yat..2.2.7.10..
2.2.d:
न तु पूर्वाह्णमध्याह्नपराह्णेषु यथोचितम् ॥
अप्रधाने तु कुर्वीत कर्म दैवादिकं च यत्॥2.2.7.10॥
2.2.m: Not [irregularly], but in the forenoon, midday, and afternoon, as is fitting; / on an insignificant [lunar day], however, whatever divine or other rite there is should be performed.

2.2.s:
eko hi kālaḥ prātastu vṛddhiśrāddhādisādhane ..
nāpekṣate sāhāyyaṃ tattithyādiviṣuvādiṣu ..11..
2.2.d:
एको हि कालः प्रातस्तु वृद्धिश्राद्धादिसाधने ॥
नापेक्षते साहाय्यं तत्तिथ्यादिविषुवादिषु ॥11॥
2.2.m: Indeed, morning is the sole time for accomplishing the vṛddhiśrāddha and the like; / that does not require assistance during equinoxes and the like, beginning with lunar days.

2.2.s:
devebhyo brahmaṇā dattaḥ pūrvāhṇastithibhiḥ saha ..
pitṛbhyo hyaparāhṇastu pārvaṇaṃ tu paraṃ vinā .. 12 ..
2.2.d:
देवेभ्यो ब्रह्मणा दत्तः पूर्वाह्णस्तिथिभिः सह ॥
पितृभ्यो ह्यपराह्णस्तु पार्वणं तु परं विना ॥ 12 ॥
2.2.m: The forenoon was given by Brahmā to the gods along with the lunar days; / the afternoon to the ancestors, without any other pārvaṇa [time].

2.2.s:
pūrvāhṇamātrasaṃprāptau tato devānprapūjayet ..
pūrvāhṇasparśamātre'pi tithikhaṇḍena cārpayet ..13..
2.2.d:
पूर्वाह्णमात्रसंप्राप्तौ ततो देवान्प्रपूजयेत् ॥
पूर्वाह्णस्पर्शमात्रेऽपि तिथिखण्डेन चार्पयेत् ॥13॥
2.2.m: Upon reaching merely the forenoon, one should thereupon worship the gods; / even by mere contact with the forenoon, one should offer with a fraction of a lunar day.

2.2.s:
kharvā darpā tathā hiṃsrā tithiśca trividhā bhavet ..
kharvādi laṃghayettulyā darpā bhavati varddhitā ..14..
2.2.d:
खर्वा दर्पा तथा हिंस्रा तिथिश्च त्रिविधा भवेत् ॥
खर्वादि लंघयेत्तुल्या दर्पा भवति वर्द्धिता ॥14॥
2.2.m: A lunar day is threefold: kharvā, darpā, and hiṃsrā; / kharvā is equal when transcending, darpā is increased,

2.2.s:
hiṃsrā tu kṣayajā jñeyā kālabhedena gṛhyate ..
kharvā darpā pare grāhyā hiṃsrā grāhyā tu pūrvataḥ .. 16..
2.2.d:
हिंस्रा तु क्षयजा ज्ञेया कालभेदेन गृह्यते ॥
खर्वा दर्पा परे ग्राह्या हिंस्रा ग्राह्या तु पूर्वतः ॥ 16॥
2.2.m: while hiṃsrā is to be known as born of diminution; it is taken according to division of time. / Kharvā and darpā should be taken on the subsequent [day], but hiṃsrā should be taken on the preceding [day].

2.2.s:
śuklapakṣe parā grāhyā kṛṣṇe pūrvā praśasyate ..
snānadānavrate caiva viṣayogo nidarśitaḥ .. 17 ..
2.2.d:
शुक्लपक्षे परा ग्राह्या कृष्णे पूर्वा प्रशस्यते ॥
स्नानदानव्रते चैव विषयोगो निदर्शितः ॥ 17 ॥
2.2.m: In the bright fortnight, the subsequent is to be taken; in the dark [fortnight], the preceding is praised. / In bathing, giving, and votive observance, the conjunction with poison is pointed out.

2.2.s:
tithau codeti savitā kālamātraṃ ca vā yadi ..
anyāpi saiva vijñeyā tithistasminnaharniśam .. 16 ..
2.2.d:
तिथौ चोदेति सविता कालमात्रं च वा यदि ॥
अन्यापि सैव विज्ञेया तिथिस्तस्मिन्नहर्निशम् ॥ 16 ॥
2.2.m:
And if the sun rises on a lunar day even for the briefest measure of time,
that very lunar day is to be known as extending for that entire day and night, even if another occurs.

2.2.s:
yathāvāste ravirbhāti ghaṭikā daśa vāpi vā..
sā tithistadahorātraṃ vyapadeśyā na cetarā..19..
2.2.d:
यथावास्ते रविर्भाति घटिका दश वापि वा॥
सा तिथिस्तदहोरात्रं व्यपदेश्या न चेतरा॥19॥
2.2.m:
Or as the sun shines at sunset, or for even ten ghaṭikās,
that lunar day is to be designated as lasting that day and night, and no other.

2.2.s:
śukle vā yadi vā kṛṣṇe kharvā darpā tithiśca yā ..
yayāstaṃ savitā yāti pitṛkārye ca sā tithiḥ .. 2.2.7.20 ..
2.2.d:
शुक्ले वा यदि वा कृष्णे खर्वा दर्पा तिथिश्च या ॥
ययास्तं सविता याति पितृकार्ये च सा तिथिः ॥ 2.2.7.20 ॥
2.2.m:
Whether in the bright or in the dark [fortnight], whatever lunar day is a kharvā or darpā,
and by which the sun sets, that is the lunar day for ancestral rites.

2.2.s:
dinadvaye'pi kutape astagāṃ tithimāśrayet ..
śrāddhakālādikaṃ yatra tatra śrāddhaṃ vidhīyate ..
vrate ca vṛddhigāminyāṃ yatrodayo raverbhavet ..21..
2.2.d:
दिनद्वयेऽपि कुतपे अस्तगां तिथिमाश्रयेत् ॥
श्राद्धकालादिकं यत्र तत्र श्राद्धं विधीयते ॥
व्रते च वृद्धिगामिन्यां यत्रोदयो रवेर्भवेत् ॥21॥

2.2.s:
amāvāsyapārvaṇe ca sā tithiḥ pitṛpūjane ..
amāvasyāmṛtasyaiva pārvaṇaṃ yatra kutracit ..22..
2.2.d:
अमावास्यपार्वणे च सा तिथिः पितृपूजने ॥
अमावस्यामृतस्यैव पार्वणं यत्र कुत्रचित् ॥22॥
2.2.m:
And in the pārvaṇa rite on a new moon, that lunar day is for worshipping the ancestors;
for one who died on the new moon day, the pārvaṇa rite is performed wherever [it falls].

2.2.s:
astagāmitithiryatra sā tithiḥ pitṛmaṃdiram..
ekoddiṣṭaṃ carettatra nodaye ca kadācana..23..
2.2.d:
अस्तगामितिथिर्यत्र सा तिथिः पितृमंदिरम्॥
एकोद्दिष्टं चरेत्तत्र नोदये च कदाचन॥23॥
2.2.m:
Where the lunar day extends to sunset, that lunar day belongs to the realm of the ancestors;
one should perform the single-ancestor rite then, and never at sunrise.

2.2.s:
śuklapakṣe ca kṛṣṇe ca yo yogaḥ parapūrvayoḥ..
pūrvedyurvā paredyurvā trisaṃdhyavyāpinī tithiḥ..
sā pūjyā ca svakṛtyeṣu pakṣayorubhayorapi ..24..
2.2.d:
शुक्लपक्षे च कृष्णे च यो योगः परपूर्वयोः॥
पूर्वेद्युर्वा परेद्युर्वा त्रिसंध्यव्यापिनी तिथिः॥
सा पूज्या च स्वकृत्येषु पक्षयोरुभयोरपि ॥24॥
2.2.m:
Both in the bright fortnight and in the dark fortnight, whatever junction occurs between the subsequent and preceding [lunar days],
a lunar day that encompasses the three twilight periods, whether on the previous day or on the following day,
is to be honoured in its respective rites in both fortnights.

2.2.s:
pūjyā hi vyastaṃ saṃtyajya pūrvaṃ caikādaśīyugam ..
dvitīyā vahninā yuktā caturthī paṃcamīyutā .. .. 25 ..
2.2.d:
पूज्या हि व्यस्तं संत्यज्य पूर्वं चैकादशीयुगम् ॥
द्वितीया वह्निना युक्ता चतुर्थी पंचमीयुता ॥ ॥ 25 ॥
2.2.m:
Indeed, having abandoned the reversed conjunction, the pair of the preceding and the ekādaśī should be honoured,
and the dvitīyā joined with the third, the caturthī joined with the fifth;

2.2.s:
etā upoṣyāstithayaḥ puṇyāḥ syurdharmavedibhiḥ ..
etadvyastāstu puṇyāni ghnaṃti pūrvakṛtānyapi .. 26 ..
2.2.d:
एता उपोष्यास्तिथयः पुण्याः स्युर्धर्मवेदिभिः ॥
एतद्व्यस्तास्तु पुण्यानि घ्नंति पूर्वकृतान्यपि ॥ 26 ॥
2.2.m:
these lunar days should be fasted on as auspicious by those who know the dharma;
when reversed from this, however, they destroy even merit accumulated previously.

2.2.s:
bāṇena viddhā yā ṣaṣṭhī munividdhā tathāṣṭamī ..
daśamyekādaśīviddhā trayodaśyā caturdaśī .. 27 ..
2.2.d:
बाणेन विद्धा या षष्ठी मुनिविद्धा तथाष्टमी ॥
दशम्येकादशीविद्धा त्रयोदश्या चतुर्दशी ॥ 27 ॥
2.2.m:
The ṣaṣṭhī overlapped by the fifth, likewise the aṣṭamī overlapped by the seventh,
the daśamī overlapped by the ekādaśī, the caturdaśī by the trayodaśī,

2.2.s:
amāvāsyā bhūtaviddhā nopoṣyā munināpi ca ..
haṃti putrakalatrāṇi dhanāni samupoṣitā .. 28 ..
2.2.d:
अमावास्या भूतविद्धा नोपोष्या मुनिनापि च ॥
हंति पुत्रकलत्राणि धनानि समुपोषिता ॥ 28 ॥
2.2.m:
and the new moon day overlapped by the fourteenth should not be fasted upon even by an ascetic;
when fasted upon, it destroys sons, wives, and wealth.

2.2.s:
viddhā ye nābhinindyāḥ syuryuktāstenābhinanditāḥ ..
vyastasya saṃbhave yugmaṃ viddhā bhavati sarvaśaḥ ..29..
2.2.d:
विद्धा ये नाभिनिन्द्याः स्युर्युक्तास्तेनाभिनन्दिताः ॥
व्यस्तस्य संभवे युग्मं विद्धा भवति सर्वशः ॥29॥
2.2.m:
Those that are overlapped would not be censured [if proper], and those joined with them are praised;
if a reversed order occurs, the pair becomes overlapped in every way.

2.2.s:
tāmastāṃ tu tithiṃ prāpya yugmānyapūjyatāmiyuḥ ..
yugmāni ca divāyoge grāhyāṇi vyastaniṃdanam .. 2.2.7.30 ..
2.2.d:
तामस्तां तु तिथिं प्राप्य युग्मान्यपूज्यतामियुः ॥
युग्मानि च दिवायोगे ग्राह्याणि व्यस्तनिंदनम् ॥ 2.2.7.30 ॥
2.2.m:
Reaching that setting lunar day, pairs would become unworthy of worship;
and pairs are to be accepted in conjunction with daytime; censure applies to the reversed [order].

2.2.s:
naktādivratayoge tu divāsaṃvarddhamarkarān ..
rātriyogaścaturthyostu viśiṣya parigṛhyate .. 31 ..
2.2.d:
नक्तादिव्रतयोगे तु दिवासंवर्द्धमर्करान् ॥
रात्रियोगश्चतुर्थ्योस्तु विशिष्य परिगृह्यते ॥ 31 ॥
2.2.m:
In the conjunction of a votive observance such as a nocturnal meal, the sun's rays increase during the day;
and the night-conjunction of the two caturthīs is especially accepted.

2.2.s:
rātriyogaṃ vināpi syādekādaśyādikaṃ vratam ..
naktaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ caiva vināyoge'pi śasyate .. 32 ..
2.2.d:
रात्रियोगं विनापि स्यादेकादश्यादिकं व्रतम् ॥
नक्तं जागरणं चैव विनायोगेऽपि शस्यते ॥ 32 ॥
2.2.m:
Even without night-conjunction, a votive observance such as ekādaśī may occur;
a nocturnal meal and a vigil are praised even without such conjunction.

2.2.s:
ekādaśyupavāsaṃ tu dvādaśīyogataścaret ..
divāyoge tu saṃpūrṇāṃ tyajedubhayapūrvataḥ .. 33 ..
2.2.d:
एकादश्युपवासं तु द्वादशीयोगतश्चरेत् ॥
दिवायोगे तु संपूर्णां त्यजेदुभयपूर्वतः ॥ 33 ॥
2.2.m:
One should observe the fast of ekādaśī in conjunction with dvādaśī;
if it is complete in daytime conjunction, one should abandon it before both.

2.2.s:
rātriyoge tu saṃpūrṇā sopāsyaikādaśī sadā ..
saptamī śukla pakṣe'pi pūjyā ṣaṣṭhyā samanvitā .. 34 ..
2.2.d:
रात्रियोगे तु संपूर्णा सोपास्यैकादशी सदा ॥
सप्तमी शुक्ल पक्षेऽपि पूज्या षष्ठ्या समन्विता ॥ 34 ॥
2.2.m:
When it is complete in conjunction with night, that ekādaśī is always to be observed;
in the bright fortnight too, saptamī joined with ṣaṣṭhī is to be honoured.

2.2.s:
niśi tu syādyadā ṣaṣṭhī saptamī navamī divā ..
upoṣya kevalāṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ toṣayedbhāskaraṃ naraḥ .. 35 ..
2.2.d:
निशि तु स्याद्यदा षष्ठी सप्तमी नवमी दिवा ॥
उपोष्य केवलां षष्ठीं तोषयेद्भास्करं नरः ॥ 35 ॥
2.2.m:
When the ṣaṣṭhī falls at night, and the saptamī and navamī during the day,
a person should fast on the isolated ṣaṣṭhī and propitiate the sun.

2.2.s:
evaṃ trayodaśīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ vidhiprāptāṃ vinā dvijāḥ ..
upoṣya pārvatīnāthaṃ toṣayedyaśca kevalam ..36 ..
2.2.d:
एवं त्रयोदशीं कृष्णां विधिप्राप्तां विना द्विजाः ॥
उपोष्य पार्वतीनाथं तोषयेद्यश्च केवलम् ॥36 ॥
2.2.m:
Likewise, O twice-born, without the prescribed dark trayodaśī,
fasting on it alone, one propitiates the lord of Pārvatī.

2.2.s:
divā trayodaśīyuktā kṛṣṇopoṣyā caturdaśī ..
pareṇāpi caturdaśyā na tu kuryādamātithau ..37..
2.2.d:
दिवा त्रयोदशीयुक्ता कृष्णोपोष्या चतुर्दशी ॥
परेणापि चतुर्दश्या न तु कुर्यादमातिथौ ॥37॥
2.2.m:
The dark caturdaśī joined with trayodaśī during the day is to be fasted upon;
and one should not perform it on the new moon day with a subsequent caturdaśī.

2.2.s:
trisaṃdhyavyāpinī prāpya yadi kuryādupauṣaṇam ..
pāraṇaṃ tu sinīvālyāṃ caturdaśyāmupoṣayet..38..
2.2.d:
त्रिसंध्यव्यापिनी प्राप्य यदि कुर्यादुपौषणम् ॥
पारणं तु सिनीवाल्यां चतुर्दश्यामुपोषयेत्॥38॥
2.2.m:
If one undertakes a fast having reached [a lunar day] encompassing the three twilight periods,
one should break the fast on the sinīvālī, fasting on the caturdaśī.

2.2.s:
caturdaśīmatikramya sinīvālyāṃ tu pāraṇāt..
vratāni tasya naśyaṃti prākṛtāni caturdaśīm ..39..
2.2.d:
चतुर्दशीमतिक्रम्य सिनीवाल्यां तु पारणात्॥
व्रतानि तस्य नश्यंति प्राकृतानि चतुर्दशीम् ॥39॥
2.2.m:
Because of breaking the fast on the sinīvālī after transgressing the caturdaśī,
his ordinary votive observances of the caturdaśī perish.

2.2.s:
saptamī lalitā bhādre śaktotthānaṃ ca vāruṇī ..
pūjyāścaitāḥ parāḥ kuryāttrisaṃdhyavyāpinīṣvapi ..2.2.7.40..
2.2.d:
सप्तमी ललिता भाद्रे शक्तोत्थानं च वारुणी ॥
पूज्याश्चैताः पराः कुर्यात्त्रिसंध्यव्यापिनीष्वपि ॥2.2.7.40॥
2.2.m:
The Lalitā-saptamī in the month of Bhādra, the raising of Indra's banner, and the Vāruṇī:
these subsequent ones should be honoured, even when [the previous] encompasses the three twilight periods.

2.2.s:
trisaṃdhyāvyāpinī pūrve parato varddhate yadi ..
saṛkṣā ṛkṣayoge tu ṛkṣābhāve parā yutā..41..
2.2.d:
त्रिसंध्याव्यापिनी पूर्वे परतो वर्द्धते यदि ॥
सऋक्षा ऋक्षयोगे तु ऋक्षाभावे परा युता॥41॥
2.2.m:
If [a lunar day] encompassing the three twilight periods occurs previously and increases further,
it is observed with the asterism when joined with the asterism, or the subsequent one is joined when the asterism is absent.

2.2.s:
ṛkṣābhāve parā grāhyā trisaṃdhyavyāpinīṣvapi ..
śrāvaṇe cādyapāde tu praśastā śakrapūjane ..42..
2.2.d:
ऋक्षाभावे परा ग्राह्या त्रिसंध्यव्यापिनीष्वपि ॥
श्रावणे चाद्यपादे तु प्रशस्ता शक्रपूजने ॥42॥
2.2.m:
In the absence of the asterism, the subsequent one is to be accepted, even among those encompassing the three twilight periods;
and in the first quarter of Śrāvaṇa, it is praised in the worship of Indra.

2.2.s:
abhāve cottarāṣāḍhā dhaniṣṭhā ca viśiṣyate ..
daṇḍārdhaṃ daṇḍamekaṃ vā tadardhaṃ palameva vā ..43..
2.2.d:
अभावे चोत्तराषाढा धनिष्ठा च विशिष्यते ॥
दण्डार्धं दण्डमेकं वा तदर्धं पलमेव वा ॥43॥
2.2.m:
In its absence, Uttarāṣāḍhā and Dhaniṣṭhā are distinguished;
for half a daṇḍa, or one daṇḍa, or half of that, or even a pala,

2.2.s:
udaye saṃyutā grāhyā sā tithiścottamā bhavet ..
trisaṃdhyavyāpinīṃ hitvā pūjyā śuklāṣṭamī parā ..44..
2.2.d:
उदये संयुता ग्राह्या सा तिथिश्चोत्तमा भवेत् ॥
त्रिसंध्यव्यापिनीं हित्वा पूज्या शुक्लाष्टमी परा ॥44॥
2.2.m:
joined at sunrise, that lunar day is to be taken and becomes excellent;
setting aside one encompassing the three twilight periods, the subsequent bright aṣṭamī is to be honoured.

2.2.s:
ravicakravatā grāhyā rathe tithyāderapi ca ..
trisaṃdhyavyāpinī yā tu palamekaṃ pare dine ..45..
2.2.d:
रविचक्रवता ग्राह्या रथे तिथ्यादेरपि च ॥
त्रिसंध्यव्यापिनी या तु पलमेकं परे दिने ॥45॥
2.2.m:
It is to be observed on a chariot with the disc of the sun on the lunar day and the like;
that which encompasses the three twilight periods, even for one pala on the following day,

2.2.s:
apare'pi ca sarvatra halānāṃ vāhanaṃ tyajet..
śuklaikādaśyamāvāsyāsaṃkrāntyāṃ śrāddhavāsare ..46..
2.2.d:
अपरेऽपि च सर्वत्र हलानां वाहनं त्यजेत्॥
शुक्लैकादश्यमावास्यासंक्रान्त्यां श्राद्धवासरे ॥46॥
2.2.m:
and everywhere on the other day, one should avoid driving ploughs;
on the bright ekādaśī, the new moon, a solstice, and on the day of a śrāddha,

2.2.s: narāśvagogajādīnāṃ vāhanātpātakī bhavet ..47..
2.2.d: नराश्वगोगजादीनां वाहनात्पातकी भवेत् ॥47॥
2.2.m: from driving men, horses, cattle, elephants, and the like, one becomes a sinner.

2.2.s:
karturgomahiṣādīnāṃ gardabhoṣṭrakharasya ca ..
na vāhayeddāsa dāsī vāhanenāsti dūṣaṇam .. 48 ..
2.2.d:
कर्तुर्गोमहिषादीनां गर्दभोष्ट्रखरस्य च ॥
न वाहयेद्दास दासी वाहनेनास्ति दूषणम् ॥ 48 ॥
2.2.m:
For the agent, [regarding] cattle, buffaloes, and the like, donkeys, camels, and asses,
he should not cause them to be driven; there is no blame in being driven by a male or female slave.

2.2.s:
bahukālikayajñe ca yajñaśrāddhe tathaiva ca ..
grāmāṃtare na doṣaḥ syāddivi nadyaṃtare'pi ca .. 49 ..
2.2.d:
बहुकालिकयज्ञे च यज्ञश्राद्धे तथैव च ॥
ग्रामांतरे न दोषः स्याद्दिवि नद्यंतरेऽपि च ॥ 49 ॥
2.2.m:
In a prolonged sacrifice, and likewise in a sacrificial śrāddha,
there is no fault in another village, in the sky, or across a river.

2.2.s:
nityaśrāddhe'pyambughaṭe yacchrāddhaṃ māsikaṃ bhavet ..
tatra gomahiṣādīnāṃ vāhane nāsti dūṣaṇam .. 2.2.7.50 ..
2.2.d:
नित्यश्राद्धेऽप्यम्बुघटे यच्छ्राद्धं मासिकं भवेत् ॥
तत्र गोमहिषादीनां वाहने नास्ति दूषणम् ॥ 2.2.7.50 ॥
2.2.m:
In a daily śrāddha, and also in the water-jar rite which is a monthly śrāddha,
there is no fault in driving cattle, buffaloes, and the like.

2.2.s:
kuryādaṃbughaṭaśrāddhaṃ na kālaniyamaṃ kvacit ..
na cānnaniyamaṃ kuryādaśmapātraṃ ca varjayet .. 51 ..
2.2.d:
कुर्यादंबुघटश्राद्धं न कालनियमं क्वचित् ॥
न चान्ननियमं कुर्यादश्मपात्रं च वर्जयेत् ॥ 51 ॥
2.2.m:
One should perform the water-jar śrāddha with no fixed rule of time anywhere;
one should not observe a restriction of food, and one should avoid a stone vessel.

2.2.s:
taijasairnirmitaṃ kumbhamatha vā vṛkṣapatrajam ..
na yojayenmṛnmayaṃ ca śūdrāṇāṃ mṛnmaye vidhiḥ .. 52 ..
2.2.d:
तैजसैर्निर्मितं कुम्भमथ वा वृक्षपत्रजम् ॥
न योजयेन्मृन्मयं च शूद्राणां मृन्मये विधिः ॥ 52 ॥
2.2.m:
A jar made of metal or produced from tree leaves [is used];
one must not employ an earthen one; an earthen one is the rule for Śūdras.

2.2.s:
nivedayecca māsāṃte mṛnmayaṃ vṛkṣamūlake ..
āsphālayetpareṇaiva na vastraṃ tu kathañcana ..
parvaśrāddhe daivalakaṃ tathā raṇḍāśramaṃ tyajet .. 53 ..
2.2.d:
निवेदयेच्च मासांते मृन्मयं वृक्षमूलके ॥
आस्फालयेत्परेणैव न वस्त्रं तु कथञ्चन ॥
पर्वश्राद्धे दैवलकं तथा रण्डाश्रमं त्यजेत् ॥ 53 ॥

2.2.s:
mātāpitṛparityāgī tailahavyādivikrayī ..
catvāriṃśadutsavānāṃ sāṣṭānāṃ ca caredyadi .. 54 ..
2.2.d:
मातापितृपरित्यागी तैलहव्यादिविक्रयी ॥
चत्वारिंशदुत्सवानां साष्टानां च चरेद्यदि ॥ 54 ॥
2.2.m:
One who abandons mother and father, one who sells oil, sacrificial oblations, and the like,
if he celebrates forty-eight festivals,

2.2.s:
striyā vimucyate kaścitsa tu raṇḍāśramī mataḥ ..
aṣṭacatvāriṃśadabdaṃ vayo yāvanna pūryate .. 55 ..
2.2.d:
स्त्रिया विमुच्यते कश्चित्स तु रण्डाश्रमी मतः ॥
अष्टचत्वारिंशदब्दं वयो यावन्न पूर्यते ॥ 55 ॥
2.2.m:
or if someone is deserted by his wife, he is considered a widower,
as long as he has not reached the age of forty-eight years.

2.2.s: putrabhāryāviyuktasya nāsti yajñādhikāritā .. 56 ..
2.2.d: पुत्रभार्यावियुक्तस्य नास्ति यज्ञाधिकारिता ॥ 56 ॥
2.2.m: For one devoid of son and wife, there is no eligibility for Vedic sacrifice.

2.2.s:
yāṃ tithiṃ samanuprāpya samudeti divākaraḥ ..
snānādhyayanadāneṣu sā tithiḥ sakalā smṛtā .. 57 ..
2.2.d:
यां तिथिं समनुप्राप्य समुदेति दिवाकरः ॥
स्नानाध्ययनदानेषु सा तिथिः सकला स्मृता ॥ 57 ॥
2.2.m:
The lunar day upon reaching which the sun rises,
is remembered as complete for bathing, Vedic study, and giving.

2.2.s:
yayāstaṃ savitā yāti kṛṣṇapakṣe tu sā tithiḥ ..
pitṝṇāṃ sakalā jñeyā snānadānādikarmasu .. .. 58 ..
2.2.d:
ययास्तं सविता याति कृष्णपक्षे तु सा तिथिः ॥
पितॄणां सकला ज्ञेया स्नानदानादिकर्मसु ॥ ॥ 58 ॥
2.2.m:
The lunar day in the dark fortnight, however, with which the sun sets,
is known as complete for the ancestors in rites of bathing, giving, and the like.

2.2.s:
saptamī śuklapakṣe yā yāvadicchecca khaṇḍitā ..
ādyabhāge raveḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ parādau yāṣṭamīyutā ..
yadyakhaṇḍā bhavetsaiva tadā jñeyā bhavātmikā .. 59 ..
2.2.d:
सप्तमी शुक्लपक्षे या यावदिच्छेच्च खण्डिता ॥
आद्यभागे रवेः षष्ठ्यां परादौ याष्टमीयुता ॥
यद्यखण्डा भवेत्सैव तदा ज्ञेया भवात्मिका ॥ 59 ॥
2.2.m:
Whatever saptamī in the bright fortnight is interrupted, for as long as one desires,
joined with ṣaṣṭhī in the sun's first part, and with aṣṭamī at the beginning of the next,
if it should be uninterrupted, then it is known as dedicated to Śiva.

2.2.s:
māghamāsena sāpyevaṃ pūrveṇa ravitoṣiṇī ..
manvaṃtarā pareṇaiva snānapānādikarmasu .. 2.2.7.60 ..
uttamatithinirṇayavarṇanam
2.2.d:
माघमासेन साप्येवं पूर्वेण रवितोषिणी ॥
मन्वंतरा परेणैव स्नानपानादिकर्मसु ॥ 2.2.7.60 ॥
उत्तमतिथिनिर्णयवर्णनम्

2.2.s:
..sūta uvāca .. ..
tithīnāṃ pravarā yasmādbrahmaṇā samudāhṛtā ..
pratipāditā pare pūrve pratipādya navodyate .. 1 ..
2.2.d:
॥सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
तिथीनां प्रवरा यस्माद्ब्रह्मणा समुदाहृता ॥
प्रतिपादिता परे पूर्वे प्रतिपाद्य नवोद्यते ॥ 1 ॥
2.2.m: Sūta said: / Because the best among lunar days was proclaimed by Brahmā, / declared after the preceding one, the first lunar day is celebrated anew.

2.2.s:
kārtikāśvayujoścaitre māghe cāpi viśeṣataḥ ..
snānaṃ dānaṃ daśaguṇaṃ śivaviṣṇvośca pūjanam .. 2 ..
2.2.d:
कार्तिकाश्वयुजोश्चैत्रे माघे चापि विशेषतः ॥
स्नानं दानं दशगुणं शिवविष्ण्वोश्च पूजनम् ॥ 2 ॥
2.2.m: In Kārtika and Āśvayuja, and especially in Caitra and Māgha, / bathing, giving gifts, and worship of Śiva and Viṣṇu are tenfold [in fruit].

2.2.s:
agnimiṣṭvā ca kṛtvā ca pratipadyāmiti smṛtam ..
haviṣā sarvadhānyāni prāpnuyādīpsitaṃ dhanam .. 3 ..
2.2.d:
अग्निमिष्ट्वा च कृत्वा च प्रतिपद्यामिति स्मृतम् ॥
हविषा सर्वधान्यानि प्राप्नुयादीप्सितं धनम् ॥ 3 ॥
2.2.m: Having sacrificed to fire and performed it, this is remembered on the first lunar day: / by means of sacrificial offering, one obtains all kinds of grain and desired wealth.

2.2.s:
bṛhaspatau dvitīyāyāṃ śuklāyāṃ vidhipūjanam ..
kṛtvā naktaṃ samaśnīyāllabhate bhūtimīpsitām ..4..
2.2.d:
बृहस्पतौ द्वितीयायां शुक्लायां विधिपूजनम् ॥
कृत्वा नक्तं समश्नीयाल्लभते भूतिमीप्सिताम् ॥4॥
2.2.m: When the second lunar day of the bright fortnight falls on a Thursday, having performed worship according to rule, / one should take a nocturnal meal; one obtains desired prosperity.

2.2.s:
mithune karkaṭe caiva govipradamanāṃtaram ..
dvitīyā yā tu vipreṃdāstāmupoṣya hariṃ yajet ..
yāmupoṣya na vaidhavyaṃ prayāti strī na saṃśayaḥ .. 5 ..
2.2.d:
मिथुने कर्कटे चैव गोविप्रदमनांतरम् ॥
द्वितीया या तु विप्रेंदास्तामुपोष्य हरिं यजेत् ॥
यामुपोष्य न वैधव्यं प्रयाति स्त्री न संशयः ॥ 5 ॥
2.2.m: In Gemini and Cancer, after subduing cows and Brahmins, / having fasted on that second lunar day, O best of Brahmins, one should worship Hari; / having fasted on which, a woman does not incur widowhood, without doubt.

2.2.s:
amūlyaśayanaṃ māsaṃ daṃpatī pratipūjayet ..
vāsobhirgandhapuṣpaiśca nānābhakṣyaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ .. 6 ..
2.2.d:
अमूल्यशयनं मासं दंपती प्रतिपूजयेत् ॥
वासोभिर्गन्धपुष्पैश्च नानाभक्ष्यैः पृथग्विधैः ॥ 6 ॥
2.2.m: One should honour a married couple for a month with priceless bedding, / with garments, fragrant flowers, and various kinds of assorted eatables.

2.2.s:
vaiśākhe śuklapakṣe tu tṛtīyāyāṃ tathaiva ca ..
gaṃgātoye naraḥ snātvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ..7..
2.2.d:
वैशाखे शुक्लपक्षे तु तृतीयायां तथैव च ॥
गंगातोये नरः स्नात्वा मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः ॥7॥
2.2.m: In Vaiśākha, in the bright fortnight, and likewise on the third lunar day, / a man having bathed in Gaṅgā water is freed from all sins.

2.2.s:
svātiyuktatṛtīyāyāṃ vaiśākhe tu viśeṣataḥ ..
māghe tu rohiṇīyuktā vṛṣe cāśvayuje tathā .. 8 ..
2.2.d:
स्वातियुक्ततृतीयायां वैशाखे तु विशेषतः ॥
माघे तु रोहिणीयुक्ता वृषे चाश्वयुजे तथा ॥ 8 ॥
2.2.m: On the third lunar day conjoined with Svāti, especially in Vaiśākha, / but in Māgha conjoined with Rohiṇī, and likewise in Taurus and in Āśvayuja,

2.2.s:
tasyāṃ yaddīyate kiñcittadakṣayamudāhṛtam ..
viśeṣato haviṣyānnaṃ modakādisamāyutam ..9..
2.2.d:
तस्यां यद्दीयते किञ्चित्तदक्षयमुदाहृतम् ॥
विशेषतो हविष्यान्नं मोदकादिसमायुतम् ॥9॥
2.2.m: whatever is given on that day is declared imperishable, / especially food suitable for sacrifice accompanied by modakas and the like.

2.2.s:
toyadānaṃ viśeṣeṇa praśaṃsaṃti manīṣiṇaḥ ..
guḍakarpūrasaṃyuktaṃ brahmaloke mahīyate .. 2.2.8.10 ..
2.2.d:
तोयदानं विशेषेण प्रशंसंति मनीषिणः ॥
गुडकर्पूरसंयुक्तं ब्रह्मलोके महीयते ॥ 2.2.8.10 ॥
2.2.m: The wise especially praise the gift of water; / [when given] accompanied by jaggery and camphor, one is magnified in the world of Brahmā.

2.2.s:
budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā tṛtīyā yadi labhyate ..
tasyāṃ snānopavāsādyamakṣayaṃ parikīrtitam ..11..
2.2.d:
बुधश्रवणसंयुक्ता तृतीया यदि लभ्यते ॥
तस्यां स्नानोपवासाद्यमक्षयं परिकीर्तितम् ॥11॥
2.2.m: If a third lunar day is obtained conjoined with Mercury and Śravaṇa, / bathing, fasting, and the like performed upon it are proclaimed imperishable.

2.2.s:
caturthībharaṇīyoge bhaveccaradinaṃ yadā ..
tadābhyarcya yamaṃ devaṃ mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ .. 12 ..
2.2.d:
चतुर्थीभरणीयोगे भवेच्चरदिनं यदा ॥
तदाभ्यर्च्य यमं देवं मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः ॥ 12 ॥
2.2.m: When there is a conjunction of the fourth lunar day with Bharaṇī on a Tuesday, / then, having worshipped the god Yama, one is freed from all sins.

2.2.s:
śivā śāṃtā sukhā caiva caturthī trividhā smṛtā ..
sāpi bhādrapade śuklā śivaloke supūjitā .. 13 ..
2.2.d:
शिवा शांता सुखा चैव चतुर्थी त्रिविधा स्मृता ॥
सापि भाद्रपदे शुक्ला शिवलोके सुपूजिता ॥ 13 ॥
2.2.m: Śivā, Śāntā, and Sukhā: the fourth lunar day is known to be of three kinds; / that one too in the bright fortnight of Bhādrapada is well-honoured in the world of Śiva.

2.2.s:
kārttike tu bhavecchāyā tathā māghe tu kīrtyate ..
tasyāṃ snānaṃ tapo dānamupavāso japastathā ..
bhavetsahasraguṇitaṃ śrāddhaṃ bhavati cākṣayam .. 14 ..
2.2.d:
कार्त्तिके तु भवेच्छाया तथा माघे तु कीर्त्यते ॥
तस्यां स्नानं तपो दानमुपवासो जपस्तथा ॥
भवेत्सहस्रगुणितं श्राद्धं भवति चाक्षयम् ॥ 14 ॥
2.2.m: In Kārttika it becomes Chāyā, and likewise it is proclaimed in Māgha; / bathing, austerity, gift-giving, fasting, and recitation of mantras upon it / becomes multiplied a thousandfold, and an ancestral rite becomes imperishable.

2.2.s:
gaṇeśe kārayetpūjāṃ modakādibhirādarāt ..
caturthyāṃ vighnanāśāya sarvakāmaprasiddhaye .. 15 ..
2.2.d:
गणेशे कारयेत्पूजां मोदकादिभिरादरात् ॥
चतुर्थ्यां विघ्ननाशाय सर्वकामप्रसिद्धये ॥ 15 ॥
2.2.m: One should respectfully arrange worship to Gaṇeśa with modakas and the like / on the fourth lunar day for the destruction of obstacles and the attainment of all desires.

2.2.s:
śrāvaṇe māsi pañcamyāṃ śuklapakṣe viśeṣataḥ ..
snāpayennavanāgāṃśca gaṃdhatoyaiḥ sugaṃdhibhiḥ .. 16 ..
2.2.d:
श्रावणे मासि पञ्चम्यां शुक्लपक्षे विशेषतः ॥
स्नापयेन्नवनागांश्च गंधतोयैः सुगंधिभिः ॥ 16 ॥
2.2.m: In the month of Śrāvaṇa, especially on the fifth lunar day of the bright fortnight, / one should bathe the nine serpents with fragrant, perfumed water.

2.2.s: teṣāṃ kule prayacchaṃti abhayaṃ prāṇarakṣaṇam .. 17 ..
2.2.d: तेषां कुले प्रयच्छंति अभयं प्राणरक्षणम् ॥ 17 ॥
2.2.m: They bestow fearlessness and preservation of life upon their family.

2.2.s:
dvādaśyobhayalekhe ca gomayena viśeṣataḥ ..
pūjayeddadhidugdhādyaiḥ siṃdūrairapi bhaktitaḥ .. 18 ..
2.2.d:
द्वादश्योभयलेखे च गोमयेन विशेषतः ॥
पूजयेद्दधिदुग्धाद्यैः सिंदूरैरपि भक्तितः ॥ 18 ॥
2.2.m: And on the twelfth, in both drawings [made] especially with cow dung, / one should worship with curds, milk, and the like, and also with vermilion, with devotion.

2.2.s:
supte janārdane kṛṣṇapañcamyāṃ bhavanāṃgaṇe ..
pūjayenmanasādevīṃ vāmāṃ snuhīti saṃśrayām .. 19 ..
2.2.d:
सुप्ते जनार्दने कृष्णपञ्चम्यां भवनांगणे ॥
पूजयेन्मनसादेवीं वामां स्नुहीति संश्रयाम् ॥ 19 ॥
2.2.m: When Janārdana is asleep, on the fifth lunar day of the dark fortnight, in the courtyard of the house / one should worship the left-sided goddess Manasā, resorting to the snuhī plant.

2.2.s:
picumaṃdasya patrāṇi sthāpayedbhavanodare ..
pūjayitvā naro devīṃ na sarpabhayamāpnu yāt .. 2.2.8.20 ..
2.2.d:
पिचुमंदस्य पत्राणि स्थापयेद्भवनोदरे ॥
पूजयित्वा नरो देवीं न सर्पभयमाप्नु यात् ॥ 2.2.8.20 ॥
2.2.m: One should place leaves of the neem tree inside the house; / having worshipped the goddess, a man will not incur fear of snakes.

2.2.s:
yeyaṃ bhādrapade ṣaṣṭhī ṣaṣṭhī ca dvijasattama ..
snānadānādikaṃ tasyāṃ sarvamakṣayamucyate .. 21 ..
2.2.d:
येयं भाद्रपदे षष्ठी षष्ठी च द्विजसत्तम ॥
स्नानदानादिकं तस्यां सर्वमक्षयमुच्यते ॥ 21 ॥
2.2.m: This sixth lunar day which falls in Bhādrapada, O best of the twice-born— / bathing, gift-giving, and the like on that sixth lunar day are all said to be imperishable.

2.2.s:
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ phalāśano viprā viśeṣānmāghakārtike ..
iha cāmutra mukhyāṃ ca labhate khyātimuttamām .. 22 ..
2.2.d:
षष्ठ्यां फलाशनो विप्रा विशेषान्माघकार्तिके ॥
इह चामुत्र मुख्यां च लभते ख्यातिमुत्तमाम् ॥ 22 ॥
2.2.m: Eating fruit on the sixth lunar day, O Brahmins, especially in Māgha and Kārtika, / one obtains prominent, supreme renown both in this world and in the next.

2.2.s:
śuddhe pakṣe ca saptamyāṃ yadā saṃkramate raviḥ ....
mahājayā tadā syādvai saptamī bhāskarapriyā .. 23 ..
2.2.d:
शुद्धे पक्षे च सप्तम्यां यदा संक्रमते रविः ॥॥
महाजया तदा स्याद्वै सप्तमी भास्करप्रिया ॥ 23 ॥
2.2.m: When the sun enters [a sign] on the seventh lunar day in the pure fortnight, / then indeed it is Mahājayā, the seventh lunar day dear to the sun.

2.2.s:
aparājitā tu bhādrasya mahāpātakanāśinī ..
lalitā kevalā jñeyā putrapautra vivarddhinī .. 24 ..
2.2.d:
अपराजिता तु भाद्रस्य महापातकनाशिनी ॥
ललिता केवला ज्ञेया पुत्रपौत्र विवर्द्धिनी ॥ 24 ॥
2.2.m: Aparājitā of Bhādra destroys great sins; / Lalitā alone is to be known as increasing sons and grandsons.

2.2.s:
śuklā vā yadi vā kṛṣṇā ṣaṣṭhī vā saptamī tu vā ..
ravivāreṇa saṃyuktā tithiḥ puṇyatamā smṛtā .. 25 ..
2.2.d:
शुक्ला वा यदि वा कृष्णा षष्ठी वा सप्तमी तु वा ॥
रविवारेण संयुक्ता तिथिः पुण्यतमा स्मृता ॥ 25 ॥
2.2.m: Whether bright or dark, whether the sixth or the seventh lunar day, / conjoined with a Sunday, the lunar day is remembered as most sacred.

2.2.s:
āśvinasya sitāṣṭamyāmaṣṭādaśabhujāṃ yajet ..
kārttike śuklapakṣe vā mahāvibhavavistaraiḥ .. 26 ..
2.2.d:
आश्विनस्य सिताष्टम्यामष्टादशभुजां यजेत् ॥
कार्त्तिके शुक्लपक्षे वा महाविभवविस्तरैः ॥ 26 ॥
2.2.m: On the bright aṣṭamī of Āśvina, or in the bright fortnight of Kārttika, / one should worship the eighteen-armed [goddess] with great displays of wealth.

2.2.s:
āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe māsi śuklāṣṭamyāṃ ca caṃḍikām ..
prātaḥ snātvārcayedbhaktyā rātrau saṃsnāpayeddvijāḥ .. 27 ..
2.2.d:
आषाढे श्रावणे मासि शुक्लाष्टम्यां च चंडिकाम् ॥
प्रातः स्नात्वार्चयेद्भक्त्या रात्रौ संस्नापयेद्द्विजाः ॥ 27 ॥
2.2.m: And on the bright aṣṭamī in the months of Āṣāḍha and Śrāvaṇa, having bathed in the morning, / one should worship Caṇḍikā with devotion, O twice-born, and bathe her at night.

2.2.s:
caitramāsi sitāṣṭamyāmaśokakusumairdvijāḥ ..
arcayenmṛnmayīṃ devīmaśokārthaṃ ca sarvadā .. 28 ..
2.2.d:
चैत्रमासि सिताष्टम्यामशोककुसुमैर्द्विजाः ॥
अर्चयेन्मृन्मयीं देवीमशोकार्थं च सर्वदा ॥ 28 ॥
2.2.m: In the month of Caitra, on the bright aṣṭamī, with aśoka blossoms, O twice-born, / one should worship the clay goddess always for the sake of freedom from sorrow.

2.2.s:
satyaṣṭamamuhūrte vā rohiṇīsahitāṣṭamī ..
śrāvaṇe māsi siṃhārke kvacitsāpi ca śasyate .. 29 ..
2.2.d:
सत्यष्टममुहूर्ते वा रोहिणीसहिताष्टमी ॥
श्रावणे मासि सिंहार्के क्वचित्सापि च शस्यते ॥ 29 ॥
2.2.m: Or when the eighth muhūrta is present, an aṣṭamī conjoined with Rohiṇī / in the month of Śrāvaṇa when the sun is in Leo is also occasionally praised.

2.2.s:
ekādaśīnāṃ koṭīnāṃ vrataiśca labhate phalam..
ato daśaguṇaṃ proktaṃ kṛtvaitatphalamāpnuyāta .. 2.2.8.30 ..
2.2.d:
एकादशीनां कोटीनां व्रतैश्च लभते फलम्॥
अतो दशगुणं प्रोक्तं कृत्वैतत्फलमाप्नुयात ॥ 2.2.8.30 ॥
2.2.m: The fruit one obtains through the votive observances of crores of ekādaśīs, / tenfold that is declared: having performed this, one obtains that fruit.

2.2.s:
aśakto'nyakriyāṃ kartumupavāsaṃ tu kevalam ..
kṛtvā vimucyate pāpātsaptakṛtyakṛtāṃ varaḥ ..31..
2.2.d:
अशक्तोऽन्यक्रियां कर्तुमुपवासं तु केवलम् ॥
कृत्वा विमुच्यते पापात्सप्तकृत्यकृतां वरः ॥31॥
2.2.m: If unable to perform other rites, having observed a mere fast, / the best of performers of the seven rites is freed from sin.

2.2.s:
na kālaniyamastatra na vāraniyamaḥ kvacit ..
nāpi nakṣatradoṣo'sti vāradoṣo na gaṇyate .. 32 ..
2.2.d:
न कालनियमस्तत्र न वारनियमः क्वचित् ॥
नापि नक्षत्रदोषोऽस्ति वारदोषो न गण्यते ॥ 32 ॥
2.2.m: There is no restriction of time in that regard, nor any restriction of day anywhere; / there is neither fault of asterism, nor is fault of weekday counted.

2.2.s:
trikālaṃ pūjayeddevaṃ divā rātrau viśeṣataḥ ..
ardharātre viśeṣeṇa puṣpairnānāvidhairapi ..33..
2.2.d:
त्रिकालं पूजयेद्देवं दिवा रात्रौ विशेषतः ॥
अर्धरात्रे विशेषेण पुष्पैर्नानाविधैरपि ॥33॥
2.2.m: One should worship the god at the three junctures of the day, by day and especially at night, / particularly at midnight, with flowers of various kinds.

2.2.s:
divā titheralābhe tu na kuryādvidhivadvratam ..
rātrisparśe yadi paraṃ rajanyāmapi cāṣṭamī ..34..
2.2.d:
दिवा तिथेरलाभे तु न कुर्याद्विधिवद्व्रतम् ॥
रात्रिस्पर्शे यदि परं रजन्यामपि चाष्टमी ॥34॥
2.2.m: If the lunar day is not obtained by day, one should not perform the votive observance according to rule; / only if there is contact at night, even if the aṣṭamī falls in the night.

2.2.s:
saptamī sārdhayāmaṃ ca rohiṇī vā na saṃspṛśet..
vratī saṃkalpayettatra na ca rātrau kadācana..35..
2.2.d:
सप्तमी सार्धयामं च रोहिणी वा न संस्पृशेत्॥
व्रती संकल्पयेत्तत्र न च रात्रौ कदाचन॥35॥
2.2.m: If the seventh lunar day or Rohiṇī touches half a watch, / the observer of the votive observance should formulate the intention there, and never at night.

2.2.s:
prāgāraṃbhaṃ prakurvīta adhimātrādhike vratī ..
viśvanāthādidevānāṃ darśanaṃ prāgvivarjayet..36..
2.2.d:
प्रागारंभं प्रकुर्वीत अधिमात्राधिके व्रती ॥
विश्वनाथादिदेवानां दर्शनं प्राग्विवर्जयेत्॥36॥
2.2.m: The observer of the votive observance should make the commencement earlier when it exceeds the measure; / one should beforehand avoid the sight of gods such as Viśvanātha.

2.2.s:
yatra tatropavāsī syādyāmāṣṭakavrataṃ caret..
yāmārdhaṃ tatparaṃ yāme pāraṇaṃ vicaredvratī..37..
2.2.d:
यत्र तत्रोपवासी स्याद्यामाष्टकव्रतं चरेत्॥
यामार्धं तत्परं यामे पारणं विचरेद्व्रती॥37॥
2.2.m: Wherever he may be, he should be fasting and observe the votive observance of eight watches; / for half a watch, and in the watch after that, the observer of the votive observance should perform the breaking of the fast.

2.2.s: tatpare cā'nnajanyaṃ vā na kuryātpāraṇaṃ gṛhī .. 38 ..
2.2.d: तत्परे चाऽन्नजन्यं वा न कुर्यात्पारणं गृही ॥ 38 ॥
2.2.m: And after that, a householder should not perform the breaking of the fast with grain-born food.

2.2.s:
nakṣatrayoge grahaṇe pūjayetparameśvaram ..
japahomādikaṃ kuryādgṛhī nopavasetkvacit .. 39 ..
2.2.d:
नक्षत्रयोगे ग्रहणे पूजयेत्परमेश्वरम् ॥
जपहोमादिकं कुर्याद्गृही नोपवसेत्क्वचित् ॥ 39 ॥
2.2.m: During a conjunction of asterisms or an eclipse, one should worship the Supreme Lord; / a householder should perform mantra recitation, fire offerings, and the like, and never fast.

2.2.s:
divāṣṭamyāṃ muhūrte vā prājāpatyena saṃyutam ..
tathāpi ca divākṛtyaṃ samāpya ca vrataṃ caret .. 2.2.8.40 ..
2.2.d:
दिवाष्टम्यां मुहूर्ते वा प्राजापत्येन संयुतम् ॥
तथापि च दिवाकृत्यं समाप्य च व्रतं चरेत् ॥ 2.2.8.40 ॥
2.2.m: By day on an aṣṭamī, or during a muhūrta conjoined with Prajāpati's asterism, / nevertheless, having finished the day's duties, one should perform the votive observance.

2.2.s:
muhūrtāṃte ca māsāṃte aṣṭamyāmapi rohiṇī ..
upavāse ca yo doṣaḥ pūjāhomaḥ praśasyate .. 41 ..
2.2.d:
मुहूर्तांते च मासांते अष्टम्यामपि रोहिणी ॥
उपवासे च यो दोषः पूजाहोमः प्रशस्यते ॥ 41 ॥
2.2.m: And at the end of a muhūrta, at the end of a month, and on an aṣṭamī [conjoined with] Rohiṇī, / whatever fault there is in fasting, worship and fire offering are praised.

2.2.s:
navamyāṃ ca sadā pūjyāḥ pratimāse'yutaṃ dvijāḥ ..
gṛhṇīyānniyamaṃ caiva yathā karma phalapradam .. .. 42 ..
2.2.d:
नवम्यां च सदा पूज्याः प्रतिमासेऽयुतं द्विजाः ॥
गृह्णीयान्नियमं चैव यथा कर्म फलप्रदम् ॥ ॥ 42 ॥
2.2.m: And on the navamī in every month, ten thousand twice-born are always to be honoured; / and one should undertake the rule according to which action yields fruit.

2.2.s:
kārtikasya tu māsasya daśamī śuklapakṣikā ..
tasyāṃ yuktāśanā viprā brahmalokamavāpnuyuḥ .. 43 ..
2.2.d:
कार्तिकस्य तु मासस्य दशमी शुक्लपक्षिका ॥
तस्यां युक्ताशना विप्रा ब्रह्मलोकमवाप्नुयुः ॥ 43 ॥
2.2.m: On the tenth lunar day of the bright fortnight of the month of Kārtika, / eating moderately on it, Brahmins attain the world of Brahmā.

2.2.s:
daśamī jyeṣṭhamāsasya sā ceddaśaharā smṛtā ..
āśvinasya mahāpuṇyā kārtike vijayā smṛtā .. 44 ..
2.2.d:
दशमी ज्येष्ठमासस्य सा चेद्दशहरा स्मृता ॥
आश्विनस्य महापुण्या कार्तिके विजया स्मृता ॥ 44 ॥
2.2.m: If that tenth lunar day of the month of Jyeṣṭha is celebrated, it is called Daśaharā; / that of Āśvina is most sacred, and in Kārtika it is called Vijayā.

2.2.s:
ekādaśī vrataparā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī ..
sarvapāpavinirmuktā yathā kurvaṃti mānavāḥ .. 45 ..
2.2.d:
एकादशी व्रतपरा सर्वपापप्रणाशिनी ॥
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्ता यथा कुर्वंति मानवाः ॥ 45 ॥
2.2.m: The eleventh lunar day is dedicated to votive observances, destroying all sins; / liberated from all sins, as men perform it.

2.2.s:
daśamyāmekabhaktastu saṃyataḥ syājjitendriyaḥ ..
ekādaśyāmupoṣyātha dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇaṃ caret ..46..
2.2.d:
दशम्यामेकभक्तस्तु संयतः स्याज्जितेन्द्रियः ॥
एकादश्यामुपोष्याथ द्वादश्यां पारणं चरेत् ॥46॥
2.2.m: On the daśamī, however, one should eat a single meal, restrained and with subdued senses. / Then, having fasted on the ekādaśī, one should break the fast on the dvādaśī.

2.2.s:
dvādaśa dvādaśīrhanti tasmāttathācaredbudhaḥ ..
pūrvedyurekādaśī pūrṇā parehani ca vardhate .. 47 ..
2.2.d:
द्वादश द्वादशीर्हन्ति तस्मात्तथाचरेद्बुधः ॥
पूर्वेद्युरेकादशी पूर्णा परेहनि च वर्धते ॥ 47 ॥
2.2.m: It destroys twelve dvādaśīs; therefore a wise man should act accordingly. / When ekādaśī is complete on the previous day and extends into the following day,

2.2.s:
na vardhate dvādaśī tu tadā tvevaṃ vyavasthitiḥ ..
vanavāsī parāṃ kuryātpūrvāṃ kuryādgṛhāśramī ..48..
2.2.d:
न वर्धते द्वादशी तु तदा त्वेवं व्यवस्थितिः ॥
वनवासी परां कुर्यात्पूर्वां कुर्याद्गृहाश्रमी ॥48॥
2.2.m: and dvādaśī does not extend, then this is the rule: / a forest-dweller should observe the second, and a householder should observe the first.

2.2.s:
pūrvevaikādaśī tyājyā vardhate cettithidvayam ..
ekādaśī dvādaśī tu tadopoṣyā parā tithiḥ .. 49 ..
2.2.d:
पूर्वेवैकादशी त्याज्या वर्धते चेत्तिथिद्वयम् ॥
एकादशी द्वादशी तु तदोपोष्या परा तिथिः ॥ 49 ॥
2.2.m: Only the first ekādaśī is to be abandoned if both lunar days extend; / when ekādaśī and dvādaśī [both extend], then the second lunar day is to be fasted upon.

2.2.s:
yadā tu pāraṇā yogyā dvādaśī nopatiṣṭhate ..
tadā pūrvaiva saṃgrāhyā tyājyā vṛddhā pare'hani .. 2.2.8.50 ..
2.2.d:
यदा तु पारणा योग्या द्वादशी नोपतिष्ठते ॥
तदा पूर्वैव संग्राह्या त्याज्या वृद्धा परेऽहनि ॥ 2.2.8.50 ॥
2.2.m: When, however, a dvādaśī suitable for breaking the fast does not present itself, / then only the first is to be taken, and the extended one on the following day is to be abandoned.

2.2.s:
ekādaśī kalāyuktā sakalā dvādaśī yadi ..
tatra kratusamaṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam .. 51 ..
2.2.d:
एकादशी कलायुक्ता सकला द्वादशी यदि ॥
तत्र क्रतुसमं पुण्यं त्रयोदश्यां तु पारणम् ॥ 51 ॥
2.2.m: If ekādaśī has a single fraction and dvādaśī is complete, / there the merit is equal to a Vedic sacrifice, but the breaking of the fast is on the trayodaśī.

2.2.s:
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca pare'hani na labhyate ..
nopoṣyā sā mahādoṣā putrapautradhanakṣayāt .. 52 ..
2.2.d:
एकादशी द्वादशी च परेऽहनि न लभ्यते ॥
नोपोष्या सा महादोषा पुत्रपौत्रधनक्षयात् ॥ 52 ॥
2.2.m: If ekādaśī and dvādaśī are not found on the following day, / that [day] is not to be fasted upon; it is a great fault, because of the destruction of sons, grandsons, and wealth.

2.2.s:
ekādaśī daśāviddhā dvādaśyāṃ liptikā yadā ..
dvādaśī pāraṇāyogyā vardhate cāpare'hani ..
tadā dinadvaye tyājyā pāraṇaṃ ca niyogataḥ .. 53 ..
2.2.d:
एकादशी दशाविद्धा द्वादश्यां लिप्तिका यदा ॥
द्वादशी पारणायोग्या वर्धते चापरेऽहनि ॥
तदा दिनद्वये त्याज्या पारणं च नियोगतः ॥ 53 ॥
2.2.m: When ekādaśī is overlapped by daśamī and extends by a minute fraction into dvādaśī, / and dvādaśī, suitable for breaking the fast, extends into the following day, / then it should be abandoned on both days, and the breaking of the fast [is to be observed] as prescribed.

2.2.s:
ṣoḍaśīgrahaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvādaśī luptapāraṇā ..
caṇḍātithau vrataṃ caiva haṃti puṇyaṃ purā kṛtam .. 54 ..
2.2.d:
षोडशीग्रहणं दृष्ट्वा द्वादशी लुप्तपारणा ॥
चण्डातिथौ व्रतं चैव हंति पुण्यं पुरा कृतम् ॥ 54 ॥
2.2.m: Seeing an eclipse on the full-moon day when the breaking of the fast on dvādaśī is lost, / a votive observance on an inauspicious lunar day destroys merit previously acquired.

2.2.s:
trayodaśyāṃ yadvihitaṃ pāraṇaṃ na tu puṇyadam ..
gṛhāśramī na kuryādvā daśamīdvādaśīkṣayāt .. 55 ..
2.2.d:
त्रयोदश्यां यद्विहितं पारणं न तु पुण्यदम् ॥
गृहाश्रमी न कुर्याद्वा दशमीद्वादशीक्षयात् ॥ 55 ॥
2.2.m: Breaking the fast which is prescribed on the trayodaśī does not bestow merit. / Or a householder should not perform it, on account of the loss of daśamī and dvādaśī.

2.2.s:
yadi rudrā daśamitrā pare'hniravisaṃkramaḥ ..
tathāpi saṃparityajya dvādaśyāṃ samupāvaset .. 56 ..
2.2.d:
यदि रुद्रा दशमित्रा परेऽह्निरविसंक्रमः ॥
तथापि संपरित्यज्य द्वादश्यां समुपावसेत् ॥ 56 ॥
2.2.m: If the eleventh lunar day is joined with daśamī and the sun's transit occurs on the following day, / even then, having abandoned it, one should fast on the dvādaśī.

2.2.s:
vajrālokanamātraṃ tu daśamī saṃviśedyadi ..
ekādaśī na bhoktavyā parā hyekādaśī tadā .. 57 ..
2.2.d:
वज्रालोकनमात्रं तु दशमी संविशेद्यदि ॥
एकादशी न भोक्तव्या परा ह्येकादशी तदा ॥ 57 ॥
2.2.m: If daśamī enters by even the sight of a lightning flash, / then the ekādaśī must not be eaten upon; the following day is indeed the ekādaśī.

2.2.s: tadā ceddaśamīviddhā samupoṣyā na dūṣaṇam.. 58 ..
2.2.d: तदा चेद्दशमीविद्धा समुपोष्या न दूषणम्॥ 58 ॥
2.2.m: If it is overlapped by daśamī then, fasting upon it carries no fault.

2.2.s:
dvādaśyāmupavāsaṃ tu yaḥ karoti narottamaḥ ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra viṣṇuranāmayaḥ .. 59 ..
2.2.d:
द्वादश्यामुपवासं तु यः करोति नरोत्तमः ॥
स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र विष्णुरनामयः ॥ 59 ॥
2.2.m: The best of men who observes a fast on dvādaśī / goes to the supreme abode where the unblemished Viṣṇu resides.

2.2.s:
upoṣya daśamīmitrāṃ mohādekādaśīṃ naraḥ ..
nirayaṃ yāti sa pretya dharmasaṃtatisaṃkṣayāt .. 2.2.8.60 ..
2.2.d:
उपोष्य दशमीमित्रां मोहादेकादशीं नरः ॥
निरयं याति स प्रेत्य धर्मसंततिसंक्षयात् ॥ 2.2.8.60 ॥
2.2.m: A man who, out of delusion, fasts on an ekādaśī joined with daśamī / goes to hell after death, because of the destruction of his lineage and righteousness.

2.2.s:
ravivāre śukravāre saṃkrāntyāṃ tu dinakṣaye ..
upavāsaṃ prakurvīta pāraṇaṃ tu vivarjayet .. 61 ..
2.2.d:
रविवारे शुक्रवारे संक्रान्त्यां तु दिनक्षये ॥
उपवासं प्रकुर्वीत पारणं तु विवर्जयेत् ॥ 61 ॥
2.2.m: On a Sunday, on a Friday, at a solar transit, and on a day of loss, / one should observe a fast, but avoid breaking the fast.

2.2.s:
śuklāṃ vā yadi vā kṛṣṇāṃ pūrvasaṃkalpitāmapi ..
ekādaśīṃ sadā kuryānna vai kṛṣṇettarāṃ kvacit ..62..
2.2.d:
शुक्लां वा यदि वा कृष्णां पूर्वसंकल्पितामपि ॥
एकादशीं सदा कुर्यान्न वै कृष्णेत्तरां क्वचित् ॥62॥
2.2.m: Whether bright or dark, even if previously resolved upon, / one should always observe the ekādaśī, and never omit the dark one.

2.2.s:
naktena vartayetkṛṣṇāmiti śāstraviniścayaḥ ..
māse caikādaśī yatra labhyate śuklapakṣake ..
tatra kuryātkṛṣṇapakṣe parā tithirna gṛhyate ..63..
2.2.d:
नक्तेन वर्तयेत्कृष्णामिति शास्त्रविनिश्चयः ॥
मासे चैकादशी यत्र लभ्यते शुक्लपक्षके ॥
तत्र कुर्यात्कृष्णपक्षे परा तिथिर्न गृह्यते ॥63॥
2.2.m: One should observe the dark [ekādaśī] with a nocturnal meal; such is the determination of the scripture. / In the month where ekādaśī falls in the bright fortnight, / there one should observe it; in the dark fortnight, the following lunar day is not taken.

2.2.s:
śrāvaṇī dvādaśī śuklā cāṃdrabhadre yadā harau ..
tatropoṣya hṛṣīkeśaṃ pūjayedvidhivannaraḥ .. 64 ..
2.2.d:
श्रावणी द्वादशी शुक्ला चांद्रभद्रे यदा हरौ ॥
तत्रोपोष्य हृषीकेशं पूजयेद्विधिवन्नरः ॥ 64 ॥
2.2.m: When the bright dvādaśī of Śrāvaṇa falls in the asterism of Śravaṇa while Hari [is asleep], / having fasted then, a man should worship Hṛṣīkeśa according to the rules.

2.2.s:
śrāvaṇe cāśvine caiva labhyate dvādaśīdine ..
śravaṇena samāyuktā mahatī sā prakīrtitā .. 65 ..
2.2.d:
श्रावणे चाश्विने चैव लभ्यते द्वादशीदिने ॥
श्रवणेन समायुक्ता महती सा प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 65 ॥
2.2.m: When on the dvādaśī day in Śrāvaṇa and in Āśvina / it is conjoined with Śravaṇa, it is proclaimed as the Great [dvādaśī].

2.2.s:
puṣyeṇa drādaśīyuktā phālgune vijayā smṛtā ..
kārtike cetparityājyā māghe tu nārakī bhavet ..66..
2.2.d:
पुष्येण द्रादशीयुक्ता फाल्गुने विजया स्मृता ॥
कार्तिके चेत्परित्याज्या माघे तु नारकी भवेत् ॥66॥
2.2.m: Conjoined with Puṣya, dvādaśī in Phālguna is known as Vijayā; / in Kārtika it should be abandoned, but in Māgha it leads to hell.

2.2.s:
yā bhādre vijayā proktā śravaṇena samāyutā..
viśeṣaḥ kathyate tatra yathāvadvratamācaret ..67..
2.2.d:
या भाद्रे विजया प्रोक्ता श्रवणेन समायुता॥
विशेषः कथ्यते तत्र यथावद्व्रतमाचरेत् ॥67॥
2.2.m: The Vijayā that is proclaimed in Bhādrapada, conjoined with Śravaṇa— / its special rule is declared, how one should observe the votive observance according to rule.

2.2.s:
ekādaśyāmuttarato dvādaśī ca divānvitā ..
niśipūrṇā dvādaśī ca śravaṇenāpi saṃyutā ..68..
2.2.d:
एकादश्यामुत्तरतो द्वादशी च दिवान्विता ॥
निशिपूर्णा द्वादशी च श्रवणेनापि संयुता ॥68॥
2.2.m: On the day following ekādaśī, when dvādaśī continues through the day, / and is complete at night, and conjoined with Śravaṇa,

2.2.s: saphalā dvādaśī jñeyā upoṣyaiṣā mahāphalā .. 69 ..
2.2.d: सफला द्वादशी ज्ञेया उपोष्यैषा महाफला ॥ 69 ॥
2.2.m: it should be known as the fruitful dvādaśī; fasted upon, this bears great fruit.

2.2.s:
dvādaśyāṃ viṣṇuviddhāyāṃ vāsudevaṃ prapūjayet ..
kṛṣṇāyāṃ tu vrataṃ kuryādbahuduḥkhaṃ samācareta .. 2.2.8.70 ..
2.2.d:
द्वादश्यां विष्णुविद्धायां वासुदेवं प्रपूजयेत् ॥
कृष्णायां तु व्रतं कुर्याद्बहुदुःखं समाचरेत ॥ 2.2.8.70 ॥
2.2.m: On a dvādaśī overlapped by Viṣṇu, one should worship Vāsudeva. / But if one undertakes the votive observance on the dark [dvādaśī], one incurs much sorrow.

2.2.s:
dvādaśī kāmaviddhā cenmanyate nāpyupoṣaṇam ..
hanyātpurākṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāmupoṣaṇam ..71..
2.2.d:
द्वादशी कामविद्धा चेन्मन्यते नाप्युपोषणम् ॥
हन्यात्पुराकृतं पुण्यं त्रयोदश्यामुपोषणम् ॥71॥
2.2.m: If dvādaśī is overlapped by trayodaśī, fasting is not commended; / fasting on trayodaśī destroys merit previously acquired.

2.2.s:
prahareprahare snānaṃ śarvaryāṃ ca vidhīyate ..
pūjanaṃ cāgnikāryaṃ ca ṣaṭsu kāryaṃ vratī caret ..72..
2.2.d:
प्रहरेप्रहरे स्नानं शर्वर्यां च विधीयते ॥
पूजनं चाग्निकार्यं च षट्सु कार्यं व्रती चरेत् ॥72॥
2.2.m: Bathing is prescribed watch by watch during the night; / worship and fire-ritual should be performed by the observer of the vow across the six [watches].

2.2.s:
ekādaśīṃ dvādaśīṃ ca prāpnoti śravaṇe yadi ..
ekādaśyāmupoṣyātha dvādaśyāmapyupāvaset..73..
2.2.d:
एकादशीं द्वादशीं च प्राप्नोति श्रवणे यदि ॥
एकादश्यामुपोष्याथ द्वादश्यामप्युपावसेत्॥73॥
2.2.m: If Śravaṇa coincides with ekādaśī and dvādaśī, / having fasted on ekādaśī, one should also fast on dvādaśī.

2.2.s:
pāraṇaṃ tu trayodaśyāṃ dvādaśī cenna labhyate ..
āmiṣānnaṃ na bhuñjīta haviṣyānnena pāraṇam ..74..
2.2.d:
पारणं तु त्रयोदश्यां द्वादशी चेन्न लभ्यते ॥
आमिषान्नं न भुञ्जीत हविष्यान्नेन पारणम् ॥74॥
2.2.m: Breaking the fast is on trayodaśī if dvādaśī is not obtained. / One must not eat meat; breaking the fast is done with sacrificial food.

2.2.s:
yadā tu pāraṇāyogyā labhyate dvādaśī tadā ..
tasyāṃ nātikramo yuktastadabhāve trayodaśī..75..
2.2.d:
यदा तु पारणायोग्या लभ्यते द्वादशी तदा ॥
तस्यां नातिक्रमो युक्तस्तदभावे त्रयोदशी॥75॥
2.2.m: When, however, a dvādaśī suitable for breaking the fast is obtained, / then transgressing it is not proper; in its absence, [the fast is broken on] trayodaśī.

2.2.s:
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca śravaṇarkṣeṇa saṃyutā ..
viṣṇuśṛṃkhalako nāma budhavāre viśiṣyate ..76..
2.2.d:
एकादशी द्वादशी च श्रवणर्क्षेण संयुता ॥
विष्णुशृंखलको नाम बुधवारे विशिष्यते ॥76॥
2.2.m: When ekādaśī and dvādaśī are conjoined with the asterism of Śravaṇa / on a Wednesday, it is called Viṣṇuśṛṅkhalaka and is especially distinguished.

2.2.s:
daśamyāṃ saṃyato bhūtvā prātarekādaśīdine ..
kṛtvā tu saṅgame snānaṃ prahareprahare dvijāḥ ..77..
2.2.d:
दशम्यां संयतो भूत्वा प्रातरेकादशीदिने ॥
कृत्वा तु सङ्गमे स्नानं प्रहरेप्रहरे द्विजाः ॥77॥
2.2.m: Having become restrained on daśamī, in the morning of the ekādaśī day, / having bathed at a confluence watch by watch, O twice-born,

2.2.s:
anena vidhinā kṛtvā vijayāyāṃ vratottamam ..
sarvapāpaṃ kṣayaṃ nītvā viṣṇuloke vasennaraḥ .. 78 ..
2.2.d:
अनेन विधिना कृत्वा विजयायां व्रतोत्तमम् ॥
सर्वपापं क्षयं नीत्वा विष्णुलोके वसेन्नरः ॥ 78 ॥
2.2.m: having performed this best of votive observances on Vijayā according to this rule, / having destroyed all sins, a man dwells in the world of Viṣṇu.

2.2.s:
