caturyugānāṃ divyānāṃ yāvatsyādviṣṇurūpadhṛka ..
tāvadeva hi sarvatra sārvabhaumo bhavennaraḥ .. 79 ..
2.2.d:
चतुर्युगानां दिव्यानां यावत्स्याद्विष्णुरूपधृक ॥
तावदेव हि सर्वत्र सार्वभौमो भवेन्नरः ॥ 79 ॥
2.2.m: For as many divine four-age cycles as he bears the form of Viṣṇu, / for that long indeed a man becomes a universal sovereign everywhere.

2.2.s:
tretāyāṃ daśajanmāni madhyadeśeṣu bho dvijāḥ ..
tataśca bhārate varṣe vedavedāṃtasāravit ..
putrapautradhanairyukto lakṣado nṛpasannibhaḥ .. 2.2.8.80 ..
2.2.d:
त्रेतायां दशजन्मानि मध्यदेशेषु भो द्विजाः ॥
ततश्च भारते वर्षे वेदवेदांतसारवित् ॥
पुत्रपौत्रधनैर्युक्तो लक्षदो नृपसन्निभः ॥ 2.2.8.80 ॥
2.2.m: For ten births in Tretāyuga in the central lands, O twice-born, / and thereafter in the land of Bhārata, knowing the essence of the Vedas and Vedānta, / endowed with sons, grandsons, and wealth, a donor of hundreds of thousands, equal to a king,

2.2.s:
jāyate daśa janmāni tretāyāṃ brāhmaṇottamaḥ ..
sapatnīkaśca dīrghāyurdharmakarmasu pūjitaḥ .. 81 ..
2.2.d:
जायते दश जन्मानि त्रेतायां ब्राह्मणोत्तमः ॥
सपत्नीकश्च दीर्घायुर्धर्मकर्मसु पूजितः ॥ 81 ॥
2.2.m: he is born for ten births as an excellent Brahmin in Tretāyuga, / with a wife, long-lived, and honoured in religious acts.

2.2.s:
bhādre māsi site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ pṛthivīpatim ..
śatrumutthāpayetprāhṇe śubhalagne śubhakṣaṇe .. 82 ..
2.2.d:
भाद्रे मासि सिते पक्षे द्वादश्यां पृथिवीपतिम् ॥
शत्रुमुत्थापयेत्प्राह्णे शुभलग्ने शुभक्षणे ॥ 82 ॥
2.2.m: In the month of Bhādrapada, in the bright fortnight, on the dvādaśī, / the lord of the earth should raise [the banner of] the enemy in the forenoon, in an auspicious lagna and an auspicious moment.

2.2.s:
śalyaśālmalikasyāpi saptaparṇīyakasya ca ..
eṣāmanyatamaṃ vṛkṣaṃ caṃpakasyārjunasya vā .. 83 ..
2.2.d:
शल्यशाल्मलिकस्यापि सप्तपर्णीयकस्य च ॥
एषामन्यतमं वृक्षं चंपकस्यार्जुनस्य वा ॥ 83 ॥
2.2.m: From the śalya, the śālmali, and the saptaparṇa, / or from one of these trees: the campaka or the arjuna,

2.2.s:
bṛhatkadaṃbavṛkṣasya dvicatvāriṃśadaṃgulaiḥ ..
dvātriṃśadaṃgulairvāpi mānadvayamathāpi vā ..
trivyāyāmaṃ ca prathamaṃ dvāviṃśahastameva vā .. 84 ..
2.2.d:
बृहत्कदंबवृक्षस्य द्विचत्वारिंशदंगुलैः ॥
द्वात्रिंशदंगुलैर्वापि मानद्वयमथापि वा ॥
त्रिव्यायामं च प्रथमं द्वाविंशहस्तमेव वा ॥ 84 ॥
2.2.m: or from a large kadamba tree, [a pole] of forty-two aṅgulas, / or of thirty-two aṅgulas, or indeed of two measures; / the first is three spans, or twenty-two cubits.

2.2.s:
hastaḥ ṣoḍaśavārasya gṛhasthasya viśiṣyate ..
hastatrayeṇa viprasya dvādaśa kṣatriyasya tu .. 85 ..
2.2.d:
हस्तः षोडशवारस्य गृहस्थस्य विशिष्यते ॥
हस्तत्रयेण विप्रस्य द्वादश क्षत्रियस्य तु ॥ 85 ॥
2.2.m: A cubit is recommended for a householder of sixteen turns; / of three cubits for a Brahmin, and twelve for a Kṣatriya;

2.2.s:
aṣṭahastaṃ tu vaiśyasya śūdrasya pañcahastakam ..
abhrataḥ śvetacchatraṃ syātpatākā ca purepure .. 86 ..
2.2.d:
अष्टहस्तं तु वैश्यस्य शूद्रस्य पञ्चहस्तकम् ॥
अभ्रतः श्वेतच्छत्रं स्यात्पताका च पुरेपुरे ॥ 86 ॥
2.2.m: of eight cubits for a Vaiśya, and of five cubits for a Śūdra. / In front there should be a white royal parasol, and a banner in city after city.

2.2.s:
ghanasārasamāyuktāṃ karpūramaṃḍanānvitām ..
raktavastraparicchannāṃ puṣpamālyairalaṃkṛtām .. 87 ..
2.2.d:
घनसारसमायुक्तां कर्पूरमंडनान्विताम् ॥
रक्तवस्त्रपरिच्छन्नां पुष्पमाल्यैरलंकृताम् ॥ 87 ॥
2.2.m: Infused with camphor, accompanied by camphor ornaments, / covered with red cloth, and adorned with flower garlands,

2.2.s:
mañcasthāṃ kārayetpūjāṃ bhaktyā ca sudṛḍho naraḥ ..
saptarātraṃ caretpūjāmaindramantreṇa mantravit .. 88 ..
2.2.d:
मञ्चस्थां कारयेत्पूजां भक्त्या च सुदृढो नरः ॥
सप्तरात्रं चरेत्पूजामैन्द्रमन्त्रेण मन्त्रवित् ॥ 88 ॥
2.2.m: a man of very firm resolve should cause worship to be performed on a platform with devotion. / The knower of mantras should perform the worship for seven nights with the mantra of Indra.

2.2.s:
kākādīnna spṛśejjātu vairapakṣe viśeṣataḥ ..
patākāyā nipāte tu rāṣṭrahāniṃ samādiśet .. 89 ..
2.2.d:
काकादीन्न स्पृशेज्जातु वैरपक्षे विशेषतः ॥
पताकाया निपाते तु राष्ट्रहानिं समादिशेत् ॥ 89 ॥
2.2.m: Crows and the like should never touch it, especially from an enemy's quarter; / but upon the fall of the banner, one should foretell ruin to the realm.

2.2.s:
patāke nissṛte bhagne mahiṣāṇāṃ vināśanam ..
sthūṇāpāte ca bhagne vā cāśvahāniṃ samādiśet .. 2.2.8.90 ..
2.2.d:
पताके निस्सृते भग्ने महिषाणां विनाशनम् ॥
स्थूणापाते च भग्ने वा चाश्वहानिं समादिशेत् ॥ 2.2.8.90 ॥
2.2.m: If the two flags slip out or break, destruction of buffaloes [is indicated]; / and if the post falls or breaks, one should predict loss of horses.

2.2.s:
taskaraśca kule tasya prāyaścittaṃ samācaret ..
tadviṣṇoriti maṃtreṇa śatapadmasamanvitam .. 91 ..
2.2.d:
तस्करश्च कुले तस्य प्रायश्चित्तं समाचरेत् ॥
तद्विष्णोरिति मंत्रेण शतपद्मसमन्वितम् ॥ 91 ॥
2.2.m: And if there is a thief in his family, he should perform an expiation / with the mantra 'tad viṣṇoḥ', together with a hundred lotuses.

2.2.s:
viṣṇumuddiśya juhuyādayutaṃ pippalasya ca ..
grahāṇāṃ ca tribhāgena cāyutaṃ juhuyādbudhaḥ .. 92 ..
2.2.d:
विष्णुमुद्दिश्य जुहुयादयुतं पिप्पलस्य च ॥
ग्रहाणां च त्रिभागेन चायुतं जुहुयाद्बुधः ॥ 92 ॥
2.2.m: Intending it for Viṣṇu, he should offer ten thousand [oblations] of pippala wood; / and the wise man should offer ten thousand oblations for the planets with a third part.

2.2.s:
ādityasyādbhutamidaṃ dvijapāte tu bho dvijāḥ ..
kapotapāte śukrasya kākādau bhaumamādiśet .. 93 ..
2.2.d:
आदित्यस्याद्भुतमिदं द्विजपाते तु भो द्विजाः ॥
कपोतपाते शुक्रस्य काकादौ भौममादिशेत् ॥ 93 ॥
2.2.m: O twice-born, when a bird falls, this is a portent of the Sun; / when a pigeon falls, of Venus; in the case of a crow and the like, one should declare it to be of Mars;

2.2.s:
bhūkaṃpe jāyate viṣṭaṃ guroradbhutamādiśet ..
kīṭaviddhe kṛte viprāścandrasyādbhutamādiśet .. 94 ..
2.2.d:
भूकंपे जायते विष्टं गुरोरद्भुतमादिशेत् ॥
कीटविद्धे कृते विप्राश्चन्द्रस्याद्भुतमादिशेत् ॥ 94 ॥
2.2.m: when an earthquake occurs, excrement appears: one should declare it a portent of Jupiter; / when it is bored through by insects, O twice-born, one should declare it a portent of the Moon;

2.2.s: patāke nissṛte bhagne rāhoradbhutamādiśet.. 95 ..
2.2.d: पताके निस्सृते भग्ने राहोरद्भुतमादिशेत्॥ 95 ॥
2.2.m: if the two flags slip out or break, one should declare it a portent of Rāhu.

2.2.s:
śivā ruvaṃti cāndrasya vānaro vā spṛśetkvacit ..
ketoradbhutamuddiṣṭaṃ bhūmikaṃpe tu te dvijāḥ .. 96 ..
2.2.d:
शिवा रुवंति चान्द्रस्य वानरो वा स्पृशेत्क्वचित् ॥
केतोरद्भुतमुद्दिष्टं भूमिकंपे तु ते द्विजाः ॥ 96 ॥
2.2.m: If jackals howl, it belongs to the Moon, or if a monkey touches it anywhere; / but when the earth quakes, that is taught as a portent of Ketu, O twice-born.

2.2.s:
trayodaśīṃ sitāṃ prāpya puṣpairnānāvidhairapi ..
kāmadevaṃ samabhyarcedgandhādyaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ .. 97 ..
2.2.d:
त्रयोदशीं सितां प्राप्य पुष्पैर्नानाविधैरपि ॥
कामदेवं समभ्यर्चेद्गन्धाद्यैः सुमनोहरैः ॥ 97 ॥
2.2.m: Having reached the bright thirteenth, with various kinds of flowers / and with highly charming perfumes and the like, he should worship Kāmadeva.

2.2.s:
caitre māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ śanau śatabhiṣā yadi ..
gaṃgāyā yadi labhyeta sūryagrahaśataiḥ samā .. 98 ..
2.2.d:
चैत्रे मासि सिताष्टम्यां शनौ शतभिषा यदि ॥
गंगाया यदि लभ्येत सूर्यग्रहशतैः समा ॥ 98 ॥
2.2.m: If in the month of Caitra on the bright eighth, on a Saturday, there is Śatabhiṣaj, / and if it is obtained at the Gaṅgā, it is equal to hundreds of solar eclipses.

2.2.s:
seyaṃ mahāvāruṇīti khyātā kṛṣṇatrayodaśī ..
asyāṃ snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca śrāddhaṃ vākṣayamucyate .. 99 ..
2.2.d:
सेयं महावारुणीति ख्याता कृष्णत्रयोदशी ॥
अस्यां स्नानं च दानं च श्राद्धं वाक्षयमुच्यते ॥ 99 ॥
2.2.m: This same dark thirteenth is renowned as the Mahāvāruṇī; / bathing, gifting, or a śrāddha on this [day] is said to be inexhaustible.

2.2.s:
madhumāse site pakṣe dambhabhañjī caturdaśī ..
tasyāṃ madanamūle ca akṣaraṃ kāmamarcayet .. 2.2.8.100 ..
2.2.d:
मधुमासे सिते पक्षे दम्भभञ्जी चतुर्दशी ॥
तस्यां मदनमूले च अक्षरं काममर्चयेत् ॥ 2.2.8.100 ॥
2.2.m: In the month of Madhu, in the bright fortnight, is the Dambhabhañjī fourteenth; / on it, at the root of a madana tree, he should worship the imperishable Kāma.

2.2.s:
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ madanasya prabhāvataḥ ..
jugupsitavacobhistu samyaktuṣṭo manobhavaḥ .. 101 ..
2.2.d:
स याति परमं स्थानं मदनस्य प्रभावतः ॥
जुगुप्सितवचोभिस्तु सम्यक्तुष्टो मनोभवः ॥ 101 ॥
2.2.m: He goes to the supreme station through the power of Madana; / for Manobhava is thoroughly pleased with coarse words.

2.2.s:
anantasya vrataṃ vakṣye sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..
anantaṃ sukhamāpnoti yaḥ kuryādbhaktimānnaraḥ .. 102 ..
2.2.d:
अनन्तस्य व्रतं वक्ष्ये सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ॥
अनन्तं सुखमाप्नोति यः कुर्याद्भक्तिमान्नरः ॥ 102 ॥
2.2.m: I shall explain the votive observance of Ananta, which destroys all sins; / a devoted man who performs it attains endless happiness.

2.2.s:
dvādaśyāṃ pūjite śakre dhvajake vāstuyaṣṭiṣu ..
tataḥ śuklacaturdaśyāmanantaṃ pūjayeddharim .. 103 ..
2.2.d:
द्वादश्यां पूजिते शक्रे ध्वजके वास्तुयष्टिषु ॥
ततः शुक्लचतुर्दश्यामनन्तं पूजयेद्धरिम् ॥ 103 ॥
2.2.m: When Śakra has been worshipped on the twelfth on the banners [and] house-pillars, / he should then worship Hari as Ananta on the bright fourteenth.

2.2.s:
kṛtvā darbhamayānantaṃ vāridhānyānvitaṃ tathā ..
pūjayeccandanairgandhairnaivedyairvividhairapi .. 104 ..
2.2.d:
कृत्वा दर्भमयानन्तं वारिधान्यान्वितं तथा ॥
पूजयेच्चन्दनैर्गन्धैर्नैवेद्यैर्विविधैरपि ॥ 104 ॥
2.2.m: Having made an Ananta out of darbha grass, accompanied by water and grain, / he should worship him with sandalwood, perfumes, and various offerings of food,

2.2.s:
caturdaśa phalairmūlairjalajaiḥ kusumairapi ..
yavagodhūmaśālīnāṃ cūrṇairnaikatamasya ca .. 105 ..
2.2.d:
चतुर्दश फलैर्मूलैर्जलजैः कुसुमैरपि ॥
यवगोधूमशालीनां चूर्णैर्नैकतमस्य च ॥ 105 ॥
2.2.m: with fourteen fruits, roots, and water-born flowers, / and with the flour of one of barley, wheat, or rice,

2.2.s:
kṛtvā pūpāhvayaṃ tasmai dadyādekaṃ śrutekṣitam ..
svayamekaṃ tu bhuñjīta dadyātsatrasya dorakam .. 106 ..
2.2.d:
कृत्वा पूपाह्वयं तस्मै दद्यादेकं श्रुतेक्षितम् ॥
स्वयमेकं तु भुञ्जीत दद्यात्सत्रस्य दोरकम् ॥ 106 ॥
2.2.m: having made what is called a cake, he should offer one to him after it has been inspected by a learned man; / he should eat one himself, and should give the thread of the sacrifice.

2.2.s:
caturdaśagranthiyutaṃ kuṃkumena vilepitam ..
caturdaśasūtramayaṃ sūtraṃ kārpāsameva ca .. 107 ..
2.2.d:
चतुर्दशग्रन्थियुतं कुंकुमेन विलेपितम् ॥
चतुर्दशसूत्रमयं सूत्रं कार्पासमेव च ॥ 107 ॥
2.2.m: It has fourteen knots, is smeared with saffron, / and is a thread made of fourteen cotton strands.

2.2.s:
ataḥ preta caturdaśyāṃ bhojayitvā tapodhanān ..
dānaṃ dattvā dvijebhyaśca yamalokaṃ na gacchati .. 108 ..
2.2.d:
अतः प्रेत चतुर्दश्यां भोजयित्वा तपोधनान् ॥
दानं दत्त्वा द्विजेभ्यश्च यमलोकं न गच्छति ॥ 108 ॥
2.2.m: Therefore, having fed ascetics on the fourteenth of the ghosts / and given gifts to the twice-born, he does not go to the world of Yama.

2.2.s:
tataḥ pretakathāṃ śrutvā śākairnaktaṃ samācaret ..
caturdaśaṃ dvādaśaṃ vā saptamaṃ vāpi pañcamam .. 109 ..
2.2.d:
ततः प्रेतकथां श्रुत्वा शाकैर्नक्तं समाचरेत् ॥
चतुर्दशं द्वादशं वा सप्तमं वापि पञ्चमम् ॥ 109 ॥
2.2.m: Then, having listened to the tale of the ghosts, he should take a nocturnal meal of herbs / on the fourteenth, or the twelfth, or the seventh, or even the fifth.

2.2.s: mānamātrādikaṃ kṛtvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 2.2.8.110 ..
2.2.d: मानमात्रादिकं कृत्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥ 2.2.8.110 ॥
2.2.m: Having performed the [gift of the] measure of grain and so forth, he is freed from all sins.

2.2.s:
māghe māsi vaṭāpāyaḥ kasya pāpaṃ punīmahe ..
snātvā tatra caturdaśyāṃ samaye tārakāmaye .. 111 ..
2.2.d:
माघे मासि वटापायः कस्य पापं पुनीमहे ॥
स्नात्वा तत्र चतुर्दश्यां समये तारकामये ॥ 111 ॥
2.2.m: In the month of Māgha, at the falling away of the banyan, whose sin do we purify? / Having bathed there on the fourteenth, at the time marked by stars,

2.2.s:
saṃbhavetphālgune māsi yā ca kṛṣṇā caturdaśī ..
śivarātririti khyātā sā jagatsarvakāmadā .. 112 ..
2.2.d:
संभवेत्फाल्गुने मासि या च कृष्णा चतुर्दशी ॥
शिवरात्रिरिति ख्याता सा जगत्सर्वकामदा ॥ 112 ॥
2.2.m: that which occurs in the month of Phālguna as the dark fourteenth / is renowned as Śivarātri; it grants all desires to the world.

2.2.s:
divā tasyā alābhe tu rātriyoge vrataṃ caret ..
caturdaśī amāviddhā tadvrataṃ parivarjayet .. 113 ..
2.2.d:
दिवा तस्या अलाभे तु रात्रियोगे व्रतं चरेत् ॥
चतुर्दशी अमाविद्धा तद्व्रतं परिवर्जयेत् ॥ 113 ॥
2.2.m: If it is not obtained during the day, he should perform the votive observance during its night-conjunction; / if the fourteenth is touched by the new moon, he should avoid that votive observance.

2.2.s:
tithiyoge ca śarvaryāṃ saṃpūrṇe vratamācaret ..
kāmaviddhā sā ca pūjyā rātriyoge caredvratī .. 114 ..
2.2.d:
तिथियोगे च शर्वर्यां संपूर्णे व्रतमाचरेत् ॥
कामविद्धा सा च पूज्या रात्रियोगे चरेद्व्रती ॥ 114 ॥
2.2.m: And when the conjunction of the lunar day is complete in the night, he should perform the votive observance; / that which is touched by the thirteenth is also to be worshipped; the observer of the vow should perform it during the night-conjunction.

2.2.s:
prahareprahare snānaṃ svayaṃ snātvā śivasya ca ..
kārayedvidhivadbhaktyā homaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi .. 115 ..
2.2.d:
प्रहरेप्रहरे स्नानं स्वयं स्नात्वा शिवस्य च ॥
कारयेद्विधिवद्भक्त्या होमं कुर्याद्यथाविधि ॥ 115 ॥
2.2.m: Bathing himself watch by watch, he should also / cause Śiva's [bath] to be performed according to rule with devotion, and should perform the oblation according to rule.

2.2.s:
atha vakṣyāmi caitrādimāse tu pūrṇimā yathā ..
citrānakṣatrasaṃyukto gurupūrṇo vidhuryadi ..
mahācaitrīti sā jñeyā pūrṇimākṣayapuṇyadā .. 116 ..
2.2.d:
अथ वक्ष्यामि चैत्रादिमासे तु पूर्णिमा यथा ॥
चित्रानक्षत्रसंयुक्तो गुरुपूर्णो विधुर्यदि ॥
महाचैत्रीति सा ज्ञेया पूर्णिमाक्षयपुण्यदा ॥ 116 ॥
2.2.m: Now I shall explain how the full moon falls in the months beginning with Caitra: / If the full moon is joined with the lunar mansion Citrā and with Jupiter, / it is to be known as Mahācaitrī, a full moon granting inexhaustible merit.

2.2.s:
viśākhādiṣu bhedeṣu pūrṇacandro guruścaret ..
mahāvaiśākhikādyāstu pūrṇimā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ .. 117 ..
2.2.d:
विशाखादिषु भेदेषु पूर्णचन्द्रो गुरुश्चरेत् ॥
महावैशाखिकाद्यास्तु पूर्णिमा द्वादश स्मृताः ॥ 117 ॥
2.2.m: When the full moon and Jupiter move into the different [mansions] beginning with Viśākhā, / twelve full-moon days are traditionally remembered, beginning with Mahāvaiśākhī.

2.2.s:
mahājyaiṣṭhī viśeṣo'yaṃ prājāpatye yathā raviḥ ..
gurupūrṇacandro jyeṣṭhāyāṃ mahājyaiṣṭhīti sā smṛtā .. 118 ..
2.2.d:
महाज्यैष्ठी विशेषोऽयं प्राजापत्ये यथा रविः ॥
गुरुपूर्णचन्द्रो ज्येष्ठायां महाज्यैष्ठीति सा स्मृता ॥ 118 ॥
2.2.m: This special Mahājyaiṣṭhī is when the Sun is in Rohiṇī; / when Jupiter and the full moon are in Jyeṣṭhā, that is traditionally remembered as Mahājyaiṣṭhī.

2.2.s:
vināpi guruṇā candraḥ kṛttikā pūrṇimā tathā ..
tathā mahākārttikī sā tithiḥ puṇyatamā bhavet .. 119 ..
2.2.d:
विनापि गुरुणा चन्द्रः कृत्तिका पूर्णिमा तथा ॥
तथा महाकार्त्तिकी सा तिथिः पुण्यतमा भवेत् ॥ 119 ॥
2.2.m: Even without Jupiter, when the Moon is with Kṛttikā on the full moon, / then that lunar day becomes Mahākārtikī, most meritorious.

2.2.s:
rohiṇyāṃ tu sthitaścandraḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu kārttike ..
mahākārttikī tathāpi syātsvargaloke'pi durlabhā .. 2.2.8.120 ..
2.2.d:
रोहिण्यां तु स्थितश्चन्द्रः पौर्णमास्यां तु कार्त्तिके ॥
महाकार्त्तिकी तथापि स्यात्स्वर्गलोकेऽपि दुर्लभा ॥ 2.2.8.120 ॥
2.2.m: When the Moon stands in Rohiṇī on the full moon in Kārttika, / it is still Mahākārtikī, difficult to obtain even in heaven.

2.2.s:
citrā vā yadi vā pūrṇā yadā syātpūrṇimātithiḥ ..
mahācaitrī tathāpi syādaśvamedhaphalapradā .. 121 ..
2.2.d:
चित्रा वा यदि वा पूर्णा यदा स्यात्पूर्णिमातिथिः ॥
महाचैत्री तथापि स्यादश्वमेधफलप्रदा ॥ 121 ॥
2.2.m: Whether it is Citrā or the full moon when the full-moon lunar day occurs, / it is still Mahācaitrī, granting the fruit of a horse sacrifice.

2.2.s:
raviṇā kṛttikāyogādravivāre ca pūrṇimā ..
mahācaitrī tathāpi syāddattasyākṣayakārikā .. 122 ..
2.2.d:
रविणा कृत्तिकायोगाद्रविवारे च पूर्णिमा ॥
महाचैत्री तथापि स्याद्दत्तस्याक्षयकारिका ॥ 122 ॥
2.2.m: From the conjunction of Kṛttikā with the Sun, and on a Sunday, when it is the full moon, / it is still Mahācaitrī, making what is given inexhaustible.

2.2.s:
evaṃ gurau guroryoge mahācaitrī prakīrtitā ..
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca japo niyama eva ca .. 123 ..
2.2.d:
एवं गुरौ गुरोर्योगे महाचैत्री प्रकीर्तिता ॥
तत्र स्नानं च दानं च जपो नियम एव च ॥ 123 ॥
2.2.m: Thus, in Jupiter or in conjunction with Jupiter, Mahācaitrī is proclaimed; / bathing, gifting, recitation, and religious restraint there—

2.2.s:
sarvamakṣayatāṃ yāti phalaṃ caivāśvamedhikam ..
pitarastarpitā yāṃti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamakṣayam .. 124 ..
2.2.d:
सर्वमक्षयतां याति फलं चैवाश्वमेधिकम् ॥
पितरस्तर्पिता यांति वैष्णवं लोकमक्षयम् ॥ 124 ॥
2.2.m: all attain imperishability, as well as the reward of a horse sacrifice; / the ancestors, when propitiated, go to the imperishable realm of Viṣṇu.

2.2.s:
bharaṇyāṃ kārttike māsi yadi syātpūrṇimā tithiḥ ..
gaṃgādvāre tu mahatī vaiśākhī puṇyadā smṛtā .. 125 ..
2.2.d:
भरण्यां कार्त्तिके मासि यदि स्यात्पूर्णिमा तिथिः ॥
गंगाद्वारे तु महती वैशाखी पुण्यदा स्मृता ॥ 125 ॥
2.2.m: If the full-moon lunar day should fall in Bharaṇī in the month of Kārttika, / then at Gaṅgādvāra the great Vaiśākhī is remembered as merit-giving.

2.2.s:
śālagrāme mahācaitrī kṛtapuṇyā mahātithiḥ ..
gaṃgādvāre tu mahatī vaiśākhī puṇyadā smṛtā .. 126 ..
2.2.d:
शालग्रामे महाचैत्री कृतपुण्या महातिथिः ॥
गंगाद्वारे तु महती वैशाखी पुण्यदा स्मृता ॥ 126 ॥
2.2.m: At Śālagrāma, the great lunar day Mahācaitrī has its merit made; / at Gaṅgādvāra the great Vaiśākhī is remembered as merit-giving.

2.2.s:
puruṣottame mahājyaiṣṭhī mahāṣāḍhī tu śṛṃkhale ..
mahāśrāvaṇī kedāre mahāpuṇyatamā matā .. 127 ..
2.2.d:
पुरुषोत्तमे महाज्यैष्ठी महाषाढी तु शृंखले ॥
महाश्रावणी केदारे महापुण्यतमा मता ॥ 127 ॥
2.2.m: At Puruṣottama is Mahājyaiṣṭhī, but Mahāṣāḍhī is at Śṛṅkhala; / Mahāśrāvaṇī is considered most holy at Kedāra;

2.2.s:
mahābhādrī badaryāṃ ca kujo'pi syānnarastathā ..
mahākārttikī puṣkare ca kānyakubje tathottaraṃ .. 128 ..
2.2.d:
महाभाद्री बदर्यां च कुजोऽपि स्यान्नरस्तथा ॥
महाकार्त्तिकी पुष्करे च कान्यकुब्जे तथोत्तरं ॥ 128 ॥
2.2.m: and Mahābhādrī is at Badarī, and Mars also becomes a man [there]; / Mahākārtikī is at Puṣkara, and further at Kānyakubja;

2.2.s:
mahatī mārgaśīrṣe syādayodhyāyāṃ tathottare ..
mahāpauṣī puṇyatamā mahāmāghī prayāgataḥ .. .. 129 ..
2.2.d:
महती मार्गशीर्षे स्यादयोध्यायां तथोत्तरे ॥
महापौषी पुण्यतमा महामाघी प्रयागतः ॥ ॥ 129 ॥
2.2.m: the great one in Mārgaśīrṣa is at Ayodhyā, and further north; / most meritorious is Mahāpauṣī, and Mahāmāghī is at Prayāga;

2.2.s: mahāphālgunī naimiṣe ca nirdiṣṭāḥ syurmahāphalāḥ .. 2.2.8.130 ..
2.2.d: महाफाल्गुनी नैमिषे च निर्दिष्टाः स्युर्महाफलाः ॥ 2.2.8.130 ॥
2.2.m: and Mahāphālgunī is at Naimiṣa: these are declared to yield great fruit.

2.2.s:
atra sma vihitaṃ karma śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham ..
sarvamakṣayatāṃ yāti varddhate cādhikaṃ phalam .. 131 ..
2.2.d:
अत्र स्म विहितं कर्म शुभं वा यदि वाशुभम् ॥
सर्वमक्षयतां याति वर्द्धते चाधिकं फलम् ॥ 131 ॥
2.2.m: Whatever rite is performed here, whether auspicious or inauspicious, / all of it attains imperishability, and its fruit increases abundantly.

2.2.s:
āśvine paurṇamāsī tu kaumudīti prakīrtitā ..
asyāṃ candrodaye lakṣmīṃ pūjayedvidhivannaraḥ .. 132 ..
2.2.d:
आश्विने पौर्णमासी तु कौमुदीति प्रकीर्तिता ॥
अस्यां चन्द्रोदये लक्ष्मीं पूजयेद्विधिवन्नरः ॥ 132 ॥
2.2.m: The full-moon [day] in Āśvina is proclaimed as Kaumudī; / on it, at moonrise, a man should worship Lakṣmī according to rule.

2.2.s:
nirvatayenna yaḥ śrāddhaṃ prabhāte paitṛkaṃ dvijaḥ ..
indukṣaye māsimāsi prāyaścittīyate tu saḥ .. 133 ..
2.2.d:
निर्वतयेन्न यः श्राद्धं प्रभाते पैतृकं द्विजः ॥
इन्दुक्षये मासिमासि प्रायश्चित्तीयते तु सः ॥ 133 ॥
2.2.m: A twice-born man who does not perform the ancestral śrāddha in the morning / at the waning of the moon month after month requires expiation.

2.2.s:
candrāśvine tu kṛṣṇāyāṃ pañcadaśyāṃ yathāvidhi ..
kṛtvā snānādikaṃ karma sopavāso dinaṃ nayet ..134..
2.2.d:
चन्द्राश्विने तु कृष्णायां पञ्चदश्यां यथाविधि ॥
कृत्वा स्नानादिकं कर्म सोपवासो दिनं नयेत् ॥134॥
2.2.m: On the dark fifteenth [day] of the lunar Āśvina, having performed / the rites of bathing and so forth according to rule, he should spend the day fasting.

2.2.s:
pradoṣasamaye lakṣmīṃ pūjayitvā yathāvidhi ..
dīpavṛkṣānyathā vṛkṣām̐llakṣmīprītyai samutsṛjet .. .. 135 ..
2.2.d:
प्रदोषसमये लक्ष्मीं पूजयित्वा यथाविधि ॥
दीपवृक्षान्यथा वृक्षाम्̐ल्लक्ष्मीप्रीत्यै समुत्सृजेत् ॥ ॥ 135 ॥
2.2.m:
Having worshipped Lakṣmī according to rule at dusk,
he should set out lamp-trees like [real] trees for the pleasure of Lakṣmī.

2.2.s:
nadītīre girau goṣṭhe śmaśāne vṛkṣamūlataḥ ..
catuṣpathe nijāgāre catvare tānnidhāpayet .. 136 ..
2.2.d:
नदीतीरे गिरौ गोष्ठे श्मशाने वृक्षमूलतः ॥
चतुष्पथे निजागारे चत्वरे तान्निधापयेत् ॥ 136 ॥
2.2.m:
On the bank of a river, on a mountain, in a cowpen, in a cremation ground, at the foot of a tree,
at a crossroad, in one's own dwelling, and in a courtyard, he should have them placed.

2.2.s:
dvirbhojanamamāvāsyāṃ na kartavyaṃ kadācana ..
śarvaryāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa māghaphālgunayornaraiḥ ..137.. ..
pravaravicāravarṇanam
2.2.d:
द्विर्भोजनममावास्यां न कर्तव्यं कदाचन ॥
शर्वर्यां च विशेषेण माघफाल्गुनयोर्नरैः ॥137॥ ॥
प्रवरविचारवर्णनम्
2.2.m:
Eating twice should never be done on the new-moon day,
especially at night, by men in [the months of] Māgha and Phālguna.
Description of the examination of pravaras

2.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
vakṣye pravarasaṃtānaṃ yathākramamiti dvijāḥ ..
yadvinā vyatyayo yasmāttasmācchāstrānusārataḥ .. 1 ..
2.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
वक्ष्ये प्रवरसंतानं यथाक्रममिति द्विजाः ॥
यद्विना व्यत्ययो यस्मात्तस्माच्छास्त्रानुसारतः ॥ 1 ॥
2.2.m:
Sūta said:
I shall declare the lineages of pravaras in proper order, O twice-born!
Because without which confusion [arises], therefore [I declare them] in accordance with the treatises.

2.2.s:
pravaratrayaṃ kāśyapasya kāśyapāśāvanairdhruvam ..
pañcāśvagautamasyādya gautamaścoya eva ca .. 2 ..
2.2.d:
प्रवरत्रयं काश्यपस्य काश्यपाशावनैर्ध्रुवम् ॥
पञ्चाश्वगौतमस्याद्य गौतमश्चोय एव च ॥ 2 ॥
2.2.m:
For Kāśyapa, the group of three pravaras is surely Kāśyapa, Āśāva, and Naidhruva.
For Gautama, the first is Pañcāśva, then Gautama and Coya.

2.2.s:
cyavano jāmadagnyaśca āplavāyanameva ca ..
mokunyāṃgirasabhāsyājjāmadagnyāplavāyanam .. 3 ..
2.2.d:
च्यवनो जामदग्न्यश्च आप्लवायनमेव च ॥
मोकुन्यांगिरसभास्याज्जामदग्न्याप्लवायनम् ॥ 3 ॥
2.2.m:
Cyavana, Jāmadagnya, and Āplavāyana;
from the Āṅgirasa lineage of Mokunī, Jāmadagnya and Āplavāyana.

2.2.s:
śāṃḍilyāsitadaivalāḥ pravaratrayameva ca ..
parāśarasya ca tathā svayaṃ śāṃbavaśiṣṭhakam .. 4 ..
2.2.d:
शांडिल्यासितदैवलाः प्रवरत्रयमेव च ॥
पराशरस्य च तथा स्वयं शांबवशिष्ठकम् ॥ 4 ॥
2.2.m:
Śāṇḍilya, Asita, and Devala are the triad of pravaras;
and likewise for Parāśara, [the triad] itself is Śāmba, Vasiṣṭha,

2.2.s:
ātreyamācāryaṇasyābālapravarameva hi ..
vātsyavāsyāyanau caiva urukaṃṭaka eva ca .. 5 ..
2.2.d:
आत्रेयमाचार्यणस्याबालप्रवरमेव हि ॥
वात्स्यवास्यायनौ चैव उरुकंटक एव च ॥ 5 ॥
2.2.m:
and Ātreya. For Ācāryaṇa, [there is] indeed the juvenile pravara;
and Vātsya, Vātsyāyana, and Urukaṇṭaka,

2.2.s:
arthakṣīramitrāvaruṇaṃ pañcamaṃ parikīrtitam..
autathyasya trayaṃ vidyādvālmīko'varameva hi .. 6 ..
2.2.d:
अर्थक्षीरमित्रावरुणं पञ्चमं परिकीर्तितम्॥
औतथ्यस्य त्रयं विद्याद्वाल्मीकोऽवरमेव हि ॥ 6 ॥
2.2.m:
and Arthakṣīra-Mitrāvaruṇa is proclaimed as the fifth.
One should know three for Autathya; Vālmīka is the junior.

2.2.s:
autathyasya ca vāśiṣṭhamaindre cakraṃ ca krauñcāyanaṃ tathā ..
autathyeti samākhyātaṃ māhiṣyaṃ cyavanaṃ tathā .. 7 ..
2.2.d:
औतथ्यस्य च वाशिष्ठमैन्द्रे चक्रं च क्रौञ्चायनं तथा ॥
औतथ्येति समाख्यातं माहिष्यं च्यवनं तथा ॥ 7 ॥
2.2.m:
And for Autathya, Vāsiṣṭha, Cakra in the Aindra [line], and Krauñcāyana;
likewise declared as Autathya are Māhiṣya and Cyavana.

2.2.s:
urukaṃṭatrayaṃ vidyātkauśikasya trayaṃ tathā ..
yadgālo devarāṭ khyātaḥ kuśikādyāśca bho dvijāḥ ..8..
2.2.d:
उरुकंटत्रयं विद्यात्कौशिकस्य त्रयं तथा ॥
यद्गालो देवराट् ख्यातः कुशिकाद्याश्च भो द्विजाः ॥8॥
2.2.m:
One should know the triad for Urukaṇṭa, and likewise three for Kauśika:
Yadgāla, Devarāṭ, and Kuśika and others are renowned, O twice-born!

2.2.s:
viśvāmitro devarāṭca svayaṃ caiva trayaṃ matam ..
ghṛtakauśikasya kuśikā viśvāmitrāghamarṣaṇam .. 9
2.2.d:
विश्वामित्रो देवराट्च स्वयं चैव त्रयं मतम् ॥
घृतकौशिकस्य कुशिका विश्वामित्राघमर्षणम् ॥ 9
2.2.m:
Viśvāmitra, Devarāṭ, and oneself are considered the three.
For Ghṛtakauśika, Kuśika, Viśvāmitra, and Aghamarṣaṇa.

2.2.s:
caṇḍakauśikasya ca tathā devarāṭ devarātakam..
viśvāmitre tu vikhyātaḥ sumantoreva eva hi .. 2.2.9.10 ..
2.2.d:
चण्डकौशिकस्य च तथा देवराट् देवरातकम्॥
विश्वामित्रे तु विख्यातः सुमन्तोरेव एव हि ॥ 2.2.9.10 ॥
2.2.m:
And likewise for Caṇḍakauśika, Devarāṭ, and Devarātaka;
and among Viśvāmitras, celebrated indeed is that of Sumantu.

2.2.s:
taruṃkaśākaṭāyanaḥ svayameva pravaratrayam ..
bhramadvayaṃ jaimineśca svayaṃ vāśiṣṭhameva ca .. 11 ..
2.2.d:
तरुंकशाकटायनः स्वयमेव प्रवरत्रयम् ॥
भ्रमद्वयं जैमिनेश्च स्वयं वाशिष्ठमेव च ॥ 11 ॥
2.2.m:
Taruṃka, Śākaṭāyana, and oneself are the three pravaras.
For Jaimini, the pair of Bhramas, oneself, and Vāsiṣṭha.

2.2.s:
śaṃkhamāṃgirasacyavanaṃ śaṃkhabhasya trayaṃ matam..
vātsyasya cyavano nāma āplavāyanakastathā .. 12 ..
2.2.d:
शंखमांगिरसच्यवनं शंखभस्य त्रयं मतम्॥
वात्स्यस्य च्यवनो नाम आप्लवायनकस्तथा ॥ 12 ॥
2.2.m:
Śaṅkha, Āṅgirasa, and Cyavana are considered the three for Śaṅkhabha.
For Vātsya, [the pravaras] are named Cyavana and Āplavāyanaka.

2.2.s:
sāvarṇasya tu sāvarṇyacyavanajāmadagnibhārgavam ..
āplavāyaneti pāṭhīne eka eva tu sattamāḥ .. 13 ..
2.2.d:
सावर्णस्य तु सावर्ण्यच्यवनजामदग्निभार्गवम् ॥
आप्लवायनेति पाठीने एक एव तु सत्तमाः ॥ 13 ॥
2.2.m:
For Sāvarṇa, however, Sāvarṇya, Cyavana, Jāmadagni, and Bhārgava;
while in the Āplavāyana reading, there is only one, O best of men!

2.2.s:
kṛṣṇājinasya kṛṣṇājinaṃ viśvāmitrasya jaiminam ..
kātyāyanasya kātyāyanagārgyāyaṇatrayaṃ tathā .. 14 ..
2.2.d:
कृष्णाजिनस्य कृष्णाजिनं विश्वामित्रस्य जैमिनम् ॥
कात्यायनस्य कात्यायनगार्ग्यायणत्रयं तथा ॥ 14 ॥
2.2.m:
For Kṛṣṇājina, Kṛṣṇājina; for Viśvāmitra, Jaimini;
for Kātyāyana, the triad of Kātyāyana and Gārgyāyaṇa.

2.2.s:
vātsyāyaneti vikhyātaṃ kuśikasya ca paṃcamam ..
amuṃ ca viśvāmitraṃ ca jāmadagnyāplavāyanam .. 15 ..
2.2.d:
वात्स्यायनेति विख्यातं कुशिकस्य च पंचमम् ॥
अमुं च विश्वामित्रं च जामदग्न्याप्लवायनम् ॥ 15 ॥
2.2.m:
Declared as Vātsyāyana, and the fifth for Kuśika;
this and Viśvāmitra, and Jāmadagnya and Āplavāyana.

2.2.s:
gārgyasya gārgyasāmuṃca tathāṃgirasa eva ca ..
bārhaspatyabharadvāja iti paṃca prakīrtitam .. 16 ..
2.2.d:
गार्ग्यस्य गार्ग्यसामुंच तथांगिरस एव च ॥
बार्हस्पत्यभरद्वाज इति पंच प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 16 ॥
2.2.m:
For Gārgya, Gārgya, Sāmu, and likewise Āṅgirasa,
Bārhaspatya, and Bharadvāja: thus five are proclaimed.

2.2.s:
vaśiṣṭhasya ca vāsiṣṭhaṃ ca tathāṃgirasa eva ca ..
mitrāvaruṇasaṃyuktaṃ tāvattasya prakīrtitam.. 17 ..
2.2.d:
वशिष्ठस्य च वासिष्ठं च तथांगिरस एव च ॥
मित्रावरुणसंयुक्तं तावत्तस्य प्रकीर्तितम्॥ 17 ॥
2.2.m:
And for Vasiṣṭha, Vāsiṣṭha, and likewise Āṅgirasa;
joined with Mitrāvaruṇa: so many are proclaimed for him.

2.2.s:
jāhvakarṇabhavakarṇau pravarau parikīrtitau ..
upamanyurupamanyostathendraḥ saha eva ca .. 18 ..
2.2.d:
जाह्वकर्णभवकर्णौ प्रवरौ परिकीर्तितौ ॥
उपमन्युरुपमन्योस्तथेन्द्रः सह एव च ॥ 18 ॥
2.2.m:
Jāhvakarṇa and Bhavakarṇa are proclaimed as the two pravaras.
For Upamanyu, Upamanyu, then Indra, together with [Pramatha].

2.2.s:
taduttameti tritayaṃ mitrāvaruṇasya ca trayam ..
ātreyagautamāṃgirasapravaratrayameva hi .. 19 ..
2.2.d:
तदुत्तमेति त्रितयं मित्रावरुणस्य च त्रयम् ॥
आत्रेयगौतमांगिरसप्रवरत्रयमेव हि ॥ 19 ॥
2.2.m:
Taduttama is the triad; and three for Mitrāvaruṇa:
indeed the triad of pravaras Ātreya, Gautama, and Āṅgirasa.

2.2.s:
kamaṃḍalotpalamitrāmitrāvaruṇa eva ca ..
kamaṃḍaluśceti tritayaṃ pravaratrayameva ca .. 2.2.9.20 ..
2.2.d:
कमंडलोत्पलमित्रामित्रावरुण एव च ॥
कमंडलुश्चेति त्रितयं प्रवरत्रयमेव च ॥ 2.2.9.20 ॥
2.2.m:
Kamaṇḍala, Utpalamitra, and Mitrāvaruṇa;
and Kamaṇḍalu: thus is the triad, indeed the three pravaras.

2.2.s:
cyavanasya tathā jñeyamūrvacyavanāplavāyanam ..
atha sa kasyāṃgirasabārhaspatya eva trayam .. 21 ..
2.2.d:
च्यवनस्य तथा ज्ञेयमूर्वच्यवनाप्लवायनम् ॥
अथ स कस्यांगिरसबार्हस्पत्य एव त्रयम् ॥ 21 ॥
2.2.m:
For Cyavana, Ūrva, Cyavana, and Āplavāyana should be known.
Then for Sa[śunaka?], Āṅgirasa and Bārhaspatya are the three.

2.2.s:
āgastyasya agastiśca māhaśca cyavaneti ca ..
viśvāmitre devarāta autathyeti tathaiva ca .. 22..
2.2.d:
आगस्त्यस्य अगस्तिश्च माहश्च च्यवनेति च ॥
विश्वामित्रे देवरात औतथ्येति तथैव च ॥ 22॥
2.2.m:
For Āgastya, Agasti, Māha, and Cyavana;
for Viśvāmitra, Devarāta, and likewise Autathya.

2.2.s:
ye noktā ye 'pyavijñātāste proktāḥ kāśyapājjagat .. 23 ..
vāstuyāgavarṇanam
2.2.d:
ये नोक्ता ये ऽप्यविज्ञातास्ते प्रोक्ताः काश्यपाज्जगत् ॥ 23 ॥
वास्तुयागवर्णनम्
2.2.m:
Those that have not been stated and those that are unknown, the world declares them [sprung] from Kāśyapa.
Description of the sacrifice to the Vāstu

2.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
vāstuyāgamatho vakṣye balimaṇḍalapūrvakam ..
aṃkurārpaṇakaṃ kṛtvā madhye kuryācca maṃḍalam .. 1 ..
2.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
वास्तुयागमथो वक्ष्ये बलिमण्डलपूर्वकम् ॥
अंकुरार्पणकं कृत्वा मध्ये कुर्याच्च मंडलम् ॥ 1 ॥
2.2.m:
Sūta said:
Now I shall declare the sacrifice to the Vāstu, preceded by a bali-circle:
having performed the sprout-offering, one should make a mandala in the centre.

2.2.s:
trihastā piṃḍikā kāryā caturasrā udakplavā ..
prādeśamātra utsedho darpaṇāṃtarnibho bhavet .. 2 ..
2.2.d:
त्रिहस्ता पिंडिका कार्या चतुरस्रा उदक्प्लवा ॥
प्रादेशमात्र उत्सेधो दर्पणांतर्निभो भवेत् ॥ 2 ॥
2.2.m:
A platform three cubits [wide] should be made, square and sloping to the north;
its height should be a span, resembling the surface of a mirror.

2.2.s:
madhye saṃmārjayedvidvānpādānnava yathākramāt..
koṇe catuṣpadaṃ jñeyaṃ dikṣu tripadakaṃ kramāt .. 3 ..
2.2.d:
मध्ये संमार्जयेद्विद्वान्पादान्नव यथाक्रमात्॥
कोणे चतुष्पदं ज्ञेयं दिक्षु त्रिपदकं क्रमात् ॥ 3 ॥
2.2.m:
In the middle, the wise man should clean nine squares in succession;
at the corner, four squares should be known, and in the cardinal directions three squares in order.

2.2.s:
pañcakaṃ yugmapādena caturdikṣu tataḥ param ..
koṇe catuṣpadaṃ sthāpyaṃ catuṣkoṇe vibhāvayet .. 4 ..
2.2.d:
पञ्चकं युग्मपादेन चतुर्दिक्षु ततः परम् ॥
कोणे चतुष्पदं स्थाप्यं चतुष्कोणे विभावयेत् ॥ 4 ॥
2.2.m:
Thereafter, a group of five with a pair of squares in the four directions;
four squares are to be placed at the corner; he should meditate upon them at the four corners.

2.2.s:
catuṣkoṇaṃ bahiḥ kuryātkoṇe cāpi catuṣṭayam ..
dvātriṃśacca bhavedbāhye cātaścāpi trayodaśa .. 5 ..
2.2.d:
चतुष्कोणं बहिः कुर्यात्कोणे चापि चतुष्टयम् ॥
द्वात्रिंशच्च भवेद्बाह्ये चातश्चापि त्रयोदश ॥ 5 ॥
2.2.m:
Outside he should make a square, and four also at the corner;
there should be thirty-two on the outside, and thirteen here [within].

2.2.s:
catvāriṃśatpañcayutā militvā vāstudevatāḥ ..
śikhī caivātha parjanyo jayaṃtaḥ kuliśāyudhaḥ .. 6 ..
2.2.d:
चत्वारिंशत्पञ्चयुता मिलित्वा वास्तुदेवताः ॥
शिखी चैवाथ पर्जन्यो जयंतः कुलिशायुधः ॥ 6 ॥
2.2.m:
Together, the deities of the Vāstu are forty-five:
Śikhin, and then Parjanya, Jayanta, the thunderbolt-armed [Indra],

2.2.s:
sūryaḥ satyo vṛṣaścaiva ākāśaṃ vāyureva ca ..
pūṣā ca vitathaścaiva guhānyaśca yamastathā ..7..
2.2.d:
सूर्यः सत्यो वृषश्चैव आकाशं वायुरेव च ॥
पूषा च वितथश्चैव गुहान्यश्च यमस्तथा ॥7॥
2.2.m:
Sūrya, Satya, and Vṛṣa, Ākāśa, and Vāyu,
Pūṣan, Vitatha, Guhānya, and Yama,

2.2.s:
gandharvo mṛgarājastu mṛgāḥ pitṛgaṇāstathā ..
dauvāriko'tha sugrīvaḥ puṣpadanto jalādhipaḥ .. 8 ..
2.2.d:
गन्धर्वो मृगराजस्तु मृगाः पितृगणास्तथा ॥
दौवारिकोऽथ सुग्रीवः पुष्पदन्तो जलाधिपः ॥ 8 ॥
2.2.m:
Gandharva, the king of beasts, the deer, and the classes of ancestors,
Dauvārika, then Sugrīva, Puṣpadanta, the lord of waters [Varuṇa],

2.2.s:
asuraḥ paśupāśau ca rogo hi mokṣa eva ca ..
bhallāṭaḥ somasarpau ca aditiśca ditistathā .. 9 ..
2.2.d:
असुरः पशुपाशौ च रोगो हि मोक्ष एव च ॥
भल्लाटः सोमसर्पौ च अदितिश्च दितिस्तथा ॥ 9 ॥
2.2.m:
Asura, Paśu and Pāśa, Roga, and Mokṣa,
Bhallāṭa, Soma and Sarpa, Aditi, and Diti.

2.2.s:
bahirdvādaśa ityetānīśānādīnyathākramam ..
īśānādicatuṣkoṇaṃ saṃsthitānpūjayedbudhaḥ .. 2.2.10.10 ..
2.2.d:
बहिर्द्वादश इत्येतानीशानादीन्यथाक्रमम् ॥
ईशानादिचतुष्कोणं संस्थितान्पूजयेद्बुधः ॥ 2.2.10.10 ॥
2.2.m:
These twelve on the outside, beginning with Īśāna, in proper order—
the wise man should worship them stationed in the four corners beginning with Īśāna.

2.2.s:
āpaścaivātha sāvitro jayo rudrastathaiva ca ..
aryamā savitā caiva vivasvānvibudhādhipaḥ .. 11 ..
2.2.d:
आपश्चैवाथ सावित्रो जयो रुद्रस्तथैव च ॥
अर्यमा सविता चैव विवस्वान्विबुधाधिपः ॥ 11 ॥
2.2.m:
And Āpas, then Sāvitra, Jaya, and Rudra,
Aryaman, Savitṛ, Vivasvat, and the lord of the gods [Indra],

2.2.s:
mitro'tha rājayakṣmā ca saptamaḥ pṛthivīdharaḥ ..
aṣṭamastvāpavatsastu paridhau brahmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 12 ..
2.2.d:
मित्रोऽथ राजयक्ष्मा च सप्तमः पृथिवीधरः ॥
अष्टमस्त्वापवत्सस्तु परिधौ ब्रह्मणः स्मृतः ॥ 12 ॥
2.2.m:
Mitra, then Rājayakṣman, and seventh Pṛthivīdhara;
and eighth Āpavatsa is remembered on the perimeter of Brahmā.

2.2.s:
pūrvādiṣu tathā pūjyā gandhapuṣpaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ..
paṃcacatvāriṃśadetaccarakyā ca caturthakam .. 13 ..
2.2.d:
पूर्वादिषु तथा पूज्या गन्धपुष्पैः पृथग्विधैः ॥
पंचचत्वारिंशदेतच्चरक्या च चतुर्थकम् ॥ 13 ॥
2.2.m:
They are to be worshipped in the east and other [directions] with perfumes and various flowers.
These are forty-five, and with Carakī [they form] the fourth group.

2.2.s:
militvā ūnapañcāśaduttamā vāstudevatāḥ ..
nānyatra yojayedviprāḥ prāsāde ca viśeṣataḥ .. 14 ..
2.2.d:
मिलित्वा ऊनपञ्चाशदुत्तमा वास्तुदेवताः ॥
नान्यत्र योजयेद्विप्राः प्रासादे च विशेषतः ॥ 14 ॥
2.2.m:
Together, the superior deities of the Vāstu are forty-nine;
one must not employ them elsewhere, O Brahmins, but especially in a temple.

2.2.s:
bahiḥ koṇe carakyādi carakaṃ ca vidārikām ..
pūtanāṃ ca tataḥ paścādvāyavye pāparākṣasīm .. 15 ..
2.2.d:
बहिः कोणे चरक्यादि चरकं च विदारिकाम् ॥
पूतनां च ततः पश्चाद्वायव्ये पापराक्षसीम् ॥ 15 ॥
2.2.m:
At the outer corners, [he should place] Carakī and others: Caraka and Vidārikā,
and Pūtanā, and then afterwards the sin-demoness in the northwest.

2.2.s:
svaiḥsvairmaṃtraiśca gaṃdhādyaiḥ pūjayetkusumādinā ..
yathoktena baliṃ dadyātpāyasānnena vā punaḥ.. 16 ..
2.2.d:
स्वैःस्वैर्मंत्रैश्च गंधाद्यैः पूजयेत्कुसुमादिना ॥
यथोक्तेन बलिं दद्यात्पायसान्नेन वा पुनः॥ 16 ॥
2.2.m:
He should worship them with their own mantras, perfumes, flowers, and the like;
he should present a bali according to what has been taught, or with milk-rice.

2.2.s:
rekhāḥ sarvatra śuklena padmaṃ raktena bhāvayet ..
rañjayedeva varṇena bahiṣpañcarajena tu .. 17 ..
2.2.d:
रेखाः सर्वत्र शुक्लेन पद्मं रक्तेन भावयेत् ॥
रञ्जयेदेव वर्णेन बहिष्पञ्चरजेन तु ॥ 17 ॥
2.2.m:
The lines should be white everywhere; he should visualize the lotus as red;
and he should color the outside with five-colored powder.

2.2.s:
devavarṇānatho vakṣye yathāvadanuvarṇitāḥ ..
rakto gaurastathā śoṇaḥ sitaraktaḥ sitastathā .. 18 ..
2.2.d:
देववर्णानथो वक्ष्ये यथावदनुवर्णिताः ॥
रक्तो गौरस्तथा शोणः सितरक्तः सितस्तथा ॥ 18 ॥
2.2.m:
Next, I shall explain the deities' colours as properly described:
red, fair, crimson, white-and-red, and white;

2.2.s:
pītaḥ śuklaśca dharmaśca pūṣā raktaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
śyāmaḥ śukraśca kṛṣṇaśca pītaḥ śuklo yathākramam .. 19 ..
2.2.d:
पीतः शुक्लश्च धर्मश्च पूषा रक्तः प्रकीर्तितः ॥
श्यामः शुक्रश्च कृष्णश्च पीतः शुक्लो यथाक्रमम् ॥ 19 ॥
2.2.m:
yellow, white; Dharma is red, and Pūṣan is declared red;
dark, bright, black, yellow, and white in sequence;

2.2.s:
pīto bhṛṃgaḥ punaḥ śuklaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śuklastathaiva ca ..
raktaḥ śuklaśca śoṇaśca kṛṣṇaraktastathaiva ca .. 2.2.10.20 ..
2.2.d:
पीतो भृंगः पुनः शुक्लः कृष्णः शुक्लस्तथैव च ॥
रक्तः शुक्लश्च शोणश्च कृष्णरक्तस्तथैव च ॥ 2.2.10.20 ॥
2.2.m:
yellow, Bhṛṅga is white, black, white as well,
red, white, crimson, and black-and-red as well;

2.2.s:
dhūmrapīto raktapītaḥ śuklaḥ kṛṣṇaśca śyāmakaḥ ..
raktavarṇena dvātriṃśaddaśa varṇāḥ prakīrtitāḥ .. 21 ..
2.2.d:
धूम्रपीतो रक्तपीतः शुक्लः कृष्णश्च श्यामकः ॥
रक्तवर्णेन द्वात्रिंशद्दश वर्णाः प्रकीर्तिताः ॥ 21 ॥
2.2.m:
smoky-yellow, red-yellow, white, black, and dark;
with red, thirty-two [and] ten colours are declared;

2.2.s:
śuklaśoṇaṃ punaḥ śvetaṃ siṃdūrābhaṃ prakīrtitam ..
pāṃḍurakuṃkumābhaṃ ca raktaṃ jñeyaṃ ca pītakam .. 22 ..
2.2.d:
शुक्लशोणं पुनः श्वेतं सिंदूराभं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
पांडुरकुंकुमाभं च रक्तं ज्ञेयं च पीतकम् ॥ 22 ॥
2.2.m:
white-and-crimson, then white, declared vermilion-hued,
pale, saffron-coloured, red, and known as yellow;

2.2.s:
śuklapītaṃ ca śvetaṃ ca gauraṃ cetyaṣṭavarṇakam ..
pītaṃ raktaṃ ca śyāmaṃ ca gauraṃ ceti catuṣṭayam.. 23 ..
2.2.d:
शुक्लपीतं च श्वेतं च गौरं चेत्यष्टवर्णकम् ॥
पीतं रक्तं च श्यामं च गौरं चेति चतुष्टयम्॥ 23 ॥
2.2.m:
white-and-yellow, white, and fair: an eightfold set of colours;
yellow, red, dark, and fair: a group of four;

2.2.s:
dharaṇīmadanaṃ vādye śaṃbhuvarṇādiprakramāt ..
śuklena rañjayeddvārānpuradvāraṃ ca madhyame .. 24 ..
2.2.d:
धरणीमदनं वाद्ये शंभुवर्णादिप्रक्रमात् ॥
शुक्लेन रञ्जयेद्द्वारान्पुरद्वारं च मध्यमे ॥ 24 ॥
2.2.m:
Dharaṇī and Madana on the instruments, beginning in sequence with Śambhu's colours;
he should colour the gates white, and the city gate in the middle;

2.2.s:
madhyeṃte ūnapañcāśatsarvaṃ ca vāstukarmaṇi ..
catvāriṃśaddvārayutaṃ gṛhadevakule'pi ca .. 25 ..
2.2.d:
मध्येंते ऊनपञ्चाशत्सर्वं च वास्तुकर्मणि ॥
चत्वारिंशद्द्वारयुतं गृहदेवकुलेऽपि च ॥ 25 ॥
2.2.m:
in the centre, at the edge, forty-nine in all in the rite of the site;
endowed with forty gates, both in a house and in a temple;

2.2.s:
mahākūpe tathā śveto anyatrāpi praśasyate ..
sulipte ca śucau deśe sārdhahastapramāṇataḥ .. 26 ..
2.2.d:
महाकूपे तथा श्वेतो अन्यत्रापि प्रशस्यते ॥
सुलिप्ते च शुचौ देशे सार्धहस्तप्रमाणतः ॥ 26 ॥
2.2.m:
and white is praised at a great well, as well as elsewhere;
on a well-smeared and pure ground, measuring one and a half cubits;

2.2.s:
daśa pūrvāyatā rekhā daśa caivottarāyatāḥ ..
ekādaśīpadaṃ kuryādrekhābhiḥ padakena tu .. 27 ..
2.2.d:
दश पूर्वायता रेखा दश चैवोत्तरायताः ॥
एकादशीपदं कुर्याद्रेखाभिः पदकेन तु ॥ 27 ॥
2.2.m:
ten lines extending eastwards, and ten lines extending northwards;
he should make the eleventh square with the lines, forming a grid of squares;

2.2.s:
sarvavāstuvibhāgena vijñeyā navakā nava ..
padasthānpūjayeddevāṃstriṃśatpañcādaśadeva tu ..28..
2.2.d:
सर्ववास्तुविभागेन विज्ञेया नवका नव ॥
पदस्थान्पूजयेद्देवांस्त्रिंशत्पञ्चादशदेव तु ॥28॥
2.2.m:
by the division of the entire site, nine nines are to be known;
he should worship the deities situated in the squares, thirty [plus] five and ten;

2.2.s:
dvātriṃśadbāhyataḥ pūjyāḥ pūjyāgāre trayodaśa ..
madhye nava pade brahmā tasyāpyaṣṭau samīpagāḥ ..29..
2.2.d:
द्वात्रिंशद्बाह्यतः पूज्याः पूज्यागारे त्रयोदश ॥
मध्ये नव पदे ब्रह्मा तस्याप्यष्टौ समीपगाः ॥29॥
2.2.m:
thirty-two are to be worshipped on the outside, thirteen within the house of worship;
in the middle, in nine squares, is Brahmā, and eight attend close to him;

2.2.s:
caturdikṣu ṣaṭpadaṃ tu tripadaṃ tu catuṣpadam ..
padaikaṃ tu catuṣkoṇe eṣa vāstuvinirṇayaḥ ..
carakyādi tato hitvā catvāriṃśacca paṃcakam.. .. 2.2.10.30 ..
2.2.d:
चतुर्दिक्षु षट्पदं तु त्रिपदं तु चतुष्पदम् ॥
पदैकं तु चतुष्कोणे एष वास्तुविनिर्णयः ॥
चरक्यादि ततो हित्वा चत्वारिंशच्च पंचकम्॥ ॥ 2.2.10.30 ॥

2.2.s:
aparaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vakṣye yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ ..
navarekhāprayogeṇa navakoṣṭhānprakalpayet .. 31 ..
2.2.d:
अपरं मण्डलं वक्ष्ये यथावदनुपूर्वशः ॥
नवरेखाप्रयोगेण नवकोष्ठान्प्रकल्पयेत् ॥ 31 ॥
2.2.m:
I shall explain another maṇḍala, properly and in due order;
by applying nine lines, he should fashion nine compartments;

2.2.s:
dvicatuṣkoṣṭhakairdikṣu yajetāryamaṇaṃ tataḥ ..
vivasvaṃtaṃ tato mittraṃ mahīdharamataḥ param .. 32 ..
2.2.d:
द्विचतुष्कोष्ठकैर्दिक्षु यजेतार्यमणं ततः ॥
विवस्वंतं ततो मित्त्रं महीधरमतः परम् ॥ 32 ॥
2.2.m:
with two fourfold compartments in the quarters, he should then worship Aryaman;
then Vivasvat, then Mitra, and after him Mahīdhara;

2.2.s:
koṇeṣu koṣṭhadvaṃdveṣu bāhyādiparikīrtitam ..
sāvitraṃ savitāraṃ ca śakramindraṃ jayaṃ punaḥ .. 33 ..
2.2.d:
कोणेषु कोष्ठद्वंद्वेषु बाह्यादिपरिकीर्तितम् ॥
सावित्रं सवितारं च शक्रमिन्द्रं जयं पुनः ॥ 33 ॥
2.2.m:
in the corners, in pairs of compartments, stated from the outside inwards:
Sāvitra and Savitṛ, Śakra and Indra, and then Jaya;

2.2.s:
rudraṃ rudrajayaṃ caiva vāyuṃ jṛṃbhakameva ca ..
pilipicchaṃ ca medhāvī vidārī pūtanā tathā .. 34 ..
2.2.d:
रुद्रं रुद्रजयं चैव वायुं जृंभकमेव च ॥
पिलिपिच्छं च मेधावी विदारी पूतना तथा ॥ 34 ॥
2.2.m:
Rudra, Rudrajaya, Vāyu, and Jṛmbhaka;
Pilipiccha, Medhāvin, Vidārī, and Pūtanā;

2.2.s:
kramādīśānaparyaṃtāṃ jayaṃtaḥ śakrabhāskarau ..
satyovṛṣāṃtarikṣau ca diśi prācyāmavasthitāḥ .. 35 ..
2.2.d:
क्रमादीशानपर्यंतां जयंतः शक्रभास्करौ ॥
सत्योवृषांतरिक्षौ च दिशि प्राच्यामवस्थिताः ॥ 35 ॥
2.2.m:
in sequence up to the northeast: Jayanta, Śakra, and the Sun;
Satya, Vṛṣa, and Antarikṣa are positioned in the eastern quarter;

2.2.s:
agniḥ pūṣā ca vitadho yamaśca gṛharakṣakaḥ ..
gaṃdharvo bhṛṃgarājaśca mṛgo dakṣiṇamāśritāḥ .. 36 ..
2.2.d:
अग्निः पूषा च वितधो यमश्च गृहरक्षकः ॥
गंधर्वो भृंगराजश्च मृगो दक्षिणमाश्रिताः ॥ 36 ॥
2.2.m:
Agni, Pūṣan, Vitatha, and Yama the house-guardian;
Gandharva, Bhṛṅgarāja, and Mṛga dwell in the south;

2.2.s:
nirṛtirdauvārikaśca sugrīvavaruṇau tataḥ ..
puṣpadaṃtasvarau śoṣarogau pratyagdiśi sthitāḥ .. 37 ..
2.2.d:
निरृतिर्दौवारिकश्च सुग्रीववरुणौ ततः ॥
पुष्पदंतस्वरौ शोषरोगौ प्रत्यग्दिशि स्थिताः ॥ 37 ॥
2.2.m:
Nirṛti and Dauvārika, then Sugrīva and Varuṇa;
Puṣpadanta, Svara, Śoṣa, and Roga are situated in the western quarter;

2.2.s:
prāṇavāyuśca nāgaśca somo bhallāṭa eva ca ..
mudgalākhyo dityaditī kuberasya diśi sthitāḥ .. 38 ..
2.2.d:
प्राणवायुश्च नागश्च सोमो भल्लाट एव च ॥
मुद्गलाख्यो दित्यदिती कुबेरस्य दिशि स्थिताः ॥ 38 ॥
2.2.m:
Prāṇavāyu, Nāga, Soma, Bhallāṭa,
Mudgala, Diti, and Aditi are situated in Kubera's quarter;

2.2.s:
militvā ca tripañcāśattebhyaḥ pūrve baliṃ haret ..
piṇyākaiḥ paramānnairvā pūrvoktairvā yathā kramāt.. 39 ..
2.2.d:
मिलित्वा च त्रिपञ्चाशत्तेभ्यः पूर्वे बलिं हरेत् ॥
पिण्याकैः परमान्नैर्वा पूर्वोक्तैर्वा यथा क्रमात्॥ 39 ॥
2.2.m:
gathering together fifty-three, he should first offer them oblations,
with oil-cake, with choice porridge, or as previously stated in due sequence;

2.2.s:
raktamaryamaṇaṃ dhyāyeccaturbhirbahubhirvṛtam ..
śvetāśvavāhanaṃ divyaṃ kirīṭaiḥ svairvibhūṣitam .. 2.2.10.40 ..
2.2.d:
रक्तमर्यमणं ध्यायेच्चतुर्भिर्बहुभिर्वृतम् ॥
श्वेताश्ववाहनं दिव्यं किरीटैः स्वैर्विभूषितम् ॥ 2.2.10.40 ॥
2.2.m:
he should meditate upon Aryaman as red, attended by four arms,
having white horses for his mount, divine, adorned with his own crowns;

2.2.s: ākṛṣṇeneti mantrasya svarṇa ṛṣijagatīchandaḥ savitraryamaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 41 ..
2.2.d: आकृष्णेनेति मन्त्रस्य स्वर्ण ऋषिजगतीछन्दः सवित्रर्यमप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 41 ॥
2.2.m: of the mantra beginning with *ākṛṣṇena*, Svarṇa is the seer, Jagatī the metre, and the application is to please Savitṛ and Aryaman;

2.2.s:
vivasvaṃtaṃ pītavarṇaṃ pītāmbaradharaṃ śubham ..
meṣasthaṃ ca mahākāyaṃ devagandharvasevitam ..42..
2.2.d:
विवस्वंतं पीतवर्णं पीताम्बरधरं शुभम् ॥
मेषस्थं च महाकायं देवगन्धर्वसेवितम् ॥42॥
2.2.m:
Vivasvat is yellow-coloured, wearing yellow garments, auspicious,
mounted upon a ram, huge-bodied, served by gods and gandharvas;

2.2.s: etātaviṣaṃtīti maṃtrasya kardama ṛṣiḥ paṃktiśchandaḥ kamalādevatāvivasvatprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 43 ..
2.2.d: एतातविषंतीति मंत्रस्य कर्दम ऋषिः पंक्तिश्छन्दः कमलादेवताविवस्वत्प्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 43 ॥
2.2.m: of the mantra beginning with *etātaviṣantī*, Kardama is the seer, Paṅkti the metre, Kamalā the deity, and the application is to please Vivasvat;

2.2.s:
mitraṃ dhyāyecchuklavarṇaṃ śvetahaṃsoparisthi tam ..
trinetraṃ tribhujaṃ caiva śvetāṃbaradharaṃ śubham .. 44 ..
2.2.d:
मित्रं ध्यायेच्छुक्लवर्णं श्वेतहंसोपरिस्थि तम् ॥
त्रिनेत्रं त्रिभुजं चैव श्वेतांबरधरं शुभम् ॥ 44 ॥
2.2.m:
he should meditate upon Mitra as white-coloured, standing upon a white swan,
three-eyed, three-armed, auspicious, dressed in white garments;

2.2.s: kayānaścīti maṃtrasya jayaṃta ṛṣirgāyatrī chandaḥ śaṅkaro devatā mitraprītaye viniyogaḥ .. ..45..
2.2.d: कयानश्चीति मंत्रस्य जयंत ऋषिर्गायत्री छन्दः शङ्करो देवता मित्रप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ ॥45॥
2.2.m: of the mantra beginning with *kayānaścī*, Jayanta is the seer, Gāyatrī the metre, Śaṅkara the deity, and the application is to please Mitra;

2.2.s:
prītaṃ mahīdharaṃ dhyāyedvṛṣabhopari saṃsthim..
tribhujaṃ padmahastaṃ ca vyālayajñopavītinam ..46..
2.2.d:
प्रीतं महीधरं ध्यायेद्वृषभोपरि संस्थिम्॥
त्रिभुजं पद्महस्तं च व्यालयज्ञोपवीतिनम् ॥46॥
2.2.m:
he should meditate upon pleased Mahīdhara standing upon a bull,
three-armed, holding a lotus, wearing a snake as his sacred thread;

2.2.s: tryambakamiti maṃtrasya gargaṛṣistriṣṭup chando haro devatā mahīdharaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 47 ..
2.2.d: त्र्यम्बकमिति मंत्रस्य गर्गऋषिस्त्रिष्टुप् छन्दो हरो देवता महीधरप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 47 ॥
2.2.m: of the mantra beginning with *tryambakam*, Garga is the seer, Triṣṭubh the metre, Hara the deity, and the application is to please Mahīdhara;

2.2.s:
sāvitrīṃ śvetavarṇāṃ ca sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutām ..
dvibhujāṃ pītavastrāṃ ca śvetasiṃhāsane sthitām .. 48 ..
2.2.d:
सावित्रीं श्वेतवर्णां च सर्वलक्षणसंयुताम् ॥
द्विभुजां पीतवस्त्रां च श्वेतसिंहासने स्थिताम् ॥ 48 ॥
2.2.m:
Sāvitrī is white-coloured, endowed with all auspicious marks,
two-armed, clad in yellow garments, seated upon a white throne;

2.2.s: raktāmbaradharāṃ raktāṃ raktamālopaśobhitām .. 49 ..
2.2.d: रक्ताम्बरधरां रक्तां रक्तमालोपशोभिताम् ॥ 49 ॥
2.2.m: wearing red garments, red-complexioned, adorned with a garland of red flowers;

2.2.s: tadvarṣaṃ iti maṃtrasya gautama ṛṣirvirāṭ chandaḥ sūryo devatā savitṛprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 2.2.10.50 ..
2.2.d: तद्वर्षं इति मंत्रस्य गौतम ऋषिर्विराट् छन्दः सूर्यो देवता सवितृप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 2.2.10.50 ॥
2.2.m: of the mantra beginning with *tadvarṣaṃ*, Gautama is the seer, Virāṭ the metre, Sūrya the deity, and the application is to please Savitṛ;

2.2.s:
śakraṃ dhyāyetpītavarṇaṃ śuklakairāvatasthitam ..
sarvadevaiḥ stūyamānaṃ dvibhujaṃ pītavāsasam ..51..
2.2.d:
शक्रं ध्यायेत्पीतवर्णं शुक्लकैरावतस्थितम् ॥
सर्वदेवैः स्तूयमानं द्विभुजं पीतवाससम् ॥51॥
2.2.m:
he should meditate upon Śakra as yellow-coloured, standing upon white Airāvata,
praised by all the deities, two-armed, clad in yellow clothes;

2.2.s: trātāramiti maṃtrasya bhārgava ṛṣistriṣṭup chando narasiṃho devatā indrajayaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 52 ..
2.2.d: त्रातारमिति मंत्रस्य भार्गव ऋषिस्त्रिष्टुप् छन्दो नरसिंहो देवता इन्द्रजयप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 52 ॥
2.2.m: of the mantra beginning with *trātāram*, Bhārgava is the seer, Triṣṭubh the metre, Narasiṃha the deity, and the application is to please Indra and Jaya;

2.2.s:
rudraṃ dhyāyecchvetavarṇaṃ vṛṣabhārūḍhavigraham ..
nāgayajñopavītaṃ ca sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam .. 53 ..
2.2.d:
रुद्रं ध्यायेच्छ्वेतवर्णं वृषभारूढविग्रहम् ॥
नागयज्ञोपवीतं च सर्वलक्षणसंयुतम् ॥ 53 ॥
2.2.m:
he should meditate upon Rudra as white-coloured, his body mounted on a bull,
with a snake for his sacred thread, endowed with all auspicious marks;

2.2.s: namaste rudreti maṃtrasya gāyatrī chaṃdastryaṃbako devatā rudraprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 54 ..
2.2.d: नमस्ते रुद्रेति मंत्रस्य गायत्री छंदस्त्र्यंबको देवता रुद्रप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 54 ॥
2.2.m: of the mantra beginning with *namaste rudra*, Gāyatrī is the metre, Tryambaka the deity, and the application is to please Rudra;

2.2.s:
raktaṃ rudraṃ jayaṃ dhyāyedraktapadmopari sthitam ..
raktaśyāmāṃbaradharaṃ dvibhujaṃ raktavāsasam .. 55 ..
2.2.d:
रक्तं रुद्रं जयं ध्यायेद्रक्तपद्मोपरि स्थितम् ॥
रक्तश्यामांबरधरं द्विभुजं रक्तवाससम् ॥ 55 ॥
2.2.m:
he should meditate upon red Rudrajaya standing upon a red lotus,
wearing garments of red and dark, two-armed, clad in red clothes;

2.2.s: tryaṃbakamiti mantrasya gāyatrīcchando maheśo devatā rudrajayaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 56 ..
2.2.d: त्र्यंबकमिति मन्त्रस्य गायत्रीच्छन्दो महेशो देवता रुद्रजयप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 56 ॥
2.2.m: of the mantra beginning with *tryambakam*, Gāyatrī is the metre, Maheśa the deity, and the application is to please Rudrajaya;

2.2.s:
api śvetaṃ tato dhyāyedvarābhayakaraṃ param ..
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ śvetapadmopari sthitam .. 57 ..
2.2.d:
अपि श्वेतं ततो ध्यायेद्वराभयकरं परम् ॥
सर्वलक्षणसंपन्नं श्वेतपद्मोपरि स्थितम् ॥ 57 ॥
2.2.m:
then he should also meditate upon Ap as white, supreme, granting boons and fearlessness,
endowed with all auspicious marks, standing upon a white lotus;

2.2.s:
īśāna iti maṃtrasya marīcirṛṣiḥ paṃkticchando vāyurdevatā apāṃ prītaye viniyogaḥ..
āpavatsaṃ pītavarṇaṃ meṣārūḍhaṃ caturbhujam ..58..
2.2.d:
ईशान इति मंत्रस्य मरीचिरृषिः पंक्तिच्छन्दो वायुर्देवता अपां प्रीतये विनियोगः॥
आपवत्सं पीतवर्णं मेषारूढं चतुर्भुजम् ॥58॥
2.2.m:
of the mantra beginning with *īśāna*, Marīci is the seer, Paṅkti the metre, Vāyu the deity, and the application is to please Apas;
Āpavatsa is yellow-coloured, mounted upon a ram, four-armed;

2.2.s: padmaśaṃkhadharaṃ vāme varābhayakaraṃ param .. 59..
2.2.d: पद्मशंखधरं वामे वराभयकरं परम् ॥ 59॥
2.2.m: holding a lotus and a conch, supreme, his left hand bestowing boons and fearlessness;

2.2.s: varuṇasyottaṃbhanamasīti mantrasya narottama ṛṣirvirāṭ chando varuṇo devatā āvayaḥ prītaye viniyogaḥ ..2.2.10.60..
2.2.d: वरुणस्योत्तंभनमसीति मन्त्रस्य नरोत्तम ऋषिर्विराट् छन्दो वरुणो देवता आवयः प्रीतये विनियोगः ॥2.2.10.60॥
2.2.m: of the mantra beginning with *varuṇasyottambhanam asi*, Narottama is the seer, Virāṭ the metre, Vāruṇa the deity, and the application is to please Āvaya;

2.2.s:
koṇasūtrasyobhayataḥ śvetakoṣṭhadvaye punaḥ..
śarvaṃ dhyāyedraktavarṇaṃ vṛṣabhopari saṃsthitam ..61....
2.2.d:
कोणसूत्रस्योभयतः श्वेतकोष्ठद्वये पुनः॥
शर्वं ध्यायेद्रक्तवर्णं वृषभोपरि संस्थितम् ॥61॥॥
2.2.m:
furthermore, on both sides of the diagonal line, in two white compartments,
he should meditate upon Śarva as red-coloured, mounted upon a bull;

2.2.s: dvibhujaṃ ca trinetraṃ ca jaṭābhāropaśobhitam ..62..
2.2.d: द्विभुजं च त्रिनेत्रं च जटाभारोपशोभितम् ॥62॥
2.2.m: two-armed, three-eyed, and adorned with a mass of matted hair.

2.2.s: mālā svāheti maṃtrasya bhārgava ṛṣirgāyatrīchando mahādevo devatā śarvaprītaye viniyogaḥ...63.
2.2.d: माला स्वाहेति मंत्रस्य भार्गव ऋषिर्गायत्रीछन्दो महादेवो देवता शर्वप्रीतये विनियोगः॥.63.
2.2.m: Of the mantra 'mālā svāhā', the seer is Bhārgava, the metre is Gāyatrī, the deity is Mahādeva, and the application is for the propitiation of Śarva.

2.2.s:
guhaṃ dhyāyetpītavarṇaṃ pītapadmāsanasthitama ..
nānābharaṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ kuṇḍalādyairalaṅkṛtam .. 64 ..
2.2.d:
गुहं ध्यायेत्पीतवर्णं पीतपद्मासनस्थितम ॥
नानाभरणशोभाढ्यं कुण्डलाद्यैरलङ्कृतम् ॥ 64 ॥
2.2.m: One should meditate upon Guha as yellow-coloured, seated on a yellow lotus seat, / rich in the splendour of various ornaments, adorned with earrings and the like.

2.2.s: sa bodha iti mantrasya agastirṛṣirgāyatrī chando haro devatā guhaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 65 ..
2.2.d: स बोध इति मन्त्रस्य अगस्तिरृषिर्गायत्री छन्दो हरो देवता गुहप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 65 ॥
2.2.m: Of the mantra 'sa bodha', the seer is Agasti, the metre is Gāyatrī, the deity is Hara, and the application is for the propitiation of Guha.

2.2.s:
aryamṇaṃ dvibhujaṃ raktaṃ raktamālyopaśobhitam..
raktapadmāsanasthaṃ ca devagandharvasevitam .. 66 ..
2.2.d:
अर्यम्णं द्विभुजं रक्तं रक्तमाल्योपशोभितम्॥
रक्तपद्मासनस्थं च देवगन्धर्वसेवितम् ॥ 66 ॥
2.2.m: Aryaman is two-armed, red, adorned with red garlands, / seated upon a red lotus seat, and served by gods and gandharvas.

2.2.s: vāto vāreti maṃtrasya kāśyapa ṛṣiranuṣṭupchando vāyurdevatā aryamaprītaye viniyogaḥ..67..
2.2.d: वातो वारेति मंत्रस्य काश्यप ऋषिरनुष्टुप्छन्दो वायुर्देवता अर्यमप्रीतये विनियोगः॥67॥
2.2.m: Of the mantra 'vāto vā', the seer is Kāśyapa, the metre is Anuṣṭubh, the deity is Vāyu, and the application is for the propitiation of Aryaman.

2.2.s:
dhyāyecca jambhakaṃ śvetaṃ dvibhujaṃ kuṭilānanam ..
karālavadanaṃ ghoraṃ varāhopari saṃsthitam .. 68 ..
2.2.d:
ध्यायेच्च जम्भकं श्वेतं द्विभुजं कुटिलाननम् ॥
करालवदनं घोरं वराहोपरि संस्थितम् ॥ 68 ॥
2.2.m: And one should meditate upon Jambhaka as white, two-armed, with a crooked face, / terrible-faced, fearsome, and mounted upon a boar.

2.2.s: kuvidogavaya iti mantrasya viśvāmitra ṛṣirjagatī chandaḥ somo devatā jaṃbhakaprītaye viniyogaḥ ..69..
2.2.d: कुविदोगवय इति मन्त्रस्य विश्वामित्र ऋषिर्जगती छन्दः सोमो देवता जंभकप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥69॥
2.2.m: Of the mantra 'kuvidogavaya', the seer is Viśvāmitra, the metre is Jagatī, the deity is Soma, and the application is for the propitiation of Jambhaka.

2.2.s:
pilapicchaṃ raktavarṇaṃ raktamālyairalaṅkṛtam ..
raktapadmāsanasthaṃ ca raktābharaṇaśobhitam .. 2.2.10.70 ..
2.2.d:
पिलपिच्छं रक्तवर्णं रक्तमाल्यैरलङ्कृतम् ॥
रक्तपद्मासनस्थं च रक्ताभरणशोभितम् ॥ 2.2.10.70 ॥
2.2.m: Pilapiccha is red-coloured, adorned with red garlands, / seated on a red lotus seat, and beautified with red ornaments.

2.2.s: devasya heti mantrasya paṃktiśchaṃdaḥ śacī devatā pilapicchaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 71 ..
2.2.d: देवस्य हेति मन्त्रस्य पंक्तिश्छंदः शची देवता पिलपिच्छप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 71 ॥
2.2.m: Of the mantra 'devasya ha', the metre is Paṅkti, the deity is Śacī, and the application is for the propitiation of Pilapiccha.

2.2.s:
pītāṃ ca carakīṃ dhyāyedraktamālyairalaṃkṛtām ..
sucāruvadanāṃ bhavyāṃ guñjāhāropaśobhitām .. 72 ..
2.2.d:
पीतां च चरकीं ध्यायेद्रक्तमाल्यैरलंकृताम् ॥
सुचारुवदनां भव्यां गुञ्जाहारोपशोभिताम् ॥ 72 ॥
2.2.m: One should meditate upon Carakī as yellow, adorned with red garlands, / very lovely-faced, auspicious, and graced with a necklace of guñjā [berries].

2.2.s: tadvarṣaṃ iti mantrasya jaṭila ṛṣirbṛhatī chando bhavo devatā carakīprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 73 ..
2.2.d: तद्वर्षं इति मन्त्रस्य जटिल ऋषिर्बृहती छन्दो भवो देवता चरकीप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 73 ॥
2.2.m: Of the mantra 'tadvarṣam', the seer is Jaṭila, the metre is Bṛhatī, the deity is Bhava, and the application is for the propitiation of Carakī.

2.2.s:
śyāmāṃ vidārikāṃ dhyāyettrinetrāṃ ca caturbhujām..
nānāgaṇayutāṃ devīṃ paṅkajadvayadhāriṇīm .. 74..
2.2.d:
श्यामां विदारिकां ध्यायेत्त्रिनेत्रां च चतुर्भुजाम्॥
नानागणयुतां देवीं पङ्कजद्वयधारिणीम् ॥ 74॥
2.2.m: One should meditate upon Vidārikā as dark, three-eyed and four-armed, / a goddess accompanied by various hosts, holding two lotuses.

2.2.s: śrīśca te iti mantrasya varuṇa ṛṣirnṛsiṃho devatā vidārikāprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 75 ..
2.2.d: श्रीश्च ते इति मन्त्रस्य वरुण ऋषिर्नृसिंहो देवता विदारिकाप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 75 ॥
2.2.m: Of the mantra 'śrīśca te', the seer is Varuṇa, the deity is Nṛsiṃha, and the application is for the propitiation of Vidārikā.

2.2.s:
raktāṃ ca pūtanāṃ dhyāyetpaṅkajasthāṃ suśobhanām ..
sarvābharaṇasaṃpannāṃ sarvālaṃkāraśobhitām .. 76 ..
2.2.d:
रक्तां च पूतनां ध्यायेत्पङ्कजस्थां सुशोभनाम् ॥
सर्वाभरणसंपन्नां सर्वालंकारशोभिताम् ॥ 76 ॥
2.2.m: One should meditate upon Pūtanā as red, seated on a lotus, very splendid, / endowed with all ornaments, and beautified with all decorations.

2.2.s: mayi gṛhṇāmīti maṃtrasya vivasvānṛṣirnārāyaṇo devatā pūtanāprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 77 ..
2.2.d: मयि गृह्णामीति मंत्रस्य विवस्वानृषिर्नारायणो देवता पूतनाप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 77 ॥
2.2.m: Of the mantra 'mayi gṛhṇāmi', the seer is Vivasvan, the deity is Nārāyaṇa, and the application is for the propitiation of Pūtanā.

2.2.s:
pūrvādidikṣu sarvāsu sārdhādyaṃtapadeṣu ca ..
īśānaṃ jaṭilaṃ śvetaṃ śūlahastaṃ mahābhujam ..78..
2.2.d:
पूर्वादिदिक्षु सर्वासु सार्धाद्यंतपदेषु च ॥
ईशानं जटिलं श्वेतं शूलहस्तं महाभुजम् ॥78॥
2.2.m: In all the directions, beginning with the east, and in the outer boundary squares: / Īśāna is matted-haired, white, spear in hand, mighty-armed,

2.2.s: trinetraṃ vṛṣabhārūḍhaṃ nāgahāro paśobhitam .. 79 ..
2.2.d: त्रिनेत्रं वृषभारूढं नागहारो पशोभितम् ॥ 79 ॥
2.2.m: three-eyed, mounted upon a bull, and adorned with a snake-necklace.

2.2.s: āyuḥśīrṣāṇa iti maṃtrasya vāmadeva ṛṣirbṛhatī chando dharaṇīdharo devatā īśānaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 2.2.10.80 ..
2.2.d: आयुःशीर्षाण इति मंत्रस्य वामदेव ऋषिर्बृहती छन्दो धरणीधरो देवता ईशानप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 2.2.10.80 ॥
2.2.m: Of the mantra 'āyuḥśīrṣāṇa', the seer is Vāmadeva, the metre is Bṛhatī, the deity is Dharaṇīdhara, and the application is for the propitiation of Īśāna.

2.2.s:
raktaṃ dhyāyecca parjanyaṃ dvibhujaṃ pītavāsasam ..
dakṣiṇe paraśuṃ dhyāyedoṃkāraṃ ca tathāpare .. 81..
2.2.d:
रक्तं ध्यायेच्च पर्जन्यं द्विभुजं पीतवाससम् ॥
दक्षिणे परशुं ध्यायेदोंकारं च तथापरे ॥ 81॥
2.2.m: And one should meditate upon Parjanya as red, two-armed, clad in yellow garments; / one should meditate upon an axe in the right hand, and likewise an oṃkāra in the other.

2.2.s: kayānaśceti mantrasya dharma ṛṣirbṛhatī chando bhavo devatā parjanya prītaye viniyogaḥ ..82..
2.2.d: कयानश्चेति मन्त्रस्य धर्म ऋषिर्बृहती छन्दो भवो देवता पर्जन्य प्रीतये विनियोगः ॥82॥
2.2.m: Of the mantra 'kayā naḥ', the seer is Dharma, the metre is Bṛhatī, the deity is Bhava, and the application is for the propitiation of Parjanya.

2.2.s:
jayantaṃ śvetaṃ śvetavṛṣabhārūḍhaṃ dhyātvā..
mānastoketi mantrasya śaktyṛṣistriṣṭupchandaḥ śaṅkaro devatā jayaṃtaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 83 ..
2.2.d:
जयन्तं श्वेतं श्वेतवृषभारूढं ध्यात्वा॥
मानस्तोकेति मन्त्रस्य शक्त्यृषिस्त्रिष्टुप्छन्दः शङ्करो देवता जयंतप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 83 ॥
2.2.m: Having meditated upon Jayanta as white and mounted upon a white bull: / of the mantra 'mā nastoka', the seer is Śakti, the metre is Triṣṭubh, the deity is Śaṅkara, and the application is for the propitiation of Jayanta.

2.2.s: śuklaṃ pītaṃ dvibhujamairāvatasthaṃ vajradharaṃ dhyātvā mūlabījena sthāpayet .. 84 ..
2.2.d: शुक्लं पीतं द्विभुजमैरावतस्थं वज्रधरं ध्यात्वा मूलबीजेन स्थापयेत् ॥ 84 ॥
2.2.m: Having meditated upon [Indra] as white-yellow, two-armed, seated upon Airāvata, holding a thunderbolt, one should install him with the root seed-syllable.

2.2.s: bhāskaraṃ raktadvibhujaṃ raktāśvasthaṃ dhyātvā māyābījena pūjayet ..85..
2.2.d: भास्करं रक्तद्विभुजं रक्ताश्वस्थं ध्यात्वा मायाबीजेन पूजयेत् ॥85॥
2.2.m: Having meditated upon Bhāskara as red, two-armed, and seated on a red horse, one should worship him with the māyā seed-syllable.

2.2.s:
satyaṃ ca dvibhujaṃ śvetaṃ trinetraṃ pītavāsasaṃ mandakuṃdabījena pūjayet..
vṛṣaṃ pītaṃ vṛṣabhārūḍhamākāśabījena pūjayet ..86..
2.2.d:
सत्यं च द्विभुजं श्वेतं त्रिनेत्रं पीतवाससं मन्दकुंदबीजेन पूजयेत्॥
वृषं पीतं वृषभारूढमाकाशबीजेन पूजयेत् ॥86॥
2.2.m: And one should worship Satya, two-armed, white, three-eyed, clad in yellow garments, with the mandakunda seed-syllable; / one should worship Vṛṣa, yellow and mounted upon a bull, with the space seed-syllable.

2.2.s:
ṛkṣaṃ nīlaṃ caturbhujaṃ mahiṣārūḍham ..
ācchīma iti mantrasya hotā yakṣa ṛṣistriṣṭupchandaḥ śaṃkaro devatā ṛkṣaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 87 ..
2.2.d:
ऋक्षं नीलं चतुर्भुजं महिषारूढम् ॥
आच्छीम इति मन्त्रस्य होता यक्ष ऋषिस्त्रिष्टुप्छन्दः शंकरो देवता ऋक्षप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 87 ॥
2.2.m: Ṛkṣa is dark blue, four-armed, and mounted upon a buffalo. / Of the mantra 'ācchīma', the seer is the Hotṛ Yakṣa, the metre is Triṣṭubh, the deity is Śaṅkara, and the application is for the propitiation of Ṛkṣa.

2.2.s:
agnimārabhya pūjayet ..
agniṃ raktaṃ saptajihvaṃ raktavāsasaṃ piṅgākṣaṃ dhyātvā ..
agnidūtamiti maṃtrasya bharadvāja ṛṣistriṣṭucchandaḥ śaṃkaro devatā agniprītaye vini yogaḥ .. 88 ..
2.2.d:
अग्निमारभ्य पूजयेत् ॥
अग्निं रक्तं सप्तजिह्वं रक्तवाससं पिङ्गाक्षं ध्यात्वा ॥
अग्निदूतमिति मंत्रस्य भरद्वाज ऋषिस्त्रिष्टुच्छन्दः शंकरो देवता अग्निप्रीतये विनि योगः ॥ 88 ॥
2.2.m: Beginning with Agni, one should worship: / having meditated upon Agni as red, seven-tongued, clad in red garments, with tawny eyes; / of the mantra 'agnidūtam', the seer is Bharadvāja, the metre is Triṣṭubh, the deity is Śaṅkara, and the application is for the propitiation of Agni.

2.2.s: vitathaṃ raktamajavāhanaṃ dvibhujaṃ dhyātvā gāyatryā pūjayet .. 89 ..
2.2.d: वितथं रक्तमजवाहनं द्विभुजं ध्यात्वा गायत्र्या पूजयेत् ॥ 89 ॥
2.2.m: Having meditated upon Vitatha as red, with a goat as his mount, and two-armed, one should worship him with the Gāyatrī.

2.2.s: gāyatryā viśvāmitra ṛṣirgāyatrīchandaḥ savitā devatā vitathaprītaye viniyogaḥ ..2.2.10.90..
2.2.d: गायत्र्या विश्वामित्र ऋषिर्गायत्रीछन्दः सविता देवता वितथप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥2.2.10.90॥
2.2.m: Of the Gāyatrī, the seer is Viśvāmitra, the metre is Gāyatrī, the deity is Savitṛ, and the application is for the propitiation of Vitatha.

2.2.s:
yamaṃ kṛṣṇamahiṣārūḍhaṃ daṇḍahastaṃ dhyāyet ..
acchiya iti mantrasya triṣṭupchando bhavānī devatā yamaprītaye viniyogaḥ ..91..
2.2.d:
यमं कृष्णमहिषारूढं दण्डहस्तं ध्यायेत् ॥
अच्छिय इति मन्त्रस्य त्रिष्टुप्छन्दो भवानी देवता यमप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥91॥
2.2.m: One should meditate upon Yama as mounted upon a black buffalo, with a staff in hand. / Of the mantra 'acchiya', the metre is Triṣṭubh, the deity is Bhavānī, and the application is for the propitiation of Yama.

2.2.s: gṛhe kṣetraṃ raktamūrdhvakeśaṃ mahābhujaṃ raktavāsasaṃ dhyātvā vahnibījena pūjayet ..92..
2.2.d: गृहे क्षेत्रं रक्तमूर्ध्वकेशं महाभुजं रक्तवाससं ध्यात्वा वह्निबीजेन पूजयेत् ॥92॥
2.2.m: In the house [compartment], having meditated upon Kṣetra as red, with upright hair, mighty-armed, and clad in red garments, one should worship him with the fire seed-syllable.

2.2.s: gandharvaṃ śvetaṃ dvibhujaṃ padmāsanasthaṃ dhyātvā yamabījena pūjayet ..93..
2.2.d: गन्धर्वं श्वेतं द्विभुजं पद्मासनस्थं ध्यात्वा यमबीजेन पूजयेत् ॥93॥
2.2.m: Having meditated upon Gandharva as white, two-armed, and seated upon a lotus seat, one should worship him with the Yama seed-syllable.

2.2.s: bhṛṅgarājaṃ raktasiṃhāsanārūḍhaṃ divyayajñopavītinaṃ dhyāyet .. 94 ..
2.2.d: भृङ्गराजं रक्तसिंहासनारूढं दिव्ययज्ञोपवीतिनं ध्यायेत् ॥ 94 ॥
2.2.m: One should meditate upon Bhṛṅgarāja as seated upon a red throne, wearing a divine sacred thread.

2.2.s: hotā yasketi mantrasya bhārgava ṛṣirgāyatrīchando yaśo devatā bhṛṃgarājaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 95 ..
2.2.d: होता यस्केति मन्त्रस्य भार्गव ऋषिर्गायत्रीछन्दो यशो देवता भृंगराजप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 95 ॥
2.2.m: Of the mantra 'hotā yaska', the seer is Bhārgava, the metre is Gāyatrī, the deity is Yaśas, and the application is for the propitiation of Bhṛṅgarāja.

2.2.s:
mṛgaṃ pītaṃ mṛgārūḍhaṃ pītavāsasaṃ dhyātvā ..
kadācaneti mantrasya vāmadevaṛṣirbṛhatī chando vāmadevo devatā mṛgaprītaye viniyogaḥ ..96..
2.2.d:
मृगं पीतं मृगारूढं पीतवाससं ध्यात्वा ॥
कदाचनेति मन्त्रस्य वामदेवऋषिर्बृहती छन्दो वामदेवो देवता मृगप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥96॥
2.2.m: Having meditated upon Mṛga as yellow, mounted upon a deer, clad in yellow garments; / of the mantra 'kadācana', the seer is Vāmadeva, the metre is Bṛhatī, the deity is Vāmadeva, and the application is for the propitiation of Mṛga.

2.2.s:
nairṛtārddhapadeṣu ca ..
nirṛtiṃ pītaṃ śvetaṃ padmāsanasthaṃ dhyātvā ..
kaidācaneti mantrasya paṃktiśchandaḥ savitā devatā nirṛtiprītaye viniyogaḥ ..97..
2.2.d:
नैरृतार्द्धपदेषु च ॥
निरृतिं पीतं श्वेतं पद्मासनस्थं ध्यात्वा ॥
कैदाचनेति मन्त्रस्य पंक्तिश्छन्दः सविता देवता निरृतिप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥97॥
2.2.m: And in the half-squares of the southwest: / having meditated upon Nirṛti as yellow-white and seated on a lotus seat; / of the mantra 'kaidācana', the metre is Paṅkti, the deity is Savitṛ, and the application is for the propitiation of Nirṛti.

2.2.s:
nairṛtārddhapadeṣu ca dauvārikaṃ śvetaśarabhārūḍhaṃ trinetraṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaṃ dhyātvā ..
hotasveti mantrasya narasiṃhaṛṣirbṛhatī chando gaṇeśo devatā dauvārikaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 98 ..
2.2.d:
नैरृतार्द्धपदेषु च दौवारिकं श्वेतशरभारूढं त्रिनेत्रं सर्वाभरणभूषितं ध्यात्वा ॥
होतस्वेति मन्त्रस्य नरसिंहऋषिर्बृहती छन्दो गणेशो देवता दौवारिकप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 98 ॥
2.2.m: And in the half-squares of the southwest, having meditated upon Dauvārika as mounted upon a white śarabha, three-eyed, and adorned with all ornaments; / of the mantra 'hotasva', the seer is Narasiṃha, the metre is Bṛhatī, the deity is Gaṇeśa, and the application is for the propitiation of Dauvārika.

2.2.s:
śyāmaṃ sugrīvaṃ kṛṣṇameṣārūḍhaṃ pītavāsasaṃ dhyātvā ..
svādityeti mantrasya triṣṭupchando vāmano devatā sugrīvaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 99 ..
2.2.d:
श्यामं सुग्रीवं कृष्णमेषारूढं पीतवाससं ध्यात्वा ॥
स्वादित्येति मन्त्रस्य त्रिष्टुप्छन्दो वामनो देवता सुग्रीवप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 99 ॥
2.2.m: Having meditated upon Sugrīva as dark, mounted upon a black ram, clad in yellow garments; / of the mantra 'svāditya', the metre is Triṣṭubh, the deity is Vāmana, and the application is for the propitiation of Sugrīva.

2.2.s: sumitriyā na iti mantrasya kandarpaṛṣiḥ paṅktiśchandaḥ sūryo devatā varuṇaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 2.2.10.100 ..
2.2.d: सुमित्रिया न इति मन्त्रस्य कन्दर्पऋषिः पङ्क्तिश्छन्दः सूर्यो देवता वरुणप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 2.2.10.100 ॥
2.2.m: Of the mantra 'sumitriyā naḥ', the seer is Kandarpa, the metre is Paṅkti, the deity is Sūrya, and the application is for the propitiation of Varuṇa.

2.2.s:
puṣpadaṃtaṃ pītaṃ meṣārūḍhaṃ pītavāsasaṃ dhyātvā ..
yā oṣadhīriti mantrasya manmatha ṛṣirjagatī chando vāyurdevatā puṣpadaṃtaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 101 ..
2.2.d:
पुष्पदंतं पीतं मेषारूढं पीतवाससं ध्यात्वा ॥
या ओषधीरिति मन्त्रस्य मन्मथ ऋषिर्जगती छन्दो वायुर्देवता पुष्पदंतप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 101 ॥
2.2.m: Having meditated upon Puṣpadanta as yellow, mounted upon a ram, clad in yellow garments; / of the mantra 'yā oṣadhīḥ', the seer is Manmatha, the metre is Jagatī, the deity is Vāyu, and the application is for the propitiation of Puṣpadanta.

2.2.s:
asuraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇamālyairalaṃkṛtaṃ kṛtvā ..
ākṛṣṇeti mantrasya hiraṇyavarṇa ṛṣirjagatī chandaḥ savitā devatā asuraprītaye viniyogaḥ .. .. 102 ..
2.2.d:
असुरं कृष्णं कृष्णमाल्यैरलंकृतं कृत्वा ॥
आकृष्णेति मन्त्रस्य हिरण्यवर्ण ऋषिर्जगती छन्दः सविता देवता असुरप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ ॥ 102 ॥
2.2.m: Having rendered Asura black, adorned with black garlands; / of the mantra 'ākṛṣṇa', the seer is Hiraṇyavarṇa, the metre is Jagatī, the deity is Savitṛ, and the application is for the propitiation of Asura.

2.2.s:
asuraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nāgahārānvitaṃ padmāsanasthaṃ dhyātvā ..
ābrahmanniti maṃtrasya nalina ṛṣistriṣṭupchando bhavānī devatā somaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 103 ..
2.2.d:
असुरं कृष्णं नागहारान्वितं पद्मासनस्थं ध्यात्वा ॥
आब्रह्मन्निति मंत्रस्य नलिन ऋषिस्त्रिष्टुप्छन्दो भवानी देवता सोमप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 103 ॥
2.2.m: Having meditated upon Asura as black, endowed with a necklace of serpents, seated on a lotus seat; / of the mantra 'ā brahman', the seer is Nalina, the metre is Triṣṭubh, the deity is Bhavānī, and the application is for the propitiation of Soma.

2.2.s:
rogaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nīlendīvaradharaṃ śvetavṛṣabhārūḍhaṃ dhyātvā ..
namaste rudra iti mantrasya nārada ṛṣiḥ paṃktiśchandaḥ śrīrdevatā rogaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 104 ..
2.2.d:
रोगं कृष्णं नीलेन्दीवरधरं श्वेतवृषभारूढं ध्यात्वा ॥
नमस्ते रुद्र इति मन्त्रस्य नारद ऋषिः पंक्तिश्छन्दः श्रीर्देवता रोगप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 104 ॥
2.2.m: Having meditated upon Roga as dark, holding a blue water-lily, and mounted on a white bull: / Of the mantra 'namas te rudra', the seer is Nārada, the meter is paṅkti, the deity is Śrī, and the ritual application is for the satisfaction of Roga.

2.2.s:
vāyukoṇādārabhya pūjayet ..
vāyuṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ dhvajahastaṃ mṛgārūḍhaṃ dhyātvā ..
devā iti mantrasya bṛhatī chando yamo devatā nāgaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 105 ..
2.2.d:
वायुकोणादारभ्य पूजयेत् ॥
वायुं धूम्रवर्णं ध्वजहस्तं मृगारूढं ध्यात्वा ॥
देवा इति मन्त्रस्य बृहती छन्दो यमो देवता नागप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 105 ॥
2.2.m: One should worship beginning from the northwest corner. / Having meditated upon Vāyu as smoke-coloured, holding a banner in his hand, and mounted on a deer: / Of the mantra 'devāḥ', the meter is bṛhatī, the deity is Yama, and the ritual application is for the satisfaction of the Nāga.

2.2.s: śvetaṃ somaṃ śvetavarṇāsanasthaṃ dhyātvā bhadrabījena pūjayet .. .. 106 ..
2.2.d: श्वेतं सोमं श्वेतवर्णासनस्थं ध्यात्वा भद्रबीजेन पूजयेत् ॥ ॥ 106 ॥
2.2.m: Having meditated upon white Soma seated on a white seat, one should worship him with the seed-syllable of Bhadra.

2.2.s:
raktaṃ bhallāṭaṃ pītavāsasaṃ dhyātvā vahnibījena pūjayet ..
pītavāsasamajavāhanaṃ hārakeyūrānvitaṃ vāyubījena maṃdarādyaiḥ pūjayet .. .. 107 ..
2.2.d:
रक्तं भल्लाटं पीतवाससं ध्यात्वा वह्निबीजेन पूजयेत् ॥
पीतवाससमजवाहनं हारकेयूरान्वितं वायुबीजेन मंदराद्यैः पूजयेत् ॥ ॥ 107 ॥
2.2.m: Having meditated upon red Bhallāṭa dressed in yellow garments, one should worship him with the seed-syllable of fire. / Dressed in yellow garments, riding a goat, endowed with necklaces and armlets, one should worship him with the seed-syllable of wind using mandāra and other [flowers].

2.2.s:
raktāṃ ditiṃ nāgahārānvitāṃ raktapadmāsanasthāṃ dhyātvā ..
mānārthaṃ iti mantrasyeti pūjayet .. 108 ..
2.2.d:
रक्तां दितिं नागहारान्वितां रक्तपद्मासनस्थां ध्यात्वा ॥
मानार्थं इति मन्त्रस्येति पूजयेत् ॥ 108 ॥
2.2.m: Having meditated upon red Diti endowed with a serpent-necklace and seated on a red lotus seat: / One should worship with the mantra 'mānārtham'.

2.2.s: māno tvā iti maṃtrasya bhārgava ṛṣiḥ paṃktiśchandaḥ pṛthivī devatā ditiprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 109 ..
2.2.d: मानो त्वा इति मंत्रस्य भार्गव ऋषिः पंक्तिश्छन्दः पृथिवी देवता दितिप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 109 ॥
2.2.m: Of the mantra 'mā no tvā', the seer is Bhārgava, the meter is paṅkti, the deity is Pṛthivī, and the ritual application is for the satisfaction of Diti.

2.2.s:
aditiṃ pītavarṇāṃ siṃhārūḍhāṃ pītāṃbaradharāṃ dhyātvā ..
hiraṇyavarṇa iti maṃtrasya janārdana ṛṣirbṛhatī chandaḥ somo devatā aditiprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 2.2.10.110 ..
2.2.d:
अदितिं पीतवर्णां सिंहारूढां पीतांबरधरां ध्यात्वा ॥
हिरण्यवर्ण इति मंत्रस्य जनार्दन ऋषिर्बृहती छन्दः सोमो देवता अदितिप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥ 2.2.10.110 ॥
2.2.m: Having meditated upon Aditi as yellow-coloured, mounted on a lion, and wearing yellow garments: / Of the mantra 'hiraṇyavarṇa', the seer is Janārdana, the meter is bṛhatī, the deity is Soma, and the ritual application is for the satisfaction of Aditi.

2.2.s:
evaṃ yathā vidhāyātha homaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi ..
homāṃte dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātkāñcanaṃ hemasaṃyutam .. 111 ..
2.2.d:
एवं यथा विधायाथ होमं कुर्याद्यथाविधि ॥
होमांते दक्षिणां दद्यात्काञ्चनं हेमसंयुतम् ॥ 111 ॥
2.2.m: Having thus performed [the rites] according to rule, one should then perform the fire-sacrifice according to rule. / At the conclusion of the fire-sacrifice, one should give a sacrificial fee of gold combined with gold.

2.2.s:
taḍāgayāgapakṣe tu suvarṇaṃ cārdhameva vā .. 112 .. ..
pūjākramavarṇanam
2.2.d:
तडागयागपक्षे तु सुवर्णं चार्धमेव वा ॥ 112 ॥ ॥
पूजाक्रमवर्णनम्
2.2.m:
In the case of a sacrifice for a reservoir, however, [one should give] a gold coin or even half of it.
Description of the Order of Worship

2.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
atha pūjākramaṃ vakṣye purāṇasmṛticoditam ..
uttare paścime vātha pūrve cāpi samācaret .. 1 ..
2.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
अथ पूजाक्रमं वक्ष्ये पुराणस्मृतिचोदितम् ॥
उत्तरे पश्चिमे वाथ पूर्वे चापि समाचरेत् ॥ 1 ॥
2.2.m: Sūta said: / Now I shall declare the order of worship prescribed by Purāṇas and Smṛtis. / One should perform it in the north, or in the west, or also in the east.

2.2.s:
nadītīre nemiprāṃte daśadvādaśasaṃkhyayā ..
maṃḍalaṃ racayedviprāścarukadvayasaṃyutam .. 2 ..
2.2.d:
नदीतीरे नेमिप्रांते दशद्वादशसंख्यया ॥
मंडलं रचयेद्विप्राश्चरुकद्वयसंयुतम् ॥ 2 ॥
2.2.m: On a riverbank or at the edge of an enclosure, O brahmins, / one should construct a mandala of ten or twelve [cubits] in measure, accompanied by two offering-vessels.

2.2.s:
tribhāgaṃ vibhajetkṣetraṃ madhyabhāgadvayena tu ..
trihastavedikāṃ kuryāttālotsedhāmudakplavām .. 3 ..
2.2.d:
त्रिभागं विभजेत्क्षेत्रं मध्यभागद्वयेन तु ॥
त्रिहस्तवेदिकां कुर्यात्तालोत्सेधामुदक्प्लवाम् ॥ 3 ॥
2.2.m: One should divide the ground into three parts; with the two central parts / one should make an altar of three cubits, one span in height and sloping to the north.

2.2.s:
uttarāśe dakṣiṇe cāratnihastāṃtare'pi ca ..
trimekhalāṃ hastamātrāṃ guṇavedīsamanvitām.. 4 ..
2.2.d:
उत्तराशे दक्षिणे चारत्निहस्तांतरेऽपि च ॥
त्रिमेखलां हस्तमात्रां गुणवेदीसमन्विताम्॥ 4 ॥
2.2.m: In the northern part and in the south, at an interval of a cubit or a cubit from the elbow, / with three tiers, measuring one cubit, furnished with three altars,

2.2.s:
mūle sārdhaṃ ca śuklāṃ ca mekhalāṃ tu tathaiva ca ..
caturaṃgulikāṃ vediṃ madhyonnatāṃ prakalpayet .. 5 ..
2.2.d:
मूले सार्धं च शुक्लां च मेखलां तु तथैव च ॥
चतुरंगुलिकां वेदिं मध्योन्नतां प्रकल्पयेत् ॥ 5 ॥
2.2.m: and with one and a half [cubits] at the base, white, and with a tier likewise; / one should fashion an altar of four fingers, raised in the middle.

2.2.s:
ṣaṭsaptāṃgulikāṃ yoniṃ paścime mekhalopari ..
vinyasennābhisaṃyuktamevaṃ kuṇḍaṃ prakalpayet .. 6 ..
2.2.d:
षट्सप्तांगुलिकां योनिं पश्चिमे मेखलोपरि ॥
विन्यसेन्नाभिसंयुक्तमेवं कुण्डं प्रकल्पयेत् ॥ 6 ॥
2.2.m: On the west, upon the tier, one should place a vulva-shaped lip / of six or seven fingers, furnished with a navel; thus one should fashion the sacrificial pit.

2.2.s:
śrāddhaṃ vṛddhyātmakaṃ kuryātsaṃkalpaṃ mānasaṃ caret ..
śrāddhārthaṃ naiva saṃkalpettathā vai devadarśane .. 7 ..
2.2.d:
श्राद्धं वृद्ध्यात्मकं कुर्यात्संकल्पं मानसं चरेत् ॥
श्राद्धार्थं नैव संकल्पेत्तथा वै देवदर्शने ॥ 7 ॥
2.2.m: One should perform a prosperity-śrāddha and make a mental resolve. / One must not make a resolve for the sake of an [ordinary] śrāddha, nor likewise when beholding a deity,

2.2.s:
gayāśrāddhārthakaṃ cāṣṭatīrthaśrāddhārthameva ca ..
aiśānyāṃ kalaśe devaṃ pūjayedgaṇanāyakam .. 8 ..
2.2.d:
गयाश्राद्धार्थकं चाष्टतीर्थश्राद्धार्थमेव च ॥
ऐशान्यां कलशे देवं पूजयेद्गणनायकम् ॥ 8 ॥
2.2.m: nor for a Gayā-śrāddha or for a śrāddha at the eight sacred places. / In the northeast, one should worship the divine Gaṇanāyaka in a water-pot.

2.2.s:
madhye kuṇḍe mahāṃścaiva viṣṇudevaṃ digīśvarān..
brahmāṇaṃ cāgnikuṇḍe tu svaiḥ svairmantraiḥ prapūjayet .. 9 ..
2.2.d:
मध्ये कुण्डे महांश्चैव विष्णुदेवं दिगीश्वरान्॥
ब्रह्माणं चाग्निकुण्डे तु स्वैः स्वैर्मन्त्रैः प्रपूजयेत् ॥ 9 ॥
2.2.m: In the central pit, [one should worship] the Great [Lord], Lord Viṣṇu, and the guardians of the directions; / and in the fire-pit, one should worship Brahmā with their respective mantras.

2.2.s:
prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāyātha bhūtaśuddhiṃ samācaret ..
dhyāyedvāṭavīśapuruṣaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam .. 2.2.11.10 ..
2.2.d:
प्राणायामं विधायाथ भूतशुद्धिं समाचरेत् ॥
ध्यायेद्वाटवीशपुरुषं सर्वलक्षणसंयुतम् ॥ 2.2.11.10 ॥
2.2.m: Then, having performed breath-control, one should execute the purification of the elements. / One should meditate on the Lord Person of the Site, endowed with all auspicious marks,

2.2.s:
śvetaṃ caturbhujaṃ śāṃtaṃ kuṇḍalādyairalaṃkṛtam ..
pustakaṃ cākṣamālāṃ ca varābhayakaraṃ param .. 11 ..
2.2.d:
श्वेतं चतुर्भुजं शांतं कुण्डलाद्यैरलंकृतम् ॥
पुस्तकं चाक्षमालां च वराभयकरं परम् ॥ 11 ॥
2.2.m: white, four-armed, tranquil, adorned with earrings and other ornaments, / [holding] a book and a rosary, supreme, granting boons and protection with his hands,

2.2.s:
pitṛvaiśvānaropetaṃ kuṭilabhrūpaśobhitam ..
karālavadanaṃ caiva ājānukaralaṃbitam .. 12 ..
2.2.d:
पितृवैश्वानरोपेतं कुटिलभ्रूपशोभितम् ॥
करालवदनं चैव आजानुकरलंबितम् ॥ 12 ॥
2.2.m: accompanied by the Ancestors and Vaiśvānara, graced with curved eyebrows, / with a dreadful visage, and his hands hanging down to his knees.

2.2.s:
mūrdhanyagniṃ samāviśya mukhe vāyuḥ samāhitaḥ ..
pṛthvīdharoryamā caiva tathāṣṭavaneṣṭitau .. 13 ..
2.2.d:
मूर्धन्यग्निं समाविश्य मुखे वायुः समाहितः ॥
पृथ्वीधरोर्यमा चैव तथाष्टवनेष्टितौ ॥ 13 ॥
2.2.m: Having entered with Fire in the head, Wind is concentrated in the mouth; / Pṛthvīdhara and Aryaman are both established in the eight woods.

2.2.s:
vakṣasthale 'parāṃ saṃdhyāṃ yajeccaiva yathāvidhi ..
netrayorditiparjanyau śrotre ditījyaputrakau .. 14 ..
2.2.d:
वक्षस्थले ऽपरां संध्यां यजेच्चैव यथाविधि ॥
नेत्रयोर्दितिपर्जन्यौ श्रोत्रे दितीज्यपुत्रकौ ॥ 14 ॥
2.2.m: Upon the chest one should worship the evening twilight according to rule; / in the eyes are Diti and Parjanya, and in the ears are Diti and the son of Ījya.

2.2.s:
sarpendrāvāsanasthau ca vāme dakṣaṃ vibhāvayet ..
satyasomāgnayastatra rāhoḥ paṃca ca paṃca ca .. 15 ..
2.2.d:
सर्पेन्द्रावासनस्थौ च वामे दक्षं विभावयेत् ॥
सत्यसोमाग्नयस्तत्र राहोः पंच च पंच च ॥ 15 ॥
2.2.m: The two serpent-kings are on his seat, and one should contemplate Dakṣa on the left; / Satya, Soma, and the fires are there, and five and five of Rāhu.

2.2.s:
rudraśca rājayakṣmā ca vāmahaste vyavasthitau ..
pārśve tu dakṣiṇe tadvadvirathaśca maharkṣakaḥ.. 16 ..
2.2.d:
रुद्रश्च राजयक्ष्मा च वामहस्ते व्यवस्थितौ ॥
पार्श्वे तु दक्षिणे तद्वद्विरथश्च महर्क्षकः॥ 16 ॥
2.2.m: Rudra and Rājayakṣman are situated in the left hand; / on the right side likewise are Viratha and Maharkṣaka.

2.2.s:
ubhau jñeyau tathā jānvorubhau gandharvapuṣpakau ..
jaṃghayorbhṛṃgasugrīvau sphicordauvāriko gaṇaḥ .. 17 ..
2.2.d:
उभौ ज्ञेयौ तथा जान्वोरुभौ गन्धर्वपुष्पकौ ॥
जंघयोर्भृंगसुग्रीवौ स्फिचोर्दौवारिको गणः ॥ 17 ॥
2.2.m: Both Gandharva and Puṣpaka are to be known on both knees; / Bhṛṅga and Sugrīva are on the shanks, and the Dauvārika troop is on the buttocks.

2.2.s:
jayaśakrau tathā meḍhre padayoḥ pitarastathā ..
evaṃ dhyātvā nyasetpuṣpaṃ some naivaṃ viciṃtayet .. 18 ..
2.2.d:
जयशक्रौ तथा मेढ्रे पदयोः पितरस्तथा ॥
एवं ध्यात्वा न्यसेत्पुष्पं सोमे नैवं विचिंतयेत् ॥ 18 ॥
2.2.m: Jaya and Śakra are on the penis, and the Ancestors are on the feet. / Having meditated thus, one should deposit a flower; on Soma one should not contemplate thus.

2.2.s:
mandaraṃ dīrghayuktena ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret..
tāvadvīryaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā praṇavaṃ brahmaṇeti ca .. 19 ..
2.2.d:
मन्दरं दीर्घयुक्तेन षडङ्गानि समाचरेत्॥
तावद्वीर्यं ततः कृत्वा प्रणवं ब्रह्मणेति च ॥ 19 ॥
2.2.m: One should perform the six bodily limbs using Mandara with a long [vowel]. / Then, having generated that power, with the praṇava and 'brahmaṇe',

2.2.s:
vāstvīśāya vidmaheti tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayāt ..
anena snapanaṃ kuryātpūjādravyāṇi prokṣayet .. 2.2.11.20 ..
2.2.d:
वास्त्वीशाय विद्महेति तन्नो विष्णुः प्रचोदयात् ॥
अनेन स्नपनं कुर्यात्पूजाद्रव्याणि प्रोक्षयेत् ॥ 2.2.11.20 ॥
2.2.m: [saying:] 'We contemplate the Lord of the Site; may that Viṣṇu inspire us'— / with this one should perform the bathing and sprinkle the articles of worship.

2.2.s:
āsanaṃ pūjayetpūrvaṃ dharmeṇāpi svaśaktitaḥ ..
ādau tu bhāskaraṃ sūryaṃ śacīnāthaṃ gaṇādhipam .. 21 ..
2.2.d:
आसनं पूजयेत्पूर्वं धर्मेणापि स्वशक्तितः ॥
आदौ तु भास्करं सूर्यं शचीनाथं गणाधिपम् ॥ 21 ॥
2.2.m: First one should worship the seat with righteousness according to one's ability: / at first, Bhāskara, Sūrya, the lord of Śacī, and the lord of the Gaṇas;

2.2.s:
ādhāraśaktiṃ pṛthivīṃ pūjayettatra paṅkajam ..
baṃdīśāsanamityuktaṃ pūjayedāsanaṃ tataḥ .. 22 ..
2.2.d:
आधारशक्तिं पृथिवीं पूजयेत्तत्र पङ्कजम् ॥
बंदीशासनमित्युक्तं पूजयेदासनं ततः ॥ 22 ॥
2.2.m: one should worship the support-power, the Earth, and the lotus there. / This is declared as the seat of Bandīśa; then one should worship the seat.

2.2.s:
sitacandanayuktena śvetapuṣpaṃ pragṛhya ca ..
harerdhyānaṃ tataḥ kuryātsthāpayenmadhyamaṇḍale ..23..
2.2.d:
सितचन्दनयुक्तेन श्वेतपुष्पं प्रगृह्य च ॥
हरेर्ध्यानं ततः कुर्यात्स्थापयेन्मध्यमण्डले ॥23॥
2.2.m: Taking a white flower anointed with white sandalwood, / one should then perform meditation on Hari and establish him in the central mandala.

2.2.s:
āvāhya cāsanaṃ dadyāttataḥ pādyādikatrayam ..
madhuparkaṃ tato dadyādvāstoṣpatimatheśvaram .. 24 ..
2.2.d:
आवाह्य चासनं दद्यात्ततः पाद्यादिकत्रयम् ॥
मधुपर्कं ततो दद्याद्वास्तोष्पतिमथेश्वरम् ॥ 24 ॥
2.2.m: Having invoked him, one should offer the seat, and then the triad beginning with water for the feet; / then one should offer the honey-mixture, and then to Vāstoṣpati, the sovereign Lord.

2.2.s:
asya mantrasya ca ṛṣiśchando gāyatramīritam ..
devatā ca bhavedbrahmā yojayedaśvamedhakam .. 25 ..
2.2.d:
अस्य मन्त्रस्य च ऋषिश्छन्दो गायत्रमीरितम् ॥
देवता च भवेद्ब्रह्मा योजयेदश्वमेधकम् ॥ 25 ॥
2.2.m: Of this mantra, the seer and meter are declared to be Gāyatra; / and the deity is Brahmā; one should employ it in the horse-sacrifice.

2.2.s:
maṃdaraṃ vijayaṃ somaṃ mahādevaṃ ca mādhavam ..
rudraṃ haraṃ jayaṃ bhaṃ ca pūrvādidalamūlake .. 26 ..
2.2.d:
मंदरं विजयं सोमं महादेवं च माधवम् ॥
रुद्रं हरं जयं भं च पूर्वादिदलमूलके ॥ 26 ॥
