2.2.m: Mandara, Vijaya, Soma, Mahādeva, and Mādhava, / Rudra, Hara, Jaya, and Bha, at the base of the petals beginning with the east;

2.2.s:
jayā ca vijayā caiva satyā māyā śivāṃbikā ..
hāsinī kāminī caitā dalamūleṣu bhāvayet .. 27 .
2.2.d:
जया च विजया चैव सत्या माया शिवांबिका ॥
हासिनी कामिनी चैता दलमूलेषु भावयेत् ॥ 27 ।
2.2.m: and Jayā, Vijayā, Satyā, Māyā, Śivā, Ambikā, / Hāsinī, and Kāminī—one should contemplate these at the bases of the petals.

2.2.s:
puṣpāñjalitrayaṃ dadyādvāstoṣpataya ityapi ..
arghyamaṃtreṇa gaṃdhādyaiḥ pūjayedbhūtimicchatā ..28..
2.2.d:
पुष्पाञ्जलित्रयं दद्याद्वास्तोष्पतय इत्यपि ॥
अर्घ्यमंत्रेण गंधाद्यैः पूजयेद्भूतिमिच्छता ॥28॥
2.2.m: One who desires prosperity should offer three double handfuls of flowers [with the mantra] 'to Vāstoṣpati', / and worship with perfumes and the like using the guest-offering mantra.

2.2.s:
vāstoṣpate bhava mate iti dhyātvā ṛtaṃ ceti maṃtreṇa pūjayet ..
ṛṣirnārāyaṇaśchando gāyatrī parikīrtitam .. 29 ..
2.2.d:
वास्तोष्पते भव मते इति ध्यात्वा ऋतं चेति मंत्रेण पूजयेत् ॥
ऋषिर्नारायणश्छन्दो गायत्री परिकीर्तितम् ॥ 29 ॥
2.2.m: Having meditated with 'vāstoṣpate bhava mate', one should worship with the mantra 'ṛtaṃ ca'. / The seer is Nārāyaṇa, and the meter is proclaimed as gāyatrī.

2.2.s:
sūryaśca devatā khyātaḥ prīṇitaḥ kuliśāyudhaḥ ..
sūryaṃ raktāsanārūḍhaṃ dvibhujaṃ raktavāsasam .. 2.2.11.30 ..
2.2.d:
सूर्यश्च देवता ख्यातः प्रीणितः कुलिशायुधः ॥
सूर्यं रक्तासनारूढं द्विभुजं रक्तवाससम् ॥ 2.2.11.30 ॥
2.2.m: And Sūrya is renowned as the deity, gratified, holding the thunderbolt-weapon. / [Meditating on] Sūrya mounted on a red seat, two-armed, dressed in red garments,

2.2.s:
raktapadmadvayadharaṃ kuṃḍalādyaiḥ suśobhitam..
evaṃ dhyātvā tu matimānhaṃsaṃ samaṃtramīśvaram..31..
2.2.d:
रक्तपद्मद्वयधरं कुंडलाद्यैः सुशोभितम्॥
एवं ध्यात्वा तु मतिमान्हंसं समंत्रमीश्वरम्॥31॥
2.2.m: holding two red lotuses, beautifully adorned with earrings and other ornaments: / having meditated thus, the wise person [worships] the Lord Haṃsa with mantra.

2.2.s:
haṃsasya iti maṃtrasya ṛṣirautathya īritaḥ ..
paṃktiśchandaḥ svayaṃ devo viniyogastu prītaye ..32..
2.2.d:
हंसस्य इति मंत्रस्य ऋषिरौतथ्य ईरितः ॥
पंक्तिश्छन्दः स्वयं देवो विनियोगस्तु प्रीतये ॥32॥
2.2.m: Of the mantra 'haṃsasya', the seer is declared to be Autathya; / the meter is paṅkti, the god is himself [the deity], and the application is for [his] satisfaction.

2.2.s:
nīlotpaladvayadharaṃ satyaṃ mṛtyūparisthitam..
svacchaśvetāṃbaradharaṃ varadaṃ bhaktavatsalam ..33..
2.2.d:
नीलोत्पलद्वयधरं सत्यं मृत्यूपरिस्थितम्॥
स्वच्छश्वेतांबरधरं वरदं भक्तवत्सलम् ॥33॥
2.2.m: Holding two blue lotuses, truth-natured, standing upon Death, / wearing spotless white garments, granting boons, affectionate to his devotees,

2.2.s:
svaṃ madātvamiti mantreṇa śvetacandanapuṣpakaiḥ ..
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ ..34..
2.2.d:
स्वं मदात्वमिति मन्त्रेण श्वेतचन्दनपुष्पकैः ॥
पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या वस्त्रालंकारभूषणैः ॥34॥
2.2.m: with the mantra beginning *svaṃ madātvaṃ*, with white sandalwood and flowers, / one should worship [him] with supreme devotion, with garments, ornaments, and decorations.

2.2.s:
uddharṣaṇa iti maṃtreṇa kṛṣṇapuṣpairathārcayet ..
satyavrata ṛṣiścāsya triṣṭupchando'sya devatā ..
savitā caiva vijñeyaḥ prītaye ca vṛṣasya ca ..35..
2.2.d:
उद्धर्षण इति मंत्रेण कृष्णपुष्पैरथार्चयेत् ॥
सत्यव्रत ऋषिश्चास्य त्रिष्टुप्छन्दोऽस्य देवता ॥
सविता चैव विज्ञेयः प्रीतये च वृषस्य च ॥35॥
2.2.m: Then, with the mantra beginning *uddharṣaṇaḥ*, one should worship with black flowers; / its seer is Satyavrata, its metre is triṣṭubh, and its deity / is known as Savitṛ, for the pleasure of Vṛṣa.

2.2.s:
śulkavarṇaṃ tathākāśamṛṣṭisaṃghaiśca saṃstutam ..
ghaṭasthaṃ dvibhujaṃ dhyāyedgadāpadmavidhāriṇam ..36..
2.2.d:
शुल्कवर्णं तथाकाशमृष्टिसंघैश्च संस्तुतम् ॥
घटस्थं द्विभुजं ध्यायेद्गदापद्मविधारिणम् ॥36॥
2.2.m: White in colour, [namely] Ākāśa, praised by hosts of sages, / seated on a pot, two-armed, holding a mace and a lotus, one should meditate on him.

2.2.s:
śanno devīti paṭhanādgandhapuṣpādibhiryajet ..
ṛṣiḥ syātkardamo viprāśchando jāgatikā tathā ..
devatā ca bhaveccāgnirākāśaprītaye nyaset ..37..
2.2.d:
शन्नो देवीति पठनाद्गन्धपुष्पादिभिर्यजेत् ॥
ऋषिः स्यात्कर्दमो विप्राश्छन्दो जागतिका तथा ॥
देवता च भवेच्चाग्निराकाशप्रीतये न्यसेत् ॥37॥
2.2.m: By reciting *śan no devī*, one should worship [him] with fragrant perfumes, flowers, and the like; / the seer is Kardama, O brāhmaṇas, the metre is jagatī, / and the deity is Agni; one should assign it for the pleasure of Ākāśa.

2.2.s:
dhvajahastamahābāhuṃ marudbhiścopasevitam..
dvibhujaṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ ca vāyuṃ dhyātvā prapūjayet..38..
2.2.d:
ध्वजहस्तमहाबाहुं मरुद्भिश्चोपसेवितम्॥
द्विभुजं धूम्रवर्णं च वायुं ध्यात्वा प्रपूजयेत्॥38॥
2.2.m: Holding a banner in hand, mighty-armed, attended by the Maruts, / two-armed and smoke-coloured: having thus meditated on Vāyu, one should worship [him].

2.2.s:
rājāna iti mantreṇa pūjayetsitataṃḍulaiḥ..
ṛṣirnārāyaṇacchando gāyatrī devatā dvijāḥ..39..
2.2.d:
राजान इति मन्त्रेण पूजयेत्सिततंडुलैः॥
ऋषिर्नारायणच्छन्दो गायत्री देवता द्विजाः॥39॥
2.2.m: One should worship [him] with white unbroken rice grains using the mantra beginning *rājānaḥ*; / the seer is Nārāyaṇa, the metre is gāyatrī, [and] the deity, O twice-born ones,

2.2.s:
devatā ca bhavedvāyuḥ prītaye tasya yojayet ..
pūṣāraktaśca dvibhujo raktapadmāsanasthitaḥ ..2.2.11.40..
2.2.d:
देवता च भवेद्वायुः प्रीतये तस्य योजयेत् ॥
पूषारक्तश्च द्विभुजो रक्तपद्मासनस्थितः ॥2.2.11.40॥
2.2.m: is Vāyu; one should employ it for his pleasure. / And Pūṣan is red, two-armed, seated on a red lotus throne.

2.2.s:
rājāna iti ca ṛcā pūjayedgandhacandanaiḥ..
gobhilosya ṛṣiḥ paṅktiśchando'tha jagatī smṛtam ..
devatā ca bhavedvāyuḥ prītaye viniyojayet ..41..
2.2.d:
राजान इति च ऋचा पूजयेद्गन्धचन्दनैः॥
गोभिलोस्य ऋषिः पङ्क्तिश्छन्दोऽथ जगती स्मृतम् ॥
देवता च भवेद्वायुः प्रीतये विनियोजयेत् ॥41॥
2.2.m: And with the verse beginning *rājānaḥ*, one should worship [him] with perfumes and sandalwood; / its seer is Gobhila, the metre is recorded as paṅkti and jagatī, / and the deity is Vāyu; one should employ it for [his] pleasure.

2.2.s:
vitathaṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ ca caturbhirbāhubhirvṛtam..
mṛgākṣapāśakhaṭvāṅga śūlaṃ ca dadhataṃ karaiḥ ..
meṣārūḍhaṃ viśālākṣaṃ rājāno mahyamīrayan .. 42 ..
2.2.d:
वितथं श्यामवर्णं च चतुर्भिर्बाहुभिर्वृतम्॥
मृगाक्षपाशखट्वाङ्ग शूलं च दधतं करैः ॥
मेषारूढं विशालाक्षं राजानो मह्यमीरयन् ॥ 42 ॥
2.2.m: Vitatha, dark-coloured, endowed with four arms, / holding a deer's eye, a noose, a khaṭvāṅga, and a trident in his hands, / mounted on a ram, large-eyed: they recite *rājāno mahyam* [for him].

2.2.s:
gṛhakṣataṃ tathā śuklaṃ caturbhirgardabhairvṛtam ..
śūlaṃ daṃḍaṃ ca khaḍvāṃgaṃ dadhataṃ vṛṣavāhanam .. 43 ..
2.2.d:
गृहक्षतं तथा शुक्लं चतुर्भिर्गर्दभैर्वृतम् ॥
शूलं दंडं च खड्वांगं दधतं वृषवाहनम् ॥ 43 ॥
2.2.m: Likewise Gṛhakṣata, white, surrounded by four donkeys, / holding a trident, a staff, and a khaṭvāṅga, having a bull as his vehicle,

2.2.s:
pītavastradharaṃ devaṃ jaṭāmukuṭasaṃyutam ..
āśuḥ śiśāna iti mantreṇa pūjayedgandhacandanaiḥ .. 44 ..
2.2.d:
पीतवस्त्रधरं देवं जटामुकुटसंयुतम् ॥
आशुः शिशान इति मन्त्रेण पूजयेद्गन्धचन्दनैः ॥ 44 ॥
2.2.m: the god wearing yellow garments, adorned with a crown of matted hair, / one should worship with perfumes and sandalwood using the mantra beginning *āśuḥ śiśānaḥ*.

2.2.s:
puṣpadaṃta ṛṣistriṣṭupchandaśca parikīrtitam ..
īśvarasya devatāyā prītaye viniyojayet .. 45 ..
2.2.d:
पुष्पदंत ऋषिस्त्रिष्टुप्छन्दश्च परिकीर्तितम् ॥
ईश्वरस्य देवताया प्रीतये विनियोजयेत् ॥ 45 ॥
2.2.m: Puṣpadanta is the seer, and the metre is proclaimed as triṣṭubh; / one should employ it for the pleasure of the deity Īśvara.

2.2.s:
yamaṃ dhyāyetkṛṣṇavarṇaṃ mahiṣasthaṃ dvibāhukam ..
daṇḍapāśadharaṃ caiva keyūrādyairvibhūṣitam.. 46 ..
2.2.d:
यमं ध्यायेत्कृष्णवर्णं महिषस्थं द्विबाहुकम् ॥
दण्डपाशधरं चैव केयूराद्यैर्विभूषितम्॥ 46 ॥
2.2.m: One should meditate on Yama, dark-coloured, seated on a buffalo, two-armed, / holding a staff and a noose, and adorned with armlets and other ornaments.

2.2.s:
īśāneti ca mantreṇa pūjayetkusumādinā ..
vāmadeva ṛṣiḥ paṃktiśchandaḥ kālosya devatā .. 47 ..
2.2.d:
ईशानेति च मन्त्रेण पूजयेत्कुसुमादिना ॥
वामदेव ऋषिः पंक्तिश्छन्दः कालोस्य देवता ॥ 47 ॥
2.2.m: And with the mantra beginning *īśāna*, one should worship [him] with flowers and other offerings; / Vāmadeva is the seer, the metre is paṅkti, and Kāla is his deity.

2.2.s:
ṣaḍānanaṃ ca gandharvaṃ pītaṃ dhyāyeccaturbhujam ..
pītāṃbaradharaṃ caiva nānābharaṇabhūṣitam .. 48 ..
2.2.d:
षडाननं च गन्धर्वं पीतं ध्यायेच्चतुर्भुजम् ॥
पीतांबरधरं चैव नानाभरणभूषितम् ॥ 48 ॥
2.2.m: And one should meditate on Gandharva as six-faced, yellow, four-armed, / wearing yellow garments, and adorned with various ornaments.

2.2.s:
yaddeva iti mantreṇa pūjayetkusumādinā ..
hārītosya ṛṣiḥ prokto jagatīchanda īritam ..
hiraṇyagarbho devatāsya prītaye viniyojayet .. 49 ..
2.2.d:
यद्देव इति मन्त्रेण पूजयेत्कुसुमादिना ॥
हारीतोस्य ऋषिः प्रोक्तो जगतीछन्द ईरितम् ॥
हिरण्यगर्भो देवतास्य प्रीतये विनियोजयेत् ॥ 49 ॥
2.2.m: One should worship [him] with flowers and the like using the mantra beginning *yad deva*; / Hārīta is declared to be his seer, the metre is proclaimed as jagatī, / and Hiraṇyagarbha is his deity; one should employ it for his pleasure.

2.2.s:
bhṛṅgarājaṃ jaṭārūḍhaṃ svacchaṃ pītāṃbaraṃ śubham ..
cakṣuḥ pīteti mantreṇa pūjayedgandhacaṃdanaiḥ .. 2.2.11.50 ..
2.2.d:
भृङ्गराजं जटारूढं स्वच्छं पीतांबरं शुभम् ॥
चक्षुः पीतेति मन्त्रेण पूजयेद्गन्धचंदनैः ॥ 2.2.11.50 ॥
2.2.m: Bhṛṅgarāja, wearing matted hair, pure, dressed in auspicious yellow garments, / one should worship with perfumes and sandalwood using the mantra beginning *cakṣuḥ pītā*.

2.2.s:
ṛṣiścāgastirākhyātastriṣṭupchandaḥ prakīrtitam ..
viśvedevā devatā ca bhṛṅgarājasya prītaye .. 51 ..
2.2.d:
ऋषिश्चागस्तिराख्यातस्त्रिष्टुप्छन्दः प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
विश्वेदेवा देवता च भृङ्गराजस्य प्रीतये ॥ 51 ॥
2.2.m: Agasti is proclaimed as the seer, the metre is stated as triṣṭubh, / and the Viśvedevas are the deity, for the pleasure of Bhṛṅgarāja.

2.2.s:
pītaṃ mṛgaṃ mṛgārūḍhaṃ jaṭāmukuṭamaṃḍitam ..
paro devā iti maṃtreṇa pūjayedbalipāyasaiḥ .. 52 ..
2.2.d:
पीतं मृगं मृगारूढं जटामुकुटमंडितम् ॥
परो देवा इति मंत्रेण पूजयेद्बलिपायसैः ॥ 52 ॥
2.2.m: Mṛga is yellow, mounted on a deer, adorned with a crown of matted hair; / one should worship [him] with offerings and milk-rice using the mantra beginning *paro devāḥ*.

2.2.s:
kapilaśca ṛṣiḥ prokto gāyatrī chanda īritam ..
varuṇo devatā cāsya prītaye viniyojayet .. 53 ..
2.2.d:
कपिलश्च ऋषिः प्रोक्तो गायत्री छन्द ईरितम् ॥
वरुणो देवता चास्य प्रीतये विनियोजयेत् ॥ 53 ॥
2.2.m: And Kapila is declared to be the seer, the metre is proclaimed as gāyatrī, / and Varuṇa is his deity; one should employ it for his pleasure.

2.2.s:
dhyāyetpitṛgaṇaṃ śukraṃ caturbhirbāhubhirvṛtam ..
pitṛbhya iti mantreṇa pūjayetkusumādinā .. 54 ..
2.2.d:
ध्यायेत्पितृगणं शुक्रं चतुर्भिर्बाहुभिर्वृतम् ॥
पितृभ्य इति मन्त्रेण पूजयेत्कुसुमादिना ॥ 54 ॥
2.2.m: One should meditate on the host of ancestors as bright, endowed with four arms; / one should worship [them] with flowers and the like using the mantra beginning *pitṛbhyaḥ*.

2.2.s:
śunaḥśepa ṛṣiścāsya triṣṭupchandaśca devatā ..
viśvedevāḥ samākhyātāḥ pitṛmedhena pūjayet .. 55 ..
2.2.d:
शुनःशेप ऋषिश्चास्य त्रिष्टुप्छन्दश्च देवता ॥
विश्वेदेवाः समाख्याताः पितृमेधेन पूजयेत् ॥ 55 ॥
2.2.m: Śunaḥśepa is its seer, the metre is triṣṭubh, and the deity / is declared to be the Viśvedevas; one should worship [them] with an ancestral offering.

2.2.s:
dauvārikaṃ cāṣṭabhujaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ vicintayet ..
raktavastrapiṃgalākṣaṃ kṛṣṇavyāghropari sthitam .. 56 ..
2.2.d:
दौवारिकं चाष्टभुजं कृष्णवर्णं विचिन्तयेत् ॥
रक्तवस्त्रपिंगलाक्षं कृष्णव्याघ्रोपरि स्थितम् ॥ 56 ॥
2.2.m: And one should contemplate Dauvārika as eight-armed, dark-coloured, / wearing red garments, with reddish-brown eyes, standing upon a black tiger.

2.2.s: yo naḥ piteti mantreṇa pūjayedbhaktitatparaḥ .. 57 ..
2.2.d: यो नः पितेति मन्त्रेण पूजयेद्भक्तितत्परः ॥ 57 ॥
2.2.m: Intent on devotion, one should worship [him] with the mantra beginning *yo naḥ pitā*.

2.2.s:
vaiśvānara ṛṣiścāsya gāyatrī chanda īritam ..
devatā ca bhavecchaktirviniyogaśca pūjane .. 58 ..
2.2.d:
वैश्वानर ऋषिश्चास्य गायत्री छन्द ईरितम् ॥
देवता च भवेच्छक्तिर्विनियोगश्च पूजने ॥ 58 ॥
2.2.m: And Vaiśvānara is its seer, the metre is proclaimed as gāyatrī, / the deity is Śakti, and the ritual application is in worship.

2.2.s:
śaṃkhābhaṃ caiva sugrīvaṃ dvibhujaṃ cakradhāriṇam ..
haṃsārūḍhaṃ mahākāyaṃ balivijñānakāraṇam .. 59 ..
2.2.d:
शंखाभं चैव सुग्रीवं द्विभुजं चक्रधारिणम् ॥
हंसारूढं महाकायं बलिविज्ञानकारणम् ॥ 59 ॥
2.2.m: And Sugrīva is radiant like a conch, two-armed, holding a discus, / mounted on a swan, large-bodied, the cause of knowing the offerings.

2.2.s:
śaṃkhapadmadharaṃ caiva mahiṣasthaṃ vicintayet..
sa iṣu hasteti maṃtreṇa pūjayedraktabhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 2.2.11.60 ..
2.2.d:
शंखपद्मधरं चैव महिषस्थं विचिन्तयेत्॥
स इषु हस्तेति मंत्रेण पूजयेद्रक्तभूषणैः ॥ 2.2.11.60 ॥
2.2.m: Holding a conch and a lotus, one should contemplate [him] seated on a buffalo; / one should worship [him] with red ornaments using the mantra beginning *sa iṣuhastaḥ*.

2.2.s:
ṛṣiḥ śaṃkhastathācchandaḥ paṅktiḥ somo'tha devatā ..
śvetaṃ jalādhipaṃ dhyāyedgandharvādyaiśca veṣṭitam .. 61 ..
2.2.d:
ऋषिः शंखस्तथाच्छन्दः पङ्क्तिः सोमोऽथ देवता ॥
श्वेतं जलाधिपं ध्यायेद्गन्धर्वाद्यैश्च वेष्टितम् ॥ 61 ॥
2.2.m: The seer is Śaṅkha, the metre is paṅkti, and Soma is the deity; / one should meditate on the Lord of Waters as white, surrounded by Gandharvas and others.

2.2.s:
ṛṣyāsanagataṃ dhyāyecchvetagandhena carcayet ..
bṛhaspate paridīyā iti maṃtreṇa bhaktitaḥ .. 62 ..
2.2.d:
ऋष्यासनगतं ध्यायेच्छ्वेतगन्धेन चर्चयेत् ॥
बृहस्पते परिदीया इति मंत्रेण भक्तितः ॥ 62 ॥
2.2.m: One should meditate on him seated on the seat of the sages and worship him with white perfume / with devotion, using the mantra beginning *bṛhaspate paridīyāḥ*.

2.2.s:
tryaṃbako'sya ṛṣistriṣṭupchando devo jalādhipaḥ ..
dhyāyecca asuraṃ raktaṃ karālaṃ naravāhanam .. 63 ..
2.2.d:
त्र्यंबकोऽस्य ऋषिस्त्रिष्टुप्छन्दो देवो जलाधिपः ॥
ध्यायेच्च असुरं रक्तं करालं नरवाहनम् ॥ 63 ॥
2.2.m: Tryambaka is his seer, the metre is triṣṭubh, and the god is the Lord of Waters. / And one should meditate on Asura as red, terrible, having a human being as his vehicle,

2.2.s:
daśabhirbāhubhiryuktaṃ kṛṣṇavastrānulepanam ..
śanno devīti maṃtreṇa kṛṣṇapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet.. 64 ..
2.2.d:
दशभिर्बाहुभिर्युक्तं कृष्णवस्त्रानुलेपनम् ॥
शन्नो देवीति मंत्रेण कृष्णपुष्पैः प्रपूजयेत्॥ 64 ॥
2.2.m: endowed with ten arms, with black garments and ointment; / one should worship [him] with black flowers using the mantra beginning *śan no devī*.

2.2.s:
ṛṣirvaiśvānaraśchando virāḍityabhidhīyate..
vaiśvānarottaro devaḥ prītaye tasya yojayet .. 65..
2.2.d:
ऋषिर्वैश्वानरश्छन्दो विराडित्यभिधीयते॥
वैश्वानरोत्तरो देवः प्रीतये तस्य योजयेत् ॥ 65॥
2.2.m: The seer is Vaiśvānara, and the metre is named virāj; / the god is Vaiśvānarottara; one should employ it for his pleasure.

2.2.s:
śeṣaṃ ṣaḍānanaṃ dhyāyetkṛṣṇaṃ ca madhupiṃgalam ..
meṣasthaṃ kuṇḍalopetaṃ nāgayajñopavītinam ..
udvarṣa iti mantreṇa pūjayedbhūtimicchatā .. 66..
2.2.d:
शेषं षडाननं ध्यायेत्कृष्णं च मधुपिंगलम् ॥
मेषस्थं कुण्डलोपेतं नागयज्ञोपवीतिनम् ॥
उद्वर्ष इति मन्त्रेण पूजयेद्भूतिमिच्छता ॥ 66॥
2.2.m: One should meditate on Śeṣa as six-faced, dark, honey-brown, / mounted on a ram, wearing earrings, wearing a serpent as a sacred thread; / he who desires prosperity should worship [him] with the mantra beginning *ud varṣa*.

2.2.s:
pāpaṃ raktaṃ trinetraṃ ca raktaṃ prānte vicintayet ..
raktaśmaśrudharaṃ caiva varahastaṃ vicintayet .. 67..
2.2.d:
पापं रक्तं त्रिनेत्रं च रक्तं प्रान्ते विचिन्तयेत् ॥
रक्तश्मश्रुधरं चैव वरहस्तं विचिन्तयेत् ॥ 67॥
2.2.m: One should contemplate Pāpa as red and three-eyed, red at the perimeter, / bearing a red beard, with a hand granting boons.

2.2.s:
siddho vīreti mantreṇa kṛṣṇapuṣpairathārcayet..
yamaṃ ca kṛkarākṣaṃ ca ākuñcanmūrdhaje dvijāḥ..68..
2.2.d:
सिद्धो वीरेति मन्त्रेण कृष्णपुष्पैरथार्चयेत्॥
यमं च कृकराक्षं च आकुञ्चन्मूर्धजे द्विजाः॥68॥
2.2.m: With the mantra beginning *siddho vīraḥ*, one should worship with black flowers / Yama, with eyes like a kṛkara bird and curled hair, O twice-born ones.

2.2.s:
kapilo'sya ṛṣiśchando'nuṣṭup caiva prakīrtitam ..
devatā ca yaśaḥ khyātaṃ prītaye viniyojayet .. 69 ..
2.2.d:
कपिलोऽस्य ऋषिश्छन्दोऽनुष्टुप् चैव प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
देवता च यशः ख्यातं प्रीतये विनियोजयेत् ॥ 69 ॥
2.2.m: Kapila is his seer, and the metre is proclaimed as anuṣṭubh; / the deity is celebrated as Yaśas; one should employ it for [his] pleasure.

2.2.s:
yamaṃ ca kṛkarākṣaṃ ca kṣamākuñcitamūrdhajam .. ..
kharasthaṃ dvibhujaṃ dhyāyedimaṃ mantramudīrayet .. 2.2.11.70 ..
2.2.d:
यमं च कृकराक्षं च क्षमाकुञ्चितमूर्धजम् ॥ ॥
खरस्थं द्विभुजं ध्यायेदिमं मन्त्रमुदीरयेत् ॥ 2.2.11.70 ॥
2.2.m: Yama, with eyes like a kṛkara bird, with hair gently curled, / mounted on a donkey, two-armed, one should meditate upon [him and] recite this mantra:

2.2.s:
vāsukiḥ syādṛṣiścāsya paṃktiśchandaśca devatā ..
hiraṇyagarbha ityuktaḥ prītaye'sya niyojayet .. 71 ..
2.2.d:
वासुकिः स्यादृषिश्चास्य पंक्तिश्छन्दश्च देवता ॥
हिरण्यगर्भ इत्युक्तः प्रीतयेऽस्य नियोजयेत् ॥ 71 ॥
2.2.m: Vāsuki is his seer, the metre is paṅkti, and the deity / is declared to be Hiraṇyagarbha; one should employ it for his pleasure.

2.2.s:
ardhapītaṃ ca dvibhujaṃ raktākṣaṃ dhūmrameva vā ..
devatābhiśca saṃpannaṃ vāto vāretireva ca .. 72 ..
2.2.d:
अर्धपीतं च द्विभुजं रक्ताक्षं धूम्रमेव वा ॥
देवताभिश्च संपन्नं वातो वारेतिरेव च ॥ 72 ॥
2.2.m: Half-yellow and two-armed, red-eyed or smoke-coloured, / endowed with divine qualities, and [addressed by the mantra] *vāto vā*.

2.2.s: ṛṣirvāyuśca gāyatrī chando vāyuśca devatā .. 73 ..
2.2.d: ऋषिर्वायुश्च गायत्री छन्दो वायुश्च देवता ॥ 73 ॥
2.2.m: The seer is Vāyu, the metre is gāyatrī, and the deity is Vāyu.

2.2.s:
mugdharaktaṃ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ tathā ..
pītavastraṃ pannagasthaṃ hārakeyūramaṃḍitam .. 74 ..
2.2.d:
मुग्धरक्तं शंखचक्रगदापद्मधरं तथा ॥
पीतवस्त्रं पन्नगस्थं हारकेयूरमंडितम् ॥ 74 ॥
2.2.m: Charming and red, holding a conch, discus, mace, and lotus, / wearing yellow garments, seated on a serpent, adorned with necklaces and armlets.

2.2.s:
avasṛṣṭā parāpata iti mantreṇa pūjayet ..
agniścāsya ṛṣiḥ proktacchandaḥ somaśca devatā .. 75 ..
2.2.d:
अवसृष्टा परापत इति मन्त्रेण पूजयेत् ॥
अग्निश्चास्य ऋषिः प्रोक्तच्छन्दः सोमश्च देवता ॥ 75 ॥
2.2.m:
One should worship [him] with the mantra, “avasṛṣṭā parāpata”;
Agni is declared to be its sage, [the meter] a meter, and Soma the deity.

2.2.s:
pītaṃ bhallāṭakaṃ dhyāyetpadmasthaṃ raktabhūṣaṇam ..
dvibhujaṃ padmahastaṃ ca devamevaṃ vicintayet ..
yanmāturiti mantreṇa pūjayetsitataṃḍulaiḥ .. 76 ..
2.2.d:
पीतं भल्लाटकं ध्यायेत्पद्मस्थं रक्तभूषणम् ॥
द्विभुजं पद्महस्तं च देवमेवं विचिन्तयेत् ॥
यन्मातुरिति मन्त्रेण पूजयेत्सिततंडुलैः ॥ 76 ॥

2.2.s:
jambhako'sya ṛṣiśchando gāyatrī samudāhṛtā ..
devatā ca bhavetkumbhaḥ prītaye viniyogataḥ .. .. 77 ..
2.2.d:
जम्भकोऽस्य ऋषिश्छन्दो गायत्री समुदाहृता ॥
देवता च भवेत्कुम्भः प्रीतये विनियोगतः ॥ ॥ 77 ॥
2.2.m:
Jambhaka is its sage, the meter is declared to be Gāyatrī,
and Kumbha is the deity, for [his] pleasure through application.

2.2.s:
somaṃ dhyāyecchyāmarūpaṃ padmāsanagataṃ param ..
nānābharaṇasampannaṃ kirīṭavaradhāriṇam ..
marmāṇiteti mantreṇa gandhādyairapi pūjayet .. 78 ..
2.2.d:
सोमं ध्यायेच्छ्यामरूपं पद्मासनगतं परम् ॥
नानाभरणसम्पन्नं किरीटवरधारिणम् ॥
मर्माणितेति मन्त्रेण गन्धाद्यैरपि पूजयेत् ॥ 78 ॥
2.2.m:
One should meditate upon the supreme Soma, of dark form, seated on a lotus posture,
endowed with various ornaments, wearing an excellent diadem.
One should also worship [him] with perfumes and other offerings using the mantra, “marmāṇi te”.

2.2.s:
ṛṣiḥ svārtho vedaśchando jagatītyabhidhīyate ..
devatā ca bhavetsomaḥ prīyate viniyojayet .. 79 ..
2.2.d:
ऋषिः स्वार्थो वेदश्छन्दो जगतीत्यभिधीयते ॥
देवता च भवेत्सोमः प्रीयते विनियोजयेत् ॥ 79 ॥
2.2.m:
The sage is Svārtha, the meter is said to be Veda-Jagatī,
and Soma is the deity; one should apply [it] so that he is pleased.

2.2.s:
darpaṃ dhyāyetkṛṣṇavarṇaṃ kṛṣṇāṃbaradharaṃ tathā ..
nāgayajñopavītiṃ ca śikhistaṃbhaṃ dvijottamāḥ .. 2.2.11.80 ..
2.2.d:
दर्पं ध्यायेत्कृष्णवर्णं कृष्णांबरधरं तथा ॥
नागयज्ञोपवीतिं च शिखिस्तंभं द्विजोत्तमाः ॥ 2.2.11.80 ॥
2.2.m:
One should meditate upon Darpa, of black colour, wearing black garments,
having a serpent as his sacred thread, and [resembling] a post of fire, O best of the twice-born.

2.2.s: paścadīśeti mantreṇa gandhādyaiḥ paripūjayet .. 81 ..
2.2.d: पश्चदीशेति मन्त्रेण गन्धाद्यैः परिपूजयेत् ॥ 81 ॥
2.2.m: One should worship [him] with perfumes and other offerings using the mantra, “paścadīśa”.

2.2.s:
mantraścāsya ṛṣiścāsya pañcāyata namīritam ..
paṃktiśchandastathā proktaṃ devaḥ pañcānanaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 82 ..
2.2.d:
मन्त्रश्चास्य ऋषिश्चास्य पञ्चायत नमीरितम् ॥
पंक्तिश्छन्दस्तथा प्रोक्तं देवः पञ्चाननः स्मृतः ॥ 82 ॥
2.2.m:
The mantra and its sage: “pañcāyatanama” is declared [as the sage];
Paṅkti is stated as the meter, and the five-faced god [Śiva] is remembered [as the deity].

2.2.s:
śyāmavarṇāṃ ditiṃ dhyāyeddvibhujāṃ pītavigrahām ..
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannāṃ sarvālaṃkāraśobhitām .. 83 ..
2.2.d:
श्यामवर्णां दितिं ध्यायेद्द्विभुजां पीतविग्रहाम् ॥
सर्वलक्षणसंपन्नां सर्वालंकारशोभिताम् ॥ 83 ॥
2.2.m:
One should meditate upon Diti, of dark colour, two-armed, with a yellow body,
endowed with all auspicious marks, adorned with all ornaments.

2.2.s: suparṇo'sīti mantreṇa pūjayetpītacandanaiḥ .. 84 ..
2.2.d: सुपर्णोऽसीति मन्त्रेण पूजयेत्पीतचन्दनैः ॥ 84 ॥
2.2.m: One should worship [her] with yellow sandalwood using the mantra, “suparṇo 'si”.

2.2.s:
ṛṣirnārāyaṇaśchando jagatī parikīrtyate ..
bhaveddevo bhārgavaśca iṣṭārthe paripūjayet .. 85 ..
2.2.d:
ऋषिर्नारायणश्छन्दो जगती परिकीर्त्यते ॥
भवेद्देवो भार्गवश्च इष्टार्थे परिपूजयेत् ॥ 85 ॥
2.2.m:
Nārāyaṇa is proclaimed as the sage, Jagatī as the meter;
the god would be Bhārgava; one should worship for the desired objective.

2.2.s:
raktābhāmaditiṃ dhyāyetsarvālaṃkārabhūṣitām ..
śukrāṃbhāritimantreṇa gandhādyairabhipūjayet .. 86 ..
2.2.d:
रक्ताभामदितिं ध्यायेत्सर्वालंकारभूषिताम् ॥
शुक्रांभारितिमन्त्रेण गन्धाद्यैरभिपूजयेत् ॥ 86 ॥
2.2.m:
One should meditate upon Aditi, of red lustre, adorned with all ornaments;
one should worship [her] with perfumes and other offerings using the mantra, “śukrāṃbhāra”.

2.2.s:
vāmadeva ṛṣiścāsya gandhādyairabhipūjayet .
devaḥ śukraḥ samākhyātaḥ stutau ca viniyojayet . . 87
2.2.d:
वामदेव ऋषिश्चास्य गन्धाद्यैरभिपूजयेत् ।
देवः शुक्रः समाख्यातः स्तुतौ च विनियोजयेत् ॥ 87
2.2.m:
Vāmadeva is its sage; one should worship with perfumes and other offerings;
Śukra is declared as the deity, and one should employ [it] in praise.

2.2.s:
īśānādikoṇagatānpūjayetsusamāhitaḥ .
āpaṃ dhyāyecchuklavarṇaṃ kuṇḍalādyairvibhūṣitam . . 88
2.2.d:
ईशानादिकोणगतान्पूजयेत्सुसमाहितः ।
आपं ध्यायेच्छुक्लवर्णं कुण्डलाद्यैर्विभूषितम् ॥ 88
2.2.m:
Well-composed, one should worship those stationed in the north-east and other corners.
One should meditate upon Āpa, white in colour, adorned with earrings and other ornaments.

2.2.s: idaṃ viṣṇuriti mantreṇa trigandhena samarcayet . . 89
2.2.d: इदं विष्णुरिति मन्त्रेण त्रिगन्धेन समर्चयेत् ॥ 89
2.2.m: One should worship [him] with triple-perfume using the mantra, “idaṃ viṣṇuḥ”.

2.2.s: ṛṣiḥ syātkardamaśchando virāḍityabhidhīyate . . 2.2.11.90
2.2.d: ऋषिः स्यात्कर्दमश्छन्दो विराडित्यभिधीयते ॥ 2.2.11.90
2.2.m: Kardama would be the sage; the meter is designated as Virāj.

2.2.s:
devaḥ somaḥ samākhyātaḥ prītaye viniyojayet..
saritaṃ dvibhujaṃ raktaṃ raktaśvetāṃbarānvitam..91..
2.2.d:
देवः सोमः समाख्यातः प्रीतये विनियोजयेत्॥
सरितं द्विभुजं रक्तं रक्तश्वेतांबरान्वितम्॥91॥
2.2.m:
Soma is declared as the deity; one should employ [it] for [his] pleasure.
[One should meditate upon] Sarit: two-armed, red, endowed with red and white garments.

2.2.s: payasā śukla iti mantreṇa pūjayetkamalādinā .. 92 ..
2.2.d: पयसा शुक्ल इति मन्त्रेण पूजयेत्कमलादिना ॥ 92 ॥
2.2.m: One should worship with lotuses and other [flowers] using the mantra, “payasā śukla”.

2.2.s:
nārāyaṇa ṛṣiścāsya paṃktiśchandaḥ prakīrtyate ..
nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ devaḥ prītaye viniyojayet .. 93 ..
2.2.d:
नारायण ऋषिश्चास्य पंक्तिश्छन्दः प्रकीर्त्यते ॥
नारायणः स्वयं देवः प्रीतये विनियोजयेत् ॥ 93 ॥
2.2.m:
Nārāyaṇa is its sage, Paṅkti is proclaimed as the meter;
Nārāyaṇa himself is the deity; one should employ [it] for [his] pleasure.

2.2.s:
jayaṃ dhyāyetpītavarṇaṃ dvibhujaṃ varahastakam ..
devaṃ kirīṭasampannaṃ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitam .. 94 ..
2.2.d:
जयं ध्यायेत्पीतवर्णं द्विभुजं वरहस्तकम् ॥
देवं किरीटसम्पन्नं सर्वालंकारभूषितम् ॥ 94 ॥
2.2.m:
One should meditate upon Jaya, yellow in colour, two-armed, his hand [raised] in boon-bestowal,
the god endowed with a diadem, adorned with all ornaments.

2.2.s:
dṛṣṭvā pariśruta iti mantreṇānena pūjayet ..
ṛṣirnārāyaṇaśchandaḥ paṃktiḥ somo'tha devatā ..95..
2.2.d:
दृष्ट्वा परिश्रुत इति मन्त्रेणानेन पूजयेत् ॥
ऋषिर्नारायणश्छन्दः पंक्तिः सोमोऽथ देवता ॥95॥
2.2.m:
One should worship with this mantra, “dṛṣṭvā pariśrutaḥ”;
Nārāyaṇa is the sage, Paṅkti the meter, and Soma the deity.

2.2.s:
rudraṃ dhyāyedraktavarṇaṃ śītāṃśukṛtaśekharam..
dvibhujaṃ śūlahastaṃ ca ḍamaruṃ ca parābhavet ..96..
2.2.d:
रुद्रं ध्यायेद्रक्तवर्णं शीतांशुकृतशेखरम्॥
द्विभुजं शूलहस्तं च डमरुं च पराभवेत् ॥96॥
2.2.m:
One should meditate upon Rudra, red in colour, with the moon made into a crest-jewel,
two-armed, with a trident in hand, and the other [hand] should hold a ḍamaru drum.

2.2.s:
divo mūrdhanniti mantreṇa ṛṣayaḥ samudāhṛtāḥ..
ṛṣiḥ syātkāśyapaśchando virāḍityabhidhīyate ..97..
2.2.d:
दिवो मूर्धन्निति मन्त्रेण ऋषयः समुदाहृताः॥
ऋषिः स्यात्काश्यपश्छन्दो विराडित्यभिधीयते ॥97॥
2.2.m:
The sages are declared with the mantra, “divo mūrdhan”;
Kāśyapa would be the sage, and the meter is designated as Virāj.

2.2.s:
svayaṃ devo viniyogaḥ stutau ca viniyojayet ..
dvibhujaṃ raktapadmasya paṃkajadvayadhāriṇam .. 98 ..
2.2.d:
स्वयं देवो विनियोगः स्तुतौ च विनियोजयेत् ॥
द्विभुजं रक्तपद्मस्य पंकजद्वयधारिणम् ॥ 98 ॥
2.2.m:
The god is himself [the deity]; the application is: one should employ [it] in praise.
[One should meditate upon him as] two-armed, having a red lotus, holding two lotuses.

2.2.s:
asya kirīṭa iti mantreṇa raktasrakcandanādibhiḥ ..
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā ṛṣirnīla udāhṛtaḥ ..
triṣṭupchando devatā syāddhradopi parikīrtitaḥ .. 99 ..
2.2.d:
अस्य किरीट इति मन्त्रेण रक्तस्रक्चन्दनादिभिः ॥
पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या ऋषिर्नील उदाहृतः ॥
त्रिष्टुप्छन्दो देवता स्याद्ध्रदोपि परिकीर्तितः ॥ 99 ॥

2.2.s:
savitāraṃ tathā dhyāyetpadmasthaṃ dvibhujaprabhum..
nānābharaṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ saptāśvarathamaṃḍitam .. 2.2.11.100 ..
2.2.d:
सवितारं तथा ध्यायेत्पद्मस्थं द्विभुजप्रभुम्॥
नानाभरणशोभाढ्यं सप्ताश्वरथमंडितम् ॥ 2.2.11.100 ॥
2.2.m:
Likewise, one should meditate upon the lord Savitṛ, stationed on a lotus, two-armed,
abounding in the beauty of various ornaments, gracing a chariot with seven horses.

2.2.s:
yaddevā iti mantreṇa gandhādyaiḥ paripūjayet ..
ṛṣirautathya ākhyātaḥ prītaye viniyojayet .. 101 ..
2.2.d:
यद्देवा इति मन्त्रेण गन्धाद्यैः परिपूजयेत् ॥
ऋषिरौतथ्य आख्यातः प्रीतये विनियोजयेत् ॥ 101 ॥
2.2.m:
One should worship with perfumes and other offerings using the mantra, “yaddevāḥ”;
Autathya is declared as the sage; one should employ [it] for [his] pleasure.

2.2.s:
dhyāyedraktaṃ vivasvantaṃ dvibhujaṃ padmavigraham..
avidyā iti mantreṇa pūjayedgandhacandanaiḥ .. 102 ..
2.2.d:
ध्यायेद्रक्तं विवस्वन्तं द्विभुजं पद्मविग्रहम्॥
अविद्या इति मन्त्रेण पूजयेद्गन्धचन्दनैः ॥ 102 ॥
2.2.m:
One should meditate upon the red Vivasvat, two-armed, having the form of a lotus;
one should worship with perfumes and sandalwood using the mantra, “avidyā”.

2.2.s:
ṛṣirgandhaḥ samākhyātastriṣṭupchandaśca īritam ..
devatā ca bhavetsomaḥ stutau ca viniyojayet .. 103 ..
2.2.d:
ऋषिर्गन्धः समाख्यातस्त्रिष्टुप्छन्दश्च ईरितम् ॥
देवता च भवेत्सोमः स्तुतौ च विनियोजयेत् ॥ 103 ॥
2.2.m:
Gandha is declared as the sage, and Triṣṭubh is stated as the meter;
Soma would be the deity, and one should employ [it] in praise.

2.2.s:
vibudhādhipaṃ tato dhyāyetpītaṃ vṛṣabhavāhanam ..
caturbhujaṃ yaṣṭihastamakṣamālaikahastakam ..
trinetraṃ raktavastraṃ ca mukuṭādyairalaṃkṛtam .. 104 ..
2.2.d:
विबुधाधिपं ततो ध्यायेत्पीतं वृषभवाहनम् ॥
चतुर्भुजं यष्टिहस्तमक्षमालैकहस्तकम् ॥
त्रिनेत्रं रक्तवस्त्रं च मुकुटाद्यैरलंकृतम् ॥ 104 ॥
2.2.m:
Then one should meditate upon Vibudhādhipa: yellow, mounted upon a bull,
four-armed, with a staff in hand, with a rosary in one hand,
three-eyed, [wearing] red garments, and adorned with diadems and other ornaments.

2.2.s:
ṛṣirhārīta ityukto jagatīcchanda īritam ..
devatā ca bhavecchaktiḥ prītaye viniyojayet .. 105 ..
2.2.d:
ऋषिर्हारीत इत्युक्तो जगतीच्छन्द ईरितम् ॥
देवता च भवेच्छक्तिः प्रीतये विनियोजयेत् ॥ 105 ॥
2.2.m:
Hārīta is said to be the sage, Jagatī is stated as the meter;
Śakti would be the deity; one should employ [it] for [her] pleasure.

2.2.s:
mitraṃ dhyāyecchuklavarṇaṃ varābhayakaraṃ param ..
meṣasthaṃ ca trinetraṃ ca kirīṭavaramaṃḍitam .. 106 ..
2.2.d:
मित्रं ध्यायेच्छुक्लवर्णं वराभयकरं परम् ॥
मेषस्थं च त्रिनेत्रं च किरीटवरमंडितम् ॥ 106 ॥
2.2.m:
One should meditate upon Mitra, white in colour, supreme, his hands granting boons and fearlessness,
mounted upon a ram, three-eyed, and adorned with an excellent diadem.

2.2.s: dhanākarastviti mantreṇa pūjayeddadhipāyasaiḥ..1 07..
2.2.d: धनाकरस्त्विति मन्त्रेण पूजयेद्दधिपायसैः॥1 07॥
2.2.m: One should worship with curds and milk-rice using the mantra, “dhanākarastu”.

2.2.s:
ṛṣirautathya ityukto jagatī chanda īritam ..
devatā ca bhavedyakṣmā prītaye viniyojayet ..108..
2.2.d:
ऋषिरौतथ्य इत्युक्तो जगती छन्द ईरितम् ॥
देवता च भवेद्यक्ष्मा प्रीतये विनियोजयेत् ॥108॥
2.2.m:
Autathya is said to be the sage, Jagatī is stated as the meter;
Yakṣman would be the deity; one should employ [it] for [his] pleasure.

2.2.s:
pītāsyaṃ rājayakṣyāṇaṃ karālaṃ ca viciṃtayet..
yaśo rūpamiti mantreṇa gandhādyaiḥ paripūjayet .. 109 ..
2.2.d:
पीतास्यं राजयक्ष्याणं करालं च विचिंतयेत्॥
यशो रूपमिति मन्त्रेण गन्धाद्यैः परिपूजयेत् ॥ 109 ॥
2.2.m:
One should visualize Rājayakṣman with a yellow face, and dreadful;
one should worship with perfumes and other offerings using the mantra, “yaśo rūpam”.

2.2.s:
dadhyaṅṅātharvaṇa ṛṣirgāyatrī chanda īritam ..
yakṣmā ca devatā caiva stutau ca viniyoja yet ..2.2.11.1 1 0..
2.2.d:
दध्यङ्ङाथर्वण ऋषिर्गायत्री छन्द ईरितम् ॥
यक्ष्मा च देवता चैव स्तुतौ च विनियोज येत् ॥2.2.11.1 1 0॥
2.2.m:
Dadhyañc Ātharvaṇa is the sage, Gāyatrī is stated as the meter;
and Yakṣman is the deity; one should employ [it] in praise.

2.2.s:
śuklāṃbaradharaṃ dhyāyeddvibhujaṃ śikhivāhanam ..
yamaṃ vineti maṃtreṇa pūjayedbhaktitatparaḥ ..111..
2.2.d:
शुक्लांबरधरं ध्यायेद्द्विभुजं शिखिवाहनम् ॥
यमं विनेति मंत्रेण पूजयेद्भक्तितत्परः ॥111॥
2.2.m:
One should meditate upon [him] wearing white garments, two-armed, mounted upon a peacock;
intent on devotion, one should worship using the mantra, “yamaṃ vinā”.

2.2.s:
ṛṣiḥ syānnāradaḥ proktaśchandonuṣṭupprakīrtitam ..
vivasvāndevatā caiva kratau ca viniyojayet ..112..
2.2.d:
ऋषिः स्यान्नारदः प्रोक्तश्छन्दोनुष्टुप्प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
विवस्वान्देवता चैव क्रतौ च विनियोजयेत् ॥112॥
2.2.m:
Nārada would be declared as the sage, the meter is proclaimed as Anuṣṭubh,
and Vivasvat is the deity; one should employ [it] in the sacrifice.

2.2.s:
evaṃ dhyātvā vivasvaṃtaṃ mahākāyaṃ mahodaram ..
abhinnarūpamaṃtreṇa gandhādyaiḥ paripūja yet .. 113 ..
2.2.d:
एवं ध्यात्वा विवस्वंतं महाकायं महोदरम् ॥
अभिन्नरूपमंत्रेण गन्धाद्यैः परिपूज येत् ॥ 113 ॥
2.2.m:
Having thus meditated upon Vivasvat, having a great body and a large belly,
one should worship with perfumes and other offerings using the mantra, “abhinnarūpa”.

2.2.s: kāśyaposya ṛṣiśchandastriṣṭubdevaḥ śacīpatiḥ .. 114 ..
2.2.d: काश्यपोस्य ऋषिश्छन्दस्त्रिष्टुब्देवः शचीपतिः ॥ 114 ॥
2.2.m: Kāśyapa is its sage, the meter is Triṣṭubh, and the god is Śacīpati.

2.2.s:
bahirīśānakoṇeṣu devādīnparipūjayet ..
kūṣmāṇḍairvaraṇāpuṣpaiḥ śaurakairvā samarcayet .. 115 ..
2.2.d:
बहिरीशानकोणेषु देवादीन्परिपूजयेत् ॥
कूष्माण्डैर्वरणापुष्पैः शौरकैर्वा समर्चयेत् ॥ 115 ॥
2.2.m:
Outside, in the north-eastern corners, one should worship the gods and other beings;
one should worship them with ash gourds, with flowers of the varaṇa, or with śauraka flowers.

2.2.s:
pītāṃ karālikāṃ dhyāyeccarakīṃ varavarṇinīm ..
svabjasthāṃ dvibhujāṃ caiva guñjāhāropaśobhitām .. 116 ..
2.2.d:
पीतां करालिकां ध्यायेच्चरकीं वरवर्णिनीम् ॥
स्वब्जस्थां द्विभुजां चैव गुञ्जाहारोपशोभिताम् ॥ 116 ॥
2.2.m:
One should meditate upon the yellow Karālikā, Carakī, of excellent complexion,
stationed on her own lotus, two-armed, and adorned with a necklace of guñjā berries.

2.2.s:
pītinyarūpamantreṇa pūjayedbhūtimicchukaḥ ..
baladeva ṛṣiścāsya chando gaurī ca devatā .. 117 ..
2.2.d:
पीतिन्यरूपमन्त्रेण पूजयेद्भूतिमिच्छुकः ॥
बलदेव ऋषिश्चास्य छन्दो गौरी च देवता ॥ 117 ॥
2.2.m:
Desiring prosperity, one should worship with the mantra, “pītinyarūpa”;
Baladeva is its sage, the meter […], and Gaurī is the deity.

2.2.s:
dhyāyedvidārikāṃ raktāṃ navayauvanasaṃyutām ..
pavitreṇa punīhīti maṃtreṇānena pūjayet .. 118 ..
2.2.d:
ध्यायेद्विदारिकां रक्तां नवयौवनसंयुताम् ॥
पवित्रेण पुनीहीति मंत्रेणानेन पूजयेत् ॥ 118 ॥
2.2.m:
One should meditate upon Vidārikā, red, endowed with fresh youth;
one should worship with this mantra, “pavitreṇa punīhi”.

2.2.s:
ṛṣirgargaḥ samākhyātastriṣṭupchandosya devatā ..
rudro'pi ca samākhyātaḥ stutau ca viniyojayet .. 119 ..
2.2.d:
ऋषिर्गर्गः समाख्यातस्त्रिष्टुप्छन्दोस्य देवता ॥
रुद्रोऽपि च समाख्यातः स्तुतौ च विनियोजयेत् ॥ 119 ॥
2.2.m:
Garga is declared as the sage, Triṣṭubh as the meter;
Rudra is also declared as its deity; one should employ [it] in praise.

2.2.s:
pāpādirākṣasīṃ dhyāyetsaurabheyoparisthitām ..
kayā na iti maṃtreṇa pūjayedgandhacandanaiḥ .. 2.2.11.120 ..
2.2.d:
पापादिराक्षसीं ध्यायेत्सौरभेयोपरिस्थिताम् ॥
कया न इति मंत्रेण पूजयेद्गन्धचन्दनैः ॥ 2.2.11.120 ॥
2.2.m:
One should meditate upon the rākṣasī Pāpā and others, standing upon a bull;
one should worship with perfumes and sandalwood using the mantra, “kayā naḥ”.

2.2.s:
ṛṣiḥ suvarṇa ākhyātaḥ paṅktiśchandaḥ prakīrtitam ..
devatā ca mahādeva iṣṭārthe viniyojayet .. 121 ..
2.2.d:
ऋषिः सुवर्ण आख्यातः पङ्क्तिश्छन्दः प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
देवता च महादेव इष्टार्थे विनियोजयेत् ॥ 121 ॥
2.2.m: The sage is declared to be Suvarṇa, the metre is proclaimed to be paṅkti, / and the deity is Mahādeva; one should employ it for one's desired goal.

2.2.s:
kuṇḍavedyā aṃtare ca sthāpavedvidhivadbudhaḥ ..
parvatāgramṛdaṃ caiva gajadaṃtamṛdaṃ tathā .. 122 ..
2.2.d:
कुण्डवेद्या अंतरे च स्थापवेद्विधिवद्बुधः ॥
पर्वताग्रमृदं चैव गजदंतमृदं तथा ॥ 122 ॥
2.2.m: And inside the altar of the sacrificial pit, the wise man should set down according to rule: / soil from a mountain peak, and likewise soil from an elephant's tusk,

2.2.s:
valmīke saṃgame caiva rājadvāracatuṣpathāt ..
kuśamūlamṛdaṃ caiva yajñiyasya vanaspateḥ .. 123 ..
2.2.d:
वल्मीके संगमे चैव राजद्वारचतुष्पथात् ॥
कुशमूलमृदं चैव यज्ञियस्य वनस्पतेः ॥ 123 ॥
2.2.m: from an anthill, from a river confluence, from a royal gate, from a crossroad, / and soil from the root of kuśa grass and from a tree suitable for sacrifice;

2.2.s:
indravallī tathākrāṃta amṛtī trapuṣasya ca ..
mālatī caṃpakaṃ caiva tathā urvārukasya ca .. 124 ..
2.2.d:
इन्द्रवल्ली तथाक्रांत अमृती त्रपुषस्य च ॥
मालती चंपकं चैव तथा उर्वारुकस्य च ॥ 124 ॥
2.2.m: indravallī, and likewise ākrāntā, amṛtī, of cucumber, / mālatī, campaka, and likewise of melon;

2.2.s:
pāribhadrasya patraiśca paritaḥ pariveṣṭanam ..
pañcatuṃgasya parito mukhe kuryātphaṇānvitam .. 125 ..
2.2.d:
पारिभद्रस्य पत्रैश्च परितः परिवेष्टनम् ॥
पञ्चतुंगस्य परितो मुखे कुर्यात्फणान्वितम् ॥ 125 ॥
2.2.m: and an enclosing all around with leaves of the pāribhadra tree; / all around the pañcatuṅga, at the mouth, he should make [a vessel] provided with hoods;

2.2.s:
śrīphalaṃ bījapūraṃ ca nālikeraṃ ca dāḍimam ..
dhātrīṃ jaṃbuphalaṃ caiva anyayā doṣamādiśet ..126..
2.2.d:
श्रीफलं बीजपूरं च नालिकेरं च दाडिमम् ॥
धात्रीं जंबुफलं चैव अन्यया दोषमादिशेत् ॥126॥
2.2.m: bilva fruit, citron, coconut, pomegranate, / āmalakī, and rose-apple fruit; through another [choice], he would indicate a defect;

2.2.s:
pañcaraktaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca nikṣipedvaruṇaṃ yajet ..
pañcopacārairvidhivadgandhapuṣpādibhiryajet..127..
2.2.d:
पञ्चरक्तं सुवर्णं च निक्षिपेद्वरुणं यजेत् ॥
पञ्चोपचारैर्विधिवद्गन्धपुष्पादिभिर्यजेत्॥127॥
2.2.m: and he should cast in five red [gems] and gold, and worship Varuṇa; / he should worship according to rule with the five articles of worship, with perfume, flowers, and the rest.

2.2.s: udvartana iti mantreṇa varuṇaṃ ca punaryajet ..128..
2.2.d: उद्वर्तन इति मन्त्रेण वरुणं च पुनर्यजेत् ॥128॥
2.2.m: And with the mantra 'Udvartana...', he should worship Varuṇa again.

2.2.s:
asya maṃtrasya ca ṛṣirviṣṇuśchanda udāhṛtam ..
gāyatrī devatā pāśī prītaye viniyojayet .. 129 ..
2.2.d:
अस्य मंत्रस्य च ऋषिर्विष्णुश्छन्द उदाहृतम् ॥
गायत्री देवता पाशी प्रीतये विनियोजयेत् ॥ 129 ॥
2.2.m: And of this mantra, the sage is Viṣṇu, the metre is declared to be / gāyatrī, the deity is the noose-bearer [Varuṇa]; one should employ it for his pleasure.

2.2.s: pañcagaṃdhānvinikṣipya hastaṃ dattvā paṭhettataḥ .. 2.2.11.130 ..
2.2.d: पञ्चगंधान्विनिक्षिप्य हस्तं दत्त्वा पठेत्ततः ॥ 2.2.11.130 ॥
2.2.m: Having thrown in the five perfumes, placing his hand upon it, he should then recite:

2.2.s:
sarve samudrāḥ saritaḥ sarāṃsi ca mahāhradāḥ...
āyāṃtu sarvapāpaghnāḥ sarvalokasukhāvahāḥ .. 131 ..
2.2.d:
सर्वे समुद्राः सरितः सरांसि च महाह्रदाः॥।
आयांतु सर्वपापघ्नाः सर्वलोकसुखावहाः ॥ 131 ॥
2.2.m: 'May all the oceans, rivers, lakes, and great pools, / destroyers of all sins, bringers of happiness to all worlds, arrive!

2.2.s:
gaṃgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāstīrthāni jaladāḥ nadāḥ ..
āyāṃtu yajamānasya duritakṣayakārakāḥ .. 132 ..
2.2.d:
गंगाद्याः सरितः सर्वास्तीर्थानि जलदाः नदाः ॥
आयांतु यजमानस्य दुरितक्षयकारकाः ॥ 132 ॥
2.2.m: May the Gaṅgā and all other rivers, sacred bathing places, clouds, and streams, / bringing about the destruction of the sacrificer's sins, arrive!'

2.2.s:
aghorājyaṣṭakakṛtā vāstoṣpataya ityapi ..
śataṃ vā cāṣṭasaṃyuktaṃ sahasraṃ vā viśeṣataḥ .. 133 ..
2.2.d:
अघोराज्यष्टककृता वास्तोष्पतय इत्यपि ॥
शतं वा चाष्टसंयुक्तं सहस्रं वा विशेषतः ॥ 133 ॥
2.2.m: Made with the Aghora eight-ghee [oblations], and also [with the mantra] 'Vāstoṣpate...': / one hundred and eight, or especially one thousand,

2.2.s:
śatārdhaṃ vā hunedviprastilairvā taṃḍulaiḥ saha ..
pālāśairvā pippalairvaudumbarairvā samācaret..134..
2.2.d:
शतार्धं वा हुनेद्विप्रस्तिलैर्वा तंडुलैः सह ॥
पालाशैर्वा पिप्पलैर्वौदुम्बरैर्वा समाचरेत्॥134॥
2.2.m: or the twice-born should offer half a hundred oblations, with sesame or with rice grains, / or he should perform it with palāśa, pippala, or udumbara [twigs],

2.2.s:
payodadhyādibhirvāpi madhvājyairvā viśiṣyate..
anyeṣāṃ ca vratenaiva ekaikāmatha vāhutim..135..
2.2.d:
पयोदध्यादिभिर्वापि मध्वाज्यैर्वा विशिष्यते॥
अन्येषां च व्रतेनैव एकैकामथ वाहुतिम्॥135॥
2.2.m: or with milk, curd, and the rest, or it is distinguished with honey and ghee; / and by the vow of others, he should offer one oblation each,

2.2.s: aṣṭāviṃśatibhiścānyairaṣṭāṣṭau paṃcapaṃca vā .. 136 ..
2.2.d: अष्टाविंशतिभिश्चान्यैरष्टाष्टौ पंचपंच वा ॥ 136 ॥
2.2.m: or twenty-eight by others, or eight each, or five each.

2.2.s:
carakyādīṃścāsanaiśca piṣṭakairvaṭakena vā ..
raktapuṣpeṇa patreṇa trimadhvaktena yatnataḥ .. 137 ..
2.2.d:
चरक्यादींश्चासनैश्च पिष्टकैर्वटकेन वा ॥
रक्तपुष्पेण पत्रेण त्रिमध्वक्तेन यत्नतः ॥ 137 ॥
2.2.m: And to Carakī and the rest, with seats, cakes, or fried dumplings, / with red flowers, leaves, carefully smeared with the three sweets—

2.2.s:
vāstoṣpate dṛḍhaṃ japtvā yajedvāstupatiṃ yadā ..
paṃcopacārairvidhivatsāṃgopāṃgairanaṃtaram ..138..
2.2.d:
वास्तोष्पते दृढं जप्त्वा यजेद्वास्तुपतिं यदा ॥
पंचोपचारैर्विधिवत्सांगोपांगैरनंतरम् ॥138॥
2.2.m: when, having firmly recited 'Vāstoṣpate...', he should worship Vāstupati / according to rule with the five articles of worship, along with the limbs and sub-limbs, thereafter

2.2.s:
balimāsādayetpaścāddadyādekaikaśaḥ kramāt..
brāhmaṇaiścaiva dadyācca sadā ājyaṃ samākṣikam .. 139 ..
2.2.d:
बलिमासादयेत्पश्चाद्दद्यादेकैकशः क्रमात्॥
ब्राह्मणैश्चैव दद्याच्च सदा आज्यं समाक्षिकम् ॥ 139 ॥
2.2.m: he should then present the offering, and give it one by one in order; / and with the brāhmaṇas he should always give ghee with honey.

2.2.s:
śālyannaṃ śikhine dadyāttathā nīlotpalāni ca ..
odanaṃ sotpalaṃ dadyātparjanyāya vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 2.2.11.140 ..
2.2.d:
शाल्यन्नं शिखिने दद्यात्तथा नीलोत्पलानि च ॥
ओदनं सोत्पलं दद्यात्पर्जन्याय विचक्षणः ॥ 2.2.11.140 ॥
2.2.m: He should give winter-rice food to Śikhin, and likewise blue water lilies; / the discerning man should give boiled rice with water lilies to Parjanya;

2.2.s:
jayāya piṣṭakaṃ kāryamindrāya ghṛtamodakaḥ ..
sūryāya piṣṭakānnaṃ ca satyāya yavapūlikām ..141..
2.2.d:
जयाय पिष्टकं कार्यमिन्द्राय घृतमोदकः ॥
सूर्याय पिष्टकान्नं च सत्याय यवपूलिकाम् ॥141॥
2.2.m: a cake is to be made for Jaya, a ghee-sweetmeat for Indra, / cake-food for Sūrya, and a barley cake for Satya;

2.2.s:
bhramāya matsyamāṃsānnaṃ śaṣkulīmatha piṣṭakam ..
vāyavye ca tathā saktūnpūṣṇe cāpūpameva hi .. 142 ..
2.2.d:
भ्रमाय मत्स्यमांसान्नं शष्कुलीमथ पिष्टकम् ॥
वायव्ये च तथा सक्तून्पूष्णे चापूपमेव हि ॥ 142 ॥
2.2.m: food with fish and meat for Bhrama, and then a fried pastry and cake; / and likewise roasted barley meal for Vāyavya, and a baked sweet cake for Pūṣan;

2.2.s:
vitathāya kalāyānnaṃ gṛharkṣāya samākṣikam ..
pūṣṇetha kṛśarānnaṃ ca śālyannaṃ ca nivedayet .. 143 ..
2.2.d:
वितथाय कलायान्नं गृहर्क्षाय समाक्षिकम् ॥
पूष्णेथ कृशरान्नं च शाल्यन्नं च निवेदयेत् ॥ 143 ॥
2.2.m: food with peas for Vitatha, [food] with honey for Gṛharkṣa; / he should then present rice with pulse for Pūṣan, and winter-rice food;

2.2.s:
gandharvāya kastūrikānnaṃ kṛśaraṃ bhṛṃgarājake ..
mṛgāya yāvakānnaṃ ca pitṛbhyo mudgapāyasam ..144..
2.2.d:
गन्धर्वाय कस्तूरिकान्नं कृशरं भृंगराजके ॥
मृगाय यावकान्नं च पितृभ्यो मुद्गपायसम् ॥144॥
2.2.m: musk-flavoured food for Gandharva, rice with pulse for Bhṛṅgarājaka, / barley food for Mṛga, and kidney-bean rice pudding for the ancestors;

2.2.s:
dauvārikāya kṛśarānanaḍuṃhe ca pūpakam ..
pāyasaṃ puṣpadaṃtāya varuṇāya ca piṣṭakam .. 145 ..
2.2.d:
दौवारिकाय कृशराननडुंहे च पूपकम् ॥
पायसं पुष्पदंताय वरुणाय च पिष्टकम् ॥ 145 ॥
2.2.m: rice with pulse for Dauvārika, and a cake for Anaḍuha; / rice pudding for Puṣpadanta, and a cake for Varuṇa;

2.2.s:
asurāya modakāṃścaiva dadyādāpikṣaye surām..
ghṛtodanaṃ ca somāya kaṇānnaṃ yakṣmaṇe dadet .. 146 ..
2.2.d:
असुराय मोदकांश्चैव दद्यादापिक्षये सुराम्॥
घृतोदनं च सोमाय कणान्नं यक्ष्मणे ददेत् ॥ 146 ॥
2.2.m: and sweetmeats for Asura, and he should give liquor for Āpikṣaya; / boiled rice with ghee for Soma, and grain-tip food he should give to Yakṣman;

2.2.s:
rogāya ghṛtalaḍḍūkaṃ sapāyasaguḍaudanam ..
akṣāya vividhānnaṃ ca bhallāṭāya tathaiva ca .. 147 ..
2.2.d:
रोगाय घृतलड्डूकं सपायसगुडौदनम् ॥
अक्षाय विविधान्नं च भल्लाटाय तथैव च ॥ 147 ॥
2.2.m: a ghee-laḍḍu for Roga, along with rice pudding and jaggery-rice; / and various foods for Akṣa, and likewise for Bhallāṭa;

2.2.s:
somāya madhuśālyannaṃ nāgāya guḍapiṣṭakam ..
adityai cāpi godhūmaṃ ghṛtapakvaṃ nivedayet .. 148 ..
2.2.d:
सोमाय मधुशाल्यन्नं नागाय गुडपिष्टकम् ॥
अदित्यै चापि गोधूमं घृतपक्वं निवेदयेत् ॥ 148 ॥
2.2.m: honey and winter-rice food for Soma, a jaggery cake for Nāga; / and he should present wheat cooked in ghee to Aditi;

2.2.s:
dityai dadyāttathā kṣīraṃ sitaśarkarayā saha ..
kṣīrānnaṃ caiva pūṣṇe ca āpavatsāya vai dadhi .. .. 149 ..
2.2.d:
दित्यै दद्यात्तथा क्षीरं सितशर्करया सह ॥
क्षीरान्नं चैव पूष्णे च आपवत्साय वै दधि ॥ ॥ 149 ॥
2.2.m: and to Diti he should give milk together with white sugar; / milk-rice to Pūṣan, and curd indeed to Āpavatsa;

2.2.s:
sāvitryai laḍḍukānnaṃ ca savitre ca guḍaudanam ..
jayāya ghṛtamannaṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ ca vivasvate .. 2.2.11.150 ..
2.2.d:
सावित्र्यै लड्डुकान्नं च सवित्रे च गुडौदनम् ॥
जयाय घृतमन्नं च मिष्टान्नं च विवस्वते ॥ 2.2.11.150 ॥
2.2.m: a laḍḍu-dish for Sāvitrī, and jaggery-rice for Savitṛ; / food with ghee for Jaya, and sweet food for Vivasvat;

2.2.s:
virūpāya ca taddadyāddharidrānnaṃ tathaiva ca ..
ghṛtaudanaṃ ca citrāya rudrāya ghṛtapāyasam .. 151 ..
2.2.d:
विरूपाय च तद्दद्याद्धरिद्रान्नं तथैव च ॥
घृतौदनं च चित्राय रुद्राय घृतपायसम् ॥ 151 ॥
2.2.m: and he should give that to Virūpa, and turmeric-food likewise; / boiled rice with ghee to Citra, and ghee-rice pudding to Rudra;

2.2.s:
māṃsaudanaṃ yakṣmaṇe ca kṛśaraṃ varuṇāya ca ..
aryamṇe śarkarāpūpaṃ bahirdadyāccatuṣṭayam .. .. 152 ..
2.2.d:
मांसौदनं यक्ष्मणे च कृशरं वरुणाय च ॥
अर्यम्णे शर्करापूपं बहिर्दद्याच्चतुष्टयम् ॥ ॥ 152 ॥
2.2.m: boiled rice with meat to Yakṣman, and rice with pulse to Varuṇa; / a sugar cake to Aryaman; on the outside he should give four:

2.2.s:
citraudanaṃ samāṃsaṃ ca matsyānnaṃ guḍapiṣṭakam ..
pratidevopari kṣīraṃ ghṛtakṣīrasamanvitam ..
tīrthatoyasamāyuktaṃ sugandhena samanvitam..153..
2.2.d:
चित्रौदनं समांसं च मत्स्यान्नं गुडपिष्टकम् ॥
प्रतिदेवोपरि क्षीरं घृतक्षीरसमन्वितम् ॥
तीर्थतोयसमायुक्तं सुगन्धेन समन्वितम्॥153॥
2.2.m: variegated boiled rice with meat, fish food, and jaggery cake; / over each deity, milk, endowed with ghee and milk, / combined with sacred water, and endowed with sweet fragrance.

2.2.s:
patākā devavarṇena dadyādbrahmādiṣu kramāt ..
maṃtraṃ japetsvasāmarthyātsvasāmarthyātstutiṃ paṭhet .. 154 ..
2.2.d:
पताका देववर्णेन दद्याद्ब्रह्मादिषु क्रमात् ॥
मंत्रं जपेत्स्वसामर्थ्यात्स्वसामर्थ्यात्स्तुतिं पठेत् ॥ 154 ॥
2.2.m: He should give a flag according to the colour of the deity, to Brahmā and the others in order; / he should recite the mantra according to his ability, and recite the praise according to his ability.

2.2.s:
puruṣastavasya sūrya ṛṣirjagatī chandaḥ ..
savitā devatā somapāke stutau viniyogaḥ .. 155 ..
2.2.d:
पुरुषस्तवस्य सूर्य ऋषिर्जगती छन्दः ॥
सविता देवता सोमपाके स्तुतौ विनियोगः ॥ 155 ॥
2.2.m: Of the praise of Puruṣa, Sūrya is the sage, jagatī is the metre, / Savitṛ is the deity; the employment is in praise during the cooking of soma.

2.2.s:
.. śaṃkara uvāca .. ..
viṣṇurjiṣṇurvibhuryajño yajñiyo yajñapālakaḥ ..
nārāyaṇo naro haṃso viṣvakseno hutāśanaḥ .. 156 ..
2.2.d:
॥ शंकर उवाच ॥ ॥
विष्णुर्जिष्णुर्विभुर्यज्ञो यज्ञियो यज्ञपालकः ॥
नारायणो नरो हंसो विष्वक्सेनो हुताशनः ॥ 156 ॥
2.2.m: Śaṅkara said: / Viṣṇu, victorious, all-pervading, sacrifice, worthy of sacrifice, protector of sacrifice, / Nārāyaṇa, Nara, Haṃsa, Viṣvaksena, fire-eater [Agni],

2.2.s:
yajñeśaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sūryaḥ surārcitaḥ ..
ādidevo jagatkartā maṇḍaleśo mahīdharaḥ .. 157 ..
2.2.d:
यज्ञेशः पुण्डरीकाक्षः कृष्णः सूर्यः सुरार्चितः ॥
आदिदेवो जगत्कर्ता मण्डलेशो महीधरः ॥ 157 ॥
2.2.m: Lord of sacrifice, lotus-eyed, Kṛṣṇa, Sūrya, worshipped by the gods, / primal deity, creator of the world, lord of the circle, bearer of the earth,

2.2.s:
padmanābho hṛṣīkeśo dātā dāmodaro hariḥ ..
trivikramastrilokeśo brahmaṇaḥ prītivarddhanaḥ .. 158 ..
2.2.d:
पद्मनाभो हृषीकेशो दाता दामोदरो हरिः ॥
त्रिविक्रमस्त्रिलोकेशो ब्रह्मणः प्रीतिवर्द्धनः ॥ 158 ॥
2.2.m: lotus-naveled, Hṛṣīkeśa, giver, Dāmodara, Hari, / Trivikrama, lord of the three worlds, increaser of Brahmā's delight,

2.2.s:
bhaktapriyo'cyutaḥ satyaḥ satyavākyo dhruvaḥ śuciḥ ..
saṃnyāsī śāstratattvajñastripaṃcāśadguṇātmakaḥ .. 159 ..
2.2.d:
भक्तप्रियोऽच्युतः सत्यः सत्यवाक्यो ध्रुवः शुचिः ॥
संन्यासी शास्त्रतत्त्वज्ञस्त्रिपंचाशद्गुणात्मकः ॥ 159 ॥
2.2.m: fond of devotees, Acyuta, Satya, true of speech, Dhruva, pure, / renunciant, knower of the truth of scriptures, consisting of fifty-three qualities,

2.2.s:
vidārī vinayaḥ śāṃtastapasvī vaidyutaprabhaḥ ..
yajñastvaṃ hi vaṣaṭkārastvamoṃkārastvamagnayaḥ .. 2.2.11.160 ..
2.2.d:
विदारी विनयः शांतस्तपस्वी वैद्युतप्रभः ॥
यज्ञस्त्वं हि वषट्कारस्त्वमोंकारस्त्वमग्नयः ॥ 2.2.11.160 ॥
2.2.m: destroyer, modesty, peaceful, ascetic, possessing the splendour of lightning; / for you are the sacrifice, the vaṣaṭ-call, you are the oṃkāra, you are the sacred fires;

2.2.s:
tvaṃ svadhā tvaṃ hi svāhā tvaṃ sudhā ca puruṣottamaḥ ..
namo devādidevāya viṣṇave śāsvatāya ca ..
anaṃtāyāprameyāya namaste garuḍadhvaja .. 161 ..
2.2.d:
त्वं स्वधा त्वं हि स्वाहा त्वं सुधा च पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
नमो देवादिदेवाय विष्णवे शास्वताय च ॥
अनंतायाप्रमेयाय नमस्ते गरुडध्वज ॥ 161 ॥
2.2.m: you are svadhā, you are svāhā, and you are nectar, the supreme spirit [Puruṣottama]; / salutations to the god of gods, to Viṣṇu, and to the eternal one; / to the infinite, the immeasurable; salutations to you whose banner is Garuḍa!

2.2.s:
brahmastavamimaṃ proktaṃ mahādevena bhāṣitam ..
prayatnādyaḥ paṭhennityamamṛtatvaṃ sa gacchati .. 162 ..
2.2.d:
ब्रह्मस्तवमिमं प्रोक्तं महादेवेन भाषितम् ॥
प्रयत्नाद्यः पठेन्नित्यममृतत्वं स गच्छति ॥ 162 ॥
2.2.m: Whoever carefully and constantly recites this praise of Brahman, / spoken by Mahādeva, he attains immortality.

2.2.s:
dhyāyaṃti ye nityamanaṃtamacyutaṃ hṛtpadmamadhye svayamāvyavasthitam ..
upāsakānāṃ prabhumekamīśvaraṃ te yāṃti siddhiṃ paramāṃ tu vaiṣṇavīm .. 163 ..
arghyadānavidhivarṇanam
2.2.d:
ध्यायंति ये नित्यमनंतमच्युतं हृत्पद्ममध्ये स्वयमाव्यवस्थितम् ॥
उपासकानां प्रभुमेकमीश्वरं ते यांति सिद्धिं परमां तु वैष्णवीम् ॥ 163 ॥
अर्घ्यदानविधिवर्णनम्
2.2.m:
Those who constantly meditate on the infinite, unfalling one, standing manifest within the heart's lotus, / the single master and sovereign of worshippers, they attain supreme Vaiṣṇava perfection.
Description of the procedure for offering arghya

2.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tato bheryādighoṣeṇa yajamāna udaṅmukhaḥ ..
kanakatoyena gandhena mudgalāgreṇa lepayet .. 1 ..
2.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
ततो भेर्यादिघोषेण यजमान उदङ्मुखः ॥
कनकतोयेन गन्धेन मुद्गलाग्रेण लेपयेत् ॥ 1 ॥
2.2.m:
Sūta said:
Then, amidst the sounding of kettle-drums and other instruments, the sacrificer, facing north, / should smear [the ground] with golden water and perfume, using the tip of a club.

2.2.s:
aiśānyāṃ madhyabhāge vā yajedvā susamāhitaḥ ..
vartulākārayedyasmānmana icchati saṃjapan .. 2 ..
2.2.d:
ऐशान्यां मध्यभागे वा यजेद्वा सुसमाहितः ॥
वर्तुलाकारयेद्यस्मान्मन इच्छति संजपन् ॥ 2 ॥
2.2.m: In the northeast or in the middle part, being well-composed, he should sacrifice, / or he should make it circular, murmuring [prayers] as his mind desires.

2.2.s:
ṛṣiḥ kaṃṭhotha gāyatrī chanda ityabhidhīyate ..
devatā pṛthivī caiva stutau ca viniyojayet ..3..
2.2.d:
ऋषिः कंठोथ गायत्री छन्द इत्यभिधीयते ॥
देवता पृथिवी चैव स्तुतौ च विनियोजयेत् ॥3॥
2.2.m: Kaṇṭha is the seer, Gāyatrī is declared the metre, / and the deity is Earth; he should employ them in the praise.

2.2.s:
vivare pūjayetkarma brahmāṇaṃ ca dharādharam ..
pṛthivīṃ gandhapuṣpādyairnaivedyairvividhairapi .. 4 ..
2.2.d:
विवरे पूजयेत्कर्म ब्रह्माणं च धराधरम् ॥
पृथिवीं गन्धपुष्पाद्यैर्नैवेद्यैर्विविधैरपि ॥ 4 ॥
2.2.m: In the cavity he should worship the Kurma, Brahmā, and the bearer of the earth, / and [he should worship] the Earth with fragrant flowers and the like, as well as with various food offerings.

2.2.s:
agrato'ṣṭadalaṃ lekhyaṃ sthāpayetkalaśaṃ tataḥ..
mukhe vidhāya kanakaṃ rājatena vinirmitam .. 5 ..
2.2.d:
अग्रतोऽष्टदलं लेख्यं स्थापयेत्कलशं ततः॥
मुखे विधाय कनकं राजतेन विनिर्मितम् ॥ 5 ॥
2.2.m: In front, an eight-petalled [lotus] should be drawn, and then he should place a jar, / having placed over its mouth gold, [or one] made of silver,

2.2.s:
śuktiśaṃkhasamaṃ vāpi viśvāmitrasamudbhavam ..
pūjayettīrthatoyena gandhapuṣpākṣatādinā ..6..
2.2.d:
शुक्तिशंखसमं वापि विश्वामित्रसमुद्भवम् ॥
पूजयेत्तीर्थतोयेन गन्धपुष्पाक्षतादिना ॥6॥
2.2.m: or equal to an oyster-shell or conch, or one derived from a mother-of-pearl. / He should worship it with water from holy fords, perfumes, flowers, unbroken grains, and the like.

2.2.s:
viṣṇukrāṃtā vacākuṣṭhacandanena viloḍitam ..
kṣīraṃ ca mātuliṃgaṃ ca sāvitraṃ ca sadūrvayā .. 7 ..
2.2.d:
विष्णुक्रांता वचाकुष्ठचन्दनेन विलोडितम् ॥
क्षीरं च मातुलिंगं च सावित्रं च सदूर्वया ॥ 7 ॥
2.2.m: Stirred with viṣṇukrāntā, vacā, kuṣṭha, and sandalwood, / and milk, and citron, and an offering to Savitṛ together with dūrvā grass,

2.2.s:
dadhyakṣataṃ madhuyutamevamarghyaṃ ca sādhayet ..
sitacandanavastrādyaiḥ śālyaiśca vividhairapi .. 8 ..
2.2.d:
दध्यक्षतं मधुयुतमेवमर्घ्यं च साधयेत् ॥
सितचन्दनवस्त्राद्यैः शाल्यैश्च विविधैरपि ॥ 8 ॥
2.2.m: with curd, unbroken grains, and honey, he should thus prepare the respectful offering / with white sandalwood, cloth and the like, and also with various kinds of winter rice.

2.2.s:
avraṇaṃ kalaśaṃ kṛtvā pañcavarṇasamanvitam ..
āvāhayettoyanidhiṃ maṃtreṇānena bhaktitaḥ .. 9 ..
2.2.d:
अव्रणं कलशं कृत्वा पञ्चवर्णसमन्वितम् ॥
आवाहयेत्तोयनिधिं मंत्रेणानेन भक्तितः ॥ 9 ॥
2.2.m: Having made an unblemished jar endowed with five colours, / he should invoke the ocean with this mantra out of devotion:

2.2.s:
āyāhi bhagavandeva toyamūrte jaleśvara ..
hṛdvarṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ paritoṣāya te namaḥ .. 2.2.12.10 ..
2.2.d:
आयाहि भगवन्देव तोयमूर्ते जलेश्वर ॥
हृद्वर्णार्घ्यं मया दत्तं परितोषाय ते नमः ॥ 2.2.12.10 ॥
2.2.m: "Come, O blessed God, whose form is water, Lord of the waters! / The respectful offering according to the heart's desire has been given by me for your satisfaction. Homage to you!"

2.2.s:
gṛhebhyaścaiva somāya tvaṣṭre caiva ca śūline ..
imaṃ me varuṇetyādi pratyekaṃ syādgatitrayam .. 11 ..
2.2.d:
गृहेभ्यश्चैव सोमाय त्वष्ट्रे चैव च शूलिने ॥
इमं मे वरुणेत्यादि प्रत्येकं स्याद्गतित्रयम् ॥ 11 ॥
2.2.m: And to the houses, to Soma, to Tvaṣṭṛ, and to the trident-bearer, / with "May this of mine, O Varuṇa" and so forth, there should be three courses for each.

2.2.s:
tatorghyadānaṃ vidhivatkṣīreṇa haviṣā madhu ..
yajamānaḥ sapatnīkaḥ kuṃbhaṃ kukṣau nidhāya ca..12..
2.2.d:
ततोर्घ्यदानं विधिवत्क्षीरेण हविषा मधु ॥
यजमानः सपत्नीकः कुंभं कुक्षौ निधाय च॥12॥
2.2.m: Then, having placed the jar at his side, the sacrificer together with his wife / [should make] the presentation of the respectful offering according to rule, with milk, clarified butter, and honey.

2.2.s:
hiraṇyagarbheti maṃtrasya bharadvājaṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ ..
chandaśca jagatī khyātaṃ devatā ca jalādhipaḥ..13..
2.2.d:
हिरण्यगर्भेति मंत्रस्य भरद्वाजऋषिः स्मृतः ॥
छन्दश्च जगती ख्यातं देवता च जलाधिपः॥13॥
2.2.m: Of the mantra "Hiraṇyagarbha", Bharadvāja is recorded as the seer, / the metre is known as Jagatī, and the deity is the Lord of Waters.

2.2.s:
varuṇasyottaṃbhaneti maṃtrasya jalakuṃbhaṃ nivedayet ..
asya maṃtrasya ca ṛṣirnāradaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ..
virāṭchandaśca īśāno devatā samudāhṛtā ..14..
2.2.d:
वरुणस्योत्तंभनेति मंत्रस्य जलकुंभं निवेदयेत् ॥
अस्य मंत्रस्य च ऋषिर्नारदः परिकीर्तितः ॥
विराट्छन्दश्च ईशानो देवता समुदाहृता ॥14॥
2.2.m: With the mantra "Varuṇasyottambhanam", he should offer the water jar. / Nārada is proclaimed as the seer of this mantra, / Virāj is the metre, and Īśāna is declared the deity.

2.2.s:
mocayenmīnayugmaṃ ca meṣayugmaṃ tathaiva ca ..
saṃbhave pakṣiyugmaṃ ca āḍīṃ vā cakravākakam ..15..
2.2.d:
मोचयेन्मीनयुग्मं च मेषयुग्मं तथैव च ॥
संभवे पक्षियुग्मं च आडीं वा चक्रवाककम् ॥15॥
2.2.m: He should release a pair of fish, and likewise a pair of rams, / and if possible, a pair of birds, either an āḍī-duck or a ruddy goose.

2.2.s:
mocayennāgayugmaṃ ca āyuvṛddheśca hetave ..
dikṣu jīvaṃtikāṃ dadyādrākṣasebhyo baliṃ haret .. 16 ..
2.2.d:
मोचयेन्नागयुग्मं च आयुवृद्धेश्च हेतवे ॥
दिक्षु जीवंतिकां दद्याद्राक्षसेभ्यो बलिं हरेत् ॥ 16 ॥
2.2.m: And he should release a pair of serpents for the sake of lengthening his life. / He should offer a jīvantikā plant in the directions, and take an offering for the rākṣasas,

2.2.s:
nirmitaṃ māṣabhaktena raktapuṣpairalaṃkṛtam ..
kṣātrako lakṣmaṇaścaiva maṇibhadro gaṇeśvaraḥ ..
sabiṃdukena haṃtena dikṣu madhye yathā kramāt .. 17 ..
2.2.d:
निर्मितं माषभक्तेन रक्तपुष्पैरलंकृतम् ॥
क्षात्रको लक्ष्मणश्चैव मणिभद्रो गणेश्वरः ॥
सबिंदुकेन हंतेन दिक्षु मध्ये यथा क्रमात् ॥ 17 ॥
2.2.m: prepared from black-gram cakes and adorned with red flowers. / Kṣātraka, Lakṣmaṇa, and Maṇibhadra, Lord of Ganas, / ending in the nasal dot and [the word] "hant", in the directions and in the centre, respectively.

2.2.s:
ye bhavā bhāvino bhūtā ye ca teṣu mayāsinaḥ ..
āharaṃ tu baliṃ tuṣṭyā prayacchaṃtu śubhaṃ mama .. 18 ..
2.2.d:
ये भवा भाविनो भूता ये च तेषु मयासिनः ॥
आहरं तु बलिं तुष्ट्या प्रयच्छंतु शुभं मम ॥ 18 ॥
2.2.m: "Whichever beings have been, are to be, and exist, and those who feed upon them, / may they receive the offering with satisfaction and grant me auspiciousness!"

2.2.s:
ityuktvā ca baliṃ dadyānnamaskuryādanaṃtaram ..
dadyātpayasvinīṃ gāṃ ca ācāryāya viśeṣataḥ .. 19 ..
2.2.d:
इत्युक्त्वा च बलिं दद्यान्नमस्कुर्यादनंतरम् ॥
दद्यात्पयस्विनीं गां च आचार्याय विशेषतः ॥ 19 ॥
2.2.m: Having spoken thus, he should give the offering and bow immediately afterwards. / And he should give a milch cow, especially to the preceptor.

2.2.s:
anyeṣāṃ hi hiraṇyaṃ ca gāṃ ca dadyāddvijanmane ..
vyāhṛtidvitayaṃ caiva tato vāruṇapaṃcakam .. 2.2.12.20 ..
2.2.d:
अन्येषां हि हिरण्यं च गां च दद्याद्द्विजन्मने ॥
व्याहृतिद्वितयं चैव ततो वारुणपंचकम् ॥ 2.2.12.20 ॥
2.2.m: He should give gold and a cow to other twice-born ones; / and then the pair of vyāhṛtis, followed by the five Varuṇa [verses].

2.2.s:
prājāpatyaṃ sviṣṭakṛcca juhuyāttadanaṃtaram ..
ghṛtaiḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ nāsti tathā rasavisārakaiḥ .. 21 ..
2.2.d:
प्राजापत्यं स्विष्टकृच्च जुहुयात्तदनंतरम् ॥
घृतैः स्विष्टकृतं नास्ति तथा रसविसारकैः ॥ 21 ॥
2.2.m: Immediately after that, he should offer the prājāpatya and the sviṣṭakṛt oblation. / There is no sviṣṭakṛt made with clarified butter, nor with fluid essences.

2.2.s:
padmotpalairmātuliṃgaiḥ panasairmātuluṃgakaiḥ ..
madhūkairviśvapuṣpaiśca tathāmrātakakāśakaiḥ .. 22 ..
2.2.d:
पद्मोत्पलैर्मातुलिंगैः पनसैर्मातुलुंगकैः ॥
मधूकैर्विश्वपुष्पैश्च तथाम्रातककाशकैः ॥ 22 ॥
2.2.m: With lotuses, blue water-lilies, citrons, jackfruits, matuluṅgas, / madhūka blossoms, viśvapuṣpas, and hog-plums and kāśa grass,

2.2.s:
abhiṣekaṃ tataḥ kuryātsuvāstviti ca vai japan ..
dadyātpūrṇāṃ ca vidhivatsūryāyārghyaṃ nivedayet .. 23 ..
2.2.d:
अभिषेकं ततः कुर्यात्सुवास्त्विति च वै जपन् ॥
दद्यात्पूर्णां च विधिवत्सूर्यायार्घ्यं निवेदयेत् ॥ 23 ॥
2.2.m: he should then perform consecration while murmuring "May it be of good site". / He should offer the full oblation according to rule and present a respectful offering to Sūrya.

2.2.s:
pañcadoṣaṃ puraskṛtya brāhmaṇānumatena ca ..
gṛhaṃ praviśya ca tato brāhmaṇānatha bhojayet .. 24 ..
2.2.d:
पञ्चदोषं पुरस्कृत्य ब्राह्मणानुमतेन च ॥
गृहं प्रविश्य च ततो ब्राह्मणानथ भोजयेत् ॥ 24 ॥
2.2.m: Having redressed the fivefold fault, and with the permission of the brāhmaṇas, / he should then enter the house and feed the brāhmaṇas.

2.2.s:
dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇe caiva dadyādvittānusārataḥ ..
jñātibhiḥ saha bhuñjīta dadhikṣīrāmiṣaṃ vinā .. 25 ..
2.2.d:
दीनांधकृपणे चैव दद्याद्वित्तानुसारतः ॥
ज्ञातिभिः सह भुञ्जीत दधिक्षीरामिषं विना ॥ 25 ॥
2.2.m: And he should give according to his means to the poor, the blind, and the destitute. / He should eat together with his kin, without curd, milk, and meat.

2.2.s:
na kṣīraṃ ca kaṣāyaṃ ca bharjitaṃ śākameva ca ..
na kāṇḍaṃ ca na puṣpaṃ ca karīraṃ ca kadācana .. 26 ..
2.2.d:
न क्षीरं च कषायं च भर्जितं शाकमेव च ॥
न काण्डं च न पुष्पं च करीरं च कदाचन ॥ 26 ॥
2.2.m: [One should] not [consume] milk, or astringent [food], or roasted greens, / nor stems, nor flowers, nor ever karīra sprouts.

2.2.s:
śālyannaṃ mūlakaṃ caiva panasāmraphalāni ca ..
mastaṃ madhughṛtaguḍaṃ mātuliṃgaṃ sasaiṃdhavam .. 27 ..
2.2.d:
शाल्यन्नं मूलकं चैव पनसाम्रफलानि च ॥
मस्तं मधुघृतगुडं मातुलिंगं ससैंधवम् ॥ 27 ॥
2.2.m: Rice made of winter grain, radishes, jackfruit and mangoes, / whey, honey, clarified butter, jaggery, citron with rock salt,

2.2.s:
badaraṃ dhātakiphalaṃ kunda puṣpaṃ tathā tilam ..
etatpraśastaṃ jānīyānmarīcāni viśeṣataḥ .. 28 ..
2.2.d:
बदरं धातकिफलं कुन्द पुष्पं तथा तिलम् ॥
एतत्प्रशस्तं जानीयान्मरीचानि विशेषतः ॥ 28 ॥
2.2.m: jujube, dhātakī fruit, kunda flowers, and sesamum— / he should know these to be praised, especially black pepper.

2.2.s:
trirātramatha saptāhaṃ parityajya khale tataḥ ..
pañcāṃgakaṃ tataḥ kuryātsthāpa yenneti yugmakam .. 29 ..
2.2.d:
त्रिरात्रमथ सप्ताहं परित्यज्य खले ततः ॥
पञ्चांगकं ततः कुर्यात्स्थाप येन्नेति युग्मकम् ॥ 29 ॥
2.2.m: Then, having avoided the threshing floor for three nights or seven days, / he should then perform the five-limbed [rite] and should set down the pair of "neti".

2.2.s:
prathamā cārkahastena dvitīyā daśahastikā ..
vitaste tu bhavecchataṃ dviguṇaṃ tadanaṃtaram .. 2.2.12.30 ..
2.2.d:
प्रथमा चार्कहस्तेन द्वितीया दशहस्तिका ॥
वितस्ते तु भवेच्छतं द्विगुणं तदनंतरम् ॥ 2.2.12.30 ॥
2.2.m: The first is twelve cubits, the second is ten cubits; / but in spans there should be a hundred, and twice that thereafter,

2.2.s:
śatārdhaṃ tataḥ paścātṣaṣṭihastamanaṃtaram .. 31 .. ..
agnihotravidhānavarṇanam
2.2.d:
शतार्धं ततः पश्चात्षष्टिहस्तमनंतरम् ॥ 31 ॥ ॥
अग्निहोत्रविधानवर्णनम्
2.2.m:
after that, half a hundred, and immediately after, sixty cubits.
Description of the rule for the agnihotra.

2.2.s:
..sūta uvāca.. ..
svagṛhyāgnividhiṃ vakṣye yogabhedeṣu sattamāḥ ..
na paroktaṃ vidhānena bhayadaṃ kīrtidhvaṃsanam .. 1 ..
2.2.d:
॥सूत उवाच॥ ॥
स्वगृह्याग्निविधिं वक्ष्ये योगभेदेषु सत्तमाः ॥
न परोक्तं विधानेन भयदं कीर्तिध्वंसनम् ॥ 1 ॥
2.2.m:
Sūta said:
O best of men, I shall describe the rule for the fire of one's own domestic ritual according to the distinctions of yoga; / not that spoken by another according to [foreign] rule, which causes fear and destroys renown.

2.2.s:
putrā eva ca kanyāśca janiṣyāścāpare sutāḥ ..
gṛhyā iti samākhyātā yajamānasya dāyadāḥ .. 2 ..
2.2.d:
पुत्रा एव च कन्याश्च जनिष्याश्चापरे सुताः ॥
गृह्या इति समाख्याता यजमानस्य दायदाः ॥ 2 ॥
2.2.m: Sons, daughters, and other children yet to be born— / these are called "domestic", the heirs of the sacrificer.

2.2.s:
teṣāṃ saṃskārayāgeṣu śāntikarmakriyāsu ca ..
ācāryavihitaḥ kalpastasmāccakṣa iti smṛtaḥ .. .. 3 ..
2.2.d:
तेषां संस्कारयागेषु शान्तिकर्मक्रियासु च ॥
आचार्यविहितः कल्पस्तस्माच्चक्ष इति स्मृतः ॥ ॥ 3 ॥
2.2.m: In their rites of passage, sacrifices, and rites of pacification, / the procedure is prescribed by the preceptor; therefore it is remembered as Dakṣa.

2.2.s:
trikuśaṃ parigṛhṇāti tataśca kurute dṛḍham ..
ṛṣirdakṣaśca jagatī chando viṣṇuśca devatā ..4..
2.2.d:
त्रिकुशं परिगृह्णाति ततश्च कुरुते दृढम् ॥
ऋषिर्दक्षश्च जगती छन्दो विष्णुश्च देवता ॥4॥
2.2.m: He takes up three blades of kuśa grass and then makes them firm. / The seer is Dakṣa, the metre is Jagatī, and the deity is Viṣṇu.

2.2.s:
kaśyapastṛpyatāmiti bhūrasīti ca śodhanam ..
ṛṣiḥ suvarṇa gāyatrī jagatī chanda iṣyate ..
devatā ca bhavetsūryaḥ pṛthivīśodhane nyaset .. 5 ..
2.2.d:
कश्यपस्तृप्यतामिति भूरसीति च शोधनम् ॥
ऋषिः सुवर्ण गायत्री जगती छन्द इष्यते ॥
देवता च भवेत्सूर्यः पृथिवीशोधने न्यसेत् ॥ 5 ॥
2.2.m: The purification is with "May Kaśyapa be satisfied" and "You are the earth". / Suvarṇa is the seer, Gāyatrī and Jagatī are the approved metres, / and Sūrya is the deity; one should apply them in the purification of the earth.

2.2.s:
aiśānyādikrameṇaiva prādakṣiṇyena yatnataḥ ..
yatpavitreti maṃtreṇa tarjanyaṃguṣṭhayorapi .. 6 ..
2.2.d:
ऐशान्यादिक्रमेणैव प्रादक्षिण्येन यत्नतः ॥
यत्पवित्रेति मंत्रेण तर्जन्यंगुष्ठयोरपि ॥ 6 ॥
2.2.m: Beginning with the northeast, proceeding clockwise with care, / with the mantra "That which is a purifier", using the forefinger and thumb,

2.2.s:
kuśagarbhatrayeṇāpi bhrāmayedvalayākṛti ..
parisamūhanamityuktaṃ snapanaṃ śṛṇu sattama .. 7 ..
2.2.d:
कुशगर्भत्रयेणापि भ्रामयेद्वलयाकृति ॥
परिसमूहनमित्युक्तं स्नपनं शृणु सत्तम ॥ 7 ॥
2.2.m: and with three inner blades of kuśa, he should turn it in the shape of a circle. / This is called sweeping around. Listen to the ablution, O best of men.

2.2.s:
īśānādeśca saṃskāraṃ kuryātparisamūhanam ..
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ caretyādinairṛtyādigrahaṃ makhe .. 8 ..
2.2.d:
ईशानादेश्च संस्कारं कुर्यात्परिसमूहनम् ॥
प्रतिष्ठायां चरेत्यादिनैरृत्यादिग्रहं मखे ॥ 8 ॥
2.2.m: He should perform the consecration by sweeping around starting from the northeast. / In the establishment, one should proceed with "Car..." and so forth, seizing from the southwest and other [directions] in the sacrifice.

2.2.s:
parisamūhanamaindrasya parvato'sya ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ ..
paṃkticchandaḥ samuddiṣṭamindrāṇī cāsya devatā .. 9 ..
2.2.d:
परिसमूहनमैन्द्रस्य पर्वतोऽस्य ऋषिः स्मृतः ॥
पंक्तिच्छन्दः समुद्दिष्टमिन्द्राणी चास्य देवता ॥ 9 ॥
2.2.m: Parvata is remembered as the seer of the sweeping around belonging to Indra; / the metre is declared to be Paṅkti, and Indrāṇī is its deity.

2.2.s:
gomayaṃ ca trigaṃdhaṃ ca paṃcamūrtikayāpi ca ..
kaniṣṭhaṃ guhyakaṃ tyaktvā devatārthe na lepayet .. 2.2.13.10 ..
2.2.d:
गोमयं च त्रिगंधं च पंचमूर्तिकयापि च ॥
कनिष्ठं गुह्यकं त्यक्त्वा देवतार्थे न लेपयेत् ॥ 2.2.13.10 ॥
2.2.m: Cow dung, three perfumes, and with five kinds of clay; / omitting the little finger and the thumb, he should not smear it for the sake of the deity.

2.2.s:
mānastokeneti ṛcā viśvedevaśca pūjyatām ..
ṛṣiḥ syātkāśyapacchando viśvadevaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 11 ..
2.2.d:
मानस्तोकेनेति ऋचा विश्वेदेवश्च पूज्यताम् ॥
ऋषिः स्यात्काश्यपच्छन्दो विश्वदेवः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 11 ॥
2.2.m: And let the Viśvedevas be worshipped with the verse "Mā nastoke". / The seer is Kāśyapa, the metre is declared, and Viśvadeva is [the deity].

2.2.s:
yojayellepayedvidvānghaṭamābaddhya sattamāḥ ..
madhyamātarjanībhyāṃ ca kuśamārabhya dakṣiṇam .. 12 ..
2.2.d:
योजयेल्लेपयेद्विद्वान्घटमाबद्ध्य सत्तमाः ॥
मध्यमातर्जनीभ्यां च कुशमारभ्य दक्षिणम् ॥ 12 ॥
2.2.m: The wise man, having tied a pot, should apply and smear, O best of men, / with the middle and forefingers, beginning with the right kuśa grass.

2.2.s:
caturastrīkṛte kṣetraṃ hastamānaṃ tathānanam ..
yajvabhiriti mantreṇa sūryaḥ prīṇāti sattamāḥ .. 13 ..
2.2.d:
चतुरस्त्रीकृते क्षेत्रं हस्तमानं तथाननम् ॥
यज्वभिरिति मन्त्रेण सूर्यः प्रीणाति सत्तमाः ॥ 13 ॥
2.2.m: When the field is made square, one cubit in measure and likewise its mouth, / Sūrya is pleased through the mantra beginning with "yajvabhiḥ", O best of men.

2.2.s:
dakṣe sārdhāṃgulaṃ tyaktvā paścimena parityajet ..
uttarāgrāṃ likhedrekhāmanyathā'maṃgalaṃ bhavet .. 14 ..
2.2.d:
दक्षे सार्धांगुलं त्यक्त्वा पश्चिमेन परित्यजेत् ॥
उत्तराग्रां लिखेद्रेखामन्यथाऽमंगलं भवेत् ॥ 14 ॥
2.2.m: Leaving one and a half fingers on the right and leaving [the space] to the west, / he should draw a line with its tip to the north; otherwise, it would be inauspicious.

2.2.s:
āpyāyasveti mantrasya dhanvatari ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ ..
triṣṭupchandaḥ samākhyātaṃ savitā cātra devatā .. 15 ..
2.2.d:
आप्यायस्वेति मन्त्रस्य धन्वतरि ऋषिः स्मृतः ॥
त्रिष्टुप्छन्दः समाख्यातं सविता चात्र देवता ॥ 15 ॥
2.2.m: For the mantra "āpyāyasva", Dhanvantari is remembered as the ṛṣi; / the metre is declared to be Triṣṭubh, and Savitṛ is the deity here.

2.2.s:
tallagnaṃ dakṣiṇe caikaṃ pūrvārddhadvādaśāṅgulam ..
anyāṃgulāṃtaraṃ caikaṃ tataḥ saptāṃgulaṃ bhavet .. 16 ..
2.2.d:
तल्लग्नं दक्षिणे चैकं पूर्वार्द्धद्वादशाङ्गुलम् ॥
अन्यांगुलांतरं चैकं ततः सप्तांगुलं भवेत् ॥ 16 ॥
2.2.m: Adjoining that, on the right, [there should be] one [line] twelve fingers long in the eastern half; / another with an interval of a finger, and then [one] seven fingers long.

2.2.s:
kuśamūlena svarṇena pratiṣṭhāyāṃ ca rājate ..
aṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ ca saṃjyotīti ca saṃjapan .. 17 ..
2.2.d:
कुशमूलेन स्वर्णेन प्रतिष्ठायां च राजते ॥
अंगुष्ठानामिकाभ्यां च संज्योतीति च संजपन् ॥ 17 ॥
2.2.m: With the root of kuśa grass or with gold, and [made] of silver during a consecration, / using the thumb and the ring finger, while muttering "saṃ jyotiḥ",

2.2.s:
saṃsmarenmitrā varuṇau ṛṣirautathyasaṃjñakaḥ ..
paṃktiśchandaḥ śivo devo rekhāmatha ca yojayet .. 18 ..
2.2.d:
संस्मरेन्मित्रा वरुणौ ऋषिरौतथ्यसंज्ञकः ॥
पंक्तिश्छन्दः शिवो देवो रेखामथ च योजयेत् ॥ 18 ॥
2.2.m: he should remember Mitra and Varuṇa; the ṛṣi is named Autathya, / the metre is Paṅkti, the deity is Śiva; and then he should draw the line.

2.2.s:
tenaivorddhvakarau kuryāddakṣavāme sakṛtsakṛt ..
bhāsvarāya kṣipedagnau tata ūrdhvaṃ raṇaṃ smṛtam .. 19 ..
2.2.d:
तेनैवोर्द्ध्वकरौ कुर्याद्दक्षवामे सकृत्सकृत् ॥
भास्वराय क्षिपेदग्नौ तत ऊर्ध्वं रणं स्मृतम् ॥ 19 ॥
2.2.m: With that very [implement] he should raise his hands once to the right and once to the left; / he should cast [it] into the fire for Bhāsvara; after that, an offering is prescribed.

2.2.s:
sadasaṃpadṛṣiḥ karṇo virāḍiti udāhṛtaḥ ..
chanda indro devatā ca pṛthivyā devatā bhavet .. 2.2.13.20 ..
2.2.d:
सदसंपदृषिः कर्णो विराडिति उदाहृतः ॥
छन्द इन्द्रो देवता च पृथिव्या देवता भवेत् ॥ 2.2.13.20 ॥
2.2.m: For "sadasaspatiḥ", the ṛṣi is Karṇa, spoken of as Virāj; / Indra is the metre and the deity, and the Earth is the deity.

2.2.s:
kuśapuṣpodakenāpi devatīrthena sattamāḥ ..
paṃcagavyena matimānpañcaratnodakena ca ..
pañcapallavatoyena mahāyoge viśeṣataḥ .. 21 ..
2.2.d:
कुशपुष्पोदकेनापि देवतीर्थेन सत्तमाः ॥
पंचगव्येन मतिमान्पञ्चरत्नोदकेन च ॥
पञ्चपल्लवतोयेन महायोगे विशेषतः ॥ 21 ॥
2.2.m: With water containing kuśa grass and flowers, with the tīrtha of the gods, O best of men, / with pañcagavya, with water containing the five gems, / and especially with water of the five sprouts in the great conjunction, the wise man [should sprinkle it].

2.2.s:
athonasya ca mantrasya variṣṭhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ..
chando'tha devī gāyatrī devatā gaṇanāyakaḥ .. 22 ..
2.2.d:
अथोनस्य च मन्त्रस्य वरिष्ठः परिकीर्तितः ॥
छन्दोऽथ देवी गायत्री देवता गणनायकः ॥ 22 ॥
2.2.m: And for the mantra beginning with "atha unaḥ", Variṣṭha is proclaimed [as the ṛṣi]; / the metre is the divine Gāyatrī, and the deity is Gaṇanāyaka.

2.2.s:
kīśādagniṃ samādāya me gṛhṇāmīti saṃpaṭhan ..
me gṛhṇāmīti maṃtrasya ṛṣirgautama īritaḥ ..
chandonuṣṭupsamākhyātaṃ vāmadevo'tha devatā .. 23 ..
2.2.d:
कीशादग्निं समादाय मे गृह्णामीति संपठन् ॥
मे गृह्णामीति मंत्रस्य ऋषिर्गौतम ईरितः ॥
छन्दोनुष्टुप्समाख्यातं वामदेवोऽथ देवता ॥ 23 ॥
2.2.m: Taking the fire from the kīśa, reciting "me gṛhṇāmi"— / for the mantra "me gṛhṇāmi", Gautama is declared as the ṛṣi, / the metre is declared as Anuṣṭubh, and Vāmadeva is the deity.

2.2.s:
kravyādagniṃ parityajya kravyādamagnimīrayan ..
mantreṇānena matimāndakṣiṇasyāṃ vinikṣipet .. 24 ..
2.2.d:
क्रव्यादग्निं परित्यज्य क्रव्यादमग्निमीरयन् ॥
मन्त्रेणानेन मतिमान्दक्षिणस्यां विनिक्षिपेत् ॥ 24 ॥
2.2.m: Discarding the corpse-devouring fire while uttering "kravyādam agnim", / the wise man should cast it away to the south with this mantra.

2.2.s:
asya mantrasya hārīta ṛṣiḥ syācchanda iṣyate ..
devatā vāmadevo'pi dāhepi viniyojayet .. 25 ..
2.2.d:
अस्य मन्त्रस्य हारीत ऋषिः स्याच्छन्द इष्यते ॥
देवता वामदेवोऽपि दाहेपि विनियोजयेत् ॥ 25 ॥
2.2.m: For this mantra, Hārīta is the ṛṣi, the metre is desired [as described], / and the deity is Vāmadeva; he should also employ it in cremation.

2.2.s:
āvāhanaṃ tataḥ kuryātsaṃsarakṣeti saṃjapan..
saṃsarakṣeti maṃtrasya ṛṣirnīla udāhṛtaḥ ..
virāṭ chando'tha vijñeyo devatā ca śatakratuḥ .. 26 ..
2.2.d:
आवाहनं ततः कुर्यात्संसरक्षेति संजपन्॥
संसरक्षेति मंत्रस्य ऋषिर्नील उदाहृतः ॥
विराट् छन्दोऽथ विज्ञेयो देवता च शतक्रतुः ॥ 26 ॥
2.2.m: Then he should perform the invocation while muttering "saṃsarakṣa"; / for the mantra "saṃsarakṣa", Nīla is declared as the ṛṣi, / Virāj is to be known as the metre, and Śatakratu is the deity.

2.2.s:
vaiśvānara iti ṛcā agnisthāpanamīritam..
maṃtramācāti prīṇāti ṛṣiḥ syātkāśyapaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
anuṣṭup ca bhavecchando devatā havyavāhanaḥ .. 27 ..
2.2.d:
वैश्वानर इति ऋचा अग्निस्थापनमीरितम्॥
मंत्रमाचाति प्रीणाति ऋषिः स्यात्काश्यपः स्मृतः ॥
अनुष्टुप् च भवेच्छन्दो देवता हव्यवाहनः ॥ 27 ॥
2.2.m: The installation of the fire is proclaimed with the verse "vaiśvānara"; / he pleases [the fire] by reciting the mantra; Kāśyapa is remembered as the ṛṣi, / Anuṣṭubh is the metre, and Havyavāhana is the deity.

2.2.s:
badhnāsīti ca maṃtreṇa agniṃ kuryātpradakṣiṇam ..
ṛṣiḥ svayaṃbhūrākhyāto virāṭchanda udāhṛtam ..
devatā paramātmā ca namaskāreṇa yojayet .. .. 28 ..
2.2.d:
बध्नासीति च मंत्रेण अग्निं कुर्यात्प्रदक्षिणम् ॥
ऋषिः स्वयंभूराख्यातो विराट्छन्द उदाहृतम् ॥
देवता परमात्मा च नमस्कारेण योजयेत् ॥ ॥ 28 ॥
2.2.m: With the mantra "badhnāsi", he should circumambulate the fire; / the ṛṣi is declared as Svayambhū, Virāj is proclaimed as the metre, / and the deity is the Supreme Self; he should accompany it with a bow.

2.2.s:
tatognidakṣiṇe bhāge prāgagrakuśakubjake ..
dvihaste bhavataścaiva hastapānāsane atha .. 29 ..
2.2.d:
ततोग्निदक्षिणे भागे प्रागग्रकुशकुब्जके ॥
द्विहस्ते भवतश्चैव हस्तपानासने अथ ॥ 29 ॥
2.2.m: Then, on the southern side of the fire, upon kuśa grass curved with tips pointing east, / two cubits [in size] there should be, and then a seat placed by hand.

2.2.s:
brahmannihopaveśyatāmiti brahmāṇaṃ viniveśayet ..
brahmayajñānṛcā dogdhrī dhenuriti tvṛcā ..2.2.13.30..
2.2.d:
ब्रह्मन्निहोपवेश्यतामिति ब्रह्माणं विनिवेशयेत् ॥
ब्रह्मयज्ञानृचा दोग्ध्री धेनुरिति त्वृचा ॥2.2.13.30॥
2.2.m: "O Brahmā, be seated here"—with this he should seat Brahmā; / with the verse "brahmayajñān" and with the verse "dogdhrī dhenuḥ",

2.2.s:
dvābhyāmiti ca mantrābhyāmiti brahmapraveśanam..
śakro'sya trāyatāmeti śṛṇu ṛgbhyāmṛṣīdvijāḥ ..31..
2.2.d:
द्वाभ्यामिति च मन्त्राभ्यामिति ब्रह्मप्रवेशनम्॥
शक्रोऽस्य त्रायतामेति शृणु ऋग्भ्यामृषीद्विजाः ॥31॥
2.2.m: with these two mantras, the entry of Brahmā takes place; / "May Śakra protect him"—listen to the ṛṣis of the two verses, O twice-born.

2.2.s:
prajāpatirṛṣiśchandastriṣṭubdevo'tha śaṃkaraḥ ..
nāradaśca ṛṣiśchandastriṣṭubdevaḥ śacīpatiḥ .. 32 ..
2.2.d:
प्रजापतिरृषिश्छन्दस्त्रिष्टुब्देवोऽथ शंकरः ॥
नारदश्च ऋषिश्छन्दस्त्रिष्टुब्देवः शचीपतिः ॥ 32 ॥
2.2.m: Prajāpati is the ṛṣi, the metre is Triṣṭubh, and the deity is Śaṅkara; / and Nārada is the ṛṣi, the metre is Triṣṭubh, and the deity is the lord of Śacī.

2.2.s:
agneruttarabhāge ca hastamānāṃtarepi ca ..
praṇītā sthāpanaṃ kuryāddina ehīti saṃjapan.. 33 ..
2.2.d:
अग्नेरुत्तरभागे च हस्तमानांतरेपि च ॥
प्रणीता स्थापनं कुर्याद्दिन एहीति संजपन्॥ 33 ॥
2.2.m: And on the northern side of the fire, at a distance of one cubit, / he should place the praṇītā vessel while muttering "dina ehi".

2.2.s:
mantrasya ca ṛṣiśchando vāmadevaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
jagatī ca bhavecchando devatā ca śatakratuḥ .. 34 ..
2.2.d:
मन्त्रस्य च ऋषिश्छन्दो वामदेवः प्रकीर्तितः ॥
जगती च भवेच्छन्दो देवता च शतक्रतुः ॥ 34 ॥
2.2.m: The ṛṣi of the mantra is proclaimed to be Vāmadeva, / the metre is Jagatī, and the deity is Śatakratu.

2.2.s:
śrīparṇīsahakārotthaṃ varuṇasya viśeṣataḥ ..
ṣaḍaṃgulena vistāraṃ viṃśatyaṃgulakena ca .. 35 ..
2.2.d:
श्रीपर्णीसहकारोत्थं वरुणस्य विशेषतः ॥
षडंगुलेन विस्तारं विंशत्यंगुलकेन च ॥ 35 ॥
2.2.m: Made of śrīparṇī or sahakāra wood, especially for Varuṇa, / six fingers in breadth, and twenty fingers

2.2.s:
dairghyeṇa ca catuḥkhyātakāṃgulaṃ ca pramāṇataḥ ..
dvyaṃgule carakākāyāmāsāsandevakarmaṇi .. 36 ..
2.2.d:
दैर्घ्येण च चतुःख्यातकांगुलं च प्रमाणतः ॥
द्व्यंगुले चरकाकायामासासन्देवकर्मणि ॥ 36 ॥
2.2.m: in length, and four fingers in height by measure; / [or] two fingers [high], of round shape, seated in the divine rite.

2.2.s:
abhicāre bhavetkāṃsyaṃ tāmraṃ syācchāṃtikarmaṇi ..
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ mṛnmayaṃ ca aṣṭāṃgulamathāpi vā .. 37 ..
2.2.d:
अभिचारे भवेत्कांस्यं ताम्रं स्याच्छांतिकर्मणि ॥
प्रतिष्ठायां मृन्मयं च अष्टांगुलमथापि वा ॥ 37 ॥
2.2.m: In sorcery it should be of bell-metal; it should be copper in a pacificatory rite; / in a consecration, of clay, or eight fingers [wide],

2.2.s:
dvādaśāṃgulaprastāraṃ taijasaṃ mānavarjitam..
imaṃ me varuṇenarcā praṇītāmatha pūrayet .. 38 ..
2.2.d:
द्वादशांगुलप्रस्तारं तैजसं मानवर्जितम्॥
इमं मे वरुणेनर्चा प्रणीतामथ पूरयेत् ॥ 38 ॥
2.2.m: with a width of twelve fingers, [or] metallic without measure; / he should then fill the praṇītā vessel with the verse "imaṃ me varuṇa".

2.2.s:
sāgarā atha prīyaṃtāmitthamādhyānamācaret ..
sakṛdacchinnadarbheṇa digvidikṣu paristaret .. 39 ..
2.2.d:
सागरा अथ प्रीयंतामित्थमाध्यानमाचरेत् ॥
सकृदच्छिन्नदर्भेण दिग्विदिक्षु परिस्तरेत् ॥ 39 ॥
2.2.m: "May the oceans be pleased"—thus he should meditate; / he should strew [the area] in the cardinal and intermediate directions with darbha grass cut once.

2.2.s:
nairṛte dikṣu sītaḥ syādvaiśvadeve tathaiva ca ..
kayā naścitra ityṛcā nāgaḥ prīṇāti sattamāḥ .. 2.2.13.40 ..
2.2.d:
नैरृते दिक्षु सीतः स्याद्वैश्वदेवे तथैव च ॥
कया नश्चित्र इत्यृचा नागः प्रीणाति सत्तमाः ॥ 2.2.13.40 ॥
2.2.m: In the south-western directions it should be white, and likewise in the Vaiśvadeva; / with the verse "kayā naś citraḥ", the serpent is pleased, O best of men.

2.2.s:
asya maṃtrasya ca ṛṣirbharadvāja udāhṛtaḥ ..
chando'nuṣṭubdevatā ca īśānaḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 41 ..
2.2.d:
अस्य मंत्रस्य च ऋषिर्भरद्वाज उदाहृतः ॥
छन्दोऽनुष्टुब्देवता च ईशानः परिकीर्तितः ॥ 41 ॥
2.2.m: For this mantra, Bharadvāja is declared as the ṛṣi, / the metre is Anuṣṭubh, and the deity is proclaimed to be Īśāna.

2.2.s:
prayojanādikaṃ dravyaṃ tata āsādayetkramāt ..
dakṣiṇādi uttarāṃtaṃ dhuvāsa ityṛcāpi ca .. 42 ..
2.2.d:
प्रयोजनादिकं द्रव्यं तत आसादयेत्क्रमात् ॥
दक्षिणादि उत्तरांतं धुवास इत्यृचापि च ॥ 42 ॥
2.2.m: Then he should set down the requisite substances in order, / from the south ending at the north, also with the verse "dhuvāsa".

2.2.s:
ṛṣiḥ syānnāradaśchandonuṣṭupcaivātha devatā ..
śatakratuśca prīṇāti yojayedatha sādarāt .. 43 ..
2.2.d:
ऋषिः स्यान्नारदश्छन्दोनुष्टुप्चैवाथ देवता ॥
शतक्रतुश्च प्रीणाति योजयेदथ सादरात् ॥ 43 ॥
2.2.m: The ṛṣi is Nārada, the metre is Anuṣṭubh, and the deity / Śatakratu is pleased; he should employ it with reverence.

2.2.s:
kāṣṭhaṃ ca paścime kuryātprayacchanpaścimena tu ..
purato'nnaṃ pañcavrīhīstilāśca sahasarṣapān .. 44 ..
2.2.d:
काष्ठं च पश्चिमे कुर्यात्प्रयच्छन्पश्चिमेन तु ॥
पुरतोऽन्नं पञ्चव्रीहीस्तिलाश्च सहसर्षपान् ॥ 44 ॥
2.2.m: He should place the firewood in the west, offering it from the west; / in front, food, the five grains, sesamum seeds together with mustard seeds,

2.2.s:
dakṣiṇe caiva āpūpaṃ bhṛṃgarājaṃ tathaiva ca ..
phalapatre vāmabhāge piṣṭakaṃ dadhi dugdhakam .. 45 ..
2.2.d:
दक्षिणे चैव आपूपं भृंगराजं तथैव च ॥
फलपत्रे वामभागे पिष्टकं दधि दुग्धकम् ॥ 45 ॥
2.2.m: and on the right cake and also bhṛṅgarāja; / on the left side, fruits and leaves, pastry, curd, and milk,

2.2.s:
panasaṃ nārikelaṃ ca modakaṃ laḍḍukaṃ tathā ..
praṇītāṃ ca digvidikṣu sthāpayedavicārayan .. 46 ..
2.2.d:
पनसं नारिकेलं च मोदकं लड्डुकं तथा ॥
प्रणीतां च दिग्विदिक्षु स्थापयेदविचारयन् ॥ 46 ॥
2.2.m: jackfruit, coconut, modaka sweets, and likewise laddu; / and without hesitation he should place the praṇītā vessel in the directions and intermediate directions.

2.2.s:
praṇītāṃ na spṛśejjātu homakāle kathaṃcana ..
snānakuṃbhaṃ ca bho viprā yāvadyāgaḥ pravartate .. 47 ..
2.2.d:
प्रणीतां न स्पृशेज्जातु होमकाले कथंचन ॥
स्नानकुंभं च भो विप्रा यावद्यागः प्रवर्तते ॥ 47 ॥
2.2.m: He must never touch the praṇītā vessel at the time of the homa under any circumstance, / nor the bathing pot, O brāhmaṇas, as long as the sacrifice proceeds.

2.2.s:
uccīrakaṃ mātuliṃgaṃ dūrvāṃ dhātrīphalāni ca ..
tulasīmālatījātī jalajāni viśeṣataḥ .. 48 ..
2.2.d:
उच्चीरकं मातुलिंगं दूर्वां धात्रीफलानि च ॥
तुलसीमालतीजाती जलजानि विशेषतः ॥ 48 ॥
2.2.m: Uccīraka, mātuliṅga, dūrvā grass, dhātrī fruits, / tulasī, mālatī, jasmine, and especially aquatic flowers,

2.2.s:
aiśānyāṃ sthāpayetsarvaṃ yacca vai kaṃkatīmayam ..
nairṛtyeti viśeṣoyaṃ yacca vaikaṃkatī śamī .. 49 ..
2.2.d:
ऐशान्यां स्थापयेत्सर्वं यच्च वै कंकतीमयम् ॥
नैरृत्येति विशेषोयं यच्च वैकंकती शमी ॥ 49 ॥
2.2.m: he should place everything in the north-east, and whatever is made of kaṅkatī wood; / in the south-west—this is the distinction—whatever is of vikaṅkata and śamī wood.

2.2.s:
yathāyogena tatsarvaṃ grāhyaṃ tatpatrameva ca ..
kṣīrapāke tu kṣīrāṃte carusthālīmathānayet .. 2.2.13.50 ..
2.2.d:
यथायोगेन तत्सर्वं ग्राह्यं तत्पत्रमेव च ॥
क्षीरपाके तु क्षीरांते चरुस्थालीमथानयेत् ॥ 2.2.13.50 ॥
2.2.m: All that should be taken appropriately, and its leaves as well; / when cooking with milk, after the milk [is boiled], he should then bring the pot for the caru.

2.2.s:
pavivacchedanakuśaiśchiṃdyātprādeśikaṃ punaḥ ..
chittvā pavitraṃ prokṣaṇyāṃ sthāpayedbalabhidāmrakam .. 51 ..
2.2.d:
पविवच्छेदनकुशैश्छिंद्यात्प्रादेशिकं पुनः ॥
छित्त्वा पवित्रं प्रोक्षण्यां स्थापयेद्बलभिदाम्रकम् ॥ 51 ॥
2.2.m: With kuśa grass for cutting the purifier, he should cut [a blade] of a span's length; / having cut the purifier, he should place the Balabhid mango leaf in the sprinkling vessel.

2.2.s:
viṣṇo rarāṭamaṃtreṇa chedayedagrabhāgataḥ ..
