pāyasena kāṭhinena pramathnīyātkadācana .. 52 ..
2.2.d:
विष्णो रराटमंत्रेण छेदयेदग्रभागतः ॥
पायसेन काठिनेन प्रमथ्नीयात्कदाचन ॥ 52 ॥
2.2.m: With the mantra "viṣṇo rarāṭam", he should cut it from the tip; / he should never stir it with firm milk-rice,

2.2.s:
na rasena na kārṣṇena na dṛḍhena kadācana ..
tāmreṇa bhasmanā cātha śuktiśaṃkhena vāgyataḥ ..53..
2.2.d:
न रसेन न कार्ष्णेन न दृढेन कदाचन ॥
ताम्रेण भस्मना चाथ शुक्तिशंखेन वाग्यतः ॥53॥
2.2.m: nor with juice, nor with iron, nor ever with something harsh; / [he should clean it] with copper, ash, and with a pearl oyster shell or conch, restrained in speech.

2.2.s:
chedayetpiñjulīṃ cāpi pavitramatha deśikaḥ..
viṣṇo rarāṭamaṃtrasya hārītaśca ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ .. 54 ..
2.2.d:
छेदयेत्पिञ्जुलीं चापि पवित्रमथ देशिकः॥
विष्णो रराटमंत्रस्य हारीतश्च ऋषिः स्मृतः ॥ 54 ॥
2.2.m:
The spiritual teacher should also cut the bunch of grass and the purifying strainer.
The seer of the mantra 'viṣṇo rarāṭam' is remembered as Hārīta;

2.2.s:
paṃktiśchaṃdo bhaveddevaḥ saṃskāre viniyojayet ..
praṇītābhājanaṃ gṛhya prokṣaṇīṃ pūrayettribhiḥ .. 55 ..
2.2.d:
पंक्तिश्छंदो भवेद्देवः संस्कारे विनियोजयेत् ॥
प्रणीताभाजनं गृह्य प्रोक्षणीं पूरयेत्त्रिभिः ॥ 55 ॥
2.2.m:
the meter is paṅkti, and he should employ it in the consecration of the deity.
Taking the praṇītā vessel, he should fill the prokṣaṇī vessel in three [pours].

2.2.s:
kāyatīrthena tatkuryāddevatīrthena cetyapi ..
vāmahastatale paścātsthāpayetprokṣaṇīyakam .. 56 ..
2.2.d:
कायतीर्थेन तत्कुर्याद्देवतीर्थेन चेत्यपि ॥
वामहस्ततले पश्चात्स्थापयेत्प्रोक्षणीयकम् ॥ 56 ॥
2.2.m:
He should do that through the tīrtha of Ka (Prajāpati) or through the tīrtha of the gods.
Afterwards, he should place the prokṣaṇī vessel upon the palm of his left hand.

2.2.s:
madhyamāmadhyamāṃguṣṭha apāmārgeṇa maṃtribhiḥ ..
uttānaṃ tatpavitraṃ ca pavitraṃ teti saṃjapan .. 57 ..
2.2.d:
मध्यमामध्यमांगुष्ठ अपामार्गेण मंत्रिभिः ॥
उत्तानं तत्पवित्रं च पवित्रं तेति संजपन् ॥ 57 ॥
2.2.m:
With the middle fingers and thumbs [holding] with Apāmārga, the mantras
recited while keeping that purifying strainer upward, murmuring 'pavitraṃ te':

2.2.s:
ṛṣiḥ syādgautamaśchando dharmarājo'tha devatā ..
atha sthāpitadravyāṇi prokṣayetsthāpayetkramāt .. 58 ..
2.2.d:
ऋषिः स्याद्गौतमश्छन्दो धर्मराजोऽथ देवता ॥
अथ स्थापितद्रव्याणि प्रोक्षयेत्स्थापयेत्क्रमात् ॥ 58 ॥
2.2.m:
The seer is Gautama, the meter is [triṣṭubh], and the deity is Dharmarāja.
Then he should sprinkle the arranged materials and place them in due order:

2.2.s:
sakṛddravye tribhiḥ kāṣṭhaistrivāraṃ maṃtrapuṣpakaiḥ ..
sthirasthāne tu saṃprāptapraṇītāyāśca dakṣiṇe .. 59 ..
2.2.d:
सकृद्द्रव्ये त्रिभिः काष्ठैस्त्रिवारं मंत्रपुष्पकैः ॥
स्थिरस्थाने तु संप्राप्तप्रणीतायाश्च दक्षिणे ॥ 59 ॥
2.2.m:
once upon the articles, with three pieces of wood, [and] thrice with flowers accompanied by mantras.
In a stable place, to the south of the praṇītā vessel that has been positioned,

2.2.s:
prādeśāṃtarataścaiva ājyasthālīmathārpayet ..
agrato maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā vahniṃ vipre tu sthāpayet .. 2.2.13.60 ..
2.2.d:
प्रादेशांतरतश्चैव आज्यस्थालीमथार्पयेत् ॥
अग्रतो मण्डलं कृत्वा वह्निं विप्रे तु स्थापयेत् ॥ 2.2.13.60 ॥
2.2.m:
at a span's distance, he should place the ghee-pan.
Having made a diagram in front, he should establish the fire, O brāhmaṇa.

2.2.s:
dyūtaṃ niḥsārayettattu nirūpyāśu krameṇa tu ..
īśāneti ca maṃtreṇa adhiśrapaṇamīritam ..61..
2.2.d:
द्यूतं निःसारयेत्तत्तु निरूप्याशु क्रमेण तु ॥
ईशानेति च मंत्रेण अधिश्रपणमीरितम् ॥61॥
2.2.m:
Having inspected it swiftly in due order, he should remove the dust.
With the mantra 'īśāna...', placing [the vessel] on the fire is enjoined.

2.2.s:
ṛṣirnārāyaṇaśchandaḥ paṃktirīśo'tha devatā..
paryagnikaraṇaṃ kuryādādarāddvayamapyatha .. 62 ..
2.2.d:
ऋषिर्नारायणश्छन्दः पंक्तिरीशोऽथ देवता॥
पर्यग्निकरणं कुर्यादादराद्द्वयमप्यथ ॥ 62 ॥
2.2.m:
The seer is Nārāyaṇa, the meter is paṅkti, and the deity is Īśa.
He should then attentively carry out the encircling with fire for both [vessels].

2.2.s:
avekṣya īśamārabhya dakṣiṇāvartakena tu ..
kulāyanīti maṃtreṇa ṛṣicchandādikaṃ smaran .. 63 ..
2.2.d:
अवेक्ष्य ईशमारभ्य दक्षिणावर्तकेन तु ॥
कुलायनीति मंत्रेण ऋषिच्छन्दादिकं स्मरन् ॥ 63 ॥
2.2.m:
Having inspected [it] beginning from the northeast in a clockwise direction,
with the mantra 'kulāyani...', remembering the seer, meter, and so forth,

2.2.s:
pariveṣyājyasthālīṃ ca triḥ sakṛdvā samāhitaḥ ..
pitarastṛpyatāmiti saṃskāre mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ .. 64 ..
2.2.d:
परिवेष्याज्यस्थालीं च त्रिः सकृद्वा समाहितः ॥
पितरस्तृप्यतामिति संस्कारे मातरः स्मृताः ॥ 64 ॥
2.2.m:
focused in mind, he should surround the ghee-pan thrice or once.
Reciting 'pitaras tṛpyatām', the Mothers are remembered in the consecration.

2.2.s:
ṛṣiḥ syājjamadagniśca gāyatrī chanda īritam ..
devatā ca pinākī syādagniṣṭome ca yojayet .. 65 ..
2.2.d:
ऋषिः स्याज्जमदग्निश्च गायत्री छन्द ईरितम् ॥
देवता च पिनाकी स्यादग्निष्टोमे च योजयेत् ॥ 65 ॥
2.2.m:
The seer is Jamadagni, the meter is stated to be gāyatrī,
and the deity is Pinākin; he should employ it in the Agniṣṭoma.

2.2.s:
ghṛtasya ca tathā tvaṃ no brahmā vai tṛpyatāmiti ..
ṣaḍaṃgulaṃ sruvaṃ paścādgṛhītvāgnau pratapya ca .. 66 ..
2.2.d:
घृतस्य च तथा त्वं नो ब्रह्मा वै तृप्यतामिति ॥
षडंगुलं स्रुवं पश्चाद्गृहीत्वाग्नौ प्रतप्य च ॥ 66 ॥
2.2.m:
And likewise of the clarified butter, 'tvaṃ no...' and 'brahmā vai tṛpyatām'.
Afterwards, having taken a six-finger sruva and heated it over the fire—

2.2.s:
trirātraṃ tu mahāyoge sakṛdanyatra sattamāḥ ..
saṃmārjayetkuśenāpi mūlādagraṃ tu secayet .. 67 ..
2.2.d:
त्रिरात्रं तु महायोगे सकृदन्यत्र सत्तमाः ॥
संमार्जयेत्कुशेनापि मूलादग्रं तु सेचयेत् ॥ 67 ॥
2.2.m:
for three nights in a great rite, but only once elsewhere, O best of men—
he should wipe it with kuśa grass and sprinkle it from the root to the tip.

2.2.s:
agrānmūlaṃ punaḥ kuryātsaṃpūjya ca punaḥ punaḥ ..
tribhistribhiḥ praṇītode prokṣayettadanaṃtaram .. 68 ..
2.2.d:
अग्रान्मूलं पुनः कुर्यात्संपूज्य च पुनः पुनः ॥
त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः प्रणीतोदे प्रोक्षयेत्तदनंतरम् ॥ 68 ॥
2.2.m:
He should do so again from the tip to the root, worshipping it again and again.
Immediately afterwards, he should sprinkle it thrice with water from the praṇītā.

2.2.s:
bhuvaṃ punaḥ pratapyātha prokṣaṇyuttarato nyaset ..
ājyapātraṃ puraskṛtya pavitraṃ ca samāharet ..69..
2.2.d:
भुवं पुनः प्रतप्याथ प्रोक्षण्युत्तरतो न्यसेत् ॥
आज्यपात्रं पुरस्कृत्य पवित्रं च समाहरेत् ॥69॥
2.2.m:
Having heated the earth again, he should place [the sruva] north of the prokṣaṇī.
Bringing the ghee-vessel forward, he should take up the purifying strainer.

2.2.s:
aṃguṣṭhe dve anāme tu gṛhṇīyāttatpavitrakam ..
aṣṭāṃgulaṃ madhyakṛtvo ghṛtaṃ triḥ pavanaṃ caret ..2.2.13.70..
2.2.d:
अंगुष्ठे द्वे अनामे तु गृह्णीयात्तत्पवित्रकम् ॥
अष्टांगुलं मध्यकृत्वो घृतं त्रिः पवनं चरेत् ॥2.2.13.70॥
2.2.m:
He should hold that purifying strainer between both thumbs and ring fingers.
Placing [it] eight fingers in the middle, he should perform the purification of the clarified butter thrice.

2.2.s:
pātāle tristathākāśe avekṣyājyaṃ tatastribhiḥ ..
prokṣaṇyāṃ ca tathā kuryādadhaḥ saṃprokṣya deśikaḥ .. 71 ..
2.2.d:
पाताले त्रिस्तथाकाशे अवेक्ष्याज्यं ततस्त्रिभिः ॥
प्रोक्षण्यां च तथा कुर्यादधः संप्रोक्ष्य देशिकः ॥ 71 ॥
2.2.m:
Having inspected the ghee thrice downward and thrice upward in the sky,
the spiritual teacher should do the same in the prokṣaṇī vessel, sprinkling underneath.

2.2.s:
tataḥ pāyasamādāya utthāya ca samantra kam ..
tūṣṇīṃ dadyāttathā cāgnau sanniveśena tattvataḥ .. 72 ..
2.2.d:
ततः पायसमादाय उत्थाय च समन्त्र कम् ॥
तूष्णीं दद्यात्तथा चाग्नौ सन्निवेशेन तत्त्वतः ॥ 72 ॥
2.2.m:
Then, having taken the pāyasa and stood up with the mantra,
he should silently offer it into the fire with proper placement according to truth.

2.2.s:
sapavitraṃ dakṣakare gṛhītvā prokṣaṇīyakam ..
aṣṭāṃgule mūlabhāge tajjalena īśāditaḥ .. 73..
2.2.d:
सपवित्रं दक्षकरे गृहीत्वा प्रोक्षणीयकम् ॥
अष्टांगुले मूलभागे तज्जलेन ईशादितः ॥ 73॥
2.2.m:
Holding the prokṣaṇī vessel with the purifying strainer in his right hand,
with that water, for eight finger-breadths from the base, beginning from the northeast,

2.2.s:
agniṃ paryukṣayetpaścāddakṣiṇāvartakena ca ..
pavitraṃ ca praṇītāyāṃ nidhāya prokṣaṇīyakam .. 74 ..
2.2.d:
अग्निं पर्युक्षयेत्पश्चाद्दक्षिणावर्तकेन च ॥
पवित्रं च प्रणीतायां निधाय प्रोक्षणीयकम् ॥ 74 ॥
2.2.m:
he should then sprinkle around the fire in a clockwise direction.
Placing the purifying strainer and the prokṣaṇī in the praṇītā,

2.2.s:
saṃyāvārthaṃ ca bho viprā agnivattatra deśikaḥ ..
dhyāyedagniṃ raktavarṇaṃ sruvahastaṃ tribāhukam .. 75 ..
2.2.d:
संयावार्थं च भो विप्रा अग्निवत्तत्र देशिकः ॥
ध्यायेदग्निं रक्तवर्णं स्रुवहस्तं त्रिबाहुकम् ॥ 75 ॥
2.2.m:
for the sake of the flour-paste offering, O brāhmaṇas, the teacher there, becoming like fire,
should meditate upon fire as red in color, holding a sruva, having three arms,

2.2.s:
kamaṃḍaluṃ pare haste tato dakṣakareṇa tu ..
sruvaṃ gṛhītvā juhuyāttūṣṇīmeva samāhitaḥ .. 76 ..
2.2.d:
कमंडलुं परे हस्ते ततो दक्षकरेण तु ॥
स्रुवं गृहीत्वा जुहुयात्तूष्णीमेव समाहितः ॥ 76 ॥
2.2.m:
with a water-pot in his other hand. Then, with his right hand,
having taken the sruva, he should offer silently, fully concentrated.

2.2.s:
aṃte ca devatoddeśaṃ prājāpatyaṃ samīrayan ..
praṇavāṃtena juhuyātsarvatra dvijasattamāḥ .. 77 ..
2.2.d:
अंते च देवतोद्देशं प्राजापत्यं समीरयन् ॥
प्रणवांतेन जुहुयात्सर्वत्र द्विजसत्तमाः ॥ 77 ॥
2.2.m:
At the end, pronouncing the dedication to the deity sacred to Prajāpati,
he should offer ending with the praṇava everywhere, O best of the twice-born.

2.2.s:
vāyukoṇaṃ samārabhya vahnikoṇāntakena tu ..
acchinnena ghṛtenaiva indrāya tadanaṃtaram .. 78 ..
2.2.d:
वायुकोणं समारभ्य वह्निकोणान्तकेन तु ॥
अच्छिन्नेन घृतेनैव इन्द्राय तदनंतरम् ॥ 78 ॥
2.2.m:
Beginning from the northwest corner and ending at the southeast corner,
with an unbroken stream of clarified butter, he should then offer to Indra.

2.2.s:
agnīṣomātmakaṃ caiva juhuyādrākṣasāditaḥ ..
aiśānakoṇaparyaṃtaṃ tato naimittikaṃ caret .. 79 ..
2.2.d:
अग्नीषोमात्मकं चैव जुहुयाद्राक्षसादितः ॥
ऐशानकोणपर्यंतं ततो नैमित्तिकं चरेत् ॥ 79 ॥
2.2.m:
And he should offer [the portion] sacred to Agni and Soma beginning from the southwest corner
up to the northeast corner; then he should perform the occasional rite.

2.2.s:
paścātsviṣṭaṃ tato dadyāddadyācca matibhistathā ..
vāruṇaṃ pañcakaṃ caiva kṛtvā pūrṇāṃ tato labhet .. 2.2.13.80 ..
2.2.d:
पश्चात्स्विष्टं ततो दद्याद्दद्याच्च मतिभिस्तथा ॥
वारुणं पञ्चकं चैव कृत्वा पूर्णां ततो लभेत् ॥ 2.2.13.80 ॥
2.2.m:
Afterwards he should offer the sviṣṭakṛt; and he should offer according to his understanding.
Having performed the set of five rites to Varuṇa, he obtains the full offering.

2.2.s:
udvāha iti maṃtra sya atharvaṇa ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ ..
chaṃdo devī ca gāyatrī devataṃ cāpi vāruṇam .. 81 ..
2.2.d:
उद्वाह इति मंत्र स्य अथर्वण ऋषिः स्मृतः ॥
छंदो देवी च गायत्री देवतं चापि वारुणम् ॥ 81 ॥
2.2.m:
The seer of the mantra 'udvāha...' is remembered as Atharvan;
the meter is divine gāyatrī, and the deity is Varuṇa.

2.2.s:
prakṛte yojayenmantrī stutau cāpi niyojayet ..
tvannogna iti maṃtrasya ṛṣirvāśiṣṭhasaṃjñakaḥ ..
chaṃdaśca bṛhatī khyātaṃ tadevāgniḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 82 ..
2.2.d:
प्रकृते योजयेन्मन्त्री स्तुतौ चापि नियोजयेत् ॥
त्वन्नोग्न इति मंत्रस्य ऋषिर्वाशिष्ठसंज्ञकः ॥
छंदश्च बृहती ख्यातं तदेवाग्निः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 82 ॥

2.2.s:
iḍo gatamiti mantrasya ṛṣiḥ ko guhyasaṃjñakaḥ ..
chandaśca jagatī khyātaṃ devo viṣṇuḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 83 ..
2.2.d:
इडो गतमिति मन्त्रस्य ऋषिः को गुह्यसंज्ञकः ॥
छन्दश्च जगती ख्यातं देवो विष्णुः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 83 ॥
2.2.m:
The seer of the mantra 'iḍo gatam...' is the one named Guhya;
the meter is celebrated as jagatī, and the deity is proclaimed to be Viṣṇu.

2.2.s:
udvartana iti maṃtrasya ṛṣiḥ ko nu prakīrtitaḥ ..
chando devī ca gāyatrī varuṇaścādhidevatā ..84..
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe madhyamaparvaṇi dvitīyabhāge trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 13 .. ..
makhavidhānavarṇanam
2.2.d:
उद्वर्तन इति मंत्रस्य ऋषिः को नु प्रकीर्तितः ॥
छन्दो देवी च गायत्री वरुणश्चाधिदेवता ॥84॥
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे मध्यमपर्वणि द्वितीयभागे त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः ॥ 13 ॥ ॥
मखविधानवर्णनम्
2.2.m:
Who indeed is proclaimed as the seer of the mantra 'udvartana...'?
The meter is divine gāyatrī, and Varuṇa is the presiding deity.
Thus ends the thirteenth chapter in the second part of the Madhyamaparvan in the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the sacrificial procedure

2.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
makhe sarvatra brahmāṇamṛtvijaṃ varayedatha ..
kuśakaṇḍīṃ svagṛhyena kṛtvāgniṃ cārcayettataḥ .. 1 ..
2.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
मखे सर्वत्र ब्रह्माणमृत्विजं वरयेदथ ॥
कुशकण्डीं स्वगृह्येन कृत्वाग्निं चार्चयेत्ततः ॥ 1 ॥
2.2.m:
Sūta said:
In every sacrifice, one should then choose the priest as Brahmā.
Having performed the kuśakaṇḍī according to one's own Gṛhyasūtra, one should then worship the fire.

2.2.s:
āghārājyabhāgau tu mahāvyāhṛtayastrayaḥ ..
sarvaṃ prāyaścittasaṃjñakaṃ prājāpatyaṃ ca sviṣṭakṛt .. 2 ..
2.2.d:
आघाराज्यभागौ तु महाव्याहृतयस्त्रयः ॥
सर्वं प्रायश्चित्तसंज्ञकं प्राजापत्यं च स्विष्टकृत् ॥ 2 ॥
2.2.m:
The two continuous ghee libations, the two butter portions, the three great mystical utterances,
the complete atonement rite, the offering to Prajāpati, and the sviṣṭakṛt offering:

2.2.s:
etannityaṃ hi sarvatra home karmaṇi nirdiśet ..
prājāpatye ca indrāya etāvāghārasaṃjñakau .. 3 ..
2.2.d:
एतन्नित्यं हि सर्वत्र होमे कर्मणि निर्दिशेत् ॥
प्राजापत्ये च इन्द्राय एतावाघारसंज्ञकौ ॥ 3 ॥
2.2.m:
One must assign this as regular in every homa rite:
the two to Prajāpati and to Indra are known as the two continuous ghee libations;

2.2.s:
agnaye caiva somāya ājyabhāgau prakīrtitau..
bhūrbhuvaḥsvastrayaścaiva mahāvyāhṛtayaḥ smṛtāḥ ..4..
2.2.d:
अग्नये चैव सोमाय आज्यभागौ प्रकीर्तितौ॥
भूर्भुवःस्वस्त्रयश्चैव महाव्याहृतयः स्मृताः ॥4॥
2.2.m:
the two butter portions are proclaimed to be for Agni and for Soma;
and the three, bhūr, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ, are remembered as the great mystical utterances.

2.2.s:
ayāścāgne iti tathā ye te śatamanuttamam ..
sarvaprāyaścittasaṃjñā ete vai pañca maṃtrakāḥ .. 5 ..
2.2.d:
अयाश्चाग्ने इति तथा ये ते शतमनुत्तमम् ॥
सर्वप्रायश्चित्तसंज्ञा एते वै पञ्च मंत्रकाः ॥ 5 ॥
2.2.m:
The mantras 'ayāścāgne...' and the supreme 'ye te śatam...':
these five mantras are indeed designated as the complete atonement.

2.2.s:
prājāpatyāhutiścaikā sviṣṭakṛccāparā smṛtā ..
caturdaśaitāḥ kṛtayo hotavyā nityasaṃjñakāḥ .. 6 ..
2.2.d:
प्राजापत्याहुतिश्चैका स्विष्टकृच्चापरा स्मृता ॥
चतुर्दशैताः कृतयो होतव्या नित्यसंज्ञकाः ॥ 6 ॥
2.2.m:
One oblation is to Prajāpati, and another is remembered as sviṣṭakṛt.
These fourteen actions are to be offered as the regular rites.

2.2.s:
kṛtvā sakṛddevatoddeśaṃ homaṃ paścātsamācaret ..
somapā ye ca goyāge naramedhāśvamedhayoḥ .. 7 ..
2.2.d:
कृत्वा सकृद्देवतोद्देशं होमं पश्चात्समाचरेत् ॥
सोमपा ये च गोयागे नरमेधाश्वमेधयोः ॥ 7 ॥
2.2.m:
Having made the dedication of the deity once, he should subsequently perform the homa.
Those who drink Soma in a cattle sacrifice, in a human sacrifice, or in a horse sacrifice,

2.2.s:
anyatra viparītena svāhāṃtena hunedbudhaḥ ..
naimittikaṃ vinā nityaṃ viphalaṃ yāti nānyathā .. .. 8 ..
2.2.d:
अन्यत्र विपरीतेन स्वाहांतेन हुनेद्बुधः ॥
नैमित्तिकं विना नित्यं विफलं याति नान्यथा ॥ ॥ 8 ॥
2.2.m:
elsewhere, the wise man should offer in the reverse manner ending with 'svāhā'.
Without the occasional rite, the regular rite becomes fruitless, not otherwise.

2.2.s:
nityaṃ varjyaṃ śatārdhena vaiśvadeve tathaiva ca ..
tryahasādhyādiyāgeṣu yannideśaṃ śṛṇu dvijāḥ .. 9 ..
2.2.d:
नित्यं वर्ज्यं शतार्धेन वैश्वदेवे तथैव च ॥
त्र्यहसाध्यादियागेषु यन्निदेशं शृणु द्विजाः ॥ 9 ॥
2.2.m:
The regular rite is to be omitted in fifty oblations, and likewise in the Vaiśvadeva.
In sacrifices accomplished over three days and so forth, hear the instruction, O twice-born:

2.2.s:
ekāhe vāghārārajyau kṛtvā naimittikīṃ kṛtīḥ ..
samā sviṣṭakṛtaṃ vidyādākṛtyādyāstataḥ param .. 2.2.14.10 ..
2.2.d:
एकाहे वाघारारज्यौ कृत्वा नैमित्तिकीं कृतीः ॥
समा स्विष्टकृतं विद्यादाकृत्याद्यास्ततः परम् ॥ 2.2.14.10 ॥
2.2.m:
In a one-day rite, having performed the two continuous libations and two butter portions, [then] the occasional actions,
one should know the sviṣṭakṛt is equal, and beyond that, the ākṛti offerings and others.

2.2.s:
viśeṣatastryahādau tu aghārāvājyapūrvakam ..
paścānnaimittikaṃ kuryātsamāptidivase pyatha .. 11 ..
2.2.d:
विशेषतस्त्र्यहादौ तु अघारावाज्यपूर्वकम् ॥
पश्चान्नैमित्तिकं कुर्यात्समाप्तिदिवसे प्यथ ॥ 11 ॥
2.2.m:
Especially in a three-day rite and the like, the two continuous libations preceded by the butter portions [are performed];
and on the day of completion, he should afterwards perform the occasional rite.

2.2.s:
āghārārājyapūrveṇa tato naimittikaṃ caret ..
sviṣṭakṛdvyāhṛtiścaiva vāruṇādyāstathā hi ṣaṭ .. 12 ..
2.2.d:
आघाराराज्यपूर्वेण ततो नैमित्तिकं चरेत् ॥
स्विष्टकृद्व्याहृतिश्चैव वारुणाद्यास्तथा हि षट् ॥ 12 ॥
2.2.m: After preceding with the two libations of clarified butter, he should then perform the occasional [rite], / as well as the Sviṣṭakṛt, the vyāhṛtis, and the six [offerings] beginning with Varuṇa.

2.2.s:
dvijātiḥ patito yatra dvitrikaṃ ca catuścatuḥ ..
ekasmindivase kuryātsomayāge ca śaiśave .. 13 ..
2.2.d:
द्विजातिः पतितो यत्र द्वित्रिकं च चतुश्चतुः ॥
एकस्मिन्दिवसे कुर्यात्सोमयागे च शैशवे ॥ 13 ॥
2.2.m: Where a twice-born has fallen, or two or three or four at a time, / he should perform [it] on one day, and in a Soma sacrifice, and in childhood.

2.2.s:
dvijātīnāṃ vivāhe tu naityikaṃ prathamaṃ bhavet ..
ekasmindivase kuryādagnikāryaṃ pṛthakpṛthak .. 14 ..
2.2.d:
द्विजातीनां विवाहे तु नैत्यिकं प्रथमं भवेत् ॥
एकस्मिन्दिवसे कुर्यादग्निकार्यं पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 14 ॥
2.2.m: At the marriage of twice-born [men], the daily [rite] comes first; / he should perform the fire-rites separately on a single day.

2.2.s:
dadyādekaṃ ca nityaṃ ca pṛthaṅ nityaṃ na cācaret ..
dvijātiḥ patito yatra dvitrikaṃ ca catuścatuḥ .. 15 ..
2.2.d:
दद्यादेकं च नित्यं च पृथङ् नित्यं न चाचरेत् ॥
द्विजातिः पतितो यत्र द्वित्रिकं च चतुश्चतुः ॥ 15 ॥
2.2.m: He should perform one daily [rite] and should not perform [them] separately each day; / where a twice-born has fallen, or two, three, or four at a time,

2.2.s:
ekasmindivase kuryāttatrāpi naittikaṃ tyajet ..
home brahmā stute viṣṇuḥ sruve caiva maheśvaraḥ .. 16 ..
2.2.d:
एकस्मिन्दिवसे कुर्यात्तत्रापि नैत्तिकं त्यजेत् ॥
होमे ब्रह्मा स्तुते विष्णुः स्रुवे चैव महेश्वरः ॥ 16 ॥
2.2.m: he should perform [it] on a single day, and even there he should omit the daily [rite]. / Brahmā is [present] in the fire-offering, Viṣṇu in praise, and Maheśvara in the sruva-ladle;

2.2.s:
ajasyāniyame cendro'dhiśrayaṇaṃ vivasvataḥ ..
paryagnikaraṇe caiva udvāhe mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ .. 17 ..
2.2.d:
अजस्यानियमे चेन्द्रोऽधिश्रयणं विवस्वतः ॥
पर्यग्निकरणे चैव उद्वाहे मातरः स्मृताः ॥ 17 ॥
2.2.m: Indra is [present] in the unconstrained [movement] of the goat, the placing on the fire belongs to Vivasvat; / in the carrying of fire around [the offering], and at marriage, the Mothers are remembered [to be present];

2.2.s:
candrādityau cotpavane vīkṣaṇe ca diśastathā ..
prokṣaṇyāṃ sthāpane durgā ime lakṣmī pratiṣṭhitā .. 18 ..
2.2.d:
चन्द्रादित्यौ चोत्पवने वीक्षणे च दिशस्तथा ॥
प्रोक्षण्यां स्थापने दुर्गा इमे लक्ष्मी प्रतिष्ठिता ॥ 18 ॥
2.2.m: the Moon and the Sun are in the purifying of clarified butter, and likewise the directions in the inspecting; / Durgā is in the water for sprinkling and its setting down; in these, Lakṣmī is established.

2.2.s:
homaṃ kuryāddvijaśreṣṭhā vidhiṃ kuryātsamāhitaḥ..
eteṣu devatāḥ proktā dvijātīnāṃ hitāya ca..19..
2.2.d:
होमं कुर्याद्द्विजश्रेष्ठा विधिं कुर्यात्समाहितः॥
एतेषु देवताः प्रोक्ता द्विजातीनां हिताय च॥19॥
2.2.m: The best of twice-born should make the fire-offering, collected in mind, he should perform the rite. / The deities have been proclaimed in these [rites] for the welfare of twice-born men.

2.2.s:
yajetsupaśubaddheṣu saṃskāre caiva parvaṇi ..
devatāḥ sarvā jñātavyā etā yajñe samāhitaiḥ ..2.2.14.20..
2.2.d:
यजेत्सुपशुबद्धेषु संस्कारे चैव पर्वणि ॥
देवताः सर्वा ज्ञातव्या एता यज्ञे समाहितैः ॥2.2.14.20॥
2.2.m: He should sacrifice when animals are properly bound, and at a life-cycle rite, and on a parvan day; / all these deities must be known in the sacrifice by those who are collected in mind.

2.2.s:
adhidaivena jānīyātkaravalyāṃ paṃcaphalaṃ yataḥ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena devatāmatha vinyaset ..21..
devadhyānavarṇanam
2.2.d:
अधिदैवेन जानीयात्करवल्यां पंचफलं यतः॥
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन देवतामथ विन्यसेत् ॥21॥
देवध्यानवर्णनम्
2.2.m:
Since five fruits are obtained in the open palm through the presiding deity, / therefore he should install the deity with every effort.
Description of the Meditation on the Deities

2.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
atha vakṣyāmi saccaiṣāṃ devānāṃ dhyānamuttamam ..
asya yajñe parijñānājjihvā samyakphalapradā ..1..
2.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
अथ वक्ष्यामि सच्चैषां देवानां ध्यानमुत्तमम् ॥
अस्य यज्ञे परिज्ञानाज्जिह्वा सम्यक्फलप्रदा ॥1॥
2.2.m: Sūta said: / Now I shall tell the true and supreme meditation upon these gods; / through knowledge of this in a sacrifice, the tongue [of fire] properly grants fruit.

2.2.s:
hiraṇyavarṇāṃ prathamāṃ vahnijihvāṃ mahādyutim ..
kanakāḍhyakarāṃ devīṃ hiraṇyākhyeṣṭasiddhaye .. 2 ..
2.2.d:
हिरण्यवर्णां प्रथमां वह्निजिह्वां महाद्युतिम् ॥
कनकाढ्यकरां देवीं हिरण्याख्येष्टसिद्धये ॥ 2 ॥
2.2.m: For the attainment of one's desired [goals] by the name of Hiraṇyā, / [one should meditate on] the first tongue of fire, of golden hue, exceedingly splendid, a goddess whose hands abound with gold;

2.2.s:
kanakāṃ dvibhujāṃ śuklāṃ hastābhyāṃ darbhasaṃyutām ..
kamaṃḍaluṃ ca bibhrāṇāṃ numaḥ sādhakasiddhidām .. 3 ..
2.2.d:
कनकां द्विभुजां शुक्लां हस्ताभ्यां दर्भसंयुताम् ॥
कमंडलुं च बिभ्राणां नुमः साधकसिद्धिदाम् ॥ 3 ॥
2.2.m: we praise [the tongue] Kanakā, two-armed, white, having darbha-grass in both hands / and bearing a water-pot, who grants success to the practitioner;

2.2.s:
udyadindunibhāṃ raktāṃ caturbhirbhujapa llavaiḥ ..
śaṃkhacakrābhayavarāndadhatīṃ praṇamāmyaham .. 4 ..
2.2.d:
उद्यदिन्दुनिभां रक्तां चतुर्भिर्भुजप ल्लवैः ॥
शंखचक्राभयवरान्दधतीं प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥ 4 ॥
2.2.m: I bow to [the tongue] resembling the rising moon, red, bearing conch, / discus, boon, and fearlessness with her four branch-like arms;

2.2.s:
bhinnāṃjanacayaprakhyāṃ svarṇakuṃbhaṃ tu vāmataḥ ..
dakṣiṇena varāraktāṃ dhārayaṃtīṃ namāmyaham .. 9 ..
2.2.d:
भिन्नांजनचयप्रख्यां स्वर्णकुंभं तु वामतः ॥
दक्षिणेन वरारक्तां धारयंतीं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 9 ॥
2.2.m: I bow to [the tongue] resembling a heap of crushed collyrium, holding a golden jar on her left, / and with her right [hand] granting boons and red;

2.2.s:
suprabhāmaṇḍalābhā ca karābhyāṃ tatkṛtāñjaliḥ ..
padmāsanasthā kauśeyavasanā me prasīdatu .. 6 ..
2.2.d:
सुप्रभामण्डलाभा च कराभ्यां तत्कृताञ्जलिः ॥
पद्मासनस्था कौशेयवसना मे प्रसीदतु ॥ 6 ॥
2.2.m: and Suprabhā, radiant with a halo of light, her hands forming an añjali, / seated on a lotus throne and clothed in silk garments, may she be pleased with me;

2.2.s:
japākusumasaṃkāśā bahurūpā sakhe mama ..
śubhadā syādbhujaiḥ śubhrā sahasraṃ dadhatī parān .. 7 ..
2.2.d:
जपाकुसुमसंकाशा बहुरूपा सखे मम ॥
शुभदा स्याद्भुजैः शुभ्रा सहस्रं दधती परान् ॥ 7 ॥
2.2.m: resembling a hibiscus flower, multiform, O friend, / bearing a thousand supreme [weapons] with her arms, white, may she grant auspiciousness to me;

2.2.s:
nīlotpalanibhe devi vahnivarṇaparābhave ..
japāpuṣpadhare nityaṃ satīrūpe prasīda me .. 8 ..
2.2.d:
नीलोत्पलनिभे देवि वह्निवर्णपराभवे ॥
जपापुष्पधरे नित्यं सतीरूपे प्रसीद मे ॥ 8 ॥
2.2.m: O goddess resembling a blue lotus, outshining the colour of fire, / ever holding a hibiscus flower, having the form of Satī, be pleased with me.

2.2.s:
mūlena vīkṣayetsthānaṃ maṃtreṇa khananaṃ matam ..
trisūtrīkaraṇaṃ kuryāccatuḥsūtraṃ nipātayet .. 9 .. ..
devadhyānavidhānavarṇanam
2.2.d:
मूलेन वीक्षयेत्स्थानं मंत्रेण खननं मतम् ॥
त्रिसूत्रीकरणं कुर्याच्चतुःसूत्रं निपातयेत् ॥ 9 ॥ ॥
देवध्यानविधानवर्णनम्
2.2.m:
He should inspect the site with the root-mantra; the digging is considered [to be done] with a mantra; / he should perform the threefold cord-laying, [and] cast down the four cords.
Description of the Injunction for Meditation on the Deities

2.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
pratiṣṭhāyāḥ pūrvadine kuryāddevādhivāsanam ..
dhānyapratiṣṭhāṃ tasyaiva yūpaṃ cāpi yathāvidhi .. 1 ..
2.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
प्रतिष्ठायाः पूर्वदिने कुर्याद्देवाधिवासनम् ॥
धान्यप्रतिष्ठां तस्यैव यूपं चापि यथाविधि ॥ 1 ॥
2.2.m: Sūta said: / On the day preceding the consecration, one should perform the preliminary sanctification of the deity, / the consecration of grains for it, and also the sacrificial post according to the rule.

2.2.s:
rātrau mūlāgre ca ghaṭe sthāpayedgaṇanāyakam ..
saṃpūjya ca vidhānena digīśāṃśca tathā grahān .. 2 ..
2.2.d:
रात्रौ मूलाग्रे च घटे स्थापयेद्गणनायकम् ॥
संपूज्य च विधानेन दिगीशांश्च तथा ग्रहान् ॥ 2 ॥
2.2.m: At night, he should install Gaṇanāyaka at the tip of the base and in a jar; / and having worshipped the lords of the directions and likewise the planets according to the rule,

2.2.s:
brahmāṇaṃ ca taḍāgeṣu varuṇaṃ śāntiyāgake ..
somaṃ ca maṃḍale sūryaṃ pāde viṣṇuṃ tathaiva ca .. 3 ..
2.2.d:
ब्रह्माणं च तडागेषु वरुणं शान्तियागके ॥
सोमं च मंडले सूर्यं पादे विष्णुं तथैव च ॥ 3 ॥
2.2.m: and Brahmā at ponds, Varuṇa in a peaceful rite, / Soma in a maṇḍala, Sūrya at the foot, and likewise Viṣṇu;

2.2.s:
śaive śaivaṃ tathā proktaṃ prapāyāmatha vāruṇam ..
ārāme caiva brahmāṇaṃ pādyādyairapi cārcayet .. 4 ..
2.2.d:
शैवे शैवं तथा प्रोक्तं प्रपायामथ वारुणम् ॥
आरामे चैव ब्रह्माणं पाद्याद्यैरपि चार्चयेत् ॥ 4 ॥
2.2.m: in a Śaiva [temple], the Śaiva [deity] is thus stated, and Varuṇa at a water-shed; / and Brahmā in a grove; he should worship them with water for the feet and so forth.

2.2.s:
drupadādīti mantreṇa snāpayetprathamaṃ budhaḥ ..
gāyatryā ca tataḥ paścādgandhadvāreti tailakam .. 5 ..
2.2.d:
द्रुपदादीति मन्त्रेण स्नापयेत्प्रथमं बुधः ॥
गायत्र्या च ततः पश्चाद्गन्धद्वारेति तैलकम् ॥ 5 ॥
2.2.m: The wise man should first bathe [the image] with the mantra beginning with ‘Drupadā’; / and thereafter with the Gāyatrī, [and apply] oil with ‘Gandhadvārā’.

2.2.s:
sunābheti ca maṃtreṇa dvābhyāmeva viśiṣyate ..
śrīśca te iti kusumaṃ phalinīti ca vai phalam .. 6 ..
2.2.d:
सुनाभेति च मंत्रेण द्वाभ्यामेव विशिष्यते ॥
श्रीश्च ते इति कुसुमं फलिनीति च वै फलम् ॥ 6 ॥
2.2.m: With the mantra ‘Sunābhā’, [the rite] is distinguished with two [mantras]; / a flower with ‘Śrīś ca te’, and a fruit with ‘Phalinī’;

2.2.s:
kāṃḍāditi ca maṃtreṇa dadyāddūrvāśataṃ tataḥ ..
siṃdoriveti siṃdūraṃ viśvāmiti ca mārjanam .. 7 ..
2.2.d:
कांडादिति च मंत्रेण दद्याद्दूर्वाशतं ततः ॥
सिंदोरिवेति सिंदूरं विश्वामिति च मार्जनम् ॥ 7 ॥
2.2.m: then he should offer a hundred dūrvā-blades with the mantra beginning with ‘Kāṇḍāt’; / vermilion with ‘Sindhor iva’, and cleansing with ‘Viśvām’.

2.2.s:
samicchetyañjanaṃ dadyādduḥsthaṃ surāsurā japan ..
candanaṃ yajvabhirjaptvā mānastoketi candanam .. 8 ..
2.2.d:
समिच्छेत्यञ्जनं दद्याद्दुःस्थं सुरासुरा जपन् ॥
चन्दनं यज्वभिर्जप्त्वा मानस्तोकेति चन्दनम् ॥ 8 ॥
2.2.m: With ‘Samicchā’ he should apply collyrium, reciting [it when] gods and asuras are distressed; / sandalwood having been recited by the sacrificers, sandalwood with ‘Mā nastoke’.

2.2.s:
yūpe caiva viśeṣoyamuttarāgraṃ pravinyaset ..
adyaiva tena maṃtreṇa sthāpayedatha vāriṇā .. 9 ..
2.2.d:
यूपे चैव विशेषोयमुत्तराग्रं प्रविन्यसेत् ॥
अद्यैव तेन मंत्रेण स्थापयेदथ वारिणा ॥ 9 ॥
2.2.m: And on the sacrificial post, this is the particular [rule]: he should place the tip pointing north; / he should then install [it] with water, with that mantra, on that very day.

2.2.s:
gāyatryā prathamaṃ caiva āpo hiṣṭheti vai japan ..
śanno devīti drupadāṃ snāpayettadanantaram .. 2.2.16.10 ..
2.2.d:
गायत्र्या प्रथमं चैव आपो हिष्ठेति वै जपन् ॥
शन्नो देवीति द्रुपदां स्नापयेत्तदनन्तरम् ॥ 2.2.16.10 ॥
2.2.m: First with the Gāyatrī and indeed reciting ‘Āpo hi ṣṭhā’, / [and] ‘Śaṁ no devī’, he should immediately bathe [it] with the Drupadā-verse.

2.2.s:
abhimantryātha brahmeti trirātraṃ maṃtramīrayan ..
yogaṃ yogadṛḍhaṃ japtvā pavitraṃ vinyasettataḥ .. 11 ..
2.2.d:
अभिमन्त्र्याथ ब्रह्मेति त्रिरात्रं मंत्रमीरयन् ॥
योगं योगदृढं जप्त्वा पवित्रं विन्यसेत्ततः ॥ 11 ॥
2.2.m: Then having consecrated [it] with ‘Brahma’, uttering the mantra for three nights, / having recited ‘Yogaṁ yoga-dṛḍham’, he should then place the purifier.

2.2.s:
tvaṃ gandharveti mantreṇa tathā subhābha ityapi ..
dvābhyāṃ tailagaṃdhayutaṃ śrīsūktenāpi puṣpakam .. 12 ..
2.2.d:
त्वं गन्धर्वेति मन्त्रेण तथा सुभाभ इत्यपि ॥
द्वाभ्यां तैलगंधयुतं श्रीसूक्तेनापि पुष्पकम् ॥ 12 ॥
2.2.m: With the mantra ‘Tvaṁ gandharva’, and likewise ‘Subhābhaḥ’, / with both, [he offers] oil mixed with perfume, and also a flower with the Śrīsūkta;

2.2.s:
dhūrasīti ca tathā dhūpamāsrajyotirbhirdīpakam ..
anumīmahatāti dadyāddūrvākṣataṃ tataḥ .. 13 ..
2.2.d:
धूरसीति च तथा धूपमास्रज्योतिर्भिर्दीपकम् ॥
अनुमीमहताति दद्याद्दूर्वाक्षतं ततः ॥ 13 ॥
2.2.m: and likewise incense with ‘Dhūr asi’, a lamp with ‘Āsrajyotirbhiḥ’; / he should then offer unbroken grain mixed with dūrvā with ‘Anumīmahatā’.

2.2.s:
viśvāmīti ca nimnyaṃtakāṃḍāditi tathākṣatam ..
siṃdoriveti sindūraṃ samidheti tathāñjanam .. 14 ..
2.2.d:
विश्वामीति च निम्न्यंतकांडादिति तथाक्षतम् ॥
सिंदोरिवेति सिन्दूरं समिधेति तथाञ्जनम् ॥ 14 ॥
2.2.m: And with ‘Viśvāmī’, down to the depths, likewise unbroken grain with ‘Kāṇḍāt’; / vermilion with ‘Sindhor iva’, and likewise collyrium with ‘Samidhā’.

2.2.s:
pādo'syetyatha bhuktaṃ syādyāḥ phalinīti punaḥ phalam ..
rūpaṃ neti dahedrūpaṃ na sociti ca pūjanam .. 15 ..
2.2.d:
पादोऽस्येत्यथ भुक्तं स्याद्याः फलिनीति पुनः फलम् ॥
रूपं नेति दहेद्रूपं न सोचिति च पूजनम् ॥ 15 ॥
2.2.m: With ‘Pādo ’sya’ there is food, again fruit with ‘Yāḥ phalinīḥ’; / with ‘Rūpaṁ na’ he should burn away the form, and worship with ‘Na sociḥ’.

2.2.s:
yuvā suvāseti vastraṃ nāgagandheti candanam ..
tato yamagṛhādbāhye maṇḍapāṃtaramāśritaḥ ..16..
2.2.d:
युवा सुवासेति वस्त्रं नागगन्धेति चन्दनम् ॥
ततो यमगृहाद्बाह्ये मण्डपांतरमाश्रितः ॥16॥
2.2.m: Garments with ‘Yuvā suvāsāḥ’, and sandalwood with ‘Nāgagandhā’; / then, having gone outside the chamber of Yama into another pavilion,

2.2.s:
sunātīti vaco dadyāttataścāvāhayetprabhum ..
tatrādhivāsanaṃ kuryādrakṣayecca surakṣibhiḥ ..17..
2.2.d:
सुनातीति वचो दद्यात्ततश्चावाहयेत्प्रभुम् ॥
तत्राधिवासनं कुर्याद्रक्षयेच्च सुरक्षिभिः ॥17॥
2.2.m: he should speak the words ‘Sunāti’ and then invoke the Lord; / there he should perform the preliminary sanctification and protect [it] with excellent protectors.

2.2.s:
ācāryo yajamānaśca ṛtvigbhojanamācaret ..
akṣāralavaṇānyāsī dadhi viśvaṃ tilāṃstyajet ..18..
2.2.d:
आचार्यो यजमानश्च ऋत्विग्भोजनमाचरेत् ॥
अक्षारलवणान्यासी दधि विश्वं तिलांस्त्यजेत् ॥18॥
2.2.m: The preceptor, the patron of the sacrifice, and the officiating priest should take their meal; / eating foods without alkali or salt, he should avoid curd, all [spices], and sesamum seeds.

2.2.s:
ādhāraṇaṃ cādhivāsaṃ vakṣye tatrānusārataḥ ..
sunāteti vaco dadyāttailaṃ caiva śive tribhiḥ .. 19 ..
2.2.d:
आधारणं चाधिवासं वक्ष्ये तत्रानुसारतः ॥
सुनातेति वचो दद्यात्तैलं चैव शिवे त्रिभिः ॥ 19 ॥
2.2.m: I shall state the holding and the preliminary sanctification according to that [tradition]: / he should speak the word ‘Sunātā’ and [offer] oil to Śiva with three [verses];

2.2.s:
pañcabhirbrāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ gandharvā iti vismaran ..
dadyādgandhaṃ tailayutaṃ gandhadvāretyṛcā punaḥ .. 2.2.16.20 ..
2.2.d:
पञ्चभिर्ब्राह्मणैः सार्धं गन्धर्वा इति विस्मरन् ॥
दद्याद्गन्धं तैलयुतं गन्धद्वारेत्यृचा पुनः ॥ 2.2.16.20 ॥
2.2.m: together with five brāhmaṇas, reciting ‘Gandharvāḥ’, / he should again offer perfume mixed with oil with the verse ‘Gandhadvārā’.

2.2.s:
yāḥ phalinīti ca phalaṃ pūgatānāmavarjanam ..
kauśikīruttamosīti dadyātkhaḍgaṃ sutīkṣṇakam .. 21 ..
2.2.d:
याः फलिनीति च फलं पूगतानामवर्जनम् ॥
कौशिकीरुत्तमोसीति दद्यात्खड्गं सुतीक्ष्णकम् ॥ 21 ॥
2.2.m: And fruit with ‘Yāḥ phalinīḥ’, without omitting betel-nuts; / with ‘Kauśikīr uttamo ’si’ he should present a very sharp sword;

2.2.s:
rūpena veti mantreṇa mudgaraṃ ca nivedayet ..
śrīśca te iti kusumaṃ viśvānīti ca saṃpaṭhan .. 22 ..
2.2.d:
रूपेन वेति मन्त्रेण मुद्गरं च निवेदयेत् ॥
श्रीश्च ते इति कुसुमं विश्वानीति च संपठन् ॥ 22 ॥
2.2.m: and with the mantra ‘Rūpeṇa vā’ he should offer a club; / [and offer] a flower with ‘Śrīś ca te’, reciting ‘Viśvāni’.

2.2.s:
nirmathanaṃ tataḥ kāryamiti sādhāraṇo vidhiḥ ..
tatodhivāsakalpe tu pradeśe tu samācaret .. 23 ..
2.2.d:
निर्मथनं ततः कार्यमिति साधारणो विधिः ॥
ततोधिवासकल्पे तु प्रदेशे तु समाचरेत् ॥ 23 ॥
2.2.m: Then churning [of the fire] should be performed; this is the common rule. / Then, in the procedure of preliminary sanctification, he should perform [it] in that place.

2.2.s:
vinādhivāsanaṃ viprāḥ pratiṣṭhānaṃ samācaret ..
na tatphalamavāpnoti vivāhe śaraṇaṃ diśet .. 24 ..
2.2.d:
विनाधिवासनं विप्राः प्रतिष्ठानं समाचरेत् ॥
न तत्फलमवाप्नोति विवाहे शरणं दिशेत् ॥ 24 ॥
2.2.m: If one performs an installation without preliminary consecration, O Brahmins, / one does not attain its fruit, [just as] in marriage one should assign refuge.

2.2.s:
tataḥ prayatnataḥ kāryaṃ pūrvāhne rātriyogataḥ ..
nitye naimittike kāmye kārayetkuṇḍamaṇḍapam .. 25 ..
2.2.d:
ततः प्रयत्नतः कार्यं पूर्वाह्ने रात्रियोगतः ॥
नित्ये नैमित्तिके काम्ये कारयेत्कुण्डमण्डपम् ॥ 25 ॥
2.2.m: Therefore it must be performed with effort in the morning in conjunction with the night. / In an obligatory, occasional, or optional rite, one should cause a sacrificial pit and pavilion to be constructed.

2.2.s:
sthaṃḍile hasta mātreṇa vālukānirmite'pi ca ..
trayodaśāṃgule haste dvihaste cāpi varddhate .. 26 ..
2.2.d:
स्थंडिले हस्त मात्रेण वालुकानिर्मितेऽपि च ॥
त्रयोदशांगुले हस्ते द्विहस्ते चापि वर्द्धते ॥ 26 ॥
2.2.m: On an altar of one cubit, even when made of sand, / it increases at thirteen angulas, at a cubit, and at two cubits.

2.2.s:
ekaikāṃgulako viprāḥ pīṭhe nāsti vicāraṇā ..
navapañcaka kuṇḍe ca lakṣādāvapi śaṃkayā .. 27 ..
2.2.d:
एकैकांगुलको विप्राः पीठे नास्ति विचारणा ॥
नवपञ्चक कुण्डे च लक्षादावपि शंकया ॥ 27 ॥
2.2.m: It is one angula at a time on the pedestal, O Brahmins, of that there is no doubt, / and in a sacrificial pit of nine or five, even at a hundred thousand and so on, out of caution.

2.2.s:
tato daśāṃgule pakṣe daśāṃgaṃ śṛṇuta dvijāḥ ..
kāṣṭhaṃ pattraṃ ca puṣpaṃ ca modakaṃ piṣṭakaṃ tathā .. 28 ..
2.2.d:
ततो दशांगुले पक्षे दशांगं शृणुत द्विजाः ॥
काष्ठं पत्त्रं च पुष्पं च मोदकं पिष्टकं तथा ॥ 28 ॥
2.2.m: Then, in the ten-angula category, listen, O twice-born ones, to the ten components: / wood, a leaf, a flower, a sweetmeat, and likewise a pastry,

2.2.s:
annaṃ ca paramānnaṃ ca hyavekṣyaṃ tilameva ca ..
etadvai gṛhapakṣe ca viṣṇupakṣe tilāditaḥ..29..
2.2.d:
अन्नं च परमान्नं च ह्यवेक्ष्यं तिलमेव च ॥
एतद्वै गृहपक्षे च विष्णुपक्षे तिलादितः॥29॥
2.2.m: cooked grain, sweet rice, clarifying butter, and sesamum. / This is indeed in the domestic category; in the category of Viṣṇu, [it begins] with sesamum and the rest;

2.2.s:
śaive yavāditaḥ kāryā śākte puṣpādito bhavet ..
sūrye pakṣe piṣṭakādi gopāle kṛśarāditaḥ .. 2.2.16.30 ..
2.2.d:
शैवे यवादितः कार्या शाक्ते पुष्पादितो भवेत् ॥
सूर्ये पक्षे पिष्टकादि गोपाले कृशरादितः ॥ 2.2.16.30 ॥
2.2.m: in the category of Śiva, it should be done beginning with barley; in that of Śakti, it should begin with flowers; / in the category of Sūrya, beginning with pastry; in that of Gopāla, beginning with spiced rice;

2.2.s:
kṛṣṇe ca karavīrādi śrīphalāni ca traipure ..
sārasvate ca śrīvṛkṣe mokṣakāme nigadyate .. 31 .. ..
devadhyānavarṇanam
2.2.d:
कृष्णे च करवीरादि श्रीफलानि च त्रैपुरे ॥
सारस्वते च श्रीवृक्षे मोक्षकामे निगद्यते ॥ 31 ॥ ॥
देवध्यानवर्णनम्
2.2.m:
and in that of Kṛṣṇa, oleander and the rest; and bilva fruits in that of Tripurā; / and in that of Sarasvatī, on the śrīvṛkṣa tree, it is prescribed for one desiring liberation.
Description of the Meditation on the Deities

2.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
aṣṭau hotāro dvārapālāthāṣṭau aṣṭau kāryā brāhmaṇā yājakāśca ..
sarve śuddhā lakṣitā lakṣaṇādyairekaḥ kāryo jāpakosminmahātmā .. 1 ..
2.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
अष्टौ होतारो द्वारपालाथाष्टौ अष्टौ कार्या ब्राह्मणा याजकाश्च ॥
सर्वे शुद्धा लक्षिता लक्षणाद्यैरेकः कार्यो जापकोस्मिन्महात्मा ॥ 1 ॥
2.2.m: Sūta said: / Eight hotṛ priests and eight door-keepers, and eight officiating Brahmins are to be employed. / All must be pure and endowed with auspicious marks and the like; in this [rite], one great-souled man should be appointed as a reciter.

2.2.s:
divyairgaṃdhairgaṃdhamālyaiḥ suvarṇaistailaṃ kāryaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ pañcaviṃśāḥ ..
āvāpyaistu dviguṇairvai balīyo divyairvastrairarhaṇādakṣiṇābhiḥ .. 2 ..
2.2.d:
दिव्यैर्गंधैर्गंधमाल्यैः सुवर्णैस्तैलं कार्यं ब्राह्मणाः पञ्चविंशाः ॥
आवाप्यैस्तु द्विगुणैर्वै बलीयो दिव्यैर्वस्त्रैरर्हणादक्षिणाभिः ॥ 2 ॥
2.2.m: Twenty-five Brahmins should be anointed with oil, with divine scents, fragrant garlands, and gold, / or indeed doubly potent with additional [items], with divine garments, worship, and priestly fees.

2.2.s:
nārhayitvā yathoktena kaścitpatraṃ niveśayet ..
anarhiteṣu vipreṣu na samyakphalamāpnuyāt .. 3 ..
2.2.d:
नार्हयित्वा यथोक्तेन कश्चित्पत्रं निवेशयेत् ॥
अनर्हितेषु विप्रेषु न सम्यक्फलमाप्नुयात् ॥ 3 ॥
2.2.m: Without worshipping them according to what has been declared, no one should place a leaf. / When the Brahmins are not worshipped, one does not obtain the full fruit.

2.2.s:
pratiṣṭhādiṣu sarveṣu samyagviprānathārhayet ..
kuśadvijaṃ tu sarvatra arghyaṃ viṣṭaramātrakam .. 4 ..
2.2.d:
प्रतिष्ठादिषु सर्वेषु सम्यग्विप्रानथार्हयेत् ॥
कुशद्विजं तु सर्वत्र अर्घ्यं विष्टरमात्रकम् ॥ 4 ॥
2.2.m: In all rites such as installations, one should duly worship the Brahmins. / A kuśa-grass Brahmin [should receive] the water offering and a seat everywhere.

2.2.s:
pradadyādarhaṇaṃ samyakpaścātpātraṃ nivedayet ..
vinārhaṇaṃ kṛte tasminnarake paripacyate .. 5 ..
2.2.d:
प्रदद्यादर्हणं सम्यक्पश्चात्पात्रं निवेदयेत् ॥
विनार्हणं कृते तस्मिन्नरके परिपच्यते ॥ 5 ॥
2.2.m: One should duly present the worship, and afterwards offer the vessel. / If it is done without worship, one is cooked in hell.

2.2.s:
pratyekaṃ brāhmaṇā yajñe vedamantreṣu pāragāḥ ..
ācāryo yadi kāryeṣu varayeddaśa govrajān .. 6 ..
2.2.d:
प्रत्येकं ब्राह्मणा यज्ञे वेदमन्त्रेषु पारगाः ॥
आचार्यो यदि कार्येषु वरयेद्दश गोव्रजान् ॥ 6 ॥
2.2.m: In the sacrifice, each of the Brahmins should be fully versed in Vedic mantras. / If the ācārya should select [them] in the rites, [let him choose] ten owners of herds of cattle.

2.2.s:
viśiṣṭānāmabhāve'pi kuryātkuśamayāndvijān ..
kuśapratikṛtau cāpi svagotraṃ svaṃ dvijaṃ vinā .. 7 ..
2.2.d:
विशिष्टानामभावेऽपि कुर्यात्कुशमयान्द्विजान् ॥
कुशप्रतिकृतौ चापि स्वगोत्रं स्वं द्विजं विना ॥ 7 ॥
2.2.m: Even in the absence of qualified [men], one should make twice-borns of kuśa grass. / But in an effigy of kuśa grass, without one's own lineage and one's own twice-born,

2.2.s:
na kuryāccaraṇoddeśaṃ tathā praharasaṃhatim ..
gotrādikīrtanāṃteṣu svanāmoddeśamīrayan .. 8 ..
2.2.d:
न कुर्याच्चरणोद्देशं तथा प्रहरसंहतिम् ॥
गोत्रादिकीर्तनांतेषु स्वनामोद्देशमीरयन् ॥ 8 ॥
2.2.m: one should not make mention of the Vedic branch nor the aggregate of hours, / uttering the mention of one's own name at the end of the proclamation of the lineage and the like.

2.2.s:
tulāpuruṣadāne ca tathā ca hāṭakācale ..
kanyādāne tathotsarge kīrtayetpravarādikam .. 9 ..
2.2.d:
तुलापुरुषदाने च तथा च हाटकाचले ॥
कन्यादाने तथोत्सर्गे कीर्तयेत्प्रवरादिकम् ॥ 9 ॥
2.2.m: In the gift of the weight of a man, and likewise in that of a mountain of gold, / in the gift of a maiden, and likewise in a consecration, one should proclaim the ancestral lineage and the rest.

2.2.s:
na pātraṃ pratikṛtyarthaṃ na cālaṃ sodakaṃ tathā ..
mṛtabhāryyo hyabhāryaśca aputro mṛtaputrakaḥ .. 2.2.17.10 ..
2.2.d:
न पात्रं प्रतिकृत्यर्थं न चालं सोदकं तथा ॥
मृतभार्य्यो ह्यभार्यश्च अपुत्रो मृतपुत्रकः ॥ 2.2.17.10 ॥
2.2.m: Neither an effigy nor an insufficient one with water is an [acceptable] recipient. / One whose wife has died, or one who is wifeless, or childless, or whose children have died,

2.2.s:
śūdrasaṃskārakaścaiva kṛpaṇo gaṇayājakaḥ ..
prāyaścittagṛhītaśca rājayājakapaiśunau .. 11 ..
2.2.d:
शूद्रसंस्कारकश्चैव कृपणो गणयाजकः ॥
प्रायश्चित्तगृहीतश्च राजयाजकपैशुनौ ॥ 11 ॥
2.2.m: one who performs sacraments for Śūdras, a miser, one who sacrifices for a multitude, / one who has undertaken an expiation, one who sacrifices for a king, a slanderer,

2.2.s:
śūdragehanivāsī ca śūdrapreraka eva ca ..
svalpakaṇṭho vāmanaśca vṛṣalīpatireva ca .. 12 ..
2.2.d:
शूद्रगेहनिवासी च शूद्रप्रेरक एव च ॥
स्वल्पकण्ठो वामनश्च वृषलीपतिरेव च ॥ 12 ॥
2.2.m: one who dwells in the house of a Śūdra, and one who acts at the instigation of a Śūdra, / one with a defective throat, a dwarf, and the husband of a Śūdra woman,

2.2.s:
bandhudveṣī gurudveṣī bhāryādveṣī tathaiva ca ..
hīnāṃgaścaiva vṛddhāṃgo bhagnadaṃtaśca dāṃbhikaḥ .. 13 ..
2.2.d:
बन्धुद्वेषी गुरुद्वेषी भार्याद्वेषी तथैव च ॥
हीनांगश्चैव वृद्धांगो भग्नदंतश्च दांभिकः ॥ 13 ॥
2.2.m: one who hates his relatives, one who hates his guru, and likewise one who hates his wife, / one with a missing limb, one with an excess limb, one with broken teeth, a hypocrite,

2.2.s:
pratigrāhī ca kunakhaḥ pāradārika eva ca ..
śvitrī kuṣṭhī kulodbhūto nidrālurvyasanārthakaḥ ..14..
2.2.d:
प्रतिग्राही च कुनखः पारदारिक एव च ॥
श्वित्री कुष्ठी कुलोद्भूतो निद्रालुर्व्यसनार्थकः ॥14॥
2.2.m: one who accepts improper gifts, one with deformed nails, an adulterer, / one with vitiligo, a leper, [even if] well-born, a sluggard, one devoted to vices,

2.2.s:
adīkṣitaḥ kadaryaśca caṃḍarogī galadvraṇaḥ ..
mahāvraṇī ca udarī yajñapātraṃ na kārayet .. 15 ..
2.2.d:
अदीक्षितः कदर्यश्च चंडरोगी गलद्व्रणः ॥
महाव्रणी च उदरी यज्ञपात्रं न कारयेत् ॥ 15 ॥
2.2.m: one who is uninitiated, a miser, one with a fierce disease, one with an ulcer on the throat, / one with severe ulcers, and one with dropsy—one should not make [any of these] a recipient at a sacrifice.

2.2.s:
varaṇāṃte tu pātrāṇāṃ pūjāmantrāñchṛṇu dvija ..
pratimantreṇa gandhādyairarcayenmantravittamaḥ .. 16 ..
2.2.d:
वरणांते तु पात्राणां पूजामन्त्राञ्छृणु द्विज ॥
प्रतिमन्त्रेण गन्धाद्यैरर्चयेन्मन्त्रवित्तमः ॥ 16 ॥
2.2.m: At the conclusion of the selection of the recipients, listen, O twice-born, to the worship mantras. / The foremost knower of mantras should worship with scents and the rest, using each respective mantra:

2.2.s:
brahmamūrtistvamācāryaḥ saṃsārātpāhi māṃ vibho ..
tvatprasādādguro yajñaṃ prāptosmi yanmayepsitam ... .. 17 ..
2.2.d:
ब्रह्ममूर्तिस्त्वमाचार्यः संसारात्पाहि मां विभो ॥
त्वत्प्रसादाद्गुरो यज्ञं प्राप्तोस्मि यन्मयेप्सितम् ॥॥। 17 ॥
2.2.m: ‘You, the ācārya, are the embodiment of Brahmā; protect me from saṃsāra, O Lord. / By your grace, O guru, I have obtained the sacrifice that was desired by me.

2.2.s:
ciraṃ me śāśvatī kīrtiryāvallokāścarācarāḥ ..
prasīda tvaṃ maheśāna pratiṣṭhākarmasiddhaye .. 18 ..
2.2.d:
चिरं मे शाश्वती कीर्तिर्यावल्लोकाश्चराचराः ॥
प्रसीद त्वं महेशान प्रतिष्ठाकर्मसिद्धये ॥ 18 ॥
2.2.m: May my eternal fame endure for a long time, as long as the worlds of mobile and immobile beings exist. / Be gracious, O Great Lord, for the success of the installation rite.

2.2.s:
tvamādiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ saṃsārārṇava tārakaḥ ..
jñānāmṛtapradācāryo yajurveda namo'stu te .. 19 ..
2.2.d:
त्वमादिः सर्वभूतानां संसारार्णव तारकः ॥
ज्ञानामृतप्रदाचार्यो यजुर्वेद नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 19 ॥
2.2.m: You are the origin of all beings, the savior across the ocean of saṃsāra. / The ācārya who grants the nectar of knowledge, O Yajurveda, obeisance to you!

2.2.s:
brahmaṇaiva samudbhūta prakāśitadigantara ..
śuddhajāṃbūnadaprakhya yajurveda namo'stu te .. 2.2.17.20 ..
2.2.d:
ब्रह्मणैव समुद्भूत प्रकाशितदिगन्तर ॥
शुद्धजांबूनदप्रख्य यजुर्वेद नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 2.2.17.20 ॥
2.2.m: Arisen from Brahmā himself, illuminator of the intermediate quarters, / resembling pure Jambūnada gold, O Yajurveda, obeisance to you!

2.2.s:
prataptakanakābhāsa bhāsitadyutibhūtala ..
mantraprakhyānasaṃsthāna yajurveda namo'stu te .. 21 ..
2.2.d:
प्रतप्तकनकाभास भासितद्युतिभूतल ॥
मन्त्रप्रख्यानसंस्थान यजुर्वेद नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 21 ॥
2.2.m: Having the luster of molten gold, illuminating the earth with your radiance, / the abode for the manifestation of mantras, O Yajurveda, obeisance to you!

2.2.s:
praphullakanakābhāsa bhāsvarāsurabhūṣita ..
prakīrṇamantrasaṃbhāravidhijña praṇato'smi te .. 22 ..
2.2.d:
प्रफुल्लकनकाभास भास्वरासुरभूषित ॥
प्रकीर्णमन्त्रसंभारविधिज्ञ प्रणतोऽस्मि ते ॥ 22 ॥
2.2.m: Having the luster of blooming gold, adorned by radiant beings, / knower of the rules for the scattered collection of mantras, I am bowed to you.

2.2.s:
ṣaḍaṃgavedavedajña ṛtviṅgamokṣaprado bhava ..
praviśya maṇḍalaṃ viprā svasthāne sthāpayetkramāt .. 23 ..
2.2.d:
षडंगवेदवेदज्ञ ऋत्विङ्गमोक्षप्रदो भव ॥
प्रविश्य मण्डलं विप्रा स्वस्थाने स्थापयेत्क्रमात् ॥ 23 ॥
2.2.m: Knower of the Veda with its six auxiliary limbs, being the sacrificial priest, be the granter of liberation.’ / Having entered the maṇḍala, O Brahmins, one should establish them in their respective places in order.

2.2.s:
vedyāḥ paścimabhāge tu ācāryaṃ sthāpayedbudhaḥ ..
kuṇḍasyāgre tu brahmāṇaṃ maṇḍalasyaiva paścime .. 24 ..
2.2.d:
वेद्याः पश्चिमभागे तु आचार्यं स्थापयेद्बुधः ॥
कुण्डस्याग्रे तु ब्रह्माणं मण्डलस्यैव पश्चिमे ॥ 24 ॥
2.2.m: The wise man should establish the ācārya on the western part of the altar, / and the Brahmā priest in front of the sacrificial pit, to the west of the maṇḍala.

2.2.s:
hotāraṃ sthāpayettatra vidhijñamatha cottare ..
dvaudvau kṛtvā jñāpakau ca khaḍgadhārakameva ca ..25..
2.2.d:
होतारं स्थापयेत्तत्र विधिज्ञमथ चोत्तरे ॥
द्वौद्वौ कृत्वा ज्ञापकौ च खड्गधारकमेव च ॥25॥
2.2.m: There he should establish the hotṛ priest, who knows the rules, in the north, / and having appointed two announcers and a sword-bearer,

2.2.s:
dvāridvāri prayatnena dvārapālānanukramāt ..
vakṣyamāṇena maṃtreṇa pratyekamatha sthāpayet ..26..
2.2.d:
द्वारिद्वारि प्रयत्नेन द्वारपालाननुक्रमात् ॥
वक्ष्यमाणेन मंत्रेण प्रत्येकमथ स्थापयेत् ॥26॥
2.2.m: at each door, with diligence, the door-keepers in sequence, / he should then establish each of them with the mantra to be spoken.

2.2.s:
pūjayedgandhapuṣpādyairvāsaso yugalena tu ..
yajñe savitate yo'sau pūjyate puruṣaḥ sadā..27..
2.2.d:
पूजयेद्गन्धपुष्पाद्यैर्वाससो युगलेन तु ॥
यज्ञे सवितते योऽसौ पूज्यते पुरुषः सदा॥27॥
2.2.m: He should worship them with scents, flowers, and other offerings, and with a pair of garments: / ‘He who is that Person ever worshipped in the sacrifice, O Savitṛ,

2.2.s:
nārāyaṇasvarūpeṇa yajñaṃ me saphalaṃ kuru ..
yajñeṣu sākṣī sarveṣu yajurvedārthatattvavit .. 28 ..
2.2.d:
नारायणस्वरूपेण यज्ञं मे सफलं कुरु ॥
यज्ञेषु साक्षी सर्वेषु यजुर्वेदार्थतत्त्ववित् ॥ 28 ॥
2.2.m: make my sacrifice fruitful in the form of Nārāyaṇa! / The witness in all sacrifices, the knower of the true meaning of the Yajurveda,

2.2.s:
ṛgvedārthasya tattvajña indrarūpa namo'stu te ..
makhaśreṣṭheṣu sarveṣu yena maṃtrāḥ suvistṛtāḥ .. .. 39 ..
2.2.d:
ऋग्वेदार्थस्य तत्त्वज्ञ इन्द्ररूप नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
मखश्रेष्ठेषु सर्वेषु येन मंत्राः सुविस्तृताः ॥ ॥ 39 ॥
2.2.m: knower of the reality of the meaning of the Ṛgveda, in the form of Indra, obeisance to you, / by whom mantras are widely expanded in all the best of sacrifices!

2.2.s:
yajurvedārthatattvajña brahmarūpa namo'stu te ..
makhaśreṣṭheṣu sarveṣu eṣa eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ .. 2.2.17.30 ..
2.2.d:
यजुर्वेदार्थतत्त्वज्ञ ब्रह्मरूप नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
मखश्रेष्ठेषु सर्वेषु एष एव विधिः स्मृतः ॥ 2.2.17.30 ॥
2.2.m: Knower of the reality of the meaning of the Yajurveda, in the form of Brahmā, obeisance to you!’ / In all the best of sacrifices, this very rule is remembered.

2.2.s:
māṃgalyaṃ karmaṇāṃ nityaṃ sarvajñaṃ jñānarūpi ṇam ..
siddhaye mama yajñasya namāmi śivarūpiṇam .. 31 ..
2.2.d:
मांगल्यं कर्मणां नित्यं सर्वज्ञं ज्ञानरूपि णम् ॥
सिद्धये मम यज्ञस्य नमामि शिवरूपिणम् ॥ 31 ॥
2.2.m: ‘The eternal auspiciousness of actions, the omniscient one whose form is knowledge, / for the success of my sacrifice, I bow to him whose form is Śiva.

2.2.s:
pālaya tvaṃ diśaḥ sarvā vidiśaśca tathā imam ..
dikpālarūpiṇaṃ vipraṃ yajñasiddhau namā myaham ..
na saṃkalpaṃ caredyāgaṃ vrataṃ devārcanaṃ tathā .. 32 ..
2.2.d:
पालय त्वं दिशः सर्वा विदिशश्च तथा इमम् ॥
दिक्पालरूपिणं विप्रं यज्ञसिद्धौ नमा म्यहम् ॥
न संकल्पं चरेद्यागं व्रतं देवार्चनं तथा ॥ 32 ॥
2.2.m: Do you protect all the directions and the intermediate directions, and likewise this [place]. / I bow to the Brahmin who has the form of the guardian of the directions, for the success of the sacrifice.’ / One should not perform a sacrifice, an observance, or the worship of deities without a solemn intention.

2.2.s:
saṃkalpamūlaḥ kāmo vai yajñāḥ saṃkalpasaṃbhavāḥ ..
saṃkalpena vinā viprā yatkiñcitkurute naraḥ .. 33 ..
2.2.d:
संकल्पमूलः कामो वै यज्ञाः संकल्पसंभवाः ॥
संकल्पेन विना विप्रा यत्किञ्चित्कुरुते नरः ॥ 33 ॥
2.2.m: Desire is rooted in solemn intention; sacrifices are born of solemn intention. / Whatever a man does without a solemn intention, O Brahmins,

2.2.s:
phalaṃ cālpālpakaṃ tasya dharmasyārddhakṣayo bhavet ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena yāgaṃ saṃkalpayetsudhīḥ .. 34 ..
2.2.d:
फलं चाल्पाल्पकं तस्य धर्मस्यार्द्धक्षयो भवेत् ॥
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन यागं संकल्पयेत्सुधीः ॥ 34 ॥
2.2.m: its fruit is exceedingly small, and half of his merit is destroyed. / Therefore, with all effort, the wise man should undertake a sacrifice with a solemn intention.

2.2.s:
kāmātparo naiva bhavenniṣkāmo'pi na śobhanaḥ ..
tasmātkāmamayaṃ dharmaṃ vinā mokṣaṃ na cācaret .. 35 ..
2.2.d:
कामात्परो नैव भवेन्निष्कामोऽपि न शोभनः ॥
तस्मात्काममयं धर्मं विना मोक्षं न चाचरेत् ॥ 35 ॥
2.2.m: There can be nothing beyond desire, nor is desirelessness praise-worthy; / therefore, one should never perform desire-filled duty without [an eye to] liberation.

2.2.s:
saṃkalpena vinā yastu dharmaṃ carati mānavaḥ ..
na tasya phalamāpnoti nityanaimittikasya ca .. 36 ..
2.2.d:
संकल्पेन विना यस्तु धर्मं चरति मानवः ॥
न तस्य फलमाप्नोति नित्यनैमित्तिकस्य च ॥ 36 ॥
2.2.m: A man who performs duty without a solemn vow / does not attain the fruit of it, whether obligatory or occasional.

2.2.s:
na kuryātsthāpane caiva kuryādvai maṃḍalāṃtare ..
gṛhītvauduṃbaraṃ pātraṃ vāripūrṇaṃ guṇānvitam .. 37 ..
2.2.d:
न कुर्यात्स्थापने चैव कुर्याद्वै मंडलांतरे ॥
गृहीत्वौदुंबरं पात्रं वारिपूर्णं गुणान्वितम् ॥ 37 ॥
2.2.m: One should not do [it] at the consecration, but within the diagram, / taking a vessel of udumbara wood, filled with water and having good qualities.

2.2.s:
jalāśayārāmakūpa saṃkalpe pūrvadiṅmukhaḥ ..
sādhāraṇe cottarāsyo grahayajñe tu saṃmukhaḥ ..38..
2.2.d:
जलाशयारामकूप संकल्पे पूर्वदिङ्मुखः ॥
साधारणे चोत्तरास्यो ग्रहयज्ञे तु संमुखः ॥38॥
2.2.m: At the solemn vow for a reservoir, a garden, or a well, he should face east; / at a general [vow], he should face north, but at a sacrifice to the planets, he should face them directly.

2.2.s:
mahāvrate pratiṣṭhāyāṃ pātraṃ tāmraṃ hiraṇmayam ..
rājatāśmamayaṃ sāṃgaṃ yadyajñeṣu praśasyate .. 39 ..
2.2.d:
महाव्रते प्रतिष्ठायां पात्रं ताम्रं हिरण्मयम् ॥
राजताश्ममयं सांगं यद्यज्ञेषु प्रशस्यते ॥ 39 ॥
2.2.m: In a great votive observance and in a consecration, a vessel of copper, gold, / silver, or stone, complete with its parts, is commended in sacrifices.

2.2.s:
yajñīyapātrapuṭakaṃ hastasthāne prakīrtitam ..
aiśyānyāṃ nikṣipettoyaṃ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ ca pūrvataḥ ..2.2.17.40..
2.2.d:
यज्ञीयपात्रपुटकं हस्तस्थाने प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
ऐश्यान्यां निक्षिपेत्तोयं प्रतिष्ठायां च पूर्वतः ॥2.2.17.40॥
2.2.m: A cup among the sacrificial vessels is declared to take the place of the hand. / He should pour the water in the north-east, and at a consecration, in the east.

2.2.s:
ākāśe nikṣipedyāge vrate īśepi nityake ..
pitṛmedhe ca goyāge naramedhe ca dakṣiṇe ..41..
2.2.d:
आकाशे निक्षिपेद्यागे व्रते ईशेपि नित्यके ॥
पितृमेधे च गोयागे नरमेधे च दक्षिणे ॥41॥
2.2.m: In a sacrifice, he should pour it into the air, and in an obligatory votive observance, to the Lord; / and in an ancestral sacrifice, a cow-sacrifice, and a human sacrifice, in the south.

2.2.s:
śuktikāṃsyādihastaiśca tāmraraupyādibhistathā..
saṃkalpo naiva kartavyo mṛnmaye ca kadācana .. 42 ..
2.2.d:
शुक्तिकांस्यादिहस्तैश्च ताम्ररौप्यादिभिस्तथा॥
संकल्पो नैव कर्तव्यो मृन्मये च कदाचन ॥ 42 ॥
2.2.m: With bowls made of conch-shell, bronze, and the like, or likewise with copper, silver, and the rest, / a solemn vow should never be made, nor ever in an earthen one.

2.2.s:
praṇavaṃ pūrvamuccārya yajedyajñeśvaraṃ smaret ..
gaṅgā cādityacaṃdrau ca dyaurbhūmī rātrivāsarau ..43..
2.2.d:
प्रणवं पूर्वमुच्चार्य यजेद्यज्ञेश्वरं स्मरेत् ॥
गङ्गा चादित्यचंद्रौ च द्यौर्भूमी रात्रिवासरौ ॥43॥
2.2.m: Having first uttered the Praṇava, he should sacrifice and remember the Lord of Sacrifice: / 'Gaṅgā, the sun and moon, heaven and earth, night and day,

2.2.s:
sūryaḥ somo yamaḥ kālo mahābhūtāni paṃca ca ..
ete śubhāśubhāsyeha karmaṇo nava sākṣiṇaḥ .. 44 ..
2.2.d:
सूर्यः सोमो यमः कालो महाभूतानि पंच च ॥
एते शुभाशुभास्येह कर्मणो नव साक्षिणः ॥ 44 ॥
2.2.m: the sun, the moon, Yama, Time, and the five great elements— / these are the nine witnesses here to a good or evil deed.'

2.2.s:
ityuccārya nyaseddharmaṃ dhyātvā puṣpāñjaliṃ sṛjet ..
amṛtaṃ kṛtyapātre ca oṃ tatsaditi nirdiśet .. 45 ..
2.2.d:
इत्युच्चार्य न्यसेद्धर्मं ध्यात्वा पुष्पाञ्जलिं सृजेत् ॥
अमृतं कृत्यपात्रे च ओं तत्सदिति निर्दिशेत् ॥ 45 ॥
2.2.m: Having recited this, he should establish Dharma; having meditated, he should offer a handful of flowers. / He should consign the nectar into the vessel for the rite, saying, 'Oṃ tat sat.'

2.2.s:
dharmaḥ śubhravapuḥ sitāṃbaradharaḥ kāryordhvadeśe vṛṣo hastābhyāmabhayaṃ varaṃ ca satataṃ rūpaṃ paraṃ yo dadhat ..
sarvaprāṇisukhāvahaḥ kṛtadhiyāṃ mokṣaikahetuḥ sadā soyaṃ pātu jagaṃti caiva satataṃ bhūyātsatāṃ bhūtaye .. 46 ..
2.2.d:
धर्मः शुभ्रवपुः सितांबरधरः कार्योर्ध्वदेशे वृषो हस्ताभ्यामभयं वरं च सततं रूपं परं यो दधत् ॥
सर्वप्राणिसुखावहः कृतधियां मोक्षैकहेतुः सदा सोयं पातु जगंति चैव सततं भूयात्सतां भूतये ॥ 46 ॥
2.2.m: Dharma, whose body is white, who wears white garments, is to be fashioned above as a bull, / ever bearing in his two hands the gesture of fearlessness and a boon, and possessing a supreme form; / he brings happiness to all living beings and is always the sole cause of liberation for those of cultivated intellect— / may this very one protect the worlds and always be for the welfare of the virtuous!

2.2.s:
yajñasaṃbaṃdhiviprāṃśca ekāhenaiva yojayet ..
havirdravyāṇi yāni syuraṣṭayāgāṃtarepi ca .. 47 ..
2.2.d:
यज्ञसंबंधिविप्रांश्च एकाहेनैव योजयेत् ॥
हविर्द्रव्याणि यानि स्युरष्टयागांतरेपि च ॥ 47 ॥
2.2.m: And he should engage the Brahmins connected with the sacrifice in a single day; / and whatever oblational materials there may be, even within eight sacrifices,

2.2.s:
punaḥpunarniyojyāni brāhmaṇā haviragnayaḥ .. 48 ..
yogasthāpanadevapratiṣṭhāpanavarṇanam
2.2.d:
पुनःपुनर्नियोज्यानि ब्राह्मणा हविरग्नयः ॥ 48 ॥
योगस्थापनदेवप्रतिष्ठापनवर्णनम्
2.2.m:
the Brahmins, the oblation, and the fires are to be employed again and again.
Description of the establishment of yoga and the consecration of deities.

2.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
māghādimāseṣvapi ṣaṭsu kāryā yogapratiṣṭhā ṛṣibhiḥ praṇītā ..
devādisaṃsthāpanamā huratra yāvanna supto madhusūdanaśca .. 1 ..
2.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
माघादिमासेष्वपि षट्सु कार्या योगप्रतिष्ठा ऋषिभिः प्रणीता ॥
देवादिसंस्थापनमा हुरत्र यावन्न सुप्तो मधुसूदनश्च ॥ 1 ॥
2.2.m: Sūta said: / The consecration of yoga has been prescribed by the sages to be performed during the six months beginning with Māgha. / The installation of deities and the like is said to take place here as long as Madhusūdana is not asleep.

2.2.s:
vāre bhṛgordevagurorbudhasya somasya sarvāḥ śubhadā bhavaṃti ..
lagne śubhasthe śubhavīkṣite vā kāryā pratiṣṭhā ca jalāśayānām .. 2 ..
2.2.d:
वारे भृगोर्देवगुरोर्बुधस्य सोमस्य सर्वाः शुभदा भवंति ॥
लग्ने शुभस्थे शुभवीक्षिते वा कार्या प्रतिष्ठा च जलाशयानाम् ॥ 2 ॥
2.2.m: On the days of Śukra, the priest of the gods, Budha, and Soma, all [consecrations] bestow auspiciousness. / The consecration of reservoirs should be performed when an auspicious [planet] occupies the ascendant or when it is aspected by an auspicious [planet].

2.2.s:
śuddhā dvitīyā ca tathā tṛtīyā trayodaśī cāpi tathaiva viprāḥ ..
tathāpi saptamyapi paurṇamāsī daśamyasau cāpyatha paṃcamī ca .. 3 ..
2.2.d:
शुद्धा द्वितीया च तथा तृतीया त्रयोदशी चापि तथैव विप्राः ॥
तथापि सप्तम्यपि पौर्णमासी दशम्यसौ चाप्यथ पंचमी च ॥ 3 ॥
2.2.m: The bright second, O Brahmins, and likewise the third, and the thirteenth; / likewise the seventh, the full moon, the tenth, and also the fifth—

2.2.s:
prāṇapratiṣṭhā ca jalāśayāderetāḥ praśastāstithayo bhavaṃti ..
aprāpya caitāni śubhāni yāni kāryā pratiṣṭhā viṣuvadvaye ca .. 4 ..
2.2.d:
प्राणप्रतिष्ठा च जलाशयादेरेताः प्रशस्तास्तिथयो भवंति ॥
अप्राप्य चैतानि शुभानि यानि कार्या प्रतिष्ठा विषुवद्वये च ॥ 4 ॥
2.2.m: these are the commended lunar days for the consecration of the life-breath in reservoirs and the like. / If these auspicious [times] cannot be obtained, the consecration should be performed at the two equinoxes,

2.2.s:
ṣaḍaśītilokāpyayanadvayena yugādike puṇyādine śubhe ca ..
kāryā taḍāgādijalāśayasya prācyāṃ pratiṣṭhā atha cottare vā .. 5 ..
2.2.d:
षडशीतिलोकाप्ययनद्वयेन युगादिके पुण्यादिने शुभे च ॥
कार्या तडागादिजलाशयस्य प्राच्यां प्रतिष्ठा अथ चोत्तरे वा ॥ 5 ॥
2.2.m: at the two Ṣaḍaśītis, at the World-increase, at the start of a Yuga, or on an auspicious sacred day. / The consecration of a reservoir such as a pond should be performed in the east or in the north.

2.2.s:
sucāru īṣatpravaṇe ca deśe suvartulaḥ ṣoḍaśahastamaṃḍapaḥ ..
dvāraiścaturbhiḥ prathitairupetaścaturmukhaścāpi bhavetsuretāḥ .. 6 ..
2.2.d:
सुचारु ईषत्प्रवणे च देशे सुवर्तुलः षोडशहस्तमंडपः ॥
द्वारैश्चतुर्भिः प्रथितैरुपेतश्चतुर्मुखश्चापि भवेत्सुरेताः ॥ 6 ॥
2.2.m: In a very pleasant, slightly sloping place, [there should be] a well-rounded pavilion of sixteen cubits, / endowed with four renowned gateways, and having four faces, well-seeded.

2.2.s:
pūrvādidvāreṣu catuṣṭayeṣu plakṣādibhistoraṇakaiḥ sureśaḥ ..
plakṣastathoduṃbarapippalau ca nyagrodhakaṃ cāpi yathākrameṇa ..7..
2.2.d:
पूर्वादिद्वारेषु चतुष्टयेषु प्लक्षादिभिस्तोरणकैः सुरेशः ॥
प्लक्षस्तथोदुंबरपिप्पलौ च न्यग्रोधकं चापि यथाक्रमेण ॥7॥
2.2.m: At the four gateways beginning with the east, O lord of the gods, [there are to be] arches made of plakṣa and other [trees]: / plakṣa, udumbara, pippala, and nyagrodha respectively in order.

2.2.s:
ūrdhve ca hastānamitāni yāni vicitramālyāṃbarabhūṣitāni ..
bhūmau yathā prīti ca hastakāni bhavaṃti caitānyapi toraṇāni ..8..
2.2.d:
ऊर्ध्वे च हस्तानमितानि यानि विचित्रमाल्यांबरभूषितानि ॥
भूमौ यथा प्रीति च हस्तकानि भवंति चैतान्यपि तोरणानि ॥8॥
2.2.m: Measured in cubits upwards, decorated with colourful garlands and cloths, / these arches are also measured in cubits on the ground according to desire.

2.2.s:
sarvatra yāgepi hi maṃḍapasya kāryā dhvajā dikṣu vidikṣu śubhrāḥ..
dikpālavarṇābhapatākayuktā madhye ca vai nīlapatākayuktāḥ .. 9 ..
2.2.d:
सर्वत्र यागेपि हि मंडपस्य कार्या ध्वजा दिक्षु विदिक्षु शुभ्राः॥
दिक्पालवर्णाभपताकयुक्ता मध्ये च वै नीलपताकयुक्ताः ॥ 9 ॥
2.2.m: Everywhere in the sacrifice, bright banners should be placed in the cardinal and intermediate directions of the pavilion, / accompanied by flags having the colours and splendours of the guardians of the directions, and in the centre, accompanied by a blue flag.

2.2.s:
dhvajāśca yasmindaśahastasammitāstasminpatākā api pañcahastāḥ ..
aratnimātrā yadi mūlabhāge paṃcāṃgu lāgre vinibaddhagūḍhāḥ .. 2.2.18.10 ..
2.2.d:
ध्वजाश्च यस्मिन्दशहस्तसम्मितास्तस्मिन्पताका अपि पञ्चहस्ताः ॥
अरत्निमात्रा यदि मूलभागे पंचांगु लाग्रे विनिबद्धगूढाः ॥ 2.2.18.10 ॥
2.2.m: Where the flagstaffs are measured at ten cubits, the flags are five cubits; / they are of the measure of an aratni at the base and secretly fastened at the tip of five fingers.

2.2.s:
dvāre ca tasmiṃśca nirūpitā vā raṃbhā supuṣpā sukhaśāḍvalāśca ..
vacābhivṛkṣottarapaṃcahastāḥ sapaṃcaśākhā api tora ṇāni ..11..
2.2.d:
द्वारे च तस्मिंश्च निरूपिता वा रंभा सुपुष्पा सुखशाड्वलाश्च ॥
वचाभिवृक्षोत्तरपंचहस्ताः सपंचशाखा अपि तोर णानि ॥11॥
2.2.m: At that gateway are set plantain trees with beautiful flowers and pleasant lawns, / or five-cubit vacā trees to the north, and arches with five branches.

2.2.s:
muṃjodbhavairbarhisamudbhavairvā suraṃjitaścettritapadmapallavaiḥ ..
puṣṭadvaye sūtritaṃ veṣṭayecca tathekṣukāṇḍairatha yāgamaṇḍapam..12..
2.2.d:
मुंजोद्भवैर्बर्हिसमुद्भवैर्वा सुरंजितश्चेत्त्रितपद्मपल्लवैः ॥
पुष्टद्वये सूत्रितं वेष्टयेच्च तथेक्षुकाण्डैरथ यागमण्डपम्॥12॥
2.2.m: Coloured with muñja grass or sacrificial grass, or with three layers of lotus shoots, / bound with cords at the two sides, he should also enclose the sacrificial pavilion with sugarcane stalks.

2.2.s:
vedistathā maṃḍapa madhyabhāge kāryā ca koṇesthituṣādihīnā..
hastocchritā reravavatī surekhapariṣkṛtā hastacatuṣṭayena .. 13 ..
2.2.d:
वेदिस्तथा मंडप मध्यभागे कार्या च कोणेस्थितुषादिहीना॥
हस्तोच्छ्रिता रेरववती सुरेखपरिष्कृता हस्तचतुष्टयेन ॥ 13 ॥
2.2.m: An altar should likewise be made in the middle part of the pavilion, free of chaff and the like in the corners, / one cubit high, having gravel, adorned with beautiful lines, measuring four cubits.

2.2.s:
vedyāṃ parityajya daśāṃgulāni aiśānyata strīṇi tathā parāṇi ..
kuṃḍāya dadyāccaturasramekamavasthitaṃ tryaṃgulamekhalojjvalam..14..
2.2.d:
वेद्यां परित्यज्य दशांगुलानि ऐशान्यत स्त्रीणि तथा पराणि ॥
कुंडाय दद्याच्चतुरस्रमेकमवस्थितं त्र्यंगुलमेखलोज्ज्वलम्॥14॥
2.2.m: Leaving ten digits on the altar, and three others from the north-east, / he should provide for the sacrificial pit one square [space] established with a gleaming girdle of three digits.

2.2.s:
prāsāde ca taḍāge ca mahārāme tathaiva ca ..
maṃḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ prayatnenaiva kārayet ..15..
2.2.d:
प्रासादे च तडागे च महारामे तथैव च ॥
मंडलं सर्वतोभद्रं प्रयत्नेनैव कारयेत् ॥15॥
2.2.m: In a temple, at a pond, and likewise in a great grove, / he should carefully make a sarvatobhadra diagram.

2.2.s:
kuṃḍaṃ cāpi prakurvīta yathābhyantaramekhalam ..
bahiryonigataṃ śvetaṃ niścitraṃ samasūtrakam ..16..
2.2.d:
कुंडं चापि प्रकुर्वीत यथाभ्यन्तरमेखलम् ॥
बहिर्योनिगतं श्वेतं निश्चित्रं समसूत्रकम् ॥16॥
2.2.m: And he should fashion the sacrificial pit so that its girdle is on the inside, / with its vulva-base on the outside, white, devoid of variegated patterns, and straightly aligned with the cord.

2.2.s:
kuṃḍāni kuryānnava kuṃḍapakṣe vedyāstathoccairavidikṣu caiva.
sarvāṇi sarvatra ca mekhalāni ṣaḍasrapaṃcāsrasamekhalāni..17..
2.2.d:
कुंडानि कुर्यान्नव कुंडपक्षे वेद्यास्तथोच्चैरविदिक्षु चैव।
सर्वाणि सर्वत्र च मेखलानि षडस्रपंचास्रसमेखलानि॥17॥
2.2.m: In the option of nine sacrificial pits, he should make the sacrificial pits high upon the altar in the cardinal and intermediate directions; / all of them with girdles everywhere—hexagonal, pentagonal, with equal girdles,

2.2.s:
aṣṭāsrajānyabjatrikoṇakāni tathārddhacandraṃ caturasrakaṃ ca..
kuṇḍasya pūrvottaradigvibhāge sthāpyo ghaṭaścandanacāruliptaḥ .. 18 ..
2.2.d:
अष्टास्रजान्यब्जत्रिकोणकानि तथार्द्धचन्द्रं चतुरस्रकं च॥
कुण्डस्य पूर्वोत्तरदिग्विभागे स्थाप्यो घटश्चन्दनचारुलिप्तः ॥ 18 ॥
2.2.m: octagonal, lotus-shaped, triangular, semi-circular, and square. / In the north-eastern direction of the sacrificial pit, a jar beautifully anointed with sandal should be installed,

2.2.s:
mālyāmbarācchāditapūrṇapāthāḥ savṛttapatraśca suvarṇagarbhaḥ .. 19 ..
..
devagrahapūjāvidhānavarṇanam
2.2.d:
माल्याम्बराच्छादितपूर्णपाथाः सवृत्तपत्रश्च सुवर्णगर्भः ॥ 19 ॥
॥
देवग्रहपूजाविधानवर्णनम्
2.2.m:
full of water, covered with a garland and cloth, having round leaves, and containing gold within.
..
Description of the procedure for worshipping the deities and the planets.

2.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
gato yāgagṛhādanyanmaṇḍalāṃtaramāśritaḥ ..
yajamānastathā nityaṃ karma kṛtvā yathāvidhi .. 1 ..
2.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
गतो यागगृहादन्यन्मण्डलांतरमाश्रितः ॥
यजमानस्तथा नित्यं कर्म कृत्वा यथाविधि ॥ 1 ॥
2.2.m: Sūta said: / Having departed from the sacrificial house and resorted to another diagram, / the sacrificer, having performed his daily duty according to the rule,

2.2.s:
paṃca devānnamaskṛtya tathā yajñeśvaraṃ harim ..
saṃkalpaṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvā brāhmaṇānāmanujñayā .. 2 ..
2.2.d:
पंच देवान्नमस्कृत्य तथा यज्ञेश्वरं हरिम् ॥
संकल्पं च ततः कृत्वा ब्राह्मणानामनुज्ञया ॥ 2 ॥
2.2.m: having bowed to the five deities and Hari, the Lord of Sacrifice, / and then having made his solemn vow with the permission of the Brahmins:

2.2.s:
etasminpuṇyadeśe tu phalaṃ gotraśca vai yamaḥ ..
vedavyāsādipraṇītaṃ yathāśāstranidarśanam .. 3 ..
2.2.d:
एतस्मिन्पुण्यदेशे तु फलं गोत्रश्च वै यमः ॥
वेदव्यासादिप्रणीतं यथाशास्त्रनिदर्शनम् ॥ 3 ॥
2.2.m: 'In this sacred place, the fruit, the lineage, and Yama— / as taught by Vedavyāsa and others, following the demonstration of the treatises,

2.2.s:
yathāyathā svatantroktaṃ puṇyā raṇyābhidhāyakam ..
jalāśayapratiṣṭhāyāṃ kariṣye vidhivaddvijāḥ .. 4 ..
2.2.d:
यथायथा स्वतन्त्रोक्तं पुण्या रण्याभिधायकम् ॥
जलाशयप्रतिष्ठायां करिष्ये विधिवद्द्विजाः ॥ 4 ॥
2.2.m: just as declared in the respective texts describing sacred forests, / I shall perform [the rite] according to rule for the consecration of the reservoir, O twice-born.'

2.2.s:
yathāyathā ca kalpoktaṃ yathākuṇḍaṃ vidhānataḥ ..
sādhivāsaṃ yathaivaikaḥ puṇyāraṇyavidhāyakaḥ .. 5 ..
2.2.d:
यथायथा च कल्पोक्तं यथाकुण्डं विधानतः ॥
साधिवासं यथैवैकः पुण्यारण्यविधायकः ॥ 5 ॥
2.2.m: And just as declared in the ritual manual, according to the sacrificial pit in the prescribed manner, / together with the preliminary consecration, just as a single person performs the sacred grove ritual,

2.2.s:
jalāśayapratiṣṭhāṃ ca kariṣye vidhivaddvijāḥ ..
saṃkalpamevaṃ kṛtvā tu vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ samācaret .. 6 ..
2.2.d:
जलाशयप्रतिष्ठां च करिष्ये विधिवद्द्विजाः ॥
संकल्पमेवं कृत्वा तु वृद्धिश्राद्धं समाचरेत् ॥ 6 ॥
2.2.m: so 'I shall perform the consecration of the reservoir according to rule, O twice-born.' / Having thus made the formal resolve, he should perform the vṛddhiśrāddha.

2.2.s: mātṛyāgaṃ puraskṛtya vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ samāpayet..7..
2.2.d: मातृयागं पुरस्कृत्य वृद्धिश्राद्धं समापयेत्॥7॥
2.2.m: Having first performed the sacrifice to the Mothers, he should conclude the vṛddhiśrāddha.

2.2.s:
bheryādighoṣeṇa sumaṃgalena padyaṃ likhedatra saṣoḍaśākṣaram ..
indrādidikpālavarāyudhāni samullikhedeva diśi sthitāni .. .. 8 ..
2.2.d:
भेर्यादिघोषेण सुमंगलेन पद्यं लिखेदत्र सषोडशाक्षरम् ॥
इन्द्रादिदिक्पालवरायुधानि समुल्लिखेदेव दिशि स्थितानि ॥ ॥ 8 ॥
2.2.m: With the auspicious sound of kettle-drums and the like, he should draw here a sixteen-syllabled lotus-verse; / he should delineate the excellent weapons of the guardians of the directions, Indra and the rest, situated in each direction.

2.2.s:
brahmeśānvarayetsarvānācāryaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ ..
svarṇakuṃḍalayugmena tathā tāmrādibhājanaiḥ .. 9 ..
2.2.d:
ब्रह्मेशान्वरयेत्सर्वानाचार्यं तु विशेषतः ॥
स्वर्णकुंडलयुग्मेन तथा ताम्रादिभाजनैः ॥ 9 ॥
2.2.m: He should choose all the priests, [such as] the Brahman, and the officiating teacher in particular, / with a pair of gold earrings and likewise with vessels of copper and other metals.

2.2.s:
nānāratnaiśca vastraiśca ācāryaṃ varayedbudhaḥ ..
hemālaṃkārayugmaiśca vāsobhirvividharaipi .. 2.2.19.10 ..
2.2.d:
नानारत्नैश्च वस्त्रैश्च आचार्यं वरयेद्बुधः ॥
हेमालंकारयुग्मैश्च वासोभिर्विविधरैपि ॥ 2.2.19.10 ॥
2.2.m: With various jewels and garments the wise man should choose the officiating teacher, / and with pairs of gold ornaments and varied cloths.

2.2.s:
yathāmānaṃ yathāśakti yathābhivṛṇuyādbudhaḥ ..
racitā yajamānena dhruvaṃ svastyastu te iti ..11..
2.2.d:
यथामानं यथाशक्ति यथाभिवृणुयाद्बुधः ॥
रचिता यजमानेन ध्रुवं स्वस्त्यस्तु ते इति ॥11॥
2.2.m: According to measure, according to capacity, just as the wise man should choose them, / arranged by the patron of the sacrifice, [he says,] 'May there truly be well-being for you.'

2.2.s:
tataḥ sarvauṣadhībhiśca yajamānaḥ sapatnikaḥ ..
āpohiṣṭhetimantreṇa snāpayāmāsuraprajāḥ .. 12 ..
2.2.d:
ततः सर्वौषधीभिश्च यजमानः सपत्निकः ॥
आपोहिष्ठेतिमन्त्रेण स्नापयामासुरप्रजाः ॥ 12 ॥
2.2.m: Then with all the herbs, along with his wife, / with the mantra 'āpo hi ṣṭhā', they bathed the childless patron of the sacrifice.

2.2.s:
yavagodhūmanīvāratilaśyāmākaśālayaḥ ..
priyaṃguvrīhayaścāṣṭau sarvauṣadhigaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 13 ..
2.2.d:
यवगोधूमनीवारतिलश्यामाकशालयः ॥
प्रियंगुव्रीहयश्चाष्टौ सर्वौषधिगणः स्मृतः ॥ 13 ॥
2.2.m: Barley, wheat, wild rice, sesame, black millet, śāli rice, / priyaṅgu, and paddy rice: these eight are considered the collection of all herbs.

2.2.s:
tataḥ śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuklamālyānulepanaḥ ..
sarvauṣadhyudakasnātaḥ snāpito vedapuṅgavaiḥ .. 14 ..
2.2.d:
ततः शुक्लाम्बरधरः शुक्लमाल्यानुलेपनः ॥
सर्वौषध्युदकस्नातः स्नापितो वेदपुङ्गवैः ॥ 14 ॥
2.2.m: Then, clad in white garments, with white garlands and ointments, / bathed with the water of all the herbs, having been bathed by the pre-eminent knowers of the Vedas,

2.2.s:
brāhmaṇairabhyanujñātaḥ purohitapuraḥsaraḥ ..
nānāmaṃgalaghoṣeṇa bherīpaṭahanisvanaiḥ .. 15 ..
2.2.d:
ब्राह्मणैरभ्यनुज्ञातः पुरोहितपुरःसरः ॥
नानामंगलघोषेण भेरीपटहनिस्वनैः ॥ 15 ॥
2.2.m: permitted by the brāhmaṇas, preceded by the family priest, / with diverse auspicious sounds and the roars of kettle-drums and paṭaha drums,

2.2.s:
yajamānaḥ sapatnīkaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ ..
paścimaṃ dvāramāsādya praviśed yāgamaṇḍapam .. 16 ..
2.2.d:
यजमानः सपत्नीकः पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः ॥
पश्चिमं द्वारमासाद्य प्रविशेद् यागमण्डपम् ॥ 16 ॥
2.2.m: the patron of the sacrifice, together with his wife and accompanied by sons and grandsons, / having approached the western door, should enter the sacrificial pavilion.

2.2.s:
carake pūjayedvighnaṃ gaṃgāṃ ca yamunāṃ tathā ..
pārśvayoścārdhato lakṣmīṃ pratihāramanukramāt .. 17 ..
2.2.d:
चरके पूजयेद्विघ्नं गंगां च यमुनां तथा ॥
पार्श्वयोश्चार्धतो लक्ष्मीं प्रतिहारमनुक्रमात् ॥ 17 ॥
2.2.m: At the threshold he should worship Vighna, and likewise Gaṅgā and Yamunā, / and on the two flanks, half-way, Lakṣmī and the door-keeper in succession.

2.2.s:
vediṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya namaskuryādyathāvidhi ..
upaviśya tatastasminbrāhmaṇānumate sthitaḥ .. 18 ..
2.2.d:
वेदिं प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य नमस्कुर्याद्यथाविधि ॥
उपविश्य ततस्तस्मिन्ब्राह्मणानुमते स्थितः ॥ 18 ॥
2.2.m: Having circumambulated the altar, he should pay homage according to rule; / then sitting down upon it, remaining with the brāhmaṇas' permission,

2.2.s:
svasti vācyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā paṃca devānprapūjayet ..
bhūtotsādaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā vikirānvikiredbhuvi .. 19 ..
2.2.d:
स्वस्ति वाच्यं ततः कृत्वा पंच देवान्प्रपूजयेत् ॥
भूतोत्सादं ततः कृत्वा विकिरान्विकिरेद्भुवि ॥ 19 ॥
2.2.m: having then pronounced the svasti blessings, he should worship the five deities. / Having then expelled the spirits, he should scatter the scatter-offerings upon the ground:

2.2.s:
apakrāmaṃtu ye bhūtā ye cāsminviprakārakāḥ ..
yasmānno nāmni vartaṃte yajñamātraṃ pravartatām .. 2.2.19.20 ..
2.2.d:
अपक्रामंतु ये भूता ये चास्मिन्विप्रकारकाः ॥
यस्मान्नो नाम्नि वर्तंते यज्ञमात्रं प्रवर्तताम् ॥ 2.2.19.20 ॥
2.2.m: 'May the spirits depart, and whoever are obstructors here; / since they do not abide in our name, let the sacrifice proceed!'

2.2.s:
pūjayedāsanaṃ paścātsvakīyaṃ puṣpacaṃdanaiḥ ..
namonaṃtāsanāyeti tathā padmāsanāya ca .. 21 ..
2.2.d:
पूजयेदासनं पश्चात्स्वकीयं पुष्पचंदनैः ॥
नमोनंतासनायेति तथा पद्मासनाय च ॥ 21 ॥
2.2.m: Afterwards he should worship his own seat with flowers and sandal-paste: / 'Obeisance to the seat of Ananta', and likewise 'to the lotus-seat';

2.2.s:
vimalāsanāya ca namo namaḥ sārāsanāya ca ..
yogāsanāya ca namaḥ pṛthivyai nama ityapi .. 22 ..
2.2.d:
विमलासनाय च नमो नमः सारासनाय च ॥
योगासनाय च नमः पृथिव्यै नम इत्यपि ॥ 22 ॥
2.2.m: 'And obeisance to the spotless seat, obeisance to the essence-seat, / and obeisance to the yoga-seat, and obeisance to the Earth.'

2.2.s:
tato bhūmitale vāmahastaṃ dattvā paṭhennaraḥ ..
pṛthvi tvayā dhṛtā lokā devi tvaṃ viṣṇunā dhṛtā .. 23 ..
2.2.d:
ततो भूमितले वामहस्तं दत्त्वा पठेन्नरः ॥
पृथ्वि त्वया धृता लोका देवि त्वं विष्णुना धृता ॥ 23 ॥
2.2.m: Then placing his left hand on the surface of the earth, the man should recite: / 'O Earth, the worlds are upheld by you; O Goddess, you are upheld by Viṣṇu;

2.2.s:
tvaṃ ca dhāraya māṃ nityaṃ pavitramāsanaṃ kuru ..
sūryāyārghyaṃ tato dattvā guruṃ natvā kṛtāñjaliḥ .. 24 ..
2.2.d:
त्वं च धारय मां नित्यं पवित्रमासनं कुरु ॥
सूर्यायार्घ्यं ततो दत्त्वा गुरुं नत्वा कृताञ्जलिः ॥ 24 ॥
2.2.m: and do you uphold me constantly, and make my seat pure.' / Then having offered water for the arghya to the Sun, bowing to the guru with palms joined in reverence,

2.2.s:
devaṃ hṛtpadmake nītvā prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ caret ..
tato'rcayedvighnarājamaiśānyāṃ ca ghaṭopari .. 25 ..
2.2.d:
देवं हृत्पद्मके नीत्वा प्राणायामत्रयं चरेत् ॥
ततोऽर्चयेद्विघ्नराजमैशान्यां च घटोपरि ॥ 25 ॥
2.2.m: bringing the deity into the lotus of his heart, he should perform three breath-controls. / Then he should worship the King of Obstacles in the northeast, upon the water-pot,

2.2.s:
gandhapuṣpaistathā vastrairnaivedyairvividhairapi ..
gaṇānāṃ tveti maṃtreṇa brahmāṇaṃ tadanaṃtaram .. 26 ..
2.2.d:
गन्धपुष्पैस्तथा वस्त्रैर्नैवेद्यैर्विविधैरपि ॥
गणानां त्वेति मंत्रेण ब्रह्माणं तदनंतरम् ॥ 26 ॥
2.2.m: with fragrant perfumes, flowers, and likewise garments, and diverse food-offerings, / with the mantra 'gaṇānāṃ tvā'. Immediately thereafter, [he should worship] Brahmā

2.2.s:
ābrahmanniti ṛcā tadviṣṇoriti saṃsmaran ..
vāsudevaṃ tataḥ paścādbalibhirgandhacaṃdanaiḥ .. 27 ..
2.2.d:
आब्रह्मन्निति ऋचा तद्विष्णोरिति संस्मरन् ॥
वासुदेवं ततः पश्चाद्बलिभिर्गन्धचंदनैः ॥ 27 ॥
2.2.m: with the verse 'ā brahman', [and Viṣṇu] recollecting 'tad viṣṇoḥ'. / After that, [he should worship] Vāsudeva with food-oblations, perfumes, and sandal-pastes.

2.2.s:
tato devaśarīraṃ tu navamāsādya triṃśatam ..
vedyāśca paritaḥ sarvānsvesve sthāne yathākramam .. 28 ..
2.2.d:
ततो देवशरीरं तु नवमासाद्य त्रिंशतम् ॥
वेद्याश्च परितः सर्वान्स्वेस्वे स्थाने यथाक्रमम् ॥ 28 ॥
2.2.m: Then, having reached thirty-nine divine bodies / all around the altar, [he should worship them] in their respective places in due order.

2.2.s:
tato rājādhirājena bhūtaśuddhiṃ samācaret ..
tato budbudamadhye tu śvetapadmāsanasthitam .. 29 ..
2.2.d:
ततो राजाधिराजेन भूतशुद्धिं समाचरेत् ॥
ततो बुद्बुदमध्ये तु श्वेतपद्मासनस्थितम् ॥ 29 ॥
2.2.m: Then, [empowered] by the king of kings, he should perform the purification of the elements. / Then, situated on a white lotus-seat in the middle of a bubble,

2.2.s:
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ śaṃkhakundendusaprabham..
kirīṭakuṇḍalayutaṃ sitaṃ paṃkajadhāriṇam .. 2.2.19.30 ..
2.2.d:
शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशं शंखकुन्देन्दुसप्रभम्॥
किरीटकुण्डलयुतं सितं पंकजधारिणम् ॥ 2.2.19.30 ॥
2.2.m: resembling pure crystal, having the lustre of a conch, the kunda flower, and the moon, / adorned with a diadem and earrings, fair-complexioned, holding a lotus,

2.2.s:
śuklamālyāṃbaraṃ śuklaṃ śuklagaṃdhānulepanam ..
ahituṇḍāsanasthaṃ ca pāśahastaṃ mahābalam .. 31 ..
2.2.d:
शुक्लमाल्यांबरं शुक्लं शुक्लगंधानुलेपनम् ॥
अहितुण्डासनस्थं च पाशहस्तं महाबलम् ॥ 31 ॥
2.2.m: wearing white garlands and white garments, anointed with white fragrant paste, / seated on a serpent's hood, holding a noose in hand, possessed of great strength,

2.2.s:
stūyamānaṃ suragaṇaiḥ siddhagaṃdharvasevitam ..
sucāruvadanaṃ devaṃ padmamālopaśobhitam .. 32 ..
2.2.d:
स्तूयमानं सुरगणैः सिद्धगंधर्वसेवितम् ॥
सुचारुवदनं देवं पद्ममालोपशोभितम् ॥ 32 ॥
2.2.m: praised by the hosts of gods, attended by Siddhas and Gandharvas, / the god of very charming face, adorned with a garland of lotuses,

2.2.s:
rājīvalocanaṃ nityaṃ nāgalokopaśobhitam ..
makaragrāhakūrmādyairnānājalacarairvṛtam .. 33 ..
2.2.d:
राजीवलोचनं नित्यं नागलोकोपशोभितम् ॥
मकरग्राहकूर्माद्यैर्नानाजलचरैर्वृतम् ॥ 33 ॥
2.2.m: lotus-eyed, constantly adorned by the serpent world, / surrounded by makaras, crocodiles, turtles, and various aquatic creatures,

2.2.s:
jalāśayagataṃ devaṃ ciṃtayejjalaśāyinam..
tato nyāsaṃ prakurvīta pacāṃgatvāvaśobhitam .. 34 ..
2.2.d:
जलाशयगतं देवं चिंतयेज्जलशायिनम्॥
ततो न्यासं प्रकुर्वीत पचांगत्वावशोभितम् ॥ 34 ॥
2.2.m: he should meditate upon the god resting in the waters, residing in the water-reservoir. / Then he should perform the ritual installation of letters, adorned with five limbs.

2.2.s:
arghyapātraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā tribhāgajalapūritam ..
aṣṭadhā mūlamaṃtraṃ ca japtvā tenodakena ca .. 35 ..
2.2.d:
अर्घ्यपात्रं ततः कृत्वा त्रिभागजलपूरितम् ॥
अष्टधा मूलमंत्रं च जप्त्वा तेनोदकेन च ॥ 35 ॥
2.2.m: Then, having prepared the arghya vessel filled with water to three parts, / and having recited the root-mantra eight times, with that water

2.2.s:
āsanaṃ yāgavastūni prokṣayettena vāriṇā ..
aruṇāya vidmahe tamoghnāya ca dhīmahi .. 36 ..
2.2.d:
आसनं यागवस्तूनि प्रोक्षयेत्तेन वारिणा ॥
अरुणाय विद्महे तमोघ्नाय च धीमहि ॥ 36 ॥
2.2.m: he should sprinkle the seat and the sacrificial requisites with that water. / 'We know Aruṇa, and we meditate on the dispeller of darkness;

2.2.s:
tanno aruṇaḥ pracodayāditi snānaṃ samācaret ..
tato gaṇeśamaiśānyāmāgneyyāṃ gurupādukām.. 37 ..
2.2.d:
तन्नो अरुणः प्रचोदयादिति स्नानं समाचरेत् ॥
ततो गणेशमैशान्यामाग्नेय्यां गुरुपादुकाम्॥ 37 ॥
2.2.m: may that Aruṇa impel us'—saying this, he should perform the bath. / Then Gaṇeśa in the northeast, the sandals of the guru in the southeast,

2.2.s:
dharmādharmādikānsarvāntsattvādīnatha cārcayet ..
sūryasomajalādīnāṃ maṇḍalāni yathākramam ..38..
2.2.d:
धर्माधर्मादिकान्सर्वान्त्सत्त्वादीनथ चार्चयेत् ॥
सूर्यसोमजलादीनां मण्डलानि यथाक्रमम् ॥38॥
2.2.m: and then he should worship all [principles], beginning with righteousness and unrighteousness, and beginning with sattva, / and the circles of the sun, moon, water, and the others, in due order.

2.2.s:
madhye śaktiṃ ca kṣīrodamanaṃtaṃ pṛthivīṃ tathā ..
kūrmaṃ cādhāraśaktiṃ ca sumeruṃ mandaraṃ tathā .. 39 ..
2.2.d:
मध्ये शक्तिं च क्षीरोदमनंतं पृथिवीं तथा ॥
कूर्मं चाधारशक्तिं च सुमेरुं मन्दरं तथा ॥ 39 ॥
2.2.m: In the centre, [he should worship] the Śakti, the Milk Ocean, Ananta, and likewise the Earth, / the Tortoise, the Foundation-Śakti, and likewise Mount Sumeru and Mandara.

2.2.s:
pañcatattvaṃ samabhyarcya sāṃgopāgamanaṃtaram ..
tataḥ śvetaṃ ca kusumaṃ sākṣataṃ yogamāyayā .. 2.2.19.40 ..
2.2.d:
पञ्चतत्त्वं समभ्यर्च्य सांगोपागमनंतरम् ॥
ततः श्वेतं च कुसुमं साक्षतं योगमायया ॥ 2.2.19.40 ॥
2.2.m: Having worshipped the five elements together with the primary and secondary limbs immediately after, / then taking a white flower along with unbroken grains by means of Yogamāyā,

2.2.s:
gṛhītvā pūrvavaddeśe sthāpayetkalaśopari ..
āvāhanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā mantreṇānena maṃtravit .. 41 ..
2.2.d:
गृहीत्वा पूर्ववद्देशे स्थापयेत्कलशोपरि ॥
आवाहनं ततः कृत्वा मन्त्रेणानेन मंत्रवित् ॥ 41 ॥
2.2.m: he should place it upon the water-pot in the place as before. / Then having performed the invocation with this mantra, the knower of mantras [should say]:

2.2.s:
ehyehi bhagavanvaruṇa eṣa yajñaḥ pravartate ..
yajñabhāgaṃ gṛhāṇedaṃ tvāmevāvāhayāmyaham .. 42 ..
2.2.d:
एह्येहि भगवन्वरुण एष यज्ञः प्रवर्तते ॥
यज्ञभागं गृहाणेदं त्वामेवावाहयाम्यहम् ॥ 42 ॥
2.2.m: 'Come, come, O Lord Varuṇa, this sacrifice is taking place! / Receive this sacrificial share; it is you alone whom I invoke!'

2.2.s:
evamāvāhya lokeśamaṣṭau mudrāḥ pradarśayet ..
gāyatryā snāpayitvā tu dadyātpādyādikatrayam .. 43 ..
2.2.d:
एवमावाह्य लोकेशमष्टौ मुद्राः प्रदर्शयेत् ॥
गायत्र्या स्नापयित्वा तु दद्यात्पाद्यादिकत्रयम् ॥ 43 ॥
2.2.m: Having thus invoked the Lord of the World, he should display the eight mudrās. / Having bathed him with the Gāyatrī, he should offer the triad beginning with foot-washing water.

2.2.s:
puṣpāñjaliṃ tato dattvā mūlamaṃtreṇa deśikaḥ ..
pūrvādipatramūleṣu dharmādīnpūjayedbudhaḥ .. 44 ..
2.2.d:
पुष्पाञ्जलिं ततो दत्त्वा मूलमंत्रेण देशिकः ॥
पूर्वादिपत्रमूलेषु धर्मादीन्पूजयेद्बुधः ॥ 44 ॥
2.2.m: Then having offered an añjali of flowers with the root-mantra, the spiritual teacher, / the wise man, should worship righteousness and the rest at the bases of the petals beginning in the east.

2.2.s:
sattvādyāḥ pūjayettatra teṣāmeva varāṃganāḥ ..
jñānaṃ dharmaṃ ca somaṃ ca rajaḥ sattvaṃ tamastathā .. 45 ..
2.2.d:
सत्त्वाद्याः पूजयेत्तत्र तेषामेव वरांगनाः ॥
ज्ञानं धर्मं च सोमं च रजः सत्त्वं तमस्तथा ॥ 45 ॥
2.2.m: There he should worship the principles beginning with sattva, and their excellent consorts: / knowledge, righteousness, the moon, and rajas, sattva, and tamas.

2.2.s:
pūrvādipatramadhye tu grahānaṣṭau prapūjayet ..
