2.2.m: upon a nandyāvarta design drawn in sandal paste, the wise person should then purify them, / each one with its respective mantra, individually over the water.

2.2.s:
dhruvapratikṛtairmaṃtrairaṣṭabhiśca yathākramam ..
pūrvākṣataṃ māṣabhaktabaliṃ dadyādvidhānataḥ .. 244 ..
2.2.d:
ध्रुवप्रतिकृतैर्मंत्रैरष्टभिश्च यथाक्रमम् ॥
पूर्वाक्षतं माषभक्तबलिं दद्याद्विधानतः ॥ 244 ॥
2.2.m: In proper sequence with the eight mantras designated as fixed, / he should offer according to rule a preliminary oblation of unbroken rice and cooked black gram.

2.2.s:
tato nārāyaṇasūktena devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vrajet ..
anyeṣāṃ caiva devānāṃ pradadyāttriṃśataṃ balim .. 245 ..
2.2.d:
ततो नारायणसूक्तेन देवं नारायणं व्रजेत् ॥
अन्येषां चैव देवानां प्रदद्यात्त्रिंशतं बलिम् ॥ 245 ॥
2.2.m: Then, with the Nārāyaṇa-sūkta, he should approach the god Nārāyaṇa; / and for the other gods, he should present thirty oblations.

2.2.s:
tata ācamanīyaṃ ca vastrayugmaṃ nivedayet ..
vakṣyamāṇena maṃtreṇa krameṇāpi vidhānataḥ .. 246 ..
2.2.d:
तत आचमनीयं च वस्त्रयुग्मं निवेदयेत् ॥
वक्ष्यमाणेन मंत्रेण क्रमेणापि विधानतः ॥ 246 ॥
2.2.m: Then he should present water for sipping and a pair of garments, / with the mantra to be spoken, and in sequence according to rule.

2.2.s:
pṛthakpṛthaktato dadyāttāvaṃtyenāpi bho dvijāḥ ..
vedasūktasamāyukte yajñasūtrasamanvite ..
sarvavarṇaprade deva vāsasī te vinirmite ..247..
2.2.d:
पृथक्पृथक्ततो दद्यात्तावंत्येनापि भो द्विजाः ॥
वेदसूक्तसमायुक्ते यज्ञसूत्रसमन्विते ॥
सर्ववर्णप्रदे देव वाससी ते विनिर्मिते ॥247॥
2.2.m: Then one should offer them individually in equal measure, O brahmins: / 'Endowed with Vedic hymns, provided with a sacred thread, / bestowing all colours, O Lord, these two garments are fashioned for you.'

2.2.s:
śarīraṃ te na jānāmi ceṣṭāṃ naiva ca naiva ca ..
mayā niveditāngandhānpragṛhya ca vilipyatām ..248..
2.2.d:
शरीरं ते न जानामि चेष्टां नैव च नैव च ॥
मया निवेदितान्गन्धान्प्रगृह्य च विलिप्यताम् ॥248॥
2.2.m: 'I know not your body, nor your movements; / accepting the perfumes offered by me, may you be anointed.'

2.2.s:
aṣṭottaraśatāndīpānparitaḥ sthāpayetkramāt ..
tadardhaṃ vā pañcaviṃśaṃ maṃtreṇa prayajetsudhīḥ .. 249 ..
2.2.d:
अष्टोत्तरशतान्दीपान्परितः स्थापयेत्क्रमात् ॥
तदर्धं वा पञ्चविंशं मंत्रेण प्रयजेत्सुधीः ॥ 249 ॥
2.2.m: One should set up one hundred and eight lamps all around in order; / or half of that, or twenty-five, the wise man should worship with the mantra:

2.2.s:
tvaṃ sūryyacandrajyotīṃṣi viṣādastvaṃ tathaiva ca..
tvameva sarvajyotīṃṣi dīpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām .. 2.2.19.250 ..
2.2.d:
त्वं सूर्य्यचन्द्रज्योतींषि विषादस्त्वं तथैव च॥
त्वमेव सर्वज्योतींषि दीपोऽयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् ॥ 2.2.19.250 ॥
2.2.m: 'You are the lights of the sun and moon, and you are indeed sadness; / you alone are all lights: may this lamp be accepted.'

2.2.s:
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kuryātpañcadhā saptadhātha vā ..
vakṣyamāṇena maṃtreṇa dadyāddhūpaṃ daśāṃgakam .. 251 ..
2.2.d:
प्रदक्षिणं ततः कुर्यात्पञ्चधा सप्तधाथ वा ॥
वक्ष्यमाणेन मंत्रेण दद्याद्धूपं दशांगकम् ॥ 251 ॥
2.2.m: Then he should make circumambulations, five times or seven times; / with the mantra to be spoken he should offer incense of ten ingredients:

2.2.s:
vanaspatiraso divyo gaṃdhāḍhyaḥ surabhiḥ śuciḥ ...
mayā nivedito bhaktyā dhūpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām .. 252 ..
2.2.d:
वनस्पतिरसो दिव्यो गंधाढ्यः सुरभिः शुचिः ॥।
मया निवेदितो भक्त्या धूपोऽयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् ॥ 252 ॥
2.2.m: 'Divine sap of trees, rich in fragrance, sweet-smelling, pure, / offered by me with devotion: may this incense be accepted.'

2.2.s:
alaṃkāraiśca gaṃdhaiśca pītavastraistathaiva ca ..
dūrvākṣatena mālyena yuktaṃ puṣpeṇa pūjayet ..
dadyātpañcāñjaliṃ paścādviṣṇusūktaṃ punarjapet .. 253 ..
2.2.d:
अलंकारैश्च गंधैश्च पीतवस्त्रैस्तथैव च ॥
दूर्वाक्षतेन माल्येन युक्तं पुष्पेण पूजयेत् ॥
दद्यात्पञ्चाञ्जलिं पश्चाद्विष्णुसूक्तं पुनर्जपेत् ॥ 253 ॥
2.2.m: With ornaments and perfumes, and likewise with yellow garments, / with dūrvā grass, unbroken grain, and a garland, he should worship [the deity] with flowers. / Afterward he should offer five handfuls [of flowers] and again mutter the Viṣṇusūkta.

2.2.s:
tataḥ suśobhane sthāne vedīṃ nirmāya deśikaḥ ..
varuṇaṃ vinyasettatra tathā puṣkariṇīmapi .. 254 ..
2.2.d:
ततः सुशोभने स्थाने वेदीं निर्माय देशिकः ॥
वरुणं विन्यसेत्तत्र तथा पुष्करिणीमपि ॥ 254 ॥
2.2.m: Then, having built an altar in a very auspicious place, the preceptor / should install Varuṇa there, and also the pond.

2.2.s:
vivāhoktena vidhinā kuryānnirmaṃchanādikam ..
gaṃdhapuṣpaṃ tato dadyādgāṃ ca dadyātsadakṣiṇām ..255..
2.2.d:
विवाहोक्तेन विधिना कुर्यान्निर्मंछनादिकम् ॥
गंधपुष्पं ततो दद्याद्गां च दद्यात्सदक्षिणाम् ॥255॥
2.2.m: According to the rule prescribed for marriage he should perform the waving of lamps and other rites; / then he should give fragrant flowers, and give a cow along with a priestly gift,

2.2.s:
cāmaraṃ vyajanaṃ chatraṃ kāṃsyaṃ lohaṃ tathaiva ca ..
kuryātpuṣkariṇīṃ ramyāṃ rājatīṃ ca tripādikām .. 256 ..
2.2.d:
चामरं व्यजनं छत्रं कांस्यं लोहं तथैव च ॥
कुर्यात्पुष्करिणीं रम्यां राजतीं च त्रिपादिकाम् ॥ 256 ॥
2.2.m: a chowrie, a fan, a royal parasol, bronze, and likewise iron. / He should make a charming pond and a silver tripod,

2.2.s:
catuṣkoṇāṃ ca suṣamāṃ dvyaṃguṣṭhaparimaṃḍalām ..
suvarṇapratimāṃ kuryādbhālenaikena bho drijāḥ .. 257 ..
2.2.d:
चतुष्कोणां च सुषमां द्व्यंगुष्ठपरिमंडलाम् ॥
सुवर्णप्रतिमां कुर्याद्भालेनैकेन भो द्रिजाः ॥ 257 ॥
2.2.m: four-cornered, beautiful, measuring two thumbs around. / He should make a golden image with one bhāla, O brahmins;

2.2.s:
atha vā svarṇapatre ca kuṃkumena tale likhet ..
bāṇaśaktipramāṇena svarṇapatraṃ tu dvyaṃgulam ..258..
2.2.d:
अथ वा स्वर्णपत्रे च कुंकुमेन तले लिखेत् ॥
बाणशक्तिप्रमाणेन स्वर्णपत्रं तु द्व्यंगुलम् ॥258॥
2.2.m: or he should draw on a gold leaf, on its surface, with saffron; / the gold leaf should measure two fingers [in breadth], with the dimension of an arrow or a spear.

2.2.s:
kārayeccaturasraṃ ca pīṭhopari nyasedbudhaḥ ..
nīrājanāṃte vipreṃdrāḥ saṃsmaredamṛtaṃ taret .. 259 ..
2.2.d:
कारयेच्चतुरस्रं च पीठोपरि न्यसेद्बुधः ॥
नीराजनांते विप्रेंद्राः संस्मरेदमृतं तरेत् ॥ 259 ॥
2.2.m: The wise man should make it square and place it upon a seat. / At the end of the waving of lamps, O foremost of brahmins, he should remember [him and] cross over to immortality.

2.2.s:
aśaktena tathaivaikakāṣṭhe vā pippalacchade ..
tāmrapaṭṭe likhedvāpi alaktena yathāvidhi ..2.2.19.260..
2.2.d:
अशक्तेन तथैवैककाष्ठे वा पिप्पलच्छदे ॥
ताम्रपट्टे लिखेद्वापि अलक्तेन यथाविधि ॥2.2.19.260॥
2.2.m: If incapable, he may similarly write on a single piece of wood, on a pippala leaf, / or on a copper plate, with red lac according to rule.

2.2.s:
prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kuryāttu varuṇāya nivedayet ..
mahaṃ tu vatsaraṃ kuryādvedaghoṣapuraḥsaram .. 261 ..
2.2.d:
प्राणप्रतिष्ठां कुर्यात्तु वरुणाय निवेदयेत् ॥
महं तु वत्सरं कुर्याद्वेदघोषपुरःसरम् ॥ 261 ॥
2.2.m: He should perform the consecration of breath and dedicate it to Varuṇa. / He should conduct the festival for a year, preceded by the sound of the Vedas.

2.2.s:
aśokaḥ khadiraḥ śālo hyaśvattho bilvakastathā ..
dhātrī kurubakaścaiva bakulo nāgakeśaraḥ .. 262 ..
2.2.d:
अशोकः खदिरः शालो ह्यश्वत्थो बिल्वकस्तथा ॥
धात्री कुरुबकश्चैव बकुलो नागकेशरः ॥ 262 ॥
2.2.m: Aśoka, khadira, śāla, aśvattha, and bilva, / dhātrī, kurubaka, bakula, and nāgakeśara—

2.2.s:
eṣāmeva kāṣṭhayūpaṃ yajamānapramāṇakam ..
samādāya ca saṃsthāpya vastrādyaiḥ pratigṛhya ca .. 263 ..
2.2.d:
एषामेव काष्ठयूपं यजमानप्रमाणकम् ॥
समादाय च संस्थाप्य वस्त्राद्यैः प्रतिगृह्य च ॥ 263 ॥
2.2.m: taking a wooden sacrificial post made of these [trees], of the height of the patron, / setting it up, and receiving it with garments and the like,

2.2.s:
yūpa rakṣeti maṃtreṇa khanitvā ca pradāpayet ..
sthiro bhaveti mantreṇa hastaṃ dattvā paṭhettataḥ .. 264 ..
2.2.d:
यूप रक्षेति मंत्रेण खनित्वा च प्रदापयेत् ॥
स्थिरो भवेति मन्त्रेण हस्तं दत्त्वा पठेत्ततः ॥ 264 ॥
2.2.m: having dug, he should install it with the mantra, 'Protect, O post'; / then, having placed his hand upon it, he should recite with the mantra, 'Be firm.'

2.2.s:
taḍāgasya tathaiśānyāṃ tathā prāsādakasya ca ..
prāpayeddakṣiṇe bhāge āvāsasya ca madhyake .. 265 ..
2.2.d:
तडागस्य तथैशान्यां तथा प्रासादकस्य च ॥
प्रापयेद्दक्षिणे भागे आवासस्य च मध्यके ॥ 265 ॥
2.2.m: In the north-eastern part of the tank, and likewise of the temple, / he should bring it to the southern part, and in the middle of the habitation.

2.2.s:
naukā gatvā tataḥ paścādyūpamādāya vāgyataḥ ..
madhyadeśe taḍāgasya samulaṃghya tathottaram .. 266 ..
2.2.d:
नौका गत्वा ततः पश्चाद्यूपमादाय वाग्यतः ॥
मध्यदेशे तडागस्य समुलंघ्य तथोत्तरम् ॥ 266 ॥
2.2.m: Then, having boarded a boat, taking the sacrificial post, with restrained speech, / in the middle part of the tank, having crossed over to the north,

2.2.s:
gaṃtavyaṃ prakalpya tatraiva āpyāyasveti vai ṛcā ..
śilāyāṃ homayettatra hunennaukāhutitrayam .. 267 ..
2.2.d:
गंतव्यं प्रकल्प्य तत्रैव आप्यायस्वेति वै ऋचा ॥
शिलायां होमयेत्तत्र हुनेन्नौकाहुतित्रयम् ॥ 267 ॥
2.2.m: having determined the place to go, right there, with the verse 'Be invigorated', / he should sacrifice upon a stone there, offering three boat-oblations:

2.2.s:
aṃgadāya svāheti bhaumāya nama ityataḥ ..
lājāśaktau dadhimadhau vāsane pratihomayet .. 268 ..
2.2.d:
अंगदाय स्वाहेति भौमाय नम इत्यतः ॥
लाजाशक्तौ दधिमधौ वासने प्रतिहोमयेत् ॥ 268 ॥
2.2.m: 'To the bestower of limbs, svāhā', then 'Obeisance to the son of Earth [Mars].' / He should make oblations of parched grain, barley-meal, curds, and honey into the vessels.

2.2.s:
kūrmāya nama ityuktvā pṛthivyai nama ityuta ..
svāhetyanaṃtamaṃtreṇa dadyādarghyamanaṃtaram..269..
2.2.d:
कूर्माय नम इत्युक्त्वा पृथिव्यै नम इत्युत ॥
स्वाहेत्यनंतमंत्रेण दद्यादर्घ्यमनंतरम्॥269॥
2.2.m: Saying 'Obeisance to the Tortoise', and 'Obeisance to the Earth', / with the mantra 'To Ananta, svāhā', he should immediately offer water of hospitality.

2.2.s:
pañcaratnena gandhena śaṃkhenārghyaṃ pradāpayet ..
caturasraṃ samākīrṇaṃ caturdikṣvadhṛtairjanaiḥ .. 2.2.19.270 ..
2.2.d:
पञ्चरत्नेन गन्धेन शंखेनार्घ्यं प्रदापयेत् ॥
चतुरस्रं समाकीर्णं चतुर्दिक्ष्वधृतैर्जनैः ॥ 2.2.19.270 ॥
2.2.m: He should offer the water of hospitality with five jewels, perfume, and a conch. / Square, crowded with people stationed in the four directions,

2.2.s:
kalpayedropayettatra hastaṃ dattvā paṭhedidam ..
sthiro bhaveti maṃtreṇa gaṃdhapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet .. 271 ..
2.2.d:
कल्पयेद्रोपयेत्तत्र हस्तं दत्त्वा पठेदिदम् ॥
स्थिरो भवेति मंत्रेण गंधपुष्पैः प्रपूजयेत् ॥ 271 ॥
2.2.m: he should fashion and erect it there; placing his hand on it, he should recite this: / with the mantra 'Be firm', he should worship it with fragrant flowers.

2.2.s:
cakraṃ sadarpaṇaṃ dadyānnāgadaṃḍaśiro gataḥ ..
vidyudatra ca kartāraṃ gra(gna?)haduḥkhaharipriyam .. 272 ..
2.2.d:
चक्रं सदर्पणं दद्यान्नागदंडशिरो गतः ॥
विद्युदत्र च कर्तारं ग्र(ग्न?)हदुःखहरिप्रियम् ॥ 272 ॥
2.2.m: He should present a discus along with a mirror, mounted on the top of a serpent-post. / Lightning is here, and the maker, dear to Hari, who removes the distress of the planets.

2.2.s:
evaṃ cakraṃ pūjayitvā śūlaṃ nāgāṃśca pūjayet ..
uccairdhvajaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā na nāgeti ca saṃpaṭhet .. 273 ..
2.2.d:
एवं चक्रं पूजयित्वा शूलं नागांश्च पूजयेत् ॥
उच्चैर्ध्वजं ततः कृत्वा न नागेति च संपठेत् ॥ 273 ॥
2.2.m: Having thus worshipped the discus, he should worship the trident and the serpents; / then, having raised high a banner, he should recite, 'Not the serpent...'

2.2.s:
gāyatrasveti maṃtreṇa paṭheddvāradvayaṃ tataḥ ..
dikpālebhyo baliṃ dadyānmāṣabhaktaṃ guḍaudanam .. 274 ..
2.2.d:
गायत्रस्वेति मंत्रेण पठेद्द्वारद्वयं ततः ॥
दिक्पालेभ्यो बलिं दद्यान्माषभक्तं गुडौदनम् ॥ 274 ॥
2.2.m: Then he should recite at the two doors with the mantra, 'Sing with the Gāyatrī...'; / he should make an offering to the guardians of the directions of cooked black gram and boiled rice with jaggery.

2.2.s:
raktapuṣpānvitaṃ kṛtvā praṇipatya prasādayet ..
sahasraṃ vā dhanaṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine..275..
2.2.d:
रक्तपुष्पान्वितं कृत्वा प्रणिपत्य प्रसादयेत् ॥
सहस्रं वा धनं दद्याद्ब्राह्मणाय कुटुंबिने॥275॥
2.2.m: Providing it with red flowers, having bowed down, he should propitiate them; / he should give wealth, either a thousand [coins], to a brahmin householder.

2.2.s:
tato bhojyaṃ sasarpiśca sahiraṇyaṃ yathāvidhi ..
ikṣusvastītikāṃ dadyājjale mātṝśca pūjayet ..276..
2.2.d:
ततो भोज्यं ससर्पिश्च सहिरण्यं यथाविधि ॥
इक्षुस्वस्तीतिकां दद्याज्जले मातॄश्च पूजयेत् ॥276॥
2.2.m: Then food with clarified butter and with gold according to rule; / he should offer an auspicious cake of sugarcane, and worship the Mothers in the water:

2.2.s:
maṃtharāṃ vasutāṃ kāṃtāṃ rākṣasīṃ ca piśācikām..
nāginīrnāgaputrāṃśca madhye saṃpūjayettataḥ .. 277 ..
2.2.d:
मंथरां वसुतां कांतां राक्षसीं च पिशाचिकाम्॥
नागिनीर्नागपुत्रांश्च मध्ये संपूजयेत्ततः ॥ 277 ॥
2.2.m: Mantharā, Vasutā, Kāntā, the rākṣasī, and the piśācikā; / then in the middle he should worship the serpent-maidens and the serpent-sons.

2.2.s:
pūrṇāṃte ca pṛthagdadyāllājādyairguḍamiśritaiḥ ..
indro balavatī svāhā yaśo balavatāmapi ..278..
2.2.d:
पूर्णांते च पृथग्दद्याल्लाजाद्यैर्गुडमिश्रितैः ॥
इन्द्रो बलवती स्वाहा यशो बलवतामपि ॥278॥
2.2.m: At the conclusion of the full oblation, he should offer separately parched grain and the like mixed with jaggery: / 'Indra is powerful, svāhā; and the fame of the powerful.'

2.2.s:
bṛhatpakṣāviśaṣo'yaṃ madhyame ca kanīyake ..
bṛhaspate ca indrāya tava devalatāmiti .. 279 ..
2.2.d:
बृहत्पक्षाविशषोऽयं मध्यमे च कनीयके ॥
बृहस्पते च इन्द्राय तव देवलतामिति ॥ 279 ॥
2.2.m: This is the rule for the superior option; in the intermediate and the least: / 'O Bṛhaspati, and to Indra', and 'Thy divine creeper...'

2.2.s:
svāheti juhuyātpaścātpraṇītāṃ cālayettataḥ..
kaniṣṭha pakṣe prāsāde tathā caiva jalāśaye .. 2.2.19.280 ..
2.2.d:
स्वाहेति जुहुयात्पश्चात्प्रणीतां चालयेत्ततः॥
कनिष्ठ पक्षे प्रासादे तथा चैव जलाशये ॥ 2.2.19.280 ॥
2.2.m: He should make the oblation with 'svāhā', and then move the praṇītā water. / In the least option, in a temple as well as in a reservoir,

2.2.s:
mandare toraṇasyaiva viṣvaksenaṃ prakalpayet ..
ārāme ca tathā setau viśeṣaḥ pañcamo dvijāḥ ..281..
2.2.d:
मन्दरे तोरणस्यैव विष्वक्सेनं प्रकल्पयेत् ॥
आरामे च तथा सेतौ विशेषः पञ्चमो द्विजाः ॥281॥
2.2.m: in a palace, at an archway, he should install Viṣvaksena; / and in a pleasure garden and on a bridge; this is the fifth distinction, O brahmins.

2.2.s:
pūjāṃtareṇa yaḥ kasya japenmantrasahasrakam ..
stutiṃ samāpya vidhivadimaṃ maṃtramudāharet .. 282 ..
2.2.d:
पूजांतरेण यः कस्य जपेन्मन्त्रसहस्रकम् ॥
स्तुतिं समाप्य विधिवदिमं मंत्रमुदाहरेत् ॥ 282 ॥
2.2.m: Whoever, during another worship, mutters a thousand mantras of whichever deity, / having concluded the praise according to rule, should utter this mantra:

2.2.s:
sarvasattvebhya ucchiṣṭamapi tajjalamuddhṛtam ..
iti paṭhitvā puṣkariṇījalaṃ haste gṛhītvā jale kṣipet .. 283 ..
2.2.d:
सर्वसत्त्वेभ्य उच्छिष्टमपि तज्जलमुद्धृतम् ॥
इति पठित्वा पुष्करिणीजलं हस्ते गृहीत्वा जले क्षिपेत् ॥ 283 ॥
2.2.m: 'Even the remnant water drawn from this is for all living beings.' / Having recited this, taking pond-water in his hand, he should cast it into the water.

2.2.s:
tato jalamātṛbhyo nama iti jalamātṝḥ prapūjayet ..
trailokye yāni sthānāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca .. 284 ..
2.2.d:
ततो जलमातृभ्यो नम इति जलमातॄः प्रपूजयेत् ॥
त्रैलोक्ये यानि स्थानानि स्थावराणि चराणि च ॥ 284 ॥
2.2.m: Then he should worship the Water-Mothers saying, 'Obeisance to the Water-Mothers.' / 'Whatever places there are in the three worlds, both stationary and moving,

2.2.s:
teṣāmāpyāyanāyaitajjalamutsṛjyate mayā ..
mātre tu kṛtametatte jagadānaṃdakārakam .. 285 ..
2.2.d:
तेषामाप्यायनायैतज्जलमुत्सृज्यते मया ॥
मात्रे तु कृतमेतत्ते जगदानंदकारकम् ॥ 285 ॥
2.2.m: this water is released by me for their invigoration. / For the Mother, this which causes joy to the world has been made by you.

2.2.s:
śivāya sarvabhūtānāṃ sadā pāhi jalāśayam ..
pibaṃto hyavagāhaṃtaḥ sukhinaḥ sarvajaṃtavaḥ .. 286 ..
2.2.d:
शिवाय सर्वभूतानां सदा पाहि जलाशयम् ॥
पिबंतो ह्यवगाहंतः सुखिनः सर्वजंतवः ॥ 286 ॥
2.2.m: For the welfare of all beings, protect the reservoir at all times; / drinking and bathing, may all creatures be happy.

2.2.s:
jalaṃ viśvopakārāya kṛtametanmayā sadā ..
kīrtistiṣṭhatu me devāścirāya dharaṇītale .. 287 ..
2.2.d:
जलं विश्वोपकाराय कृतमेतन्मया सदा ॥
कीर्तिस्तिष्ठतु मे देवाश्चिराय धरणीतले ॥ 287 ॥
2.2.m: This water has been made by me always for the benefit of the universe; / O gods, may my fame endure for a long time on the surface of the earth.

2.2.s:
tvatprasādānmahābhāga nāgarāja namo'stu te ..
ye'tra kecidvipadyaṃte svakarmaphalabhojanāḥ .. 288 ..
2.2.d:
त्वत्प्रसादान्महाभाग नागराज नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
येऽत्र केचिद्विपद्यंते स्वकर्मफलभोजनाः ॥ 288 ॥
2.2.m: By your grace, O noble one, O King of Serpents, obeisance be to you! / Whosoever meet their end here, experiencing the fruit of their own actions,

2.2.s:
teṣāṃ doṣairna lipye'haṃ svaṃsvaṃ gamamavāpnuyāt ..
nārāyaṇo jagatprāṇaḥ sarvakāmapradāyakaḥ .. 289 ..
2.2.d:
तेषां दोषैर्न लिप्येऽहं स्वंस्वं गममवाप्नुयात् ॥
नारायणो जगत्प्राणः सर्वकामप्रदायकः ॥ 289 ॥
2.2.m: may I not be tainted by their faults; may each attain his own destination! / Nārāyaṇa is the life-breath of the universe, the bestower of all desires.'

2.2.s:
āpeyā mātaraḥ saṃtu jagatāṃ vṛkṣayonayaḥ ..
apāṃpate rasāyātra yādasāmīśvara prabho .. 2.2.19.290 ..
2.2.d:
आपेया मातरः संतु जगतां वृक्षयोनयः ॥
अपांपते रसायात्र यादसामीश्वर प्रभो ॥ 2.2.19.290 ॥
2.2.m: May the waters be mothers, the origins of trees for the worlds; / O Lord of waters, in the earth here, O ruler of aquatic beings, O Master!

2.2.s:
varuṇāsyāsane kīrtiṃ sanātana namostu te ..
tattoyaṃ nidhivaddadyāddakṣiṇārthaṃ dvijanmane .. 291 ..
2.2.d:
वरुणास्यासने कीर्तिं सनातन नमोस्तु ते ॥
तत्तोयं निधिवद्दद्याद्दक्षिणार्थं द्विजन्मने ॥ 291 ॥
2.2.m: O Varuṇa, [bestow] renown on this seat; O eternal one, praise be to you! / He should give that water, like a treasure, to a twice-born as the sacrificial fee;

2.2.s:
suvarṇaṃrajataṃ dadyādanaḍvāhaṃ payasvinīm ..
dadyāddhenudvayaṃ paścātkuryādbrāhmaṇatarpaṇam ..292..
2.2.d:
सुवर्णंरजतं दद्यादनड्वाहं पयस्विनीम् ॥
दद्याद्धेनुद्वयं पश्चात्कुर्याद्ब्राह्मणतर्पणम् ॥292॥
2.2.m: he should give gold and silver, a draft-ox, and a milch cow. / Afterwards he should give a pair of cows, and then perform the satisfaction of the brahmins.

2.2.s:
vahnipūjāṃ puraskṛtya mantreṇa prāśayettataḥ ..
pitṝṇāṃ dāpayedarghyaṃ tato devaṃ prasādayet .. 293 ..
2.2.d:
वह्निपूजां पुरस्कृत्य मन्त्रेण प्राशयेत्ततः ॥
पितॄणां दापयेदर्घ्यं ततो देवं प्रसादयेत् ॥ 293 ॥
2.2.m: First worshipping the fire, he should then partake [of the offering] with the mantra. / He should have the water offering presented to the ancestors, and then propitiate the god.

2.2.s:
biṃbamudrāṃ padmamudrāṃ nāgamudrāṃ pradarśayet ..
vaiśvānarā iti ṛcā pūjāṃ kṛtvā vivarjayet ..294..
2.2.d:
बिंबमुद्रां पद्ममुद्रां नागमुद्रां प्रदर्शयेत् ॥
वैश्वानरा इति ऋचा पूजां कृत्वा विवर्जयेत् ॥294॥
2.2.m: He should display the bimba gesture, the lotus gesture, and the serpent gesture. / Having performed the worship with the verse beginning 'Vaiśvānara...', he should disperse [the deities].

2.2.s:
yaste prāṇāñjapanpaścātprakuryādatha candanam..
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ paścāttaḍāgasya śṛṇu dvijāḥ ..295..
2.2.d:
यस्ते प्राणाञ्जपन्पश्चात्प्रकुर्यादथ चन्दनम्॥
प्रदक्षिणं ततः पश्चात्तडागस्य शृणु द्विजाः ॥295॥
2.2.m: Reciting 'Yaste prāṇān...', he should then offer sandalwood paste. / Listen, O twice-born ones: afterwards comes the clockwise circumambulation of the reservoir.

2.2.s:
brāhmaṇānpurataḥ kṛtvā vedaghoṣaṃ samuccaran ..
mahāmaṅgalapūrveṇa praviśedbhavanaṃ sudhīḥ .. 296 ..
2.2.d:
ब्राह्मणान्पुरतः कृत्वा वेदघोषं समुच्चरन् ॥
महामङ्गलपूर्वेण प्रविशेद्भवनं सुधीः ॥ 296 ॥
2.2.m: Placing the brahmins at the front, chanting the roar of the Vedas, / the wise man should enter his home preceded by great auspicious rites.

2.2.s:
tato gṛhārcanaṃ kuryādbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam ..
dīnānāṃ kṛpaṇānāṃ ca savitre'rghyaṃ nivedayet ..297..
madhyamavidhānavarṇanam
2.2.d:
ततो गृहार्चनं कुर्याद्ब्राह्मणानां च भोजनम् ॥
दीनानां कृपणानां च सवित्रेऽर्घ्यं निवेदयेत् ॥297॥
मध्यमविधानवर्णनम्
2.2.m:
Then he should perform worship of the home and feeding of the brahmins, / and of the poor and wretched, and present the water offering to the Sun.
Description of the intermediate procedure

2.2.s:
..sūta uvāca .. ..
saptāgniṣṭomako nāma dyuttamaḥ kathito vidhiḥ ..
madhyame madhyamaphalaṃ kaniṣṭhe tu kaniṣṭhakam .. 1 ..
2.2.d:
॥सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
सप्ताग्निष्टोमको नाम द्युत्तमः कथितो विधिः ॥
मध्यमे मध्यमफलं कनिष्ठे तु कनिष्ठकम् ॥ 1 ॥
2.2.m: Sūta said: / The highest procedure, named after the seven Agniṣṭomas, has been related. / In the intermediate one there is intermediate fruit, and in the lowest, the lowest.

2.2.s:
adhunā madhyamaṃ vakṣye vidhiṃ śāstrānusārataḥ ..
yathāvibhavayāgena yatkartavyaṃ nareṇa vai .. 2 ..
2.2.d:
अधुना मध्यमं वक्ष्ये विधिं शास्त्रानुसारतः ॥
यथाविभवयागेन यत्कर्तव्यं नरेण वै ॥ 2 ॥
2.2.m: Now I will explain the intermediate procedure according to the treatises, / which a man should perform with a sacrifice suited to his means.

2.2.s:
sadyodhivāsakalpena yūpādīnadhivāsya ca ..
pūrvasminneva divase daivajñakathite śubhe .. 3 ..
2.2.d:
सद्योधिवासकल्पेन यूपादीनधिवास्य च ॥
पूर्वस्मिन्नेव दिवसे दैवज्ञकथिते शुभे ॥ 3 ॥
2.2.m: Having performed the preliminary consecration of the sacrificial post and other items according to the quick consecration rite, / on the previous day itself at an auspicious hour declared by an astrologer,

2.2.s:
muhūrte kalaśaṃ sthāpya saṃgṛhya gaṇanāyakam ..
sthāpayetprathamaṃ yūpamā pohiṣṭhetimantrakaiḥ .. 4 ..
2.2.d:
मुहूर्ते कलशं स्थाप्य संगृह्य गणनायकम् ॥
स्थापयेत्प्रथमं यूपमा पोहिष्ठेतिमन्त्रकैः ॥ 4 ॥
2.2.m: having installed the water pot and received Gaṇanāyaka, / he should first erect the sacrificial post with the mantras beginning 'Āpo hi ṣṭhā...'.

2.2.s:
śanno devyāstataḥ paścādgandhadvāreti gaṃdhakam ..
śrīsūktena tato dadyātpuṣpaṃ dūrvākṣataṃ tataḥ .. 5..
2.2.d:
शन्नो देव्यास्ततः पश्चाद्गन्धद्वारेति गंधकम् ॥
श्रीसूक्तेन ततो दद्यात्पुष्पं दूर्वाक्षतं ततः ॥ 5॥
2.2.m: Then [with the verse] 'Śaṃ no devī...', and then fragrant substance with 'Gandhadvārā...'; / then he should offer flowers, dūrvā grass, and unbroken grains with the Śrīsūkta.

2.2.s:
kāṇḍāditi ca mantreṇa tato dhūpaṃ nivedayet ..
ye gṛhṇāmīti ca ṛcā pūjāyāṃ sthāpayettataḥ .. 6 ..
2.2.d:
काण्डादिति च मन्त्रेण ततो धूपं निवेदयेत् ॥
ये गृह्णामीति च ऋचा पूजायां स्थापयेत्ततः ॥ 6 ॥
2.2.m: Then he should offer incense with the mantra beginning 'Kāṇḍāt...'; / and then install [the deity] in worship with the verse beginning 'Ye gṛhṇāmi...'.

2.2.s: vivāhavidhinā sarvaṃ kāryaṃ caivādhivāsanam .. 7 ..
2.2.d: विवाहविधिना सर्वं कार्यं चैवाधिवासनम् ॥ 7 ॥
2.2.m: And every preliminary consecration should be performed according to the marriage rite.

2.2.s:
sarvameva prayuṃjīta taḍāgādiṣu paṇḍitaḥ ..
adhivāsya taḍāgādīnācāryādīṃśca sarvaśaḥ .. 8 ..
2.2.d:
सर्वमेव प्रयुंजीत तडागादिषु पण्डितः ॥
अधिवास्य तडागादीनाचार्यादींश्च सर्वशः ॥ 8 ॥
2.2.m: The learned man should employ all of this for reservoirs and the like. / Having consecrated the reservoirs and other works, and the preceptors and others in all respects,

2.2.s:
saṃgṛhya gaṃdhapuṣpādyairdhūpairdīpaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ ..
tataḥ prabhātasamaye nityaṃ nirvartya śāstrataḥ .. 9 ..
2.2.d:
संगृह्य गंधपुष्पाद्यैर्धूपैर्दीपैः सुशोभनैः ॥
ततः प्रभातसमये नित्यं निर्वर्त्य शास्त्रतः ॥ 9 ॥
2.2.m: having received them with fragrant perfumes, flowers, and the like, and very beautiful incenses and lamps, / then, at the time of dawn, having performed the daily duties according to the treatises,

2.2.s:
vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ tataḥ kuryānmātṛpūjāpuraḥsaram ..
alaṃkṛtya yathāśakti ācāryādīṃścaredbudhaḥ .. 2.2.20.10 ..
2.2.d:
वृद्धिश्राद्धं ततः कुर्यान्मातृपूजापुरःसरम् ॥
अलंकृत्य यथाशक्ति आचार्यादींश्चरेद्बुधः ॥ 2.2.20.10 ॥
2.2.m: the wise man should then perform the prosperity ancestral rite preceded by the worship of the Mothers. / Having adorned the preceptors and others according to his ability, he should proceed.

2.2.s:
śṛṇuyātpaścime bhāge maṃḍapasya samīpataḥ ..
madhyadeśe samudbhūtaṃ yajñapātraṃ praśasyate .. 11 ..
2.2.d:
शृणुयात्पश्चिमे भागे मंडपस्य समीपतः ॥
मध्यदेशे समुद्भूतं यज्ञपात्रं प्रशस्यते ॥ 11 ॥
2.2.m: He should listen on the western side near the pavilion; / a sacrificial vessel born in the central region is commended,

2.2.s:
atha vā tatra deśīyaṃ guruṃ vā śrotriyodbhavam ..
yajñe pradhānadvitīyamṛtvigācāryameva hi .. 12 ..
2.2.d:
अथ वा तत्र देशीयं गुरुं वा श्रोत्रियोद्भवम् ॥
यज्ञे प्रधानद्वितीयमृत्विगाचार्यमेव हि ॥ 12 ॥
2.2.m: or else a local guru, or one born of a Vedic scholar. / In the sacrifice, the chief second is indeed the officiating priest and preceptor.

2.2.s:
vaitānakalpe saṃpannaṃ śaktikalpaparāyaṇam ..
nigamajñānasaṃpannaṃ yajñe pātraṃ praśasyate .. 13 ..
2.2.d:
वैतानकल्पे संपन्नं शक्तिकल्पपरायणम् ॥
निगमज्ञानसंपन्नं यज्ञे पात्रं प्रशस्यते ॥ 13 ॥
2.2.m: One accomplished in the ritual of the three fires, devoted to the Śākta rituals, / and endowed with knowledge of the Vedas is commended as a worthy recipient in the sacrifice.

2.2.s:
patnīhīnamaputraṃ ca śyāvadaṃtamadaṃtakam ..
gaṇānāṃ yājakaṃ ṣaṃḍhaṃ svagotraṃ parivarjayet .. 14 ..
2.2.d:
पत्नीहीनमपुत्रं च श्यावदंतमदंतकम् ॥
गणानां याजकं षंढं स्वगोत्रं परिवर्जयेत् ॥ 14 ॥
2.2.m: One who is wifeless, sonless, has dark teeth, or is toothless, / a priest of multitudes, a eunuch, or one of his own lineage he should avoid.

2.2.s:
apradhāneṣu yajñeṣu dānayajñeṣu sattamāḥ ..
niyojayetsvagotraṃ ca home nasti vicāraṇā .. 15 ..
2.2.d:
अप्रधानेषु यज्ञेषु दानयज्ञेषु सत्तमाः ॥
नियोजयेत्स्वगोत्रं च होमे नस्ति विचारणा ॥ 15 ॥
2.2.m: In non-primary sacrifices, and in donation sacrifices, O virtuous ones, / he may employ one of his own lineage, and in the fire oblation there is no restriction.

2.2.s:
kuśapratikṛtau cāpi tataḥ svargaṃ sa gacchati ..
dhanamādau ca saṃśodhya tato yajñaṃ samācaret .. 16 ..
2.2.d:
कुशप्रतिकृतौ चापि ततः स्वर्गं स गच्छति ॥
धनमादौ च संशोध्य ततो यज्ञं समाचरेत् ॥ 16 ॥
2.2.m: Even by an effigy of kuśa grass, he goes from there to heaven. / Having first purified the wealth, he should then perform the sacrifice.

2.2.s:
ayājyayājanodbhūtaṃ pallavaṃ vyavahārake ..
kūṭasākṣyeṇa pallave sthāpyahārakameva ca .. 17 ..
2.2.d:
अयाज्ययाजनोद्भूतं पल्लवं व्यवहारके ॥
कूटसाक्ष्येण पल्लवे स्थाप्यहारकमेव च ॥ 17 ॥
2.2.m: Sprouts obtained from sacrificing for those unfit to sacrifice, in business, / sprouts obtained by false witness, and theft of deposits;

2.2.s:
devasvaṃ brāhmaṇasvaṃ ca lohavikrayaṇaṃ dhanam ..
havirvikrayaṇaṃ kṛtvā putrabhāryā divikrayī .. 18 ..
2.2.d:
देवस्वं ब्राह्मणस्वं च लोहविक्रयणं धनम् ॥
हविर्विक्रयणं कृत्वा पुत्रभार्या दिविक्रयी ॥ 18 ॥
2.2.m: property of the gods, property of brahmins, wealth from selling iron, / selling oblations, or one who sells his son or wife—

2.2.s:
niṃditāni purāṇeṣu yatkṛtaṃ tatra tatphalam ..
yajñasadmani viprāṃśca na śrāddhānbhojayetkvacit ..
na dadyāttasya dānaṃ ca yāvannaiva samāpayet .. 19 ..
2.2.d:
निंदितानि पुराणेषु यत्कृतं तत्र तत्फलम् ॥
यज्ञसद्मनि विप्रांश्च न श्राद्धान्भोजयेत्क्वचित् ॥
न दद्यात्तस्य दानं च यावन्नैव समापयेत् ॥ 19 ॥
2.2.m: these are condemned in the Purāṇas; whatever was done brings that fruit. / In the sacrificial hall, he should never feed brahmins at an ancestral rite, / nor should he give a gift to such a person as long as he has not concluded [the rite].

2.2.s:
brahmannācāryamukhyosi saṃsārāttrāhi māṃ vibho ..
tvatprasādādguro yajñe prāpnuyāṃ mānasepsitam .. 2.2.20.20 ..
2.2.d:
ब्रह्मन्नाचार्यमुख्योसि संसारात्त्राहि मां विभो ॥
त्वत्प्रसादाद्गुरो यज्ञे प्राप्नुयां मानसेप्सितम् ॥ 2.2.20.20 ॥
2.2.m: 'O Brahmin, you are the foremost preceptor; save me from worldly existence, O Lord! / By your grace, O guru, may I attain what is desired in my mind in this sacrifice.

2.2.s:
ciraṃ me śāśvatī kīrtiryāvallokāścarācarāḥ ..
prasīda tvaṃ maheśāna pratiṣṭhākarmasiddhaye .. 21 ..
2.2.d:
चिरं मे शाश्वती कीर्तिर्यावल्लोकाश्चराचराः ॥
प्रसीद त्वं महेशान प्रतिष्ठाकर्मसिद्धये ॥ 21 ॥
2.2.m: May my eternal fame endure as long as the worlds of mobile and immobile beings exist. / Be pleased, O Maheśāna, for the success of this consecration rite!

2.2.s:
tvamādiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ saṃsārārṇavatāraka ..
jñānāmṛtapradācārya viṣṇu rūpa namo'stu te .. 22 ..
2.2.d:
त्वमादिः सर्वभूतानां संसारार्णवतारक ॥
ज्ञानामृतप्रदाचार्य विष्णु रूप नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 22 ॥
2.2.m: 'You are the beginning of all beings, the savior from the ocean of worldly existence, / the preceptor who bestows the nectar of knowledge; O form of Viṣṇu, praise be to you!

2.2.s:
brahmāsanasamudbhūtaṃ prakāśitadigaṃtaram ..
tvaṃ ca jāṃbūnadaprakhya yajurveda namostu te ..23..
2.2.d:
ब्रह्मासनसमुद्भूतं प्रकाशितदिगंतरम् ॥
त्वं च जांबूनदप्रख्य यजुर्वेद नमोस्तु ते ॥23॥
2.2.m: O one arisen from the seat of Brahmā, who illuminates the directions, / resembling Jambū river gold, O Yajurveda, praise be to you!

2.2.s:
praphullakamalodbhāsi bhāsvarāṃbarabhūṣita ..
prakīrṇaśāstrasaṃbhāra vidhijña praṇatosmi te ..24..
2.2.d:
प्रफुल्लकमलोद्भासि भास्वरांबरभूषित ॥
प्रकीर्णशास्त्रसंभार विधिज्ञ प्रणतोस्मि ते ॥24॥
2.2.m: O you who shine like a full-blown lotus, adorned with radiant garments, / who possess an array of scattered treatises, knower of rituals, I bow to you!

2.2.s:
jvaladvaiśvānaraprakhya dhūmaśyāmālitānana ..
ṣaḍaṃgavedatattvajña ṛtviṅ mokṣaṃ samācara .. 25 ..
2.2.d:
ज्वलद्वैश्वानरप्रख्य धूमश्यामालितानन ॥
षडंगवेदतत्त्वज्ञ ऋत्विङ् मोक्षं समाचर ॥ 25 ॥
2.2.m: Resembling blazing Vaiśvānara, with face darkened by smoke, / knower of the truth of the six-limbed Veda, O officiating priest, bring about liberation!'

2.2.s:
tatastūryādighoṣeṇa puraskṛtya dvijottamān ..
yajamānaḥ sapatnīkaḥ praviśedyāgamaṇḍapam .. 26 ..
2.2.d:
ततस्तूर्यादिघोषेण पुरस्कृत्य द्विजोत्तमान् ॥
यजमानः सपत्नीकः प्रविशेद्यागमण्डपम् ॥ 26 ॥
2.2.m: Then, to the sound of musical instruments and the like, placing the best of the twice-born in front, / the patron of the sacrifice, together with his wife, should enter the sacrificial pavilion.

2.2.s:
svasthāne sthāpayedviprānmakhe dharmairyathākramam ..
pūjayedgandhamālyādyairgaṃdhādyaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ .. 27 ..
2.2.d:
स्वस्थाने स्थापयेद्विप्रान्मखे धर्मैर्यथाक्रमम् ॥
पूजयेद्गन्धमाल्याद्यैर्गंधाद्यैः सुमनोहरैः ॥ 27 ॥
2.2.m: He should seat the brahmins in their proper places at the sacrifice in due order according to the rules. / He should worship them with delightful scents, garlands, and the like, and pleasant fragrances.

2.2.s:
yajñe suvitate yosau pūjyate puruṣaḥ sadā ..
nārāyaṇasvarūposau yajñaṃ me saphalaṃ kuru ..28..
2.2.d:
यज्ञे सुवितते योसौ पूज्यते पुरुषः सदा ॥
नारायणस्वरूपोसौ यज्ञं मे सफलं कुरु ॥28॥
2.2.m: 'That Person who is always worshipped when the sacrifice is well spread out, / he who has the form of Nārāyaṇa—make my sacrifice fruitful!

2.2.s:
makhaśreṣṭheṣu sarveṣu yena maṃtrāḥ suvistṛtāḥ ..
yajurvedārthatattvajña brahmarūpa namostu te ..29..
2.2.d:
मखश्रेष्ठेषु सर्वेषु येन मंत्राः सुविस्तृताः ॥
यजुर्वेदार्थतत्त्वज्ञ ब्रह्मरूप नमोस्तु ते ॥29॥
2.2.m: O you by whom mantras are broadly expanded in all the best sacrifices, / knower of the true meaning of the Yajurveda, O form of Brahmā, praise be to you!

2.2.s:
yajñeṣu sākṣī sarveṣu vedavedārthatattvavit ..
ṛgvedajña mahāprājña viśvarūpa namostu te .. 2.2.20.30 ..
2.2.d:
यज्ञेषु साक्षी सर्वेषु वेदवेदार्थतत्त्ववित् ॥
ऋग्वेदज्ञ महाप्राज्ञ विश्वरूप नमोस्तु ते ॥ 2.2.20.30 ॥
2.2.m: Witness in all sacrifices, knower of the truth of the Veda and the Vedic meaning, / knower of the Ṛgveda, of great wisdom, of universal form, praise be to you!

2.2.s:
māṃgalyaṃ karmaṇāṃ nityaṃ śāśvataṃ brahmarūpiṇam ..
siddhaye mama yajñasya namāmi śivarūpiṇam .. 31 ..
2.2.d:
मांगल्यं कर्मणां नित्यं शाश्वतं ब्रह्मरूपिणम् ॥
सिद्धये मम यज्ञस्य नमामि शिवरूपिणम् ॥ 31 ॥
2.2.m: Ever the auspiciousness of rites, eternal, having the form of Brahmā— / for the success of my sacrifice, I bow to the one who has the form of Śiva!'

2.2.s:
pālayaṃti diśaḥ sarvā vidiśaśca tathā imāḥ ..
dikpālarūpiṇaṃ vipraṃ yajñasiddhyai namāmyaham ..
pātayeddakṣiṇaṃ jānu vikirānvikirettataḥ .. 32 ..
2.2.d:
पालयंति दिशः सर्वा विदिशश्च तथा इमाः ॥
दिक्पालरूपिणं विप्रं यज्ञसिद्ध्यै नमाम्यहम् ॥
पातयेद्दक्षिणं जानु विकिरान्विकिरेत्ततः ॥ 32 ॥
2.2.m: 'They protect all the cardinal directions and these intermediate directions. / I bow to the brahmin having the form of the guardians of the directions for the success of the sacrifice.' / He should lower his right knee and then scatter the scatter-offerings.

2.2.s:
trailokye yāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ..
brahmaviṣṇuśivāḥ sarve rakṣāṃ kurvaṃtu tāni vai..33..
2.2.d:
त्रैलोक्ये यानि भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च ॥
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवाः सर्वे रक्षां कुर्वंतु तानि वै॥33॥
2.2.m: 'Whatever beings there are in the three worlds, immobile and mobile, / and Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva—may all of them provide protection!'

2.2.s:
vedyāvedīti maṃtreṇa paṭhedvediṃ praṇamya ca..
saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyairimaṃ maṃtramudā haret.. 34 ..
2.2.d:
वेद्यावेदीति मंत्रेण पठेद्वेदिं प्रणम्य च॥
संपूज्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैरिमं मंत्रमुदा हरेत्॥ 34 ॥
2.2.m: He should recite [a mantra] with 'Vedyā vedī...', bow to the altar, / worship it with fragrant perfumes, flowers, and the like, and utter this mantra:

2.2.s:
yājanaṃ yajamānaśca śreyasā tatra yājakaḥ ..
idamarghyamidaṃ pādyaṃ dhūpoyaṃ pratigṛhyatām .. 35 ..
2.2.d:
याजनं यजमानश्च श्रेयसा तत्र याजकः ॥
इदमर्घ्यमिदं पाद्यं धूपोयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् ॥ 35 ॥
2.2.m: 'May the conducting of the sacrifice, the patron, and the officiating priest therein be endowed with welfare. / May this water offering, this water for the feet, and this incense be accepted!'

2.2.s:
aiśānyāṃ kalaśe devaṃ saṃpūjya gaṇa nāyakam ..
brahmāṇaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca dvitīyakalaśe yajet ..36..
2.2.d:
ऐशान्यां कलशे देवं संपूज्य गण नायकम् ॥
ब्रह्माणं वासुदेवं च द्वितीयकलशे यजेत् ॥36॥
2.2.m:
Having worshipped the god, the leader of the Gaṇas, in the pitcher in the north-east,
one should worship Brahmā and Vāsudeva in the second pitcher.

2.2.s:
maṃḍalaṃ caiva viṣṇurvai dvārakārūpamāsthitaḥ..
tena tvāṃ pūjayāmyadya svargaprāptiṃ kuruṣva me .. .. 37 ..
2.2.d:
मंडलं चैव विष्णुर्वै द्वारकारूपमास्थितः॥
तेन त्वां पूजयाम्यद्य स्वर्गप्राप्तिं कुरुष्व मे ॥ ॥ 37 ॥
2.2.m:
"Indeed Viṣṇu has assumed the form of Dvārakā and the maṇḍala;
therefore I worship you today; grant me the attainment of heaven!"

2.2.s:
pūrvādidikṣu kalaśānsaṃsthāpya ca trayaṃtrayam ..
ardhapādasavarṇena nirmitaṃ tāraṇaṃ budhaḥ .. 38 ..
2.2.d:
पूर्वादिदिक्षु कलशान्संस्थाप्य च त्रयंत्रयम् ॥
अर्धपादसवर्णेन निर्मितं तारणं बुधः ॥ 38 ॥
2.2.m:
Having placed three pitchers in each direction, beginning with the east,
the wise one [places] an arch fashioned of gold weighing an eighth of a pala.

2.2.s:
gaṃgāmṛttikayā yukte pallave saṃnivedayet ..
maṃdaraṃ kalpayitvā tu gopīnāṃ ca kulena vā ..39..
2.2.d:
गंगामृत्तिकया युक्ते पल्लवे संनिवेदयेत् ॥
मंदरं कल्पयित्वा तु गोपीनां च कुलेन वा ॥39॥
2.2.m:
He should present it upon the shoots joined with Ganges clay.
Having fashioned [Mount] Mandara, or with the multitude of gopīs,

2.2.s:
kalaśopari saṃsthāpya maṃdaraṃ saṃprapūjayet ..
syonā pṛthivīti maṃtreṇa gaṃdhapuṣpaiḥ pṛthigvidhaiḥ ..2.2.20.40..
2.2.d:
कलशोपरि संस्थाप्य मंदरं संप्रपूजयेत् ॥
स्योना पृथिवीति मंत्रेण गंधपुष्पैः पृथिग्विधैः ॥2.2.20.40॥
2.2.m:
placing it on top of the pitcher, he should worship Mandara
with the mantra *syonā pṛthivī* and with various kinds of fragrant flowers.

2.2.s:
( syonā pṛthivīti mantrasya sumaṃta ṛṣirjagatī chando haro devatā maṃdaraprītaye viniyogaḥ) ..
evaṃ dakṣiṇadigbhāge navatolakanirmitam ..
prādeśamātralohaṃ tu raupyeṇa gaṃdhamādanam ..
mṛdā saṃghaṭanaiḥ paścātkadācana ṛcā yajet .. 41 ..
2.2.d:
( स्योना पृथिवीति मन्त्रस्य सुमंत ऋषिर्जगती छन्दो हरो देवता मंदरप्रीतये विनियोगः) ॥
एवं दक्षिणदिग्भागे नवतोलकनिर्मितम् ॥
प्रादेशमात्रलोहं तु रौप्येण गंधमादनम् ॥
मृदा संघटनैः पश्चात्कदाचन ऋचा यजेत् ॥ 41 ॥
2.2.m:
(Of the mantra *syonā pṛthivī*, Sumanta is the ṛṣi, jagatī is the metre, Hara is the deity; the application is for the pleasing of Mandara.)
Likewise in the southern direction, [Mount] Gandhamādana fashioned of nine tolas,
of iron measuring a span, [fashioned] with silver,
with clay assemblages, he should afterwards worship with the *kadā cana* verse.

2.2.s:
kadācaneti maṃtrasya sūrya ṛṣistriṣṭupchandaḥ sūryo devatā gaṃdhamādanaprītaye viniyogaḥ ..)
uttare toraṇatodreraṃguṣṭhadvayamānake ..
tolakadvayamānena yavānāṃ piṣṭakopari .. 42 ..
2.2.d:
कदाचनेति मंत्रस्य सूर्य ऋषिस्त्रिष्टुप्छन्दः सूर्यो देवता गंधमादनप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥)
उत्तरे तोरणतोद्रेरंगुष्ठद्वयमानके ॥
तोलकद्वयमानेन यवानां पिष्टकोपरि ॥ 42 ॥
2.2.m:
(Of the mantra *kadā cana*, Sūrya is the ṛṣi, triṣṭubh is the metre, Sūrya is the deity; the application is for the pleasing of Gandhamādana.)
In the north, from the arch [of] the mountain measuring two thumbs,
with a measure of two tolas, upon a cake of barley,

2.2.s:
( āpyāyasveti maṃtrasya kardama ṛṣirjagatī chandaḥ śacī devatā supārśvaprītaye viniyogaḥ ..)
pūjayetpārśvakalaśe dhātrādīnpūrvadikkramāt ..
śrīsūktenaiva mantreṇa yajedvijayasaptakam ..
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatādinā .. 43 ..
2.2.d:
( आप्यायस्वेति मंत्रस्य कर्दम ऋषिर्जगती छन्दः शची देवता सुपार्श्वप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥)
पूजयेत्पार्श्वकलशे धात्रादीन्पूर्वदिक्क्रमात् ॥
श्रीसूक्तेनैव मन्त्रेण यजेद्विजयसप्तकम् ॥
पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या गंधपुष्पाक्षतादिना ॥ 43 ॥
2.2.m:
(Of the mantra *āpyāyasva*, Kardama is the ṛṣi, jagatī is the metre, Śacī is the deity; the application is for the pleasing of Supārśva.)
he should worship Dhātṛ and the others in the side pitcher in the order of the eastern direction.
With the mantra that is the Śrīsūkta he should worship the seven Vijayas;
he should worship with supreme devotion, with fragrant flowers, unbroken grains, and the like.

2.2.s:
aṃbāaṃbiketi maṃtrasya nalina ṛṣirgāyatrī chandaḥ śaṃbhurdevatā jaya prītaye viniyogaḥ ..
gāyatryā pūjayeddakṣe paścimaṃ kalaśadvayam .. 44 ..
2.2.d:
अंबाअंबिकेति मंत्रस्य नलिन ऋषिर्गायत्री छन्दः शंभुर्देवता जय प्रीतये विनियोगः ॥
गायत्र्या पूजयेद्दक्षे पश्चिमं कलशद्वयम् ॥ 44 ॥
2.2.m:
(Of the mantra *ambā ambikā*, Nalina is the ṛṣi, gāyatrī is the metre, Śambhu is the deity; the application is for the pleasing of Jaya.)
With the Gāyatrī he should worship on the right the two western pitchers.

2.2.s:
( gāyatryā viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ savitā devatā vijayaprītaye viniyogaḥ ..)
bhadraṃ caiva subhadraṃ ca prayataḥ saṃyajedbudhaḥ..45..
2.2.d:
( गायत्र्या विश्वामित्र ऋषिः सविता देवता विजयप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥)
भद्रं चैव सुभद्रं च प्रयतः संयजेद्बुधः॥45॥
2.2.m:
(Of the Gāyatrī, Viśvāmitra is the ṛṣi, Savitṛ is the deity; the application is for the pleasing of Vijaya.)
The wise one, restrained, should worship Bhadra and Subhadra.

2.2.s:
(uttare yugmakalaśe manonnā iti maṃtrasya aṃtaka ṛṣirbṛhatī chaṃdo nirṛtirdevatā bhūtaprītaye viniyogaḥ..)
bhūtaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā nyāsaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ ..
vidhāyārghyādikaṃ caiva dharmādimaṃḍale yajet ..46..
2.2.d:
(उत्तरे युग्मकलशे मनोन्ना इति मंत्रस्य अंतक ऋषिर्बृहती छंदो निरृतिर्देवता भूतप्रीतये विनियोगः॥)
भूतशुद्धिं ततः कृत्वा न्यासं कृत्वा विधानतः ॥
विधायार्घ्यादिकं चैव धर्मादिमंडले यजेत् ॥46॥
2.2.m:
(In the pair of pitchers in the north, of the mantra *manonvā*, Antaka is the ṛṣi, bṛhatī is the metre, Nirṛti is the deity; the application is for the pleasing of the bhūtas.)
Then, having performed the purification of the elements and having performed the placement according to rule,
and having offered arghya and the like, he should worship the circle of Dharma and the rest.

2.2.s:
madhye ādhāraśaktyādīnvaruṇaṃ madhyato yajet ..
pūrvādikramataścaiva indrādīnkuladevatāḥ ..47..
2.2.d:
मध्ये आधारशक्त्यादीन्वरुणं मध्यतो यजेत् ॥
पूर्वादिक्रमतश्चैव इन्द्रादीन्कुलदेवताः ॥47॥
2.2.m:
In the middle [he should worship] the supporting energy and the rest, and Varuṇa in the centre;
and in order from the east, Indra and the others, the deities of the family.

2.2.s:
pārśvadvaye karṇikāyā brahmāṇaṃ cāpyanantakam ..
svaiḥsvairmaṃtrairyathoktaiśca balibhirgandhapuṣpakaiḥ .. 48 ..
2.2.d:
पार्श्वद्वये कर्णिकाया ब्रह्माणं चाप्यनन्तकम् ॥
स्वैःस्वैर्मंत्रैर्यथोक्तैश्च बलिभिर्गन्धपुष्पकैः ॥ 48 ॥
2.2.m:
On both sides of the pericarp [he should worship] Brahmā and Ananta,
with their respective mantras as prescribed, and with offerings, fragrant flowers,

2.2.s:
indrābhiṣekamaṃtrasya vādyaṃ gāṃdhārarāgakam ..
agnestejosīti vādyaṃ rāgaṃ caiva varāṭakam .. 49 ..
2.2.d:
इन्द्राभिषेकमंत्रस्य वाद्यं गांधाररागकम् ॥
अग्नेस्तेजोसीति वाद्यं रागं चैव वराटकम् ॥ 49 ॥
2.2.m:
For Indra's consecration mantra, the instrumental music is in the Gāndhāra melody;
for Agni, the instrumental music for *tejosi* and the melody is Varāṭaka.

2.2.s:
ghanakaṃṭakamasyāpi vācyaṃ rāgaṃ tu gurjaram ..
rakṣodhipasya saṃgrāmaṃ vaitālaṃ vādyamucyate .. 2.2.20.50 ..
2.2.d:
घनकंटकमस्यापि वाच्यं रागं तु गुर्जरम् ॥
रक्षोधिपस्य संग्रामं वैतालं वाद्यमुच्यते ॥ 2.2.20.50 ॥
2.2.m:
The vocal music for this [god of death] is Ghanakaṇṭaka, and the melody is Gurjara;
for the lord of rākṣasas, the instrumental music is called Saṃgrāma and Vaitāla.

2.2.s:
nāṭakākhyaṃ tathā rāgaṃ varuṇasyāpi me śṛṇu ..
vādyaṃ rājyābhiṣekākhyaṃ rāgo vasaṃtasaṃjñakaḥ .. 51 ..
2.2.d:
नाटकाख्यं तथा रागं वरुणस्यापि मे शृणु ॥
वाद्यं राज्याभिषेकाख्यं रागो वसंतसंज्ञकः ॥ 51 ॥
2.2.m:
Hear also from me the melody called Nāṭaka for Varuṇa;
the instrumental music is called Rājyābhiṣeka, and the melody is named Vasanta.

2.2.s:
īśasya naṃdighoṣākhyaṃ vādyaṃ rāgotha kāmadaḥ ..
suvarṇaṃ duṃdubhirvādyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ kathito budhaiḥ .. 52 ..
2.2.d:
ईशस्य नंदिघोषाख्यं वाद्यं रागोथ कामदः ॥
सुवर्णं दुंदुभिर्वाद्यं ब्रह्मणः कथितो बुधैः ॥ 52 ॥
2.2.m:
For Īśa, the instrumental music is named Nandighoṣa, and then the melody is Kāmada;
golden kettle-drums are the instrumental music stated by the wise for Brahmā.

2.2.s:
rāgo devī vasaṃtaśca anaṃtasya nibodha me ..
vādyaṃ gāṃdhāratārākhyaṃ rāgaścāṅgāravātakaḥ .. 53 ..
2.2.d:
रागो देवी वसंतश्च अनंतस्य निबोध मे ॥
वाद्यं गांधारताराख्यं रागश्चाङ्गारवातकः ॥ 53 ॥
2.2.m:
O goddess, know the melody Vasanta for Ananta from me;
the instrumental music is called Gāndhāratāra, and the melody is Aṅgāravātaka.

2.2.s:
some ghoṣe bhavedvādyaṃ jaleśasya mahātmanaḥ ..
mālavākhyo bhavedrāgaḥ patrāgreṣu mahānapi .. 54 ..
2.2.d:
सोमे घोषे भवेद्वाद्यं जलेशस्य महात्मनः ॥
मालवाख्यो भवेद्रागः पत्राग्रेषु महानपि ॥ 54 ॥
2.2.m:
For Soma, the instrumental music should be Ghoṣa; for the great-souled lord of waters,
the melody should be called Mālava, and also Mahān at the tips of the leaves.

2.2.s:
svaiḥ svairdharmaiśca saṃgṛhya dakṣiṇe pṛthivīṃ yajet ..
syonā pṛthivīti maṃtreṇa upacāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ .. 55 ..
2.2.d:
स्वैः स्वैर्धर्मैश्च संगृह्य दक्षिणे पृथिवीं यजेत् ॥
स्योना पृथिवीति मंत्रेण उपचारैः पृथग्विधैः ॥ 55 ॥
2.2.m:
Grasping with their respective duties, he should worship the Earth in the south
with the mantra *syonā pṛthivī* and with various kinds of services.

2.2.s:
maṇḍapasyottare bhāge mahādevaṃ prapūjayet ..
namo vṛkṣebhya ityādi naivedyaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ .. 56 ..
2.2.d:
मण्डपस्योत्तरे भागे महादेवं प्रपूजयेत् ॥
नमो वृक्षेभ्य इत्यादि नैवेद्यैश्च पृथग्विधैः ॥ 56 ॥
2.2.m:
In the northern part of the pavilion he should worship Mahādeva
with [the mantra] *namo vṛkṣebhyaḥ* and the like, and with various kinds of food offerings.

2.2.s:
( mahādevaṃ dvibhujaṃ ḍamaruśūladharamumāsahitaṃ dhyātvā ..
namo vṛkṣebhya iti mantrasya brahmā ṛṣirgā yatrī chaṃdaścandro devatā candraprītaye viniyogaḥ ..)
gaṃdhapuṣpādibhirbhaktyā bhūtāni parito yajet .. 57 ..
2.2.d:
( महादेवं द्विभुजं डमरुशूलधरमुमासहितं ध्यात्वा ॥
नमो वृक्षेभ्य इति मन्त्रस्य ब्रह्मा ऋषिर्गा यत्री छंदश्चन्द्रो देवता चन्द्रप्रीतये विनियोगः ॥)
गंधपुष्पादिभिर्भक्त्या भूतानि परितो यजेत् ॥ 57 ॥

2.2.s:
vetālāśca piśācāśca rākṣasāśca sarī sṛpāḥ ..
asmātprayāṃtu me sthānādye cānye vighnakārakāḥ .. 58 ..
2.2.d:
वेतालाश्च पिशाचाश्च राक्षसाश्च सरी सृपाः ॥
अस्मात्प्रयांतु मे स्थानाद्ये चान्ये विघ्नकारकाः ॥ 58 ॥
2.2.m:
"May the vetālas, the piśācas, the rākṣasas, the reptiles,
and whatever other obstructors there are, depart from this place of mine!"

2.2.s:
madhuyuktaṃ pāyasānnaṃ varuṇāya nivedayet ..
pītaṃ cālohitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śuddhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca dhūmrakam.. 59 ..
2.2.d:
मधुयुक्तं पायसान्नं वरुणाय निवेदयेत् ॥
पीतं चालोहितं कृष्णं शुद्धं कृष्णं च धूम्रकम्॥ 59 ॥
2.2.m:
He should offer milk-rice mixed with honey to Varuṇa.
Yellow, red, black, pure, black, and smoke-coloured,

2.2.s:
pītaṃ śuklaṃ tathā citraṃ śvetamannaṃ yathākramam..
balayastu digīśānāṃ grahāṇāmapi tāñchṛṇu .. 2.2.20.60 ..
2.2.d:
पीतं शुक्लं तथा चित्रं श्वेतमन्नं यथाक्रमम्॥
बलयस्तु दिगीशानां ग्रहाणामपि ताञ्छृणु ॥ 2.2.20.60 ॥
2.2.m:
yellow, white, variegated, and white food in due order—
now hear these offerings to the lords of the directions and also to the planets:

2.2.s:
kṣīraudanaṃ graheśāya śuklānnaṃ śaśine smṛtam ..
lohitānnaṃ ca bhaumāya budhāya kṣīraṣāṣṭikam .. 61 ..
2.2.d:
क्षीरौदनं ग्रहेशाय शुक्लान्नं शशिने स्मृतम् ॥
लोहितान्नं च भौमाय बुधाय क्षीरषाष्टिकम् ॥ 61 ॥
2.2.m:
Rice cooked in milk for the lord of the planets; white food is traditionally taught for the Moon;
red food for Mars; milk-ṣāṣṭika rice for Mercury;

2.2.s:
pītamannaṃ devaguroḥ śukrasya sitataṃdulam ..
māṃsaudanaṃ śanerjñeyaṃ rāhośca kṛṣṇa bhaktakam .. 62 ..
2.2.d:
पीतमन्नं देवगुरोः शुक्रस्य सिततंदुलम् ॥
मांसौदनं शनेर्ज्ञेयं राहोश्च कृष्ण भक्तकम् ॥ 62 ॥
2.2.m:
yellow food for the preceptor of the gods; white polished rice for Venus;
meat-rice is known for Saturn; and black boiled rice for Rāhu.

2.2.s:
dhūmravarṇaṃ tu tāmraṃ tu bhaumasya kṣīraṣāṣṭikam ..
piṣṭakānnaṃ śivasyoktaṃ bhūtānāṃ māṣabhaktakam .. 63 ..
2.2.d:
धूम्रवर्णं तु ताम्रं तु भौमस्य क्षीरषाष्टिकम् ॥
पिष्टकान्नं शिवस्योक्तं भूतानां माषभक्तकम् ॥ 63 ॥
2.2.m:
Smoke-coloured, copper-coloured, and milk-ṣāṣṭika rice for Mars;
pastry-food is declared for Śiva, and black-gram rice for the bhūtas.

2.2.s:
evaṃ baliṃ vidhāyātha agre kuṃbhaṃ niveśayet ..
pradeśadvyaṅgulaṃ nāma aṣṭottarasahasrakam ..64..
2.2.d:
एवं बलिं विधायाथ अग्रे कुंभं निवेशयेत् ॥
प्रदेशद्व्यङ्गुलं नाम अष्टोत्तरसहस्रकम् ॥64॥
2.2.m:
Having thus made the offering, he should then place a jar in front,
measuring a span and two fingers, [chanting] a thousand and eight [times].

2.2.s:
bahvaṃgulakaṃ vinyasya vinyasya kalaśopari..
niśāvāṃchtisūtraiśca saṃveṣṭya pihitaṃ tathā .. 65 ..
2.2.d:
बह्वंगुलकं विन्यस्य विन्यस्य कलशोपरि॥
निशावांछ्तिसूत्रैश्च संवेष्ट्य पिहितं तथा ॥ 65 ॥
2.2.m:
Having placed [a leaf-garland] of many fingers on top of the pitcher,
it is wrapped with turmeric-sought threads and covered.

2.2.s:
śarāvaṃ ca punardadyādvardhanīṃ pratipūjayet ..
astrāya phaḍiti maṃtreṇa dhyātvā devaṃ jaleśvaram .. 66 ..
2.2.d:
शरावं च पुनर्दद्याद्वर्धनीं प्रतिपूजयेत् ॥
अस्त्राय फडिति मंत्रेण ध्यात्वा देवं जलेश्वरम् ॥ 66 ॥
2.2.m:
He should again present a saucer and worship the vardhanī vessel;
having meditated on the god, the lord of waters, with the mantra *astrāya phaṭ*,

2.2.s:
sūktaṃ yajedyathāśakti śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japet ..
kuṃḍeṣu vinyasennāgānaṣṭau pūrvādiṣu kramāt .. 67 ..
2.2.d:
सूक्तं यजेद्यथाशक्ति शतमष्टोत्तरं जपेत् ॥
कुंडेषु विन्यसेन्नागानष्टौ पूर्वादिषु क्रमात् ॥ 67 ॥
2.2.m:
he should recite the hymn according to his ability, and murmur it a hundred and eight times.
In the sacrificial pits he should deposit the eight serpents in order, beginning with the east.

2.2.s:
anaṃtaṃ pūjayetpūrvaṃ mānenāṃgulamātrakam ..
nirmitaṃ kāṃcanenaiva saptavartikayā sudhīḥ .. 68 ..
2.2.d:
अनंतं पूजयेत्पूर्वं मानेनांगुलमात्रकम् ॥
निर्मितं कांचनेनैव सप्तवर्तिकया सुधीः ॥ 68 ॥
2.2.m:
The wise one should first worship Ananta, measuring only a finger,
fashioned of gold, with a seven-fold wick.

2.2.s:
rājataṃ vāsukiṃ nāgaṃ yajetpatrāṃtare punaḥ ..
pādamātrepi cāṃguṣṭhamātraṃ tāmrasya bhakṣyakam .. 69 ..
2.2.d:
राजतं वासुकिं नागं यजेत्पत्रांतरे पुनः ॥
पादमात्रेपि चांगुष्ठमात्रं ताम्रस्य भक्ष्यकम् ॥ 69 ॥
2.2.m:
He should worship the silver serpent Vāsuki again on another leaf;
measuring a quarter-pala, or thumb-sized, of copper, an edible offering.

2.2.s:
paṃcāṃgulaṃ tolikayā lohaṃ karkoṭakaṃ punaḥ ..
vartikābhiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirbṛhatparvapramāṇakam .. 2.2.20.70 ..
2.2.d:
पंचांगुलं तोलिकया लोहं कर्कोटकं पुनः ॥
वर्तिकाभिः षोडशभिर्बृहत्पर्वप्रमाणकम् ॥ 2.2.20.70 ॥
2.2.m:
Next, the iron Karkoṭaka measuring five fingers by weight,
with sixteen wicks, having the size of a large joint.

2.2.s:
śaṃkhapālaṃ kuśamayamardhapādena nirmitam..
aṃguṣṭhamātraṃ raktena nāgaṃ tālakamātrakam ..71..
2.2.d:
शंखपालं कुशमयमर्धपादेन निर्मितम्॥
अंगुष्ठमात्रं रक्तेन नागं तालकमात्रकम् ॥71॥
2.2.m:
Śaṅkhapāla made of kuśa grass, fashioned of an eighth of a pala;
thumb-sized, with red [colour], a serpent measuring a tāla.

2.2.s:
aṃguṣṭhe tolakaṃ paścātpadmanāgaṃ punaryajet ..
tolakārdhapramāṇena aṃgulaṃ parimāṇataḥ .. 72 ..
2.2.d:
अंगुष्ठे तोलकं पश्चात्पद्मनागं पुनर्यजेत् ॥
तोलकार्धप्रमाणेन अंगुलं परिमाणतः ॥ 72 ॥
2.2.m:
Afterwards, one tola in thumb-size, he should worship the serpent Padma,
measuring half a tola, with a measure of a finger.

2.2.s:
kuryācchailamayaṃ samyagyathāvallakṣaṇānvitam ..
mahāpadmasya vai tasya pūrvamānena nirmitam .. 73 ..
2.2.d:
कुर्याच्छैलमयं सम्यग्यथावल्लक्षणान्वितम् ॥
महापद्मस्य वै तस्य पूर्वमानेन निर्मितम् ॥ 73 ॥
2.2.m: One should properly make [the serpent] out of stone, duly endowed with the characteristics, / made according to the previous measurement of that Mahāpadma.

2.2.s:
dhyātvānaṃtaṃ caturbāhuṃ śuklasaptaphaṇānvitam ..
dakṣiṇordhvakare śaṃkhamadhicakraṃ pratiṣṭhitam .. 74 ..
2.2.d:
ध्यात्वानंतं चतुर्बाहुं शुक्लसप्तफणान्वितम् ॥
दक्षिणोर्ध्वकरे शंखमधिचक्रं प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥ 74 ॥
2.2.m: Having meditated on Ananta as four-armed, endowed with seven white hoods, / with a conch placed in the upper right hand and a discus above,

2.2.s:
vāmordhve tu gadāpadmaṃ madhyasthāne vyavasthitam ..
sarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktamevaṃ dhyātvā yathāvidhi ..75...
2.2.d:
वामोर्ध्वे तु गदापद्मं मध्यस्थाने व्यवस्थितम् ॥
सर्वालंकारसंयुक्तमेवं ध्यात्वा यथाविधि ॥75॥।
2.2.m: and in the upper left a mace, and a lotus situated in the middle, / adorned with all ornaments—having meditated thus according to the rule,

2.2.s:
sahasraśīrṣeti maṃtreṇa pūjayitvā baliṃ haret ..
lājaiśca tilasaṃmiśraiḥ kṣīrayuktaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ .. 76 ..
2.2.d:
सहस्रशीर्षेति मंत्रेण पूजयित्वा बलिं हरेत् ॥
लाजैश्च तिलसंमिश्रैः क्षीरयुक्तैः पृथग्विधैः ॥ 76 ॥
2.2.m: and having worshipped with the mantra beginning with 'Sahasraśīrṣā', he should make an offering / with parched grain mixed with sesame seeds, combined with milk, of various kinds.

2.2.s:
caturvidhaṃ tathā śvetaṃ sarvālaṃkārasaṃyutam ..
svakīyaṃ prajapettatra āpyāyasveti vai ṛcā .. 77 ..
2.2.d:
चतुर्विधं तथा श्वेतं सर्वालंकारसंयुतम् ॥
स्वकीयं प्रजपेत्तत्र आप्यायस्वेति वै ऋचा ॥ 77 ॥
2.2.m: Likewise, fourfold, white, and adorned with all ornaments, / he should whisper his own [mantra] there with the verse 'Āpyāyasva'.

2.2.s:
piṇyākaṃ nāgajihvāṃ ca tathā sarjarasaṃ dadhi ..
balayastasya nirdiṣṭāstakṣakaṃ lohitaṃ yajet .. 78 ..
2.2.d:
पिण्याकं नागजिह्वां च तथा सर्जरसं दधि ॥
बलयस्तस्य निर्दिष्टास्तक्षकं लोहितं यजेत् ॥ 78 ॥
2.2.m: Oilcake, nāgajihvā, resin, and curd / are prescribed as his offerings. He should worship red Takṣaka,

2.2.s:
padmaṃ ṭaṃkaṃ dadhānaṃ ca bhujābhyāṃ nāgasattamam..
manonnā iti maṃtreṇa ājyaṃ somo baliṃ haret .. 79 ..
2.2.d:
पद्मं टंकं दधानं च भुजाभ्यां नागसत्तमम्॥
मनोन्ना इति मंत्रेण आज्यं सोमो बलिं हरेत् ॥ 79 ॥
2.2.m: holding a lotus and a chisel with two arms, the excellent serpent. / With the mantra beginning with 'Mano nvā', he should make an offering of clarified butter and soma.

2.2.s:
karkoṭakaṃ ca dvibhujaṃ pītavastradharaṃ yajet ..
pañca nadya iti ṛcā viṣṇukrāṃtā balirbhavet .. 2.2.20.80 ..
2.2.d:
कर्कोटकं च द्विभुजं पीतवस्त्रधरं यजेत् ॥
पञ्च नद्य इति ऋचा विष्णुक्रांता बलिर्भवेत् ॥ 2.2.20.80 ॥
2.2.m: And he should worship two-armed Karkoṭaka, wearing yellow garments. / With the verse beginning with 'Pañca nadyaḥ', the offering should be Viṣṇukrāntā.

2.2.s:
pītavastraṃ ca kuliśaṃ yājayettu caturbhujam ..
bhujābhyāmūrdhvabhāge tu raktapadmadharaṃ harim .. 81 ..
2.2.d:
पीतवस्त्रं च कुलिशं याजयेत्तु चतुर्भुजम् ॥
भुजाभ्यामूर्ध्वभागे तु रक्तपद्मधरं हरिम् ॥ 81 ॥
2.2.m: And he should worship four-armed [Vāsuki], wearing yellow garments and holding a thunderbolt, / and Hari holding red lotuses with his upper arms.

2.2.s:
śarkarā kuṣṭhakaṃ caiva balistasya prakī rtitaḥ..
dvibhujaṃ śaṃkhapālaṃ ca śaṃkhābhaṃ śaṃkhadhāriṇam .. 82 ..
2.2.d:
शर्करा कुष्ठकं चैव बलिस्तस्य प्रकी र्तितः॥
द्विभुजं शंखपालं च शंखाभं शंखधारिणम् ॥ 82 ॥
2.2.m: Sugar and kuṣṭha are declared as his offering. / And two-armed Śaṅkhapāla, shining like a conch and holding a conch,

2.2.s:
padmāsanasthaṃ padmābhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ ca varaṃ vibhum..
dhruvakṣitidhruvosīti maṃtrābhyāṃ pūjayetpṛthak .. 83 ..
2.2.d:
पद्मासनस्थं पद्माभ्यां हस्ताभ्यां च वरं विभुम्॥
ध्रुवक्षितिध्रुवोसीति मंत्राभ्यां पूजयेत्पृथक् ॥ 83 ॥
2.2.m: seated on a lotus posture, the all-pervading lord granting boons with his hands holding two lotuses, / he should worship separately with the two mantras 'Dhruvā kṣitiḥ' and 'Dhruvo 'si'.

2.2.s:
ghaṭaudanaṃ bhṛṃgarājaṃ padmaṃ ca valayastayoḥ ..
svagṛhyoktena vidhinā saṃsthāpyāgniṃ kuśaṃḍikām .. 84 ..
2.2.d:
घटौदनं भृंगराजं पद्मं च वलयस्तयोः ॥
स्वगृह्योक्तेन विधिना संस्थाप्याग्निं कुशंडिकाम् ॥ 84 ॥
2.2.m: A pot of cooked rice, bhṛṅgarāja, and a lotus are the offerings for those two. / Having established the fire according to the rule stated in one's own Gṛhya text, and having performed the kuśaṇḍikā rite,

2.2.s:
kṛtvā ājyasya saṃskāraṃ vāruṇaṃ śrapayeccarum ..
juhuyādaṣṭa bilvāni digīśānāṃ ghṛtena vai .. 85 ..
2.2.d:
कृत्वा आज्यस्य संस्कारं वारुणं श्रपयेच्चरुम् ॥
जुहुयादष्ट बिल्वानि दिगीशानां घृतेन वै ॥ 85 ॥
2.2.m: and having consecrated the clarified butter, one should cook a caru for Varuṇa. / He should indeed offer eight bilva [leaves] with clarified butter to the lords of the directions.

2.2.s:
ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyādgrahāṇāṃ ca trayaṃtrayam ..
susamidbhirghṛtamadhu payobhirmiśritaiḥ pṛthak .. 86 ..
2.2.d:
एकैकामाहुतिं दद्याद्ग्रहाणां च त्रयंत्रयम् ॥
सुसमिद्भिर्घृतमधु पयोभिर्मिश्रितैः पृथक् ॥ 86 ॥
2.2.m: He should give an oblation to each, and three to each of the planets, / with good kindling sticks mixed separately with clarified butter, honey, and milk.

2.2.s:
palāśasamidhaṃ paścātpratiṣṭhāmāhutitrayam ..
śivasya paramānnena juhuyādaṣṭasaṃkhyayā .. 87 ..
2.2.d:
पलाशसमिधं पश्चात्प्रतिष्ठामाहुतित्रयम् ॥
शिवस्य परमान्नेन जुहुयादष्टसंख्यया ॥ 87 ॥
2.2.m: Then [with] a palāśa kindling stick, [offering] three oblations for the installation, / he should sacrifice eight times with the supreme food (pāyasa) for Śiva.

2.2.s:
madhvājyaguḍamiśrābhirlājābhirjuhuyātpṛthak ..
lājānyathoktaṃ vitaredekaikāmāhutiṃ kramāt .. 88 ..
2.2.d:
मध्वाज्यगुडमिश्राभिर्लाजाभिर्जुहुयात्पृथक् ॥
लाजान्यथोक्तं वितरेदेकैकामाहुतिं क्रमात् ॥ 88 ॥
2.2.m: He should sacrifice separately with parched grain mixed with honey, clarified butter, and jaggery; / as prescribed, he should offer the parched grain, one oblation each in order.

2.2.s:
sthālīpākasya juhuyādekaikāmāhutiṃ punaḥ ..
varuṇaṃ ca samuddiśya rudraṃ sarvaṃ pṛthakpṛthak .. 89 ..
2.2.d:
स्थालीपाकस्य जुहुयादेकैकामाहुतिं पुनः ॥
वरुणं च समुद्दिश्य रुद्रं सर्वं पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 89 ॥
2.2.m: He should again offer one oblation each of the domestic cooked offering (sthālīpāka), / dedicated separately to Varuṇa and to all of Rudra.

2.2.s:
vāstoṣpataya iti maṃtreṇa pañcagavyo bhavettataḥ ..
syonāpṛthivīti maṃtreṇa vrīhimṛttikayā punaḥ .. 2.2.20.90 ..
2.2.d:
वास्तोष्पतय इति मंत्रेण पञ्चगव्यो भवेत्ततः ॥
स्योनापृथिवीति मंत्रेण व्रीहिमृत्तिकया पुनः ॥ 2.2.20.90 ॥
2.2.m: Then there should be fivefold cow-products with the mantra beginning with 'Vāstoṣpate'. / Then again with soil from rice-plants with the mantra beginning with 'Syonā pṛthivī',

2.2.s:
vṛṣānna iti maṃtreṇa kayā na iti vai punaḥ ..
kuśamūlamṛdā caiva catuṣpathamṛdā tathā .. 91 ..
2.2.d:
वृषान्न इति मंत्रेण कया न इति वै पुनः ॥
कुशमूलमृदा चैव चतुष्पथमृदा तथा ॥ 91 ॥
2.2.m: with the mantra beginning with 'Vṛṣānnaḥ' and again with 'Kayā naḥ', / and with soil from the root of kuśa grass, and likewise with soil from a crossroads,

2.2.s:
imā rudreti maṃtreṇa śrīśceti ṛcā punaḥ ..
padmakhaṇḍasya ca mṛdā snāpayetsusamāhitaḥ .. 92 ..
2.2.d:
इमा रुद्रेति मंत्रेण श्रीश्चेति ऋचा पुनः ॥
पद्मखण्डस्य च मृदा स्नापयेत्सुसमाहितः ॥ 92 ॥
2.2.m: with the mantra beginning with 'Imā Rudra', and again with the verse beginning with 'Śrīś ca', / and with soil from a lotus-clump, he should bathe [them], being well-collected.

2.2.s:
tadviṣṇoriti maṃtreṇa tathā puṣpodakena ca ..
tīrthodakena kṛṣṇena triraktena triśītakaiḥ .. 93 ..
2.2.d:
तद्विष्णोरिति मंत्रेण तथा पुष्पोदकेन च ॥
तीर्थोदकेन कृष्णेन त्रिरक्तेन त्रिशीतकैः ॥ 93 ॥
2.2.m: With the mantra beginning with 'Tad viṣṇoḥ', and likewise with flower-water, / with sacred water, with black [water], with thrice-red, with thrice-chilled [waters],

2.2.s:
pañcaraktena raktānāṃ mṛdā kaiśca kuśodakaiḥ ..
svarṇatoyaiśca kalaśairaṣṭottaraśatena tu .. 94 ..
2.2.d:
पञ्चरक्तेन रक्तानां मृदा कैश्च कुशोदकैः ॥
स्वर्णतोयैश्च कलशैरष्टोत्तरशतेन तु ॥ 94 ॥
2.2.m: with fivefold red, with the soil of red [substances], with some kuśa-water, / and with golden water from one hundred and eight jars,

2.2.s:
taijasairmārttikaiścāpi aṣṭāviṃśatibhistathā ..
yathāśakti tu saṃsthāpya kuṃkumaiścandanairapi .. 95 ..
2.2.d:
तैजसैर्मार्त्तिकैश्चापि अष्टाविंशतिभिस्तथा ॥
यथाशक्ति तु संस्थाप्य कुंकुमैश्चन्दनैरपि ॥ 95 ॥
2.2.m: or with metallic ones and clay ones, twenty-eight in number; / having set them up according to his ability, also with saffron and sandalwood,

2.2.s:
annaṃ lipya tato mṛdbhirdadyāccaiva yathākramam ..
surāsureti ca ṛcā vastrayugmena veṣṭayet .. 96 ..
2.2.d:
अन्नं लिप्य ततो मृद्भिर्दद्याच्चैव यथाक्रमम् ॥
सुरासुरेति च ऋचा वस्त्रयुग्मेन वेष्टयेत् ॥ 96 ॥
2.2.m: having smeared food, he should then apply the soils in proper order; / and with the verse beginning with 'Surāsura', he should wrap [them] with a pair of cloths.

2.2.s:
dhvajaṃ ca dhanunāgeti gaṃdhadvāreti gomayam ..
dhūrasīti tato dhūpaṃ hotre cāhutidīpakam .. 97 ..
2.2.d:
ध्वजं च धनुनागेति गंधद्वारेति गोमयम् ॥
धूरसीति ततो धूपं होत्रे चाहुतिदीपकम् ॥ 97 ॥
2.2.m: And a banner with [the mantra] 'Dhanvanāgāḥ', cow dung with 'Gandhadvārām', / then incense with 'Dhūr asi', and a light for the oblation to the hotṛ priest,

2.2.s:
siṃdhosīti ca siṃdūraṃ svabhāve raktakaṃ tathā ..
mālatīkusumaiḥ kṛtyairnāgānsaṃsthāpayettataḥ .. 98 ..
2.2.d:
सिंधोसीति च सिंदूरं स्वभावे रक्तकं तथा ॥
मालतीकुसुमैः कृत्यैर्नागान्संस्थापयेत्ततः ॥ 98 ॥
2.2.m: and vermilion with 'Sindhor asi', as well as natural red powder. / Then he should install the serpents with cultivated jasmine flowers,

2.2.s:
dhārābhiḥ śatapuṣpābhirgandhatoyādibhistathā ..
athavāśvatthapatreṣu vaṭapatreṣu vā sudhīḥ .. 99 ..
2.2.d:
धाराभिः शतपुष्पाभिर्गन्धतोयादिभिस्तथा ॥
अथवाश्वत्थपत्रेषु वटपत्रेषु वा सुधीः ॥ 99 ॥
2.2.m: with streams [of water], with hundred-blossomed flowers, and likewise with scented water and the like; / or the wise man, on aśvattha leaves or on vaṭa leaves,

2.2.s:
rocanā kuṃkumairvāpi saṃlikhya tatra pūjayet ..
prakṣipettatra muktā hi kalaśeṣu vinikṣipet .. 2.2.20.100 ..
2.2.d:
रोचना कुंकुमैर्वापि संलिख्य तत्र पूजयेत् ॥
प्रक्षिपेत्तत्र मुक्ता हि कलशेषु विनिक्षिपेत् ॥ 2.2.20.100 ॥
2.2.m: having drawn [them] with yellow pigment or saffron, should worship them there. / He should throw pearls there, indeed he should deposit them in the jars.

2.2.s:
maṃḍapasyottaredeśe śayyāṃ nirmāya śobhanām ..
rājataṃ vāruṇaṃ tasyāṃ pādamātreṇa nirmitām .. 101 ..
2.2.d:
मंडपस्योत्तरेदेशे शय्यां निर्माय शोभनाम् ॥
राजतं वारुणं तस्यां पादमात्रेण निर्मिताम् ॥ 101 ॥
2.2.m: Having prepared a beautiful couch in the northern part of the pavilion, / on it a silver image of Varuṇa made of the measure of one foot,

2.2.s:
aṃguṣṭhamātraṃ saṃsthāpya tataḥ puṣkariṇīmapi ..
svarṇapādena ghaṭitāṃ caturasrāṃ suśobhanām .. 102 ..'
2.2.d:
अंगुष्ठमात्रं संस्थाप्य ततः पुष्करिणीमपि ॥
स्वर्णपादेन घटितां चतुरस्रां सुशोभनाम् ॥ 102 ॥'
2.2.m: having installed one of the size of a thumb, then also a pond / fashioned with a quarter-measure of gold, four-sided and very beautiful;

2.2.s:
aṃguṣṭhamātraṃ sampūjya varuṇāya nivedayet ..
yathāśakti tato gāṃ ca saṃbhave pañcaviṃśatiḥ .. 103 ..
2.2.d:
अंगुष्ठमात्रं सम्पूज्य वरुणाय निवेदयेत् ॥
यथाशक्ति ततो गां च संभवे पञ्चविंशतिः ॥ 103 ॥
2.2.m: having worshipped the one of thumb-size, he should offer it to Varuṇa. / Then according to his ability a cow, and if possible twenty-five,

2.2.s: suvarṇaṃ rājataṃ caiva dhānyaṃ vāso varāṭakam .. .. 104 ..
2.2.d: सुवर्णं राजतं चैव धान्यं वासो वराटकम् ॥ ॥ 104 ॥
2.2.m: gold, silver, grain, cloth, and cowrie shells.

2.2.s: nāgayaṣṭiṃ samādāya kiṃciduttaragāṃ tathā .. 105 ..
2.2.d: नागयष्टिं समादाय किंचिदुत्तरगां तथा ॥ 105 ॥
2.2.m: Taking the serpent-staff, pointing somewhat towards the north,

2.2.s:
tatokṣatāya bhaumāya kṛtvā cājyāhutitrayam ..
lājāndadhisamāyuktaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu guḍaṃ tathā .. 106 ..
2.2.d:
ततोक्षताय भौमाय कृत्वा चाज्याहुतित्रयम् ॥
लाजान्दधिसमायुक्तं घृतं मधु गुडं तथा ॥ 106 ॥
2.2.m: and having made three oblations of clarified butter to the uninjured Mars (Bhauma), / parched grain combined with curd, clarified butter, honey, and jaggery,

2.2.s:
kṣīraṃ ca piṣṭakaṃ caiva śaṣkulīgandhapuṣpakam ..
paṃcāmṛtaṃ pañcaratnaṃ garbhe dadyātsamāhitaḥ .. 107 ..
2.2.d:
क्षीरं च पिष्टकं चैव शष्कुलीगन्धपुष्पकम् ॥
पंचामृतं पञ्चरत्नं गर्भे दद्यात्समाहितः ॥ 107 ॥
2.2.m: milk, flour-cakes, large cakes, perfume, and flowers, / the five nectars, and the five jewels, he should deposit into the cavity, being composed.

2.2.s:
ācāryo yajamānena susannaddhaiśca bhṛtyakaiḥ ..
gaṃgājaleśayormadhye paṃcaghoṣapuraḥsaram .. 108 ..
2.2.d:
आचार्यो यजमानेन सुसन्नद्धैश्च भृत्यकैः ॥
गंगाजलेशयोर्मध्ये पंचघोषपुरःसरम् ॥ 108 ॥
2.2.m: The teacher, along with the patron and well-equipped attendants, / between the water of the Gaṅgā and the master of waters, preceded by fivefold sounds,

2.2.s:
avāpya ca tato yaṣṭiṃ sthiro bhavati vairivā ..
dhruvaṃ dhruveti maṃtreṇa yaṣṭimā maṃtrayettataḥ .. 19103 ..
2.2.d:
अवाप्य च ततो यष्टिं स्थिरो भवति वैरिवा ॥
ध्रुवं ध्रुवेति मंत्रेण यष्टिमा मंत्रयेत्ततः ॥ 19103 ॥
2.2.m: and having set up the staff, he becomes firm or holds his enemies in check. / Then he should consecrate the staff with the mantra beginning with 'Dhruvaṃ dhruva':

2.2.s:
yajñapriyāsi devi tvaṃ sarvavighnavināśinī ..
pāhi māṃ sarvapāpebhya ātmanā tvaṃ sthirībhava .. 2.2.20.110 ..
2.2.d:
यज्ञप्रियासि देवि त्वं सर्वविघ्नविनाशिनी ॥
पाहि मां सर्वपापेभ्य आत्मना त्वं स्थिरीभव ॥ 2.2.20.110 ॥
2.2.m: 'O goddess, you are dear to the sacrifice, the destroyer of all obstacles; / protect me from all sins; become firm yourself!'

2.2.s:
ityāmaṃtrya yajeccaiva gāyatrīṃ ca paṭhettataḥ ..
vanaspateti viḍavāmiti maṃtraṃ japetpunaḥ .. 111 ..
2.2.d:
इत्यामंत्र्य यजेच्चैव गायत्रीं च पठेत्ततः ॥
वनस्पतेति विडवामिति मंत्रं जपेत्पुनः ॥ 111 ॥
2.2.m: Having addressed [it] thus, he should worship it and then recite the Gāyatrī. / He should again whisper the mantra 'Vanaspate' [and] 'Viḍavām'.

2.2.s:
punarāgatya tāṃ vediṃ nirmathya varuṇaṃ prabhum ..
tathā puṣkariṇīṃ caiva vardhanīṃ kalaśodaraiḥ .. 112 ..
2.2.d:
पुनरागत्य तां वेदिं निर्मथ्य वरुणं प्रभुम् ॥
तथा पुष्करिणीं चैव वर्धनीं कलशोदरैः ॥ 112 ॥
2.2.m: Having returned to that altar, having churned for the lord Varuṇa, / and likewise for the pond and the water-jar from the bellies of the jars,

2.2.s:
aniṣṭaṃ mārjayennāgānuddhṛtya kalaśaṃ tathā ..
pāṣāṇābhyaṃtaraṃ kṛtvā gomayaiḥ parilipya ca .. 113 ..
2.2.d:
अनिष्टं मार्जयेन्नागानुद्धृत्य कलशं तथा ॥
पाषाणाभ्यंतरं कृत्वा गोमयैः परिलिप्य च ॥ 113 ॥
2.2.m: he should wipe away misfortune from the serpents, having raised the jar; / having placed it within stones and smeared it with cow dung,

2.2.s:
varuṇaṃ puṣkariṇyāṃ ca jalamadhye vinikṣipet ..
namostviti ca mantreṇa baliṃ dadyācca pāyasam .. 114 ..
2.2.d:
वरुणं पुष्करिण्यां च जलमध्ये विनिक्षिपेत् ॥
नमोस्त्विति च मन्त्रेण बलिं दद्याच्च पायसम् ॥ 114 ॥
2.2.m: he should throw Varuṇa and the pond into the middle of the water. / And with the mantra beginning with 'Namo 'stu', he should offer a rice-milk offering (pāyasa).

2.2.s:
nirmanthettatra yo nāgaḥ sthāpayettu yathāvidhi ..
śrāvayettamimaṃ maṃtramatra saṃnihito bhava .. 115 ..
2.2.d:
निर्मन्थेत्तत्र यो नागः स्थापयेत्तु यथाविधि ॥
श्रावयेत्तमिमं मंत्रमत्र संनिहितो भव ॥ 115 ॥
2.2.m: Whichever serpent he should produce there by churning, he should install according to rule; / he should cause it to hear this mantra: 'Be present here!

2.2.s:
atra svāmī bhavānnāga rakṣaṇīyastvayā janaḥ ..
gāyatreṇa tvā chaṃdasāmīmantraṃ saṃśrāvayetpunaḥ .. .. 116 ..
2.2.d:
अत्र स्वामी भवान्नाग रक्षणीयस्त्वया जनः ॥
गायत्रेण त्वा छंदसामीमन्त्रं संश्रावयेत्पुनः ॥ ॥ 116 ॥
2.2.m: Be the master here, O serpent; the people are to be protected by you!' / He should again recite to it the mantra beginning with 'Gāyatreṇa tvā chandasā'.

2.2.s:
saṃpūjya gaṃdhapuṣpādyaiḥ purato nikṣipeddiśi ..
pidhāya nāgarājānamṛcābhyāṃ parisūtrakaiḥ .. 117 ..
2.2.d:
संपूज्य गंधपुष्पाद्यैः पुरतो निक्षिपेद्दिशि ॥
पिधाय नागराजानमृचाभ्यां परिसूत्रकैः ॥ 117 ॥
2.2.m:
Having worshipped [him] with perfumes, flowers, and the like, one should cast [him] in the forward direction,
having covered the king of serpents with two verses [and] cords.

2.2.s:
sanniruddhyāśu saṃsthāpya baliṃ dadyā dvidhānataḥ ..
lājaudanaṃ manastasya yajjāgrata ṛcā japet .. 118 ..
2.2.d:
सन्निरुद्ध्याशु संस्थाप्य बलिं दद्या द्विधानतः ॥
लाजौदनं मनस्तस्य यज्जाग्रत ऋचा जपेत् ॥ 118 ॥
2.2.m:
Having restrained and quickly installed [him], one should offer a bali according to the ritual rules:
fried grain and cooked rice. One should recite the verse 'yajjāgrataḥ' for his mind.

2.2.s:
evaṃ bhūriti maṃtrai svaiḥ svaireva tu pṛthagvidhaiḥ ..
svāsu dikṣu ca saṃsthāpya pūja yecca prayatnataḥ .. 119 ..
2.2.d:
एवं भूरिति मंत्रै स्वैः स्वैरेव तु पृथग्विधैः ॥
स्वासु दिक्षु च संस्थाप्य पूज येच्च प्रयत्नतः ॥ 119 ॥
2.2.m:
In this way, with the mantras 'bhūḥ' and others, each distinct and appropriate to itself,
and having established [them] in their respective quarters, one should worship them diligently.

2.2.s:
pūrvabhāge puṣkariṇyāṃ haritābhaṃ savajrakam ..
halagrahīta maṃtreṇa nyasya lājāhutiṃ kule .. 2.2.20.120 ..
2.2.d:
पूर्वभागे पुष्करिण्यां हरिताभं सवज्रकम् ॥
हलग्रहीत मंत्रेण न्यस्य लाजाहुतिं कुले ॥ 2.2.20.120 ॥
2.2.m:
In the eastern part of the pond, one of emerald hue with a diamond
should be laid down with the mantra 'halagrahīta', offering fried grain into the water;

2.2.s:
trātāramiti maṃtreṇa agnau vinyasya mauktikam ..
manaḥśilāṃ pravālaṃ ca agnimīḍeti saṃpaṭhet ..121..
2.2.d:
त्रातारमिति मंत्रेण अग्नौ विन्यस्य मौक्तिकम् ॥
मनःशिलां प्रवालं च अग्निमीडेति संपठेत् ॥121॥
2.2.m:
In the south-east, placing a pearl with the mantra 'trātāram',
as well as realgar and coral, one should recite 'agnim īḷe';

2.2.s:
vaiśvānareṇa mantreṇa paṭhallām̐jāhutiṃ punaḥ ..
dadyādye te śatamantreṇa paścime kāṭikaṃ nyaset ..122..
2.2.d:
वैश्वानरेण मन्त्रेण पठल्लाम्̐जाहुतिं पुनः ॥
दद्याद्ये ते शतमन्त्रेण पश्चिमे काटिकं न्यसेत् ॥122॥
2.2.m:
Reciting the Vaiśvānara mantra, one should again make an offering of fried grain.
With the mantra 'ye te śatam', one should deposit glass in the west,

2.2.s:
śālibījena sahitaṃ kayā na iti maṃtrakam ..
varuṇasyo iti maṃtreṇa dadyādaṣṭādaśāhutīḥ ..123..
2.2.d:
शालिबीजेन सहितं कया न इति मंत्रकम् ॥
वरुणस्यो इति मंत्रेण दद्यादष्टादशाहुतीः ॥123॥
2.2.m:
Together with grains of śāli rice, [reciting] the mantra 'kayā naḥ'.
With the mantra 'varuṇasya', one should offer eighteen oblations;

2.2.s:
uttare rocanāṃ kanyāṃ tathaiva gaurasarṣapam ..
kuṃkumena samāyuktaṃ kuvidaṃḍamṛcā paṭhan .. 124 ..
2.2.d:
उत्तरे रोचनां कन्यां तथैव गौरसर्षपम् ॥
कुंकुमेन समायुक्तं कुविदंडमृचा पठन् ॥ 124 ॥
2.2.m:
In the north, [one should deposit] yellow orpiment, priyaṅgu, and likewise white mustard,
together with saffron, while reciting the verse 'kuvidaṅgam';

2.2.s:
vinyasya tena maṃtreṇa pradadyādāhutiṃ punaḥ ..
aiśānyāṃ maṃdrakaṃ raṃgamī śāvā iti saṃpaṭhan .. 125 ..
2.2.d:
विन्यस्य तेन मंत्रेण प्रदद्यादाहुतिं पुनः ॥
ऐशान्यां मंद्रकं रंगमी शावा इति संपठन् ॥ 125 ॥
2.2.m:
Having deposited [them] with that mantra, one should offer an oblation again.
In the north-east, reciting 'īśāvāsyam', [one should deposit] coral and tin;

2.2.s:
saṃsthāpyājyāhutiṃ dadyāttamīśāna ṛcā punaḥ..
āsadyairmaṃtrasaṃyuktairdevaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ yajet .. 126 ..
2.2.d:
संस्थाप्याज्याहुतिं दद्यात्तमीशान ऋचा पुनः॥
आसद्यैर्मंत्रसंयुक्तैर्देवं नारायणं यजेत् ॥ 126 ॥
2.2.m:
Having installed it, one should offer an oblation of clarified butter with the verse 'tam īśānam'.
With mantras beginning with 'āsadya', one should worship Lord Nārāyaṇa;

2.2.s:
varuṇātmakaṃ tato dhyātvā tato nīrājanaṃ paṭhet ..
jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā paṭhejjñānāmṛtaṃ stavam .. 127 ..
2.2.d:
वरुणात्मकं ततो ध्यात्वा ततो नीराजनं पठेत् ॥
जानुभ्यामवनिं गत्वा पठेज्ज्ञानामृतं स्तवम् ॥ 127 ॥
2.2.m:
Then, having meditated upon him as identical with Varuṇa, one should recite the lustration rite.
Touching the earth with one's knees, one should recite the hymn 'Jñānāmṛta'.

2.2.s:
dharmo vaṃśaṃ tataḥ kuryādutsargāṃte vidhīyate ..
tato devīṃ punaḥ kṛtvā dattvā puṣpāñjalitrayam .. 128 ..
2.2.d:
धर्मो वंशं ततः कुर्यादुत्सर्गांते विधीयते ॥
ततो देवीं पुनः कृत्वा दत्त्वा पुष्पाञ्जलित्रयम् ॥ 128 ॥
2.2.m:
Then one should perform the continuity of virtue; it is prescribed at the conclusion of the dedication.
Then, fashioning the goddess anew and offering three handfuls of flowers,

2.2.s:
sarvasattvopakārāya samutsṛjettu vai janam ..
utsṛṣṭaṃ sarvasattvebhyo dṛśyate jalamūrjitam .. 129 ...
2.2.d:
सर्वसत्त्वोपकाराय समुत्सृजेत्तु वै जनम् ॥
उत्सृष्टं सर्वसत्त्वेभ्यो दृश्यते जलमूर्जितम् ॥ 129 ॥।
2.2.m:
One should dedicate [the water] for the benefit of all living beings, O people:
'Dedicated to all living beings, let the water be seen abundant,

2.2.s:
ramaṃtīṃ sarvabhūtāni snānapānāvagāhanaiḥ ..
varuṇaṃ ca tato devaṃ puṣkariṇyāṃ ca nikṣipet .. 2.2.20.130 ..
2.2.d:
रमंतीं सर्वभूतानि स्नानपानावगाहनैः ॥
वरुणं च ततो देवं पुष्करिण्यां च निक्षिपेत् ॥ 2.2.20.130 ॥
2.2.m:
Delighting all creatures through bathing, drinking, and plunging.'
Then one should release the god Varuṇa into the pond,

2.2.s:
jale varuṇamantreṇa matsyādīnprakṣipettataḥ ..
pakṣiṇaśca śubhāṃstatra bhekaṃ kūrmaṃ ca kardamam ..131..
2.2.d:
जले वरुणमन्त्रेण मत्स्यादीन्प्रक्षिपेत्ततः ॥
पक्षिणश्च शुभांस्तत्र भेकं कूर्मं च कर्दमम् ॥131॥
2.2.m:
And then, with the Varuṇa mantra, release fish and other [aquatic creatures] into the water,
and auspicious birds there, a frog, a turtle, and mud,

2.2.s:
śaivālaṃ prakṣipeccaiva dakṣiṇāṃ tadanaṃtaram ..
suvarṇaṃ dhānyaratnaṃ ca ācāryāya pṛthagdadet..132..
2.2.d:
शैवालं प्रक्षिपेच्चैव दक्षिणां तदनंतरम् ॥
सुवर्णं धान्यरत्नं च आचार्याय पृथग्ददेत्॥132॥
2.2.m:
And one should also toss in moss. Immediately after that, [one should offer] the priestly gift;
one should present gold, grain, and jewels separately to the preceptor;

2.2.s:
ṛtvigbhyaśca pṛthagdadyādyathāvittānusārataḥ ..
brāhmaṇebhyo gāyanebhyo vasubhyaśca pṛthakpṛthak .. 133 ..
2.2.d:
ऋत्विग्भ्यश्च पृथग्दद्याद्यथावित्तानुसारतः ॥
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो गायनेभ्यो वसुभ्यश्च पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 133 ॥
2.2.m:
And one should give to the officiating priests separately according to one's wealth,
[and] separately to the brahmins, singers, and assistants.

2.2.s:
nityaṃ samāpya vidhivaddadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ punaḥ ..
dadyādarghyaṃ ca sūryāya hastāsa iti saṃjapan .. 134 ..
2.2.d:
नित्यं समाप्य विधिवद्दद्यात्पूर्णाहुतिं पुनः ॥
दद्यादर्घ्यं च सूर्याय हस्तास इति संजपन् ॥ 134 ॥
2.2.m:
Having completed the daily rites according to rule, one should again offer the final oblation,
and offer arghya to the sun while muttering 'hastāsaḥ'.

2.2.s:
tataḥ pradakṣiṇāvartaṃ saṃveṣṭya kṣīradhārayā ..
prāsādapakṣe prāsādamārāme atha maṃḍapam ..135..
2.2.d:
ततः प्रदक्षिणावर्तं संवेष्ट्य क्षीरधारया ॥
प्रासादपक्षे प्रासादमारामे अथ मंडपम् ॥135॥
2.2.m:
Then, encircling with a stream of milk in a clockwise direction—
in the case of a temple, the temple, or in a garden, the pavilion—

2.2.s:
śatādhidhārayā śaktyā trivāraṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha ..
vikīrya lājakusumaṃ vrīhīścaiva kapardakān .. 136 ..
2.2.d:
शताधिधारया शक्त्या त्रिवारं ब्राह्मणैः सह ॥
विकीर्य लाजकुसुमं व्रीहीश्चैव कपर्दकान् ॥ 136 ॥
2.2.m:
With a stream poured through a hundred holes or according to capacity, three times together with brahmins,
scattering parched grain, flowers, paddy, and cowries,

2.2.s:
tūryaghoṣeṇa mahatā tato viprapuraḥsaram ..
yajamānaḥ sapatnīkaḥ praviśetsvagṛhaṃ punaḥ .. 137 ..
2.2.d:
तूर्यघोषेण महता ततो विप्रपुरःसरम् ॥
यजमानः सपत्नीकः प्रविशेत्स्वगृहं पुनः ॥ 137 ॥
2.2.m:
To the great sound of musical instruments, preceded then by brahmins,
the sacrificer along with his wife should enter his home again.

2.2.s:
tato gṛhārcanaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇānatha bhojayet ..
kumārīśca kumārāṃśca dīnāndhakṛpaṇānapi ..138..
2.2.d:
ततो गृहार्चनं कृत्वा ब्राह्मणानथ भोजयेत् ॥
कुमारीश्च कुमारांश्च दीनान्धकृपणानपि ॥138॥
2.2.m:
Then, having performed the domestic worship, he should feed the brahmins,
as well as young girls, boys, the destitute, the blind, and the miserable.

2.2.s:
nārāyaṇaṃ tato dadyādvipramuddiśya bhaktitaḥ .. 139 .. ..
viṣayānukramaṇikā
2.2.d:
नारायणं ततो दद्याद्विप्रमुद्दिश्य भक्तितः ॥ 139 ॥ ॥
विषयानुक्रमणिका
2.2.m:
Then, with devotion, he should give Nārāyaṇa [as a gift] directed to a brahmin.

2.2.m:
1. 208: Description of drawing the maṇḍala with regard to ritual action, 21 verses.
2. 209: Description of the methods of constructing various maṇḍalas such as Krauñcaghrāṇa and others, 110 verses.
3. 211: Description of the standard value of the sacrificial fee and the like according to particular rites, preceded by a description of the defect in performing a rite without a sacrificial fee, 40 verses.
4. 212: Description of the standard value of the sacrificial fee and the like according to particular materials and rites, preceded by a description of the measure of the full-vessel, 45 verses.
5. 212: Description of the method of making and establishing the water jar and other implements with regard to ritual action, 26 verses.
6. 213: Description of the determination of the characteristics and natures of the four kinds of months for their utility in rites based on months, 56 verses.
7. 214: Description of the division of time with regard to rites for gods and ancestors, and description of the determination of lunar days in particular rites, 60 verses.
8. 215: Description of the fruits of rites performed on particular lunar days beginning with the first day and ending with the new moon in particular months, 137 verses.
9. 218: Description of the lineages of gotras and pravaras, 23 verses.
10. 218: Description of the procedure for the Vāstu sacrifice preceded by the offering circle, 112 verses.
11–12. 221: Description of the mantras, meters, sages, and deities, preceded by the description of the meditation on each deity, in the sequence of worshipping the deities of the site, 164 verses.
13. 224: Description of the procedure for offering arghya to deities, 31 verses.
14. 224: Description of the fire-ritual procedure as taught in one's own Gṛhyasūtra, 84 verses.
15. 226: Description of the rule for Kuśakaṇḍikā and the sthālīpāka offering in the fire ritual, 21 verses.
16. 226: Description of the meditation on the tongues of fire, 9 verses.
17. 227: Description of the duties to be performed on the day preceding the consecration, 31 verses.
18. 227: Description of the appointment of brahmins employed in the sacrificial rite, 48 verses.
19. 228: Description of the consecration procedure, preceded by the determination of the proper time for consecration, 19 verses.
20. 229: Description of the manner of worshipping the deities in the consecration of a house-site, 297 verses.
21. 235: Description of the procedure for the consecration of a house-site according to the intermediate mode, 138 verses.
(Thus ends the second part.)
